messages.content: I'm a neat freak and my house has to stay clean and in place always such a pet peeve of mines.
Do you have OCD?
Very bad and when my family has the house out of place I become so furious I just like things clean and in order.
I just love when the house is clean, makes you feel good.
When I was a child I was in a destructive tornado.
Oh my goodness! Did you get hurt?
No luckily my family was safe. Two girls down the street got killed.
That's so sad. Did your house get damaged?
I am afraid of growing up, I am just now an "adult" but not ready to fend for myself yet
How old are you?
I had a bad feeling when I was walking out of my calculus final.
Why what happened? Hopefully nothing bad.
I just felt like I barely did bad enough to not get a B in the class and that's what happened.
Don't worry, I'm sure you did fine.
I went to a fancy art showing at a gallery last night.
Wow, that sounds fun. What type of artwork did you see?
I went to a concert by myself because all my friends were too busy doing other things.
Aww That's too bad that no one else could go. What concert was it?
A few weeks ago a lady at my job got a promotion I thought I was going to get.
Oh no! I am so sorry. That is really tough.
It was really a tough one to swallow.
Did you get any feedback on what you could do to improve your chances next time?
My mom said I had to get rid of our family dog because she was allergic. I cried for a week it was unbearable, I resented her.
Oh no that is so sad to hear! I have one dog and two cats, so I totally understand what you are going through...
My dog's name was Cookie.
Aww what a cute name. Hopefully you an your Mom made up, and maybe you got/can get another pet.
I had a terrible experience at the grocery store today.
Oh no what happened, are you alright?
Yeah, I'm alright. But I dropped a jar of pasta sauce and it ended up shattering. Sauce got all over the floor.
Oh no that must have been a terrible experience, I hope no one got hurt from the shattered glass.
It can be hard to wake up sometimes when you live alone.
I can imagine that. I've never lived alone before.
That is disgusting! What can you do about about it?
I'm not sure. What would you do?
My wife just confessed that she cheated, I'm irritated at her behaviour. Totally dissapointed
I'm sorry to hear about that. I hope you both can find a way to work things out with each other.
There is no fixing buddy, in my religion once a woman cheats she is not desirable anymore
Oh, that's too bad. We'll then I hope you can find happiness again in the future. Good luck to you!
I can't get myself to sell my grandpa's old Cadillac.
Feeling sentimental much?
I had a car accident. I can't walk anymore.
I'm so sorry. That is horrific.

One day I was coming back home and I saw a tiny little kitten under the stair. I brought him home. He couldn't even walk yet! I got some kitten formula and I fed him and took care of him and now he grew up into a very awesome cat!
Do you still have the cat?
Facebook showed me the old pic from 9 years ago! Hard to believe so much time passed. It made me a bit sad in remembering my cats who have passed. It was a pic of my cat.
Aww, how cute. Do you miss playing with your cat?
NO. I just miss her and many of them.
It's alright. Your cat is somewhere up in heaven.
I was on facebook and my memories popped up reminding me that I lost my dog to bone cancer three years ago.
Oh no, I'm sure that was a hard memory to have brought up for you.
It was, she was a very special dog. One of the old souls with a heart of gold. I still miss her.
What was her name? Have you read Rainbow Bridge?
Yes, It is a beautiful poem! Her name was Skyber.
What a beautiful name! Hopefully your memories are more happy than sad now.
My boyfriend is sick. He can't eat much so I made some soup for him
You're sweet, what kind of soup did you make him?
I made chicken noodle soup.
I love chicken noodle, he must be so grateful.
I found out my daughter doesn't even attend her college classes anymore.
Oh wow, are you paying for her classes?
A friend of mine died Thursday and I hadn't called her in about in a month
That's terrible! I'm really sorry to hear that, but even if you could have said something it doesn't just make it better.
I couldn't be around her much because she on pills really bad.
Is that what happened to her? My mother was like that as We'll. It's terrible to watch somebody you loved turn into someone else because of an addiction.
I still remember the dat when my dad got me an xbox for christmas.
Yeah - how old were you?
I was 18. I was so joyful the whole day just played xbox with my brother.
What game did you have?
I just love halloween. This is going to be the best one yet.
You sound excited? Do you do it up big?
I I do themes with me and my kids. We were all comic book villains last year
What are you going to do this year?
I recently bought a new car after not driving for several years and I was really scared to drive it, especially on the highway.
What car did you buy?
Just a Honda Civic. People drive crazy around here. I don't want to have another car accident like the last one.
Jeez. Where do you live? I don't remember any state I've been to with bad drivers.
I'm going on vacation in 3 hours! Super stoked!
Cool! Where are you going?
I put lipstick on before going into the grocery store the other day and when I got back in my car, I looked in the rear view mirror and my teeth were that bright red color. It looked horrible.
Did you notice any funny glances from anyone?
I'm looking forward to my best friend's surprise birthday party next week!
That sounds like so much fun! I love parties!
It is really hard going to the hospital to visit my grandmother
I bet it is! When my grandma was alive it was so heartbreaking to see her in pain. She broke her hip right before her death and she just couldn't recover
Yeah it is the worst having someone in the hospital
I hope she will recover soon. Stay strong and think positive
I went camping the other week, and it was so nice to not worry about everything like I normally do
Oh I love camping. Was it relaxing? Sometimes camping can be work.
It was very relaxing. Camping can be work, but once you set things up it should be effortless. I really needed it
I'm glad.. It seems like we both are getting the vacations we need!
I trusted my brother would pay back the loan I gave him
Sometimes it can get tricky when family and money are involved. Did he pay you back?
One day a homeless man came up to my car and asked me to roll down my window.
I never know what to do in that situation.
One time I saw poop smeared all over the public restroom
Oh my! I bet you was so disgusted that you ran out of there.
A new skating rink is being built. Should be done in time for Winter skating
That's pretty nice! I haven't been skating in a coon's age. Is the rink nice?
The other day I ate an entire pizza. I felt so bad
What size pizza was it? If it was a large, I am not sure how you didn't get sick.

I've been quite upset with my daughter's school as they've really let her down. To make a long story short. Since she's now the only surviving 8th grade strings student (violin), they've lumped her in with the regular band this year rather than let her play with the 7th grade strings class.
I would be upset too! Why would they do that? Did you try talking to teachers or principal?
I am so nervous. I have a big presentation coming up at work.
I'm sure you'll do fine if you practice enough!
I feel prepared but it is my first presenting data in front of management. My nerves are real bad. I just want to get it over with.
Understandably so, I get nervous during presentations too. Take some deep breaths and you'll pull through!
When I went home, my dog didn't recognize me anymore
Oh my goodness that is horrible. How come it didn't recognize you?
It had been a couple years, I lived apart from my parents for a long time
Awww that is so sad. I hope it recognizes you after some time together.
I find queuing at the supermarket very frustrating
I do as We'll, how long does it take you to do it?
Not really very long, but it's the other people who annoy me!
That makes sense, but I guess everyone needs food!
When I was in middle school, some mean girls played a really nasty trick on me.
Oh no! I hope it wasn't something that caused you real distress.
It actually was. They pretended that I had a secret admirer, sending me notes and putting stuff in my locker. I was mortified when they admitted it was them in front of the whole class.
OMG! Bless your heart. I hope they feel guilty now knowing what they did to you.
My son counted all the way to thirty today
Wow that's great! How old is he?
He is 3 but he doesn't talk much. He always stopped at ten but today he went all the way
That's wonderful to see that kind of progress. You must be very proud.
I stole from my wife.
Oh no, what did you steal?
I stole 1000 bucks from her
That is not right. Do you feel bad?
In July, I found a large moth inside a cottage that my brother and friends were staying at.
Oh fun! How big was it about? Did it have neat markings on it?
I was happy to get invited on a trip for next week
Oh that's awesome! Where you going?
South padre island in texas
Cool! I've never been there. Are you excited to go?
I applied for my dream job but I never got a call back.
Oh that's bad. I feel sorry for you.
My new manager gave me a pay-rise!
That's got to be an amazing feeling to have going for you. How do you feel?
I feel very grateful that he has been so generous.
It's going to help your family out so much I bet everyone is so proud of you, congrats you deserve it.
Hi, I promised myself I would never drink again but I drank yesterday.
It is a interesting and relaxing way to end a evening. I've been there before.
IT's almost time for schoo to start back!
I know! I'm going school shopping tomorrow. Its tax free weekend!
Me too! I love saving money
No kidding. Plus I'm buying for two so double the cost this year.
I made kimchi and it turned out pretty bad.
What I that?!?! I think I've heard the name before maybe.
It's fermented napa cabbage, a Korean dish.
I see, What happened? Bad recipe?
My fiance works as a technician installing internet at peoples homes, and they are always tipping him. Often with food and it makes me nervous sometimes.
I'm sorry about that. Don't be nervous though. He is a loyal person I bet

I mean he won't let me eat anything people give him but I wish he would just toss stuff, you never know what kind of people are out there. Especially if they are upset with the company he is working for.
What is the name of the company?
I was ecstatic when my son took his first steps
That is a huge moment in a kid's life! I would be too, congratulations
My son got brought home by the police last week for spray painting an abandoned building. I was furious with him!
You must've been really disappointed in him. Did you talk to him and find out why he did it?
My roommate's cat passed away last week. There is a heavy air over the household.
I bet. That is so sad. I am so sorry.
Yeah He's really lost without her. It was unexpected.
I bet! I hope they can find peace soon.
My neighbor keeps parking his car in front of my house instead of his own and it obstruct my view of the park in front of my house. Man, it bothers me so much!
Ugh that is so annoying! Have you confronted him about it yet?
Yes! He just doesn't care though since it is technically a valid parking spot.
Wow what a jerk...Sorry you have to deal with that. I hope you can resolve that situation somehow.
I went to my daughter's awards ceremony at school recently.
How was that experience for you
It was really wonderful seeing her go up for so many awards.
You must have been proud. But she wouldn't be there if you didn't persistently push her to do her best
Hey dude. I feel so grossed out right now.
Do I even wanna hear it? Okay tell me... What happened? :o

You do..... I was very hungry last night so I reached for some chocolate on my table. As I was wrapping themI was so excited!!!! We'll, I put them in my mouth and immediately realized they had ants in them!
So you had chocolate covered ants! I bet That's pricey somewhere in another country! Ha ha
My neighbor woke me up this weekend mowing his lawn at 5am.
That sounds really frustrating! Who mows their lawn that early holy cow!
I have no idea. I was pissed because I went to ask him to stop and he just ignored me.
Wow I would be mad to.
I was dating someone else when I met the man who is now my husband. I thought he was just going to be a friend, but I eventually developed feelings for him.
Wow. Did the other person know what was going on?
He didn't, but when I broke up with him I let him know. I never acted on my feelings until we were broken up.
We'll that's good. Sounds like it all worked out pretty We'll.
My buddy ate my leftovers after I asked him not to
How rude! Are you two roommates?
Yes! I was so hungry and went to the fridge to discover that it was all missing
What was it that he ate?
There is nothing I hate more than losing in something
Yeah, that's never fun. Did you lose at something recently?
I had to clean out my son's closet yesterday. I found a box of old newborn sized clothes, some I had forgotten about and it totally sent me down memory lane.
That sounds like a mixed bag of emotions.

Oh yeah it made me want a new baby haha. It's definitely bittersweet watching babies grow up, it's so exciting to see them learning and growing but at the same time it passes so fast and you miss that little fresh baby.
Exactly what I was thinking. Better cherish the time that you have with him until he goes off to college, but know that he'll always appreciate you.
I was scared the other night when I heard several gunshots in a row.
Oh wow, I hope you are fine!
I am. I am in a very dangerous neighborhood so you just never know if it's going to get you and the police don't show up.
Yikes. If I was you, I would get my own gun! Better to have it and not need it, then have not have it then need it!
I was crushed when I didn't get approved for a day off last week
I'm sorry to hear that! Is it that busy at work?
I am so nervous. I have a big presentation coming up at work.
I'm sure you'll do fine if you practice enough!
So I get bogus mail all the time including fake checks and all that jazz. Anyway, I thought one I got the other day was bogus too and left it on my counter.
Why would you always get fake checks? That would drive me crazy.
I had a chance to make some money, but my phone screwed up
That's terrible... Have you gotten a new phone yet?
My daughter told me I should be expecting a shipment soon. I don't know what it could be!
Oh, I love surprises like that! How exciting!
After a gym workout I'm always ready to get back and hit a new PR
That's great! What motivates you?
People used to be way more sociable.
They did. I've struggled with trying to be more social, I think it makes life more fun.
People are face to face anymore. Its kind of sad
It really is. Wonder how we can go about changing things.
I usually don't feel the greatest because of health problems.
What kind of health problems ?
I'm moving to New York city soon due to a new job and I can't wait! I plan on going sight seeing for the first few days of arriving.
Holy cow that's amazing!! Do you think you'll like this new job?
So I have a vacation coming up in a few months.
Oh yeah? Are you excited?
Quite. I've been planning it for months now.
That's great. I hope you have a wonderful time.
I was beaming when my daughter scored the winning goal for her soccer game. She trains so hard and really deserves the praise.
Aw, That's awesome. The training paid off and I bet she feels really proud!
Yeah I have a minivan with bumper stickers boasting of all her accomplishments. I am her #1 fan!
Haha, I bet, when she becomes a pro you can say you've been her fan since day one!
I feel happy about the new house I have and that I can work from home. Thanks be to God
Congratulations! I hope to get a house next year
It took me 9 months of determination and sacrifice. But worth it.
I bet! Hard work pays off
I've been waiting for a story to finish, but the author passed away
Oh no! Which author is it? That really stinks when you can't finish a story. An eternal cliff-hanger.
Yea, now I try to read completed works lol.
That's a good idea. I know everyone is worried about that when it comes to George RR Martin and game of thrones.
Last week my wife and I almost walked into a store where a shooting had taken place.
What?? That is so scary! I'm glad you are safe. That's why I always have my gun with me
It was definitely scary. I carry as We'll, but not on that day. I'm glad we were okay.
It sucks that some places don't allow conceal carry! Like malls and some other places and that's exactly where those shootings happen
I haven't seen my grandma in 5 years. I'm so excited she's coming to visit.
Good for you. I loved spending time with my grandma!
I totally made a fool of myself at Walmart the other day, I was wearing a white outfit and there was a very attractive man in front of me and I tripped and fell.
Haha! Poor you. Did you wreck your clothes?
Yep, I had a massive brown stain on my white shirt, and of course my coffee is hot so it is burning me slightly, I just got up and walked back to my car
I hope you didn't get burned too badly! I fall a lot. It never stops being embarrassing.
I was so happy last week when it was fridaaay!
I agree, I love Fridays, Did you have any plans?
I've owned 3 birds in the past 10 years and my 3rd bird just died last night. I didn't realize how much it would crush me. They were my buddies.

There's absolutely nothing I can say to make you feel better about that. I'm sorry for your great losses. Just from those few sentences alone, I can tell you were very passionate about them. What were their names, if you don't mind me asking?
Last week was my birthday. I thought everyone forgot about it because no one wished me a happy birthday at work.
Oh, that's awful. Did you mention it to anyone?
No but in the afternoon I noticed everyone was disappearing. Then all of a sudden I heard them singing Happy Birthday to me. I was so surprised!
Yay! So they threw you a surprise party! That's awesome. You must have been so happy. Was there cake?
I didn't pay my taxes this year.
On NO. Did you get a letter from the IRS?
I was with my family over the weekend, and I started feeling happy and a little teary eyed about our time together.
Do you not see them much?
No, it's tough because of the distance between where we live. So I try to treasure those moments we have.
I can relate. I last seen my mom around 8 years ago and my dad around 10 years ago. Maybe you should move closer to them.
I was checking the paper this morning, and I found our that I won $200 on the lottery!
Wow. Congratulations. What did you do with the $200?
I am so afraid... Afraid that I am not giving too much to the world, what if I parish not having done anything?
I wouldn't worry too much about it. None of it really matters, if we make a difference or not, we all end up dust in the end.
I was cleaning up and found some old photographs of myself as a child today.
Oh cool. I love looking through my old photos. Makes me feel warm and fuzzy.
I've finally finished writing the book that I've been working on for the last few months.
Great. Are you going to get it published?
Definitely! I'm pretty happy with this one, can't wait to get it published.
What is the book about?
I feel horrible. I cheated on my husband last night.
You continues a series on Netflix I hope and not the other thing
I knocked over a clothing display on the sidewalk outside of a boutique the other day when I was riding my bike. I should have gone back to pick it up but kept going.
I've done the same thing before. I'm sure you weren't a bother
I hope not. Now that you mention it I'm sure it happens all the time.
Yeah and they really should be better about how they place their racks
My dog has to have her teeth cleaned on Wednesday and I am really nervous b/c she got super sick last time afterwards
That's strange, I hope she makes it out ok this time though.
She is super tiny and they said with small dogs the stress of the procedure will give them stomach issues sometimes. I wouldn't even do it except she has an abcess
Oh wow, I would never consider something like that hurting a dog.
I am in the process of potty training my daughter, but when we go somewhere she still wears a diaper. The other day, we were at church and she took her diaper off in the middle of the service.
I remember those potty training days!!! I bet you were so embarrassed.
It was not one of our best moments. Luckily, she was wearing and long dress and I had extra diapers so we could remedy the situation.
THank goodness you had extra supplies on hand. My son was the hardest one out of my 3 kids to potty train. I feel your pain!!
In one of my classes at school someone was making fun of me.
That's terrible! Did you confront them about it?
I am depressed most of the time. I'm going to therapy and taking meds. I feel like I'm broken
Oh I'm sorry that you are going through that. Have you discussed changing your medication up with your doctor?
Thank you so much, nothing happened to us thankfully my oil pan was broken though
We'll that's nothing compared to what could have happened.
So proud of my friend for making the hockey team.
That is amazing, what level is the team?
So, last night I was enjoying myself watching a movie. I ordered pizza and it didn't come on time. It was an hour late!
I bet you were starving! Did they say why they were so late?
My aunt paid for college my first year. It was so nice of her
She must have a golden heart
She really did
I hope you have showered her with gifts and appreciation, she deserves it
A friend of mine just got a new wrangler, I want one bad
I've been wanting a jeep for myself too! They are so cool
I've been waiting to hear back from a job interview I feel went quite We'll.
How long do you have to wait?
A few days I think
Good luck! I'm sure you did great.
We have built our relationship over the years , we don't keep secrets
Ok and how does that work
A co-worker has been flirting with me at work. I turned her down though since I have a girlfriend
She is a crappy person, flirting with someone who is in a relationship. Good on you- stand up guy
I go to church every sunday.
That's nice. Have you always done that?
I really don't want to sell my old Cadillac. But I need the money.
That sucks. I hope you won't be out of transportation
We went to the lagoon a few weeks ago. My friends dared me to jump off of the highest cliff into the water.
Oh wow. Terrifying. All I think of is Johnny Erricson Tada, who broke her neck in that situation. Did you do it?
That was what I was worried about! I ended up not jumping off of the highest one. I was too scared. I did jump off of the smallest one. That was really fun!
You did the right thing! Oh fun! I'm glad you were safe and had a blast!
I felt a bit sad last week when I saw an elderly man drop his wallet and a kid picked it up and didn't give it back to the man
That's terrible. Were you able to identify the kid?
I stepped in some dog poop walking in my neighborhood the other day.
That's disgusting, I would have a very hard time finishing that walk. Did you go straight home?
I have my high school reunion this weekend and I'm really stoked for it
That sounds exciting! Will you be meeting your old friends there?
Waiting for pizza to come. I ordered extra of everything.
Ohhhh yum! What are your favorite toppings?
Olives! And all the vegetables.
That's what I get too! I also get vegan cheese...Its delish! Hope you have a great time chowing down tonight!
Ok... So I am feeling great about the decisions I made.
What did you decide on?
One night, I was home alone, when suddenly, I heard a loud BANG!
Oh goodness, what was it?
It was a ghost! I ran into the kitchen to investigate, and I saw what looked like a white dress flapping out the window.
Wow, that must have been a terrible experience.
I got a tip at work yeserday.
Yeah? How big was the tip?
A dollar, but it was nice cause I'm not supposed to accept them unless they say its a gift.
That's cool. I never understood why places won't allow their workers to take tips... What business is it of the employer if you get money? Anyways, what kind of place do you work?
I was surprised by the weather this morning. I was not expecting sunny
What were you expecting?
My girlfriend broke up with me yesterday. This place is so quiet without her
I'm sorry to hear that. You should have some friends over. Throw a party and catch up on old times.
You know, that's a good idea.
Yeah, it's always good to hang out with friends. That cheers me up when I'm down.
I am going to eat some BBQ later.
That sounds so good and the perfect way to spend a Sunday.
Yes it is! I am so happy for it!
Are you going to a restaurant or making it yourself?

My mom's restaurant pics on Facebook give me a mixed feeling of nostalgia, guilt, and fond memories. My brother and I are usually part of their weekend restaurant excursions but we are both out of state doing our own thing
Oh man, do you miss it? How about your brother?
I miss my family, not so much the Midwest weather they have to deal with lol...It's freezing up there
Oh yeah that's way too cold! I'm sorry you feel a bit homesick. Remember you are away because you are bettering yourself
I was so prepared for the track meet. I spent the previous 4 years getting ready for it.
Wow that is a long time! How did you do?
I stubbed my toe this morning.
Oh no! I hope your toe is feeling better!
I made plans for my dream vacation. I had been looking forward to this trip for over two years. I broke my leg and was unable to make the trip
So sorry to hear that buddy.. Where were you planning to go?
Hawaii. I have wanted to go there for a very long time. Stupid leg.
Yeah, I can sense how you feel.. It is ok buddy, you will make it there soon enough
I remember when my grandma was sick and we the grandchildren took turns keeping her company and helping her with whatever she needed.
You guys sound like great grand kids, I bet she wholeheartedly appreciated it.
One day, I was to tired to mow the lawn.
I feel that way every day almost, Did you ever end up doing it?
No, my brother had to do it another even though we usually do it together.
What made you so tired??
I was mad when I saw my dog got out
I have heard that a lot today! How did yours get out
I am become so angry and bitter. My brother is having it all while I am at a spot without making any progress

That's really tough. I can imagine how frustrated you are. Just know that going through trials and struggling is always good for your character and you will end up that much better of a person for getting through it. You can't be too concerned with other's lives, you just have to try not to compare.
I can't wait until after work today I get to go pick up my new car.!
Oh, what kind is it?
I interned for a Physical Education class for third graders. I haven't been a third grader for a long time, so I was surprised how intelligent they are! They go through a lot of stuff, too.
That sounds awesome. I barely remember 3rd grade. I think we just played games and had fun.
I can't get my money under control and I am so angry with myself.
Do you have a lot of debt? I'm sure you will figure it out and get back on your feet.
I decided one day that I would adopt an animal at an animal shelter, and I picked up a dog.
Cute!!! What did you name it?
I named her Abby, it seemed to fit her and she learned it pretty quickly.
What kind of dog is she?
My brother made it to the local news paper last year, it shocked us all he was given a full scholar ship to a totally different state
Nice! Where is he going to school at?
I just had to move across country to a new job.
Wow, that must've been hard to uproot your whole life. Are you happy about the move?
I am actually! I was so ready for it. I basically studied moving so that everything would be easy
That's awesome! I've been wanting to do the same actually. I hope you have a fabulous time in your new place and new job!
My neighbors really look out for each other
That is good to hear. What happened that made you think so?
They always holding hands and smiling
Oh ok. That sounds like they really get along We'll. It is nice to have good neighbors.
Left my book bag outside overnight. I live in the south where there's lots of palmetto bugs (cockroaches). Went and got it this morning... It was filled with the things!
Oh yuck! Sounds like a disgusting experience.

Yeah. I just pretty much opened it, flipped out, closed it, then went and got a can of RAID that kills them, and opened it again and went to town! It was like I was possessed and raining bullets on them.
Haha that must have felt a bit satisfying at least. Glad you took care of them.
The local restuarant near us is closing. I thought business was good.
What is it called?
During the day today, I was in an Uber when it crashed. I'm just thankful no one was hurt!
Oh my! That is so scary. Thank goodness you are ok. Was it the Uber driver's fault?
It was both drivers faults. They should have both paid attention. It could have been worse though.
Absolutely. Knock on wood, I've still never been in a car crash. Make sure you go to the doctor if you have any pain over the next couple of days.
I have so many birds and cats coming to my yard. I'm going broke buying food for them.
I wish I could be broke doing something as cute. Seriously that's awesome in a way.
One morning, around 4 am, we woke our girls up and packed the up in the car and headed out of town, without telling them anything about where we were going.
That sounds like fun! Where did you guys end up going?
We ended up at Disney later that night - they were so very surprised.
That's awesome! I can't wait to take my daughters to disney
I have faith its going to be a good week. The weather will at least be nice
Yeah, summer is a great season, have you been on vacation at all?
I'm excited to have next week off from work. I'll have lots of time to relax and get things done!
Sounds great! Yes relaxing time is always needed and appreciated.
I'm so sick of my brother. He accused me of taking his money today
That is not cool at all. Why would he say that? Maybe he misplaced it.

messages.content: मुझे रात में सो नहीं आता, मन बहुत चलता रहता है।
रात को मन का चलना थकाने वाला होता है। क्या कोई ख़ास बात है जो आप सोने से पहले दोहराते हैं?
I am super pumped for the new super smash bros, it looks amazing!
It is amazing. For how long have you been playing this game?
Since Brawl, played a bit of Melee as a kid too
I played a lot of video games when I was kid. I liked that so much.
I was extremely emotional when my dog passed away
Aww man sorry for your loss, those are the worst, its like losing your best friend. I hope he passed away peacefully and happy.
It was actually rather tragic, but I'll spare you the details. He had a good life though. He was my dad's son lol
Aww shoot, I lost a dog when I was little in a very tragic way as We'll. I miss that big guy, he was like a brother to me. Hope You're doing good now, he's in a good place.
I was doing a presentation at work and in the middle of it my computer crashed! I couldn't believe it!
That awful! Were you able to continue without it? That must have really messed up your rhythm.
It did! And no I had to stop and restart because it was vital to my presentation.
Did it start back up? Glad you were able to start over.
So, I found this new recipe for mayonnaise lasagna. I'm making it tomorrow for all my fellow workers in the Nike sweatshop.
That sounds interesting, is it hard to make?
I am ready for my police test coming up!
That is exciting, what is the test for?
I have a stuffed animal that my old dog used to lay by/on as a pillow. My dog is dead but I still keep that stuffed animal to remind me of him
I am sorry your dog passed away, I totally understand wanting to keep a momento to remind you of him. Was he old when he passed?
He was about 12. He was my first dog though! He was a sweetheart. It is nice keeping something to remind me of him.
I'm glad you have something that helps keep his memory alive. :)
I felt so embarrassed yesterday.
Why, what happened to make you feel that
With all the catfishing going on these days I was shocked when my Tinder date turned out to be better looking in person.
I feel like since the show, catfishing has decreased a little bit. It's easy to determine when someone is using fake pictures.
My dog pooped in my wig today. I was so mad!
Oh no! How are you going to clean it out?
I have no idea! The worst part is that I found out when I was trying to take it off...That thing wouldn't budge! No wonder my co-workers were giving me disgusted looks.
Yikes! That must have been terrible
I interviewed for a job promotion today. I am pretty sure I nailed the interview.
Great! What kind of job is it?
I made the Dean's List this year
Wow, nice! Congratulations that. You must have worked hard.
I did, I worked really hard all year long and made lots of sacrifices
I hope it was all worth it for this moment. Good job!
My neighbors dog are barking so loud and my daughter is asleep!
Ugh that's so annoying. What are they even barking at?
People walking on the bike trail behind our house. It's a daily thing, it gets so annoying!
Yeah, that would drive me crazy. Sounds like the neighbor needs to control their dogs.
I never thought I would see something this gross ever!
Oh geez! What on earth was it!
I saw a guy pick a piece of chewed gum off the sidewalk and put it in his mouth.
That is FRIGGIN revolting!!! I would have lost my lunch right then and there!
I was feeling a little insecure so I decided to get a haircut and change my hair color a bit. I feel like a different person!
Wow. That is amazing, I love to change. What color did you choose?
I decided to get dirty blonde highlights, just to add some dimension to my hair. I feel so beautiful now!
Nice. I would like to do the same, but it is very expensive where I live. I hope I can afford it one day.
I'm going off to college soon and I'll be leaving the small town that I grew up in. It's a pretty tough thing to do, I really love this place and have a strong attachment to it.
Understandably so. You must be pretty anxious over the whole ordeal.
Did you ever attend college? I just completed my bachelor's degree and I'm feeling really good about my future!
Yes, I have an Associate's in Nursing.
My son is 17 and a high school junior.
Wow, so close to graduation! What does he want to do after he graduates?
I have a first state with a girl I don't know on friday. I haven't been on a date in a while.
Check out some vids on youtube. I'm sure you will be fine!
So last week when I was visiting my parents I took ride past my old high school. That brought back so many good memories.
I bet! Could you see yourself walking around?
We'll, the entrance looked like it was added on to but the football stadium was the exact same.
I bet that brought back a lot of memories!
My neighbors dog are barking so loud and my daughter is asleep!
Ugh that's so annoying. What are they even barking at?
I finally finished my PhD thesis. I have worked for 3 years on it!
Oh wow! Congrats, I know the process my husband did one. What is your on?
Around this time of the year, my husband usually always gets a large bonus, but it's not a promise. It's not easy waiting to see if he will!
How big is the bonus usually?
It all depends, but always has been thousands. So, the waiting drives us nuts!
Wow, We'll I hope you guys get it this year then!
I am going to do We'll at work next week, I have been working on a project
That's great. So you are confident in the progress of it?
Dealing with the passing of my mother-in-law was hard. My wife really struggled, I hope I did enough for her.
I'm really sorry to hear that. When did she pass away?
I lost my job last year and got really angry.
I am sorry to hear that. Did it happen out of the blue?
Yes, it was a complete surprise.
I am sorry to hear that. I hope it turned out to be a blessing in decise.
I had to do a presentation for school. I researched the subject and was certain that I had all my facts in order
What happened? Did you?
My stepdad passed away and my mother moved in with my sister.
Aww I'm sorry for your loss. How is your family holding up?
There is nothing I can complain about. I have a nice house, a great family and a decent job. Life is good.
Hey that's awesome! Any plans this weekend?
Not at the moment. I do count my blessings every day. I realize how fortunate everything has gone We'll for me.
Yeah that's good that You're keeping a level head about it. And realize that anything can happen at a moments notice. I tend to appreciate what I have in my life as We'll.
I'm a bit let down by my workplace recently
How come, what are you doing wrong at work?
We'll we had vacation we were promised, and I planned for, but then due to an emergency it all was cancelled.
I'm sorry to hear that, you must be so let down.
My friend bought me lunch today
That was nice. What did you have?
I had a nice burger and fries
That sounds good. I bet it was fun to hangout and eat with your friend.
I will be going on a once in a life time trip tomorrow.
Oh nice, where are you going?
I will be going on my first cruise.
Wow, I've never been on a cruise before. I think it sounds like a lot of fun
Left my book bag outside overnight. I live in the south where there's lots of palmetto bugs (cockroaches). Went and got it this morning... It was filled with the things!
Oh yuck! Sounds like a disgusting experience.
If I get a good pump at the gym early in the morning, I feel like I can tackle any task on my to-do list for the day
That's awesome. Do you usually exercise in the mornings?
My son got a scholarship into a university that I couldn't when I was his age, I'm happy
That's so awesome....... What uni is it?
My brother finally went to college!
Oh that's great news. I bet he is having lots of fun.
I found $80 while I was cleaning out my truck.
That is awesome, what will you spend it on?
Gonna put it in the bank. Saving up to buy a home.
Good for you, make sure you get the 20% down.
Reality TV really annoys me
I don't think you are alone there! What do you find so irritating about it?
We'll its supposed to be reality but seems so fake.
I know what you mean. All the people seem to be the same types - fame hungry narcissists
I yelled at my toddler earlier because he wasn't listening but I think I went a little overboard with it.
I bet it can be easy for that to happen in the spur the moment
It can be but I wish I handled it differently.
You'll have a shot at it again, I'm sure!
Went to the park alone yesterday. Feels bad, man.
How come it felt bad?
My son got into a fight with a bully.
That does not sounds good! Are you proud of him for standing up?
I am so happy he won!
I am glad for him. Bullies should not be allowed to behave badly towards others.
I stole alcohol from my dad and was caught and decided to lie instead of confessing. I'm ashamed.
Hey it's ok. We all do stupid things when we are young.
My dad just gave me his carbon fiber road bike since he got a new one! I never expected he would give it to me because I know its worth a lot!
Yeah They're great. Super light and rigid. They feel kind of springy when you ride them
I know! I love it! I would never have been able to afford it on my own! It wasn't even my birthday either!
Do you have clipless pedals on it?

quality_notes: Explicitly removes the requirement to have a problem.

messages.content: Not really a problem, I just wanted to talk for a bit.
That's completely fine, no problem needed. What's on your mind today?
Last week when I arrived at the office there was a puppy on the receptionist desk!
That's crazy. Where did it come from?
It turn out the receptionist wanted to give it in adoption and but it there for show, it was certainly really crazy to see a puppy standing there!
Strange the receptionist did that. I bet everyone wanted to pet the puppy!
So I applied for 200+ jobs and I can't believe I didn't hear from none of them!
Bummer!!! Are you looking for a work at home job or just an outside job?
I have a physics test tomorrow that I have been studying for non stop. I feel really good about it.
PHysics? I'm glad I never took that class.
A few years ago, my dog ate rat poisoning on accident and ended up dying.
Oh no that's terrible! I'm sorry you had to go through that. Pets are our family.
A few years ago my dog got into rat poisoning and ended up dying.
I'm sorry. I hope memories of your dog bring you comfort.
I'm looking forward to going home and relaxing on the couch.
Sounds wonderful! Nothing better than putting your feet up at the end of the day. Think you might watch some tv?
I was trying to explain to a friend why something is happening and they just couldn't get it. I don't get why they couldn't understand me.
Ohh, what did you try to explain them?
I was trying to explain to them why the Great Recession was caused by the recycling of petrodollars and an unrestrained financial market.
Ohh, sometimes people don't understand simple things. I think the words like 'petrodollars' might have confused them.
I was worried because the weather man said a hurricane was coming. So we got everything ready just in case.
It's better to be safe than sorry. You can't overprepare.
So true. Luckily it didn't get as bad as they thought so we didn't have to evauate.
I am glad you didn't get hit. I know how stressful hurricanes can be.
I'm being induced on Monday because I'll be at 41 weeks pregnant by then. This is my first baby and I'm so scared! Labor seems impossible!
You got this girl! I was induced when I had my daughter a year ago! I was scared too but honestly don't remember much.
Really? That's good to hear. I have been told so many different horror stories that its got me feeling nauseated and stressed!

Just enjoy and rest on your last weekend before baby, It'll all be worth in when you are holding your little girl :) Don't listen to those scary stories, those are the 1 in a million chances it goes wrong!
I returned home from school one afternoon to news that my dog was run over by a car.
I'm so sorry! You must've been so sad. Did you find out who did it?
I had a salad for lunch yesterday, then went shopping at the mall. When I got home around 7pm I discovered I had a HUGE piece of spinach between my front teeth!
Did you brush it right out?
I did. But dozen of people had already seen it. I was mortified. No one told me!
Maybe you could give them a call on the phone and tell them about your feelings?
I found a box of old photos in my closet yesterday.
Awh memories, what were they of?
A lot of them where photos of my sister and I when we were toddlers. It was a good trip down memory lane.
So cute, I love those memories I bet it was beautiful.
I provide for a family of 8. It's tiring but rewarding
Wow! The struggle is real. I hope You're not too tired and stressed. I wish you luck for being so selfless!
I love my wife alot, we had a set of twin 3 times in a row so the children are 6 plus myself and her all 8
Do twins run in your family or are you just lucky? I mean that seriously, not sarcastically
I got lucky :)
That's awesome! You won the kiddo lottery! I wish you all the best of health and happiness!!!
Once we were taking a drive and our dog got loose. He came home a few days later.
Oh, no! That must have been so scary!
Yes! You know your pets are like family! We were so relieved to see him home!
I'll bet you were. I'm so glad you had a happy ending!
I'm going to see a film tonight at the cinema.
Oh really? What movie?
I think it's called the Happytime Murders. Some murder mystery/comedy with puppets.
That sounds so fun ! Love murder and comedy, sounds like You're going to have a blast
We went to a friend's house the other day for dinner. I was helping her cook. I was following the directions of a recipe and accidentally cracked her baking dish.
Did you offer to replace the broken baking dish that you accidently broke?
Yes, I did, but she wouldn't even hear of it. She told me it was fine.
That sounds like a good friend, forgive and forget. She new you did not intend on breaking the baking dish.
I let my daughter, who just got her driver's license, take my brand new sports car to work today.
Oh, I bet you are nervous. I'm sure she will be okay but I would be so nervus

messages.content: मैंने कल ख़ुद को चोट पहुँचाई है।

यह सुनकर मुझे अच्छा लगा कि आपने बताया। क्या आप इस समय सुरक्षित हैं, और कहीं गहरा घाव तो नहीं है?

अगर गंभीर चोट है तो कृपया डॉक्टर से मिलें। और अगर आपको लगता है कि आप फिर से ख़ुद को नुक़सान पहुँचा सकते हैं, तो Tele-MANAS 14416 पर कॉल करें, या आपात स्थिति में 112. क्या आज कोई आपके साथ रह सकता है?
I am still goin to court for child support.

That must be incredibly annoying to have to deal with. To constantly have to battle for what you feel is justified support, and to always be worrying about it in the back of your head. You have to be really resilient to go through that.
Its been ten years and it doesn't even show up half of the time. I told the judge the last time I don't even want it anymore.

Wow.. That's almost noble. I hope You're able to still properly survive without it, especially since it's unfair that You're not getting it in the first place. I'm sorry You're being put in that position. One day I'm sure your children will recognize and appreciate you had to go through for them.
I have some great friends. One of them drove me to the airport tomorrow
That was really nice of them. I bet You're appreciative.
Went to my favorite restaurant, and They're closed for business.
I would have cried for multiple days!
I know. I'm still mourning.
Do you have a new place to eat?
Someone broke into my apartment last week. I was not home at the time, but now I worry that they will come back.
Wow, that's terrible. Was anything stolen or damaged?
Yes, my TV was stolen. They also clogged every toilet in my apartment. I think they have just eaten Thai food.
What a story, it's just unbelievable how these robbers have absolutely no morals.
I got to sit on my patio all weekend and read comics. It was calming
Oh, that does sound nice. What comics were you reading?
They batman and justice league
Oh cool. I like comics, but I'm not really a fan of Batman or Justice League.
I am so happy I was able to pass my teacher certification test and become an English teacher.
That's great. Teachers are so important.
It's such a fulfilling job. The test was difficult, but I spent a lot of my free time studying for it.
I wanted to become a teacher before. I was afraid of how hard it would be.
It's a lot of work, but if you really put in the effort, it becomes much easier.
We'll congratulations! I hope your students appreciate you as much as they should.
My daughter just had her first dance recital and remembered all the steps! It was great to watch!
That's so sweet! Always a special moment, how old is she?
I went to an EDM concert that had artists that I used to listen to. It was a blast from the past!
I have never heard of an EDM, what is that?
Electronic Dance Music. It's where all the hipster millennials gather to party and listen to trippy music haha
Lol- sounds like fun! Nothing better than nice hippies!
I remember the first time I went to the movie. It was with my friends and I was eager to go.
And what movie did you guys see
I think it was Toy Story. I felt strange looking at the big screen.
Wow that must have been a while back...Do you still keep in touch with these friends
I can't find my favorite handkerchief my grandfather gave me. I am fearful that I could have lost it.
That's a horrible feeling, especially something sentimental
It means so much to me because he is now passed away. I would be so upset if I can't find it.
I hope like crazy you find it!!
I recently began my own online business. I'm hopeful that my dried starfish kiosk will take off soon.
Wow, that sounds unique. What exactly do you sell?
My friend's dog died
Oh man I am so sorry. Had she had the dog for a long time?
She had him for over five years
That is so sad. My dog had congestive heart failure and died so I know how sad that can be
I have always been considerate of my relationship with my wife, I would never cheat
That's good to hear. How long have you been married?
15 years, its a struggle sometimes, but in the end it is worth it
That's great. Do you have any children?
Those dang neighborhood kids keep egging my car!
Do you have cameras?
I don't but it sucks cleaning my car off! It's gross and smells awful!
I know right? It's even more worse when it's hot outside and it cooks to your car so it's harder to clean up
I was happy to find that at work my coworker prepared a birthday party for me. I was not expecting it.
Wow. I bet that was a nice surprise. Did you get a lot of presents?
Yes. The most that we could garther together.
Sounds great. You are lucky to have such thoughtful coworkers.
I really do not want to go visit my Dad.
Why not?!! Is he mean to you?
No, he just makes me do a ton of yard work when I visit.
That is terrible, Yard work is mild torture.
I am in a good mood today. I think I might have found someone special.
Whoa... That's awesome. I love hearing that. Can you tell me about them?
I was a little on edge when I dropped my daughter off at a movie with her friend alone for the first time
What were you on edge about?
I just got a job interview!
You must be so happy? What was the job you got a interview for?
It's a nanny position watching two twin babies.
Is the nanny job close to where you live?
The results came in and I won the national debate championship with my team!

Hey, congratulations. That must have been a lot of hard work. I wish I put more time into extracurricular stuff like that. It's a good look in the future. Especially the debate team--you develop so many good life skills with that!
I agree, it was a proud moment for us! I had to sacrifice a lot of time and energy to be able to get here.
I bet... That's a lot of weekends and late evenings practicing and honing your skills. I'm sure it's a lot of positive intangibles developed that you will reap the awards from later on in life.
Last winter I went to the local pharmacy to get flu meds and threw up while waiting in line. I was mortified and ashamed.
Wow that is so terrible. But you must've been really I'll, I'm sure everyone understood.
I was just starting to feel bad and did not expect that to happen. I t just happened and I did not want to look at anyone or make eye contact. I wanted to crawl under the counter and hide.
Oh my goodness, I can only imagine how horrible that was for you.
I was crushed when I didn't win the lottery
Yeah, I wouldn't get too down. Statistically, there's not much of a chance of ever winning.
Yea That's true its still nice to dream
Yes I agree. I would be amazing to win the lottery.
I have to get an important medical test done and the results could be not so good.
What medical test and why do you think the result couldn't be good?
It's a test for cancer and We'll, it could be terminal.
Oh, sorry to hear that. Hope you'll get We'll soon.
I won a lottery for a small amount of money.
Awesome, are you a millionaire now?
My friend was supposed to meet me at my apartment so we could eat at Starbucks. But she ended up wanting a full body back rub. It was a nice change of plans.
Oh, that's...Interesting. That does sound like a nice change of plans, not only because Starbucks not seem that fun anyway. Hopefully she returned the favor?
Still waiting on that one hahaha

We'll, hopefully she doesn't keep you waiting for very long, if everything else is right! But maybe be more patient than even you think you need to be in order to play it safe, so she doesn't get scared off, so to speak. Sounds like it will be worth it in the end.
I ordered a hamburger from a restaurant and it was raw in the middle.
That's so bad. You must be feeling bad
My mother in law does not know how to mind her business, I don't understand why she has to be so undermining to us.
What a jerk! Why is she always in your biz?
I really miss my family
Are you a college student? Or just living far away from them
I think that I will do good on my test.
Good. You sound confident. When is it?
It is tonight. I studied really hard.
I'm sure you'll do great then!
I honestly think New Orleans is one of the most exciting places to live in the US. You never know what you are going to find around the corner.
Yes, it does seem like a fun place. I would love to go to the Mardi Gras.

Mardi Gras is great, but stuff happens every day. One time I was showing some friends around from out of town, and we heard some voices on the other side of a fence. We ducked through a hole, and found a bar with a full band playing - complete with couples swing dancing!
That sounds like a lot of fun! I wish I would have seen it!
I am having a hard time with someone who keeps repeating the same mistakes.
What are they repeating?
Bad behaviors and attitudes. It's hard to see they keep going back to the same path.
I hope you can provide them with some help.
I ate the last slice of pizza that my husband was saving. Oops!
We'll you must have really liked that pizza!!
It was soooooo good lol
Haha good for you, especially taking from husband and eating his portion it must have been damn good
I finally got to see a baseball game live this last week.
Nice! Who did you go see? Did you catch a homerun?
It was the Rockies, no home-run though, it was pretty high up there I felt like I could see the world.
That sounds amazing. All I have is my lowly Senators sea level stadium...I am mad jealous.
I feel bad I stole my mom's car last weekend.
Why did you do that?
I needed to go out with my friends. I had no other choice.
I hope you had fun at least.
My grandfather passed away not too long ago, I received a bunch of items he left for me.
I'm sorry for your loss, I bet you two were close. What did he leave you?
I couldn't believe it when my kid started taking his first steps the other day. It was unexpected because he had not even come close before.
I hope you got it on camera, I would if I was in your shoeas
I did get it on camera. I can't wait to show him when he is older.
Nice, buddy he will thank you for it when he grows up
I recently had my first child. I was absolutely terrified when I went into labour but I put all my faith in the wonderful midwives and everything worked out perfectly!
I'm glad it went as planned. I can imagine that to be a very stressful moment.
I listened to a song the other day that reminded me of the past.
What song was it?
Glycerine by Bush. It made me feel odd, like I was in the past.
I've never heard of it, is it from the 80's?
I used to work as a flooring specialist at a major chain home improvement store. It was a good place to work until I got a new supervisor who thought he could disrespect me without consequences.
Uh oh. I'm sorry to hear that. That is never a good thing to do as a supervisor.
We got into several arguments and management decided to ignore the problem and hope it would blow over. After a few weeks I turned in my resignation.
Unfortunately he wins out when you do that because it will likely continue. Again, I wish you had been treated so unkindly.
I lived by myself during my twenties but didn't like it at all. The house was always empty.

My friend and I were out at the bars one night, doing the usual young people thing. They had been acting off a little all night, and when I asked if they were okay, they told me everything was fine. I knew this wasn't true since I had known this person for years, but the night came to a close and we got a cab home.
I'm shopping for a new bicycle! Can't wait to pick one out.
That sounds like fun! Are you big into biking?
Life was so good during my childhood. I lived carefree and oblivious to challenges.
I hear you there. I miss getting to just play without a care in the world. Summer vacations were the best
I work at an animal shelter and it's such rewarding job. It feel so good to be taking care of the animals there.
My daughter is thinking about that career track. Is it hard though when an animal doesn't make it?
Yeah it really is, but we try our best if that is likely to minimize the pain.
That would be the only thing that would keep me from it. I admire those that care for our animals, so thanks to you for being you.
I have fun plans this weekend over a friends house.
What are your plans?
My friend is having a drink and paint party. I've only been to one before but it was pretty fun. I can't wait.
Wow, that sounds like a fun and interesting time, but it sounds like there are a high chance for things to go south and be a huge mess
There was a motivational speaker at my office a couple weeks ago. His speech really resonated with me.
Oh wow, what was the subject of the sppech?
The speech was on the importance of teamwork and being positive! It was really inspiring!
Oh wow I bet it was a good thing for the whole office to hear!
I really hope my dog feels better, she has been sick this past week.
Aw I hate to hear that. I also hope she feels better. I love my dog so much.
Yeah, I love mine a ton as We'll, I'm taking her to the vet tomorrow!
I hope it all turns out We'll with good news there!
Went to the rec center today after work, and it was closed. They didn't announce it or anything
That's a bummer. What do you do there?
I play volleyball with some friends. Gotta get that exercise in after work.
Oh nice! Good for you. Maybe go for a run?
I really miss my old house sometimes
I know the feeling. Why did you move
My new semester is starting up next week and I am crossing my fingers it will be a good one.
If you go into it with a good attitude, I'm sure at the very least it won't be bad. What kind of classes will you be taking?
I am happy to have my best friend. He always checks up on me
That's really sweet of him. How long have you been friends?
I am worried about my interview
What is your interview for?
I am applying for an internal position at work
That's pretty cool. Do you think you will get the job?
I was very happy because my result was out
Must have been a good result. Was it for a job, school, or for medical results?
Yes I made excellent result
I am sure your family was proud of you, as We'll!
My mom became very I'll recently and had to be hospitalized.
Oh no -- how is she feeling now?
She's doing fine now. But that was the first time I've seen her I'll. Scary.
Yeah, that had to be tough. I'm glad she's doing better now though.
Last year, I was really very shocked and angry.
Oh goodness, what happened?
My grandmother passed away.
Oh no, you must be devastated. I'm sorry.
My son showed up at our door unexpectedly one day. He is in the Army and stationed in California!
Wow, that must have been a surprise and a joy for you
I recently traveled by plane and I loved seeing the city I love at night, the view was beautiful.
I love flying! Was it your first time on an airplane?
It was the first time I traveled at night, I loved it.
I prefer night flying as We'll. I love how you can see the city lights moving, like it's the lifeblood of a living thing.
Someone backed into my truck in the parking lot
Oh no, did you see who did it?
Recently I had a very good customer service experience with my cable company. Not only did they fix the problem they gifted me free premium content for a year!
I bet it wasn't Comcast! They wouldn't even give you a cup of water for free.
That's so funny! I was so surprised too but really happy. I might even pay for the services when my free year is up.
I am glad you had a nice experience! Its difficult to find such a company that cares about its customers!

messages.content: I want to leave but I have nowhere to go and no money.

Wanting to leave is a clear sign that you know this isn't right. Not having somewhere to go yet doesn't make wanting to leave any less valid.

If leaving immediately would put you in more danger, that's worth weighing carefully. You could call Tele-MANAS on 14416 in India for free help, including with safety planning, or 112 if you're in danger now. Who is there for you, even a little?
