Wow, that must of been a trip. How did it make you feel?
It brought back lots of good memories :)
Awesome, I've gone through old albums like that before as We'll, and it always makes me feel good.
I am so happy for my dad. He finally paid off his student debt loans after all these years. I can see a change in his demeanor and I feel so ecstatic for him!
I bet that is so relieving! It sucks how much debt you need to take on in order to go to school these days!
I was almost in a nasty car crash earlier
Oh my gosh, that's terrible. How did that happen
I was on a flight and a kid kept kick the back of my chair.
Did you ask the kid or the kid's parents to stop kicking your chair?
Yes, I was so irritated.
How long was the flight you were on?
I used to be miserable when no one would hit me up and I'd spend the weekend solo at my parents' house...Now I turn off my phone just to keep from getting distracted
That sounds sad. What are you getting distracted from?
Lately, my two year old boy has been so much into wearing dresses and playing with babie dolls, I don't even want to think of I
Is that good or bad? Why the concern?
I don't feel good about myself right now. I took something from a boyfriend's house without him knowing.
Oops. Could you sneak it back in without him seeing you?
I thought about that but I was thinking I would be honest and tell him what I did and why. Do you think I should?
Depends how close you are and how mad he'll be. Usually, I advocate honesty, but don't know enough about your situation to advise.
We'll, I think he is cheating on me so I took his spare I-phone that I suspect he is using to do it with! It is locked and I can't get in the phone to find the evidence.
Oh boy. I honestly don't know what to say. Maybe ask him outright if he's cheating. If he is, do you really want to stay with him? If not, it doesn't matter if he knows about the phone or not!
Some people like to move away when they are older. I think I'm fine where I am.
I agree, it's better to live in your own surroundings and have your own independence.

I went to the beach for the first time since I was pretty young, and the smell of the seawater triggered a lot of memories. I didn't find this out until I got back home that memories are sometimes really closely tied to scents.
Oh yes they are! I love it when that happens
It's the first time I've ever experienced it! Oh, and the beach was really nice, too.
Lol! Cool, what kind of memory did it trigger?
When my buddy asked me to help him clean out his grandmother's house who had recently passed, I was not prepared for what we found.
Oh dang. Was she a hoarder? What did you find?
You hit it right on the money. She was not only a hoarder but a cat lady, and the mix of paper, bugs and cat feces was an affront to the senses.
I can't even imagine the stench...Did you make out with any buried treasure?
I was thinking about my boyfriends wedding proposal the other night, it had left me in absolute shock. I did not expect him to get down on one knee and propose.
Why. Did you started dating recently or something
No we'd been dating a very long time but he was never the traditional kind. Never wanted an official ceremony but after meeting me I guess it all changed!
The most important thing is what you want.
My grandmother is in the hospital after being in a car accident. The doctors are taking good care of her so I feel she is in good hands.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that about your grandmother. I'm close to my grandmother so I would definitely need for the doctors to provide the best of care. I'm sure you are looking for a speedy recovery.
I had good vibes all through out my final day in college I was so ready to graduate
Was? That almost makes it sound like you didn't graduate or something went wrong, did you graduate?
Yes lol I did graduate just thinking in past tense. Did you go to college
Nope, unfortunately not, I was hoping to at one point but it never worked out. What did you study?
What was major were you interested in ? I went for business management

Medicine and/or nursing, initially also liked psychiatry but then realised that its history is full of abuse and horror, some of which still is ongoing so I didn't want to participate in that. What can one use a business management degree for? Do you literally become a manager in some business or how does that work?
I got mad last year when I was fired
I would had the same reaction. Why did they fire you?
I had to wait in line at the store the other day for 15 minutes!
Ew, that's always the worst. What were you getting?
Just some random food stuffs. It wouldn't have been so bad but there was only one cashier.
That's always the case! So annoying. I love the self checkout options. I wish more places had that.
I was in a bad spot when my dad died. I just felt lost
I'm so sorry, was it a sickness?
It was a random brain thing that got him instantly
That is so terrible, life is so short. You never knwo when You're going to go
I was walking down the street the other day and I found 20$ just sitting there on the ground! I was so happy!
I have never been so lucky.
I have an interview tomorrow and I just keep thinking I will perform badly in it.
I'm sure you'll be fine. Sell yourself.
Thanks. I'll try my best. Maybe I will do some yoga do help relieve this anxiety!
I'm sure that will help. I have confidence in you.
I'm jealous I didn't the height gene my brother did. I feel so short when I'm around him.
I feel jealous I didn't get the artistic genes my brother got lol
Haha, I guess we all get jealous of something our brother has. But I bet they are too of something we have.
Probably! Makes me feel better now lol
Next week I'm finally going on vacation! I feel like it has been forever.
That's awesome! Where are you vacationing to?
I'm really hopeful that I'll land a new promotion at work.
As long as you work hard and stay dedicated, I'm sure it will come!
A few years back I was addicted to drugs and alcohol... I could not take care of my responsibilities...
I'm glad You're feeling better. I'm sorry you went through that, I hear that addition is tough and often starts after having a major surgical operation.
I received a full ride scholarship to my dream school. I was so happy.
Wow, that sounds amazing. I would have died and gone to heaven if I had gotten one.
I decided to go a new route home from school today, but it didn't turn out as planned.
Uhoh, did you get lost?
No, it just took me somewhere dodgy.
Oh that is scary. I hope you were ok. Make sure your doors are locked
I finally feel like everything is coming together for me, either that or I have just learned how to control my stress.
How is everything coming together?
I am finally finished with my work project!
That's great! What kind of project is it?
It's one of those that are for another business and about making money!
Making money's always good! Do you think it'll be a success?
I lost my keys at the park yesterday.
Oh no! Do you have an idea what part of the park?
I have no clue, I'm so irritated at myself.
Sorry to hear that. Hopefully you can replace them soon.
One of my coworkers was outright belligerent today.
That sucks! What were they upset about?
I don't even know! She does that sometimes, and just badgers you. I can't figure out what fires her up.
It sounds like a very challenging environment to work in.
I feel very satisfied with life right now. My friends and family are healthy, and I am doing good in my classes
Being happy where your life is has got to be one of the best feelings. I'm happy for you!
I felt sooooo nervous going to my last job interview! Nerves must occur in proportion to how badly you *want* something!
I know what you mean. Did you get the job?
I am so upset about my current working situation!
Oh no! I am sorry to hear that, what is going on?
The raise that was mine is now taken from my arch enemy of work!
That would make anyone upset! I am sorry!
I lost my job for 2 years now.I was invited for an interview by a multinational org.
Those two years must have been tough. But this sounds like an exciting opportunity for you!
My pet toad died, I am so sad.
I am so sorry to hear that. How long have you had him?
I have had him for five years.
You must have developed strong attachments to him over all these years. To be honest, I am not an animal lover individual
I am feeling very at peace today.
Why do you feel at peace?
I got to see some family members that I haven't seen in a while, so I feel pretty good.
What did you do with them?
Last year during the spring, our area got record rainfall. My basement ended up getting flooded and destroying many of my childhood things and keepsakes.
That's the worst! Because now you'll be freaking out trying to think of the things you may not even remember whether or not could have been there. That must be an anxious feeling.
I have been posted to the middle east for work, I'm a little bit edgy about what the place will be like
I've heard it's quite dangerous, are you scared?
Yes kind of because I will be away from my family for 6 month in a place where they have different belief system about everything
I bet it's going to be hard to fit in culturally, are you religious?
My dog passed away and I cried.
I am so sorry. You must be heartbroken.
Yes he was my best friend.
How long was he part of your life?
I wish I had a bigger house, I see people with these nice houses and feel envious.'
I know I hear you... Maybe one day we will win the lotto.
I feel sorry for the kid in my street.
I feel sorry for him too, although I don't know what for. Can you refresh my memory?
Her mother beaten up severely. That's why she cried that much.
Ah, yes, I remember now. That mother deserves to be hanged.
I have never been this unhappy in my whole life
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried to talk to a professional about that?
I will try but it's my brother he took a car I saved so much to buy and had an accident with it
That's terrible. I hope the situation sorts itself out.
I was very close to my mom and my grandma. They passed away a couple of years ago. I have so many great memories
I'm really sorry for your loss. At least they still live on through your memories.
Today I slipped when I was walking to class on campus.
Oh no, how embarassing! Did anyone see?
I felt so embarrassed yesterday.
Why, what happened to make you feel that
I walked out of the bathroom with some toilet paper stuck to my shoe.
Nice, I never understood why that's embarassing haha
My cat of 15 years passed away today...
Oh no, why are all the pets dying. It is so sad when that happens.
I have no idea why it's happening all at once, but I had that cat for a good long while. He was such a great cat.
I bet you will miss your feline friend. Hopefully they are in a better place now.
My brother is watching over some possessions of mine while I leave for a trip. There's some expensive exercise equipment he has to look after.
I have some of that too. It would make me a little nervous.
My son applied to a prestigious college and the wait killed us. I was anxious and nervous waiting to see if he was accepted!
DID HE GET ACCEPTED? I HOPE SO
He did! He's in his 3rd year, going to be an Aerospace Engineer, so we are very proud of him.
OMG that's amazing, good on him! You must be so proud
It was amazing seeing my mother graduate today!
Graduate from school? I bet you are very proud of her
I feel so proud of all that my husband and I have accomplished together
Aww That's great! Sounds like you two are a power couple!
He is the perfect balance to set off my strengths and weaknesses
Sounds like you two are the perfect match, cherish your marriage.

There were a lot of reasons why I needed to put my pictures of my mom away after she died but I found one this morning out of nowhere and it brought back some great memories instead of tears for once.
I'm glad to hear it brought memories and not tears! Its hard losing a parent.
It is, I don't wish this on anyone but unfortunately, most of us have to go through it!
Yes we do I understand I lost both of my parents at 22
I recently flew for the first time on an airplane!
Wow! That must have been exciting. Were you nervous?
I just got a puppy, but I have to leave him at home while I go to work. I feel so bad.
That would be sad, do you keep him in a cage?
Fortunately, NO. I let him run around the house, but I feel like he gets bored, so I keep the TV on for him.
That's nice, what does he enjoy watching?
I was at the casino last weekend and on my first pull of the slot machine, I won 1,000 dollars!
WHOA! That's awesome! I've never won anything in my life lol
I'm spending my first summer in Massachusetts. It's a lot hotter than I expected it to be.
Is it really? How hot is it there?
The hottest it got was 99 degrees. It has been in the mid 80s mostly, but I was expecting cooler weather in New England.
That is hot, but it is a bit hotter where I live here
I only got a B- on an assignment I worked really hard on recently, but I'm working even harder now studying to ace the exam!
Wow! I'm sorry to hear that. Do you think you will get an A this time?
I do actually!
Congratulations! Studying can be hard, but sometimes it's about technique rather than time spent. Are you doing anything different this time?
I'm just sitting here with my cat in my lap and thinking about all the money in my bank account. Life is good
That's fantastic! Have you been working extra hard to earn it all, or did it come to you some other way?
Let's just say it's mine to keep, and now everything is taken care of. I don't have a care in the world
Wow! I'm really happy for you- that must be such a great feeling of peace.
My long term boyfriend and I broke up recently. I'm so lost right now.
When that happened to me I watched a lot of movies , for some reason the sad movies made me cry, but just be strong and patient one day you realize you can do better or find someone new

When I was in middle school, I had a friend come over to ride horses with me. After riding my mother pressured me to get on a horse bareback I wasn't comfortable riding. She made such a big scene that I got on to make her stop.
Oh no, did you get hurt?

Yes, the horse took off running and I got thrown into a metal fence. My mother then proceeded to yell and me and make fun of me for trusting her. She told me that I should never trust anyone not even my own parents, it was really embarrassing to get yelled at in from my friend. Afterwards my ribs hurt for 2 months.
Yikes, I'm sorry to hear that. That sounds horrifying!
I was so terrified, but I went skydiving a few weeks ago!
Oh wow! Are you afraid of heights at all?
I'm deathly afraid of heights! I'm so glad I was able to overcome my fear because it was a great experience!
That's great! Maybe I should conquer my fear of heights that way, too!
He seams fine when I talk with him but I know he is not. H has had a problem with substance abuse in the past
That's really rough. Do you think he may have relapsed?
We'll My stepmom just died last week and I am concerned for him greatly
I would be too. Going through something like that can take a toll on anyone, and makes it hard to cope with everyday life. I hope he gets the help he needs.
Hi, I have a co work always asking me questions about how to use her mobile. It is almost always the same questions.
It must be so frustrating to have to answer the same thing over and over. Is she older?
Yes, she is. She is telling that all the cell phone that she has been using have deleting her contacts.
My aunt does the same thing! I think what she is doing is accidentally deleting texts, and she doesn't understand how to check her contacts list. What do you think is happening with your co-worker?
I never thought that I would be noticed.
By who? Who are you trying to get noticed by?
My employers gave me employee of the month and a nice gift to go along with the award.
Oh that's so nice! I'm sure You're a great coworker and employee
My friends girlfriend kissed me at a party last week. It's been weighing heavy on my mind. Should I tell him?
Why did you wait a week? Tell her to tell him
I was at the fair, and I spilled my drink all over myself
Oh no! Did you have to go home and change?
My new job is starting tomorrow. I'm feeling nervous, but really optimistic about it.
Hey that's cool it's a new opportunity, what are you gonna do?
It's a job they opened up for graphic design! I'm super excited to get started and learn more from them.
Hey that's really good I'm proud of you!!!!
My AC went out yesterday.
Oh no, that's horrible.. July is not the time for that! Do you have someone ready to come out and fix it yet?
Someone is coming out this afternoon.
That's good to hear, how hot is it where you are?
My pet toad died, I am so sad.
I am so sorry to hear that. How long have you had him?

So, here I was home from work. My new husband and dad were remodeling tour trailor's bathroom. I went to change to help. A little green lizard was on my shirt. In an INSTANT this yucky thing JUMPED on my head. I screamed so bad my dad said "I think you better go check on your wife.
That sounds so frightening! Was your husband helpful?
No! He just sat there laughing as I screamed for him to find that lizard. Reptiles are gross to me.
I agree! I would have been screaming, too! (And I would have been annoyed at my husband for laughing!)
I feel like there is nothing that I can't do, I feel so powerful! And smart! I just implemented a kmeans algorithm with my own method
Sounds like you are pretty confident in yourself!
Yup I am ! So so confident and I think this is a good trait to have
I agree that it is as We'll. In most situations, it can work to one's benefit.
I have to get surgery tomorrow morning. I'm really nervous about it.
I get really anxious too. What are you having surgery on?
I am getting my wisdom teeth taken out!
I've had that done before. The waking up with gauze in your mouth is the worst part.
My stepmom called today with some bad news. News I was not expecting at all.
What was the news?
My dogs love to lay on me!
I feel as if dogs think humans are the most comfortable bed!
I love when my dogs cuddle with me!
Yes! Cuddling is I feel an instinctual joy!
I am waiting to hear back on how We'll I did on my college entrance exams.
Oh wow! I am sure that you did great! Did you just finish high school?
I was so sick last week. But I'm so lucky to have my girl friend she stayed with me
Oh no! I am so sorry to hear that. I hope you are feeling better.
I'm going to meet my long distance girlfriend next weekend!
That's so cool! DO you get to see her often? Have you ever gotten to see her in person before or did you meet online?
We met online and are meeting in person for the first time!
Soooooo exciting! Are you nervous? I bet it's going to go amazingly We'll and you'll have so much fun. You think she might be the one or not there yet?
My sister passed away several years ago. I really had a hard time with the grief and couldn't really relate to anyone that tried to help me with it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I know exactly what you are going through. My brother tragically passed away 2.5 years ago. He was only 32
For me, one of life's greatest pleasures is to be sitting on my porch with a good book and a glass of wine.
What book do you enjoy reading?
I finally got around to making mug cake
How was it?
It was delicious. I haven't had cake that didn't come out of a plastic bag in over a year.
I have no idea what kind of ingredients you even put in a mug cake?
I am highly upset that I'm the only one concerned with earning money for our bills
Am sorry about that, what are others doing about it
Not much. It's all on me. It sucks
Sorry, just tryy to be patient with them

I hope this doesn't make me sound like a horrible boyfriend, but when my girlfriend first moved into my house, I felt very apprehensive towards the move at first. I was used to it being one way, and she was changing everything. Took some getting used to.
I'm sure it did! It's not easy to have to adapt to another person's habits.
I know. It caused some tension the first week or so. I had to take a deep breath, and realize its just things, and it was just me being reluctant to change.
Yes, sometimes we have to learn to let go of the little things so we can appreciate the more important things. It sounds like you have done a great job!
I am having some financial issues. I am selling almost everything before the bailiff come.
I am sorry you are going through that
I have a test coming up that I've been studying for weeks for.
Oh boy!! WHat is the test over?
It's a Japanese language test for college. I feel pretty good about it though, been going over and over it every night.
Japanese language seems like it would be heard to learn. Good luck on your test, I'm sure you will do fine.
I was scared when I went home alone the other day
Oh I am sorry to hear that. Are you normally frightened to go home alone?
My neighbor was drunk the other night coming home, and hit my car!
Oh no, did you file a police report?
No I didn't, but I reached out to their insurance and He's going to be paying for it.
That is good, glad it will get taken care of
I was out working in my garden when I noticed my neighbor's dog had dug a hole under my fence and was running right at me barking!
Did it scare you or did you make a new friend? It happened to me a few years ago and it turns out the dog just needed a friend.
The weather outside is great for this time of year.
Sounds nice. What's the temperature where you are?
I'm not sure how my future is going to turn out. I have been worried about that a lot lately.
What have you been worried about?
Pretty much everything. I'm not where I want to be. Financially speaking: I'm a poor person. My health has really gone downhill this year. Pretty much everything isn't good.
Oh wow, I'm sorry to hear that! I hope things start looking better for you. Can you file for disability or social security?
I stole money from my son's piggy bank.
Why did you do that?
I recently saw a hot dog eating contest.
It must have been quite interesting. Did it make you feel hungry?
Visited my mom last weekend and remember all the times we fought. We fought over such little things
Aw, I am sorry to hear that. Are things better now between the two of you?
Some people are so slow at answering text messages, it's like they read it and never reply
I agree. Its frusterating, especially when it was an important conversation.
I was walking down our downtown club area one night a friend bumped into me and I tripped over a little fence.
Oh, man. Did you end up falling?
Yeah took a hard fall. Right on to my knees. No way to catch myself at all.
Ouch. Did you get bruised up?
My friend bragged too much about being good at FIFA. We played a round against each other and I beat him very badly at it
Good for you!!! I think its annoying when people act like that about anything.
Hi friend, have you ever been to the mountains?
LOVE the mountains. Mainly in the New Mexico / Colorado area -- but also to the Alps. How about you?
I have never been but once, to a trip in the Alps with my friends!
Lovely! Did you ski or sled? Sledding is a whoooooole different animal there!
I just payed all my bills thanks to some money I didn't knew I had
That's great for you.. Where did you find the cash?
In my bank statement, two days ago
Right on time, huh? I'm happy for you buddy
I was envious last week when my friend got a new car. It makes me want one
Are you able to afford one?
Not just yet
Good things come to those who wait, I know it's hard now because your friend got one but it'll work out for you
My partner is away getting treatment and therapy and it's hard.
I'm sorry to hear that. What do they get treatment for?
Oh he just has a lot of trauma from childhood and he takes a lot out on me so he has to get help in order for anything to continue between us.
I'm sure that's really tough. I hope he appreciates all that You're doing for him, and I'm sure it'll work out :)
My life is great!
I'm glad. You seem very happy
My son won the spelling bee yesterday. I felt so proud of him!
That is great. Do you remember what words he had to spell?
One time I was giving a presentation and something really embarrassing happened.
Oh, tell me about it, please!
I started up the presentation and I accidentally copied an inappropriate image into one of the slides..
Oh no! What happened next?
I gave instructions
To whom did you give instructions?
My subordinate in the office
Did you feel powerful giving instructions?
When I went on a first date with my now fiance, he picked me up in his black shiny new Cadillac XLR.
Wow, it sounds like a great time with him!
I thought it was the coolest car I've ever seen. It was just a two seat but beefy. It was like goin out with batman! LOL
Haha! That does sound like an amazing car!
Pleased with my new dog today.
Oh yeah? What did your dog do?
A pitcher on my team signed with a big time college
That is awesome. I bet you really helped him develop his talent.
It was great to see how much he had improved from his freshman year
You have made a big difference. Glad you are making a difference.
I love mystery boxes in games! Unfortunately I usually don't get anything good.
That sounds fun! What are they exactly?
Last weekend my friends and I went away on holiday and two of them got belligerent drunk and completely ruined the night.
I hate when that happens. Did they end up apologizing at all or did they play it off like nothing happened?
We had to have a talk the next day. One had no memory of the night and the other half apologized. We've moved on, but I'm still sore about it.
I would be too. Its not fun when a couple people ruin a night that should be a great time!
My cat went missing 3 days ago. I found her.

That must have been a little bit of a roller coaster. That's kind of why I'm not wild about cats, is because They're so independent, and the outside cats can just go hang out somewhere for days and not have a care in the world about you. But I guess that suits some people.
My friend's eyes keep hurting at night. She's been to the doctor, but they can't find anything wrong with her
The weirdest thing... It sucks when you don't know What's causing it. Has she been to an eye doctor or just a general dr?
She's just been to her doctor. I'll see if she can see a specialist.
Sounds like a good idea I hope her pain goes away asap!
When I went on a first date with my now fiance, he picked me up in his black shiny new Cadillac XLR.
Wow, it sounds like a great time with him!

messages.content: I can't breathe and I think I'm having a panic attack and something terrible is happening to me.

That sounds really frightening, and I want to stay with you through it. Panic attacks are intense but they do pass, usually within about ten to twenty minutes.

Right now, try to breathe in slowly for four counts and out for six. Plant your feet on the floor and notice five things you can see. If the pain in your chest is severe, or if you're not sure what's happening, please call 112 or get to a doctor, because I don't want you guessing about your body.
I stepped in bubble gum in the parking lot at work.
That really sucks, I've had that happen to me as We'll.
I finally finished my Phlebotomy class . It was an hour's drive one way, but thankfully it's over and a hospital nearby is hiring I heard. Whew!
That's amazing! How do you anticipate dealing with people who are afraid of needles?
I was pretty sick this morning. I was even throwing up
Are you ok?
Did you enjoy high school?
Not particularly. I wasn't my best self at that time. I suppose who really is, though.
I loved it. I went to my moms and saw old pictures. I love my life now but just to not have the responbilities.
At least you had a good experience. I definitely feel you on the responsibilities part!
I feel a bit sad about this weekend. I have to work on a big project for work instead of visiting my family.
I'm sorry to hear that. Hopefully after this project you can get some time off to spend with your family.
I'm so happy that it is Friday!
Oh me too! Do you have a monday to Friday type job?
My wife is the best thing to happen to me since sliced bread
That's awesome! Tell me about her.
As a kid I was afraid to sleep in my room because of my closet
Did you think a ghoul or monster were in there? I had similar fears growing up.
I thought we had a ghost for a long time
What did you do to get over the fear?
I just got older and was no longer afraid
Makes sense. We'll I'm glad you finally got some sleep haha.
I am moving into a new apartment in three weeks and can't wait. It'll be quiet as it looks onto a forest!
Is it loud where you are now? New places are always so fun!
I was able to get an interview for a great job, by the time I was going into it I felt that I knew everything they would require and I was not worried at all.
Nice! You sound like you prepared very We'll
I did, I prepared in every way possible. It was all worth it in the end because I was able to show them just how valuable I was.
I love that feeling. Being prepared for whatever comes your way, good luck!
I went skydiving a few weeks ago. It was certainly an exercise in trust.
I used to want to do that so bad when I was younger. Was it amazing?
It was! And my tandem partner was great. I'm still alive, which is a testament. :)
That's so awesome. I don't think I would have the courage now. Will you do it again?
I'm so glad my health is good
That's great! I'm glad to hear that. We often take our health for granted.
My grandma ended up getting really sick this last week.
Oh no, I am sorry to hear that. How is she doing and how are you holding up?
She is getting much better. My family and I did everything we could to take care of her.
That is great that she has such a great support group and loving family members to support her. I hope she gets We'll soon! :)
Tomorrow's an exciting day for my family. We're sending our two youngest children to a new school!
Oh nice! Tell me about the new school?
I am moving to new appartment. The new neighborhood is so nice. I am so happy that I found this appartment.
That is great, congratulations on the new place. Is it somewhere you have wanted to move for a while now?
I just broke up with my boyfriend of 8 years. I am beyond distraught.
I bet. You guys were together for so long. Is this for the best?
I hope so. I wish he would have broken up with me sooner.
We'll I am sorry to hear that. If you need anyone to talk to let me know.

I understand. I remember when we had to save games to 5 inch floppy disks. They made really strange shuffling sounds and a lot of times didn't even read.

Our sense of security.

Nervous. Surgery is a big step and I'm afraid something will go wrong.
I understand I would be too but now a days technology is really good just make sure its a reliable hospital!

We were eating ice cream last night and my son walked over to a police officer and started talking to him.
We'll that's sweet. How did the policeman react?
I had a speech I had to deliver at work in front of a big prospective client.
Ooh that is rough having to prepare for. How do you think you did?
I got a little upset when my friend canceled on my last weekend, I was looking forward to hanging
Sorry for that. I hate last minute cancellations. Did he have a good reason?
No That's what made it worse to me
Who needs friends like that. So what did you do?
I was irked when I saw a dent in my car door

My mother is looking for a better job, since not only are her two current jobs really bad but we also need more household income.
Oh wow I'm the same, I hope she gets it, its really stressful
My friend had to miss a concert, because I was sick.
Oh wow I'm sorry, but your health is more important!
Thanks a lot! She didn't have to miss it actually but didn't want to go without me.
Sounds like you have a great friend!
My family loves to argue when we get together. It is annoying when we are in a restaurant and won't stop bickering.

You are right. Sometimes I want to be invisible. I wish we would all just get along.
I understand, trust me. My family was the same way growing up.
My best friend is coming to visit me tomorrow.
Cool! What are you all gonna do?
We are going to go clubbing! I am so happy to see her!
That's awesome!! I hope you have fun and be safe!

Yeah that is a really good point actually! Being kind of scared could be a good thing for me.
Exactly! Embrace the danger. Become the danger. Do like 800 flips while You're falling through the air, but do yourself a favor and don't vomit okay?
There's a new Korean restaurant that's opening up.
I have never tried korean food , and I love trying different kinds of food I would be so excited
I heard a loud crash in my backyard!!
What what happend next? What was it? Did you decide too explore this further?
A few years ago I saw the cutest puppy at the pound. I brought him home to my son.
Aww, I love puppies. Did your son love him?
This guy "friend" my ex was talking to all of the time made me uncofortable
I understand. Me too, I don't like people talking too much.
Today I finally got my dream car!
Awesome! What kind?
I just finished doing all my laundry and packing for my trip. Finally.. Ready to go!
Congrats! Where are you going?
I am going on a cruise to the Bahamas. I've been getting ready all day.
OH I'm so jealous! Have lots of fun!
Hi, I accidentally had an affair with my wife's coworker.

I wanted to take friday off but, I'm unable too.
Did you already make plans?
Yes

Fishing

I've been waiting to hear back from a job interview I feel went quite We'll.
How long do you have to wait?
My brother just bought my all time favorite car.
That is cool! What kind of car?
I was super late for my meeting on tuesday , I got so embarrassed

It was actually, and because of the traffic I couldn't make it
Sorry to hear that, were they understanding about it?
I've been having to deal with me and my wife's new business and it's been kind of stressful.
My husband owns a business and its also stressful. What kind of business did yall start?
A spiritual service business.
Oh . What do you do for that?
I can't wait to visit my family back home they are so far away I don't get to see them a lo
When will you be going ?
In a couple of weeks I am really happy to see them it has been 5 years
Wow, I hope you have a really nice trip.
I am getting lunch today and it will be great!
Where are you getting lunch?
I am feeling positive about the economy these days
That's terrific! Is there anything in particular that makes you feel good about it?
This mother's day was amazing! I got so much more than expected and it was all so heartfelt
That is great!! Sometimes we mom's get a bit forgotten, so to have an entire day where we are just loved is such a great feeling.
I got mad when I lost my dog
Oh no! I would have too. Did you find him?
I'm really bummed out today, I had to get rid of my dog because I had to move across the country.
Oh you must be so sad, I know I would be if that had happened to me.
My older sister stole money from me.
Do you know it was her for sure? That is horrible that you can't trust your own sister.
I got some fast food today and it was sooo good!
I bet. I love fast food soooo much. What did you have?
Oh lord...The bad one..Mcdonalds! Lol- I can't have wheat so I can't eat much..I wanted nuggets SO bad too..I don't eat it often..But junk food tastes nice now and again.
It really does. I feel your pain on the no wheat policy. I used to eat fast food all of the time and now I am a no wheat no oil vegan, so No fast food.

Oh you know, I need to go vegan as We'll! So much has wheat in it. Most of the vegan stuff here does. I am in the midwest and I can't have too much fruit..I don't like most veggies and I am on keto :/ SIGH! I am getting there though. You can have fries though unless You're a celiac!

I'm not celiac, but I just eat whole food plant based. It has been hard for me because I also hate vegetables (not good for a vegan) but I drink a lot of fresh vegetable juices and whole food smoothies to get the nutrients in. I feel so much better now, though, that I can't go back. Check out the Happy Pear on youtube, they have great vegan recipes.
I went fishing over the weekend and made a pretty sweet catch!
How fun. How big was your catch?
It was every bit of 10-15 lbs catfish. Scared the heck out of me when he hit on the bait!
That's a big one. I bet it was scary. Did you eat it?
We knew she was pregnant, but didn't know the gender yet. Imagine my shock when I saw the ultrasound for the gender!
I am sure it will be fine, do you have a preference
Tonight I tripped while out at dinner, total clums
Oh my, I hope you weren't embarrassed about it, if it was a good trip?
Yes, I totally was!
Nice! I would love to go on trips except that my boss wouldn't like it if I did!
I am thankful for my supportive family
That's great. Have they always been as supportive as they are now
I'm going to be away from my girlfriend for a year, but she should know that she can trust me.
Sometimes it is very hard and the jealousy can come out. I hope you have a really strong relationship though.
Thank you. It will definitely test our relationship and hopefully, we come through it.
I have seen many relationships be destroyed because of time and space. Good luck to you all.
My father dropped in unexpectedly, I hadn't seen him in 3 years!
That's awesome! Did you guys do anything?
My friend helped me move to uni last week
Awww that's so sweet of them, are you guys close?
Yea I was super thankful that he helped me
That's so nice, are you looking forward to uni?
My husband says he stopped drinking but I'm reluctant to believe him

He's said it before and nothing's changed. I don't want to get my hopes up.
We'll I'm sure the odds are against him, but I hope he succeeds this time.
I am really excited for the new super smash bros, it looks awesome so far!
I agree, looks like a great game to play with friends! When is it coming out?
It comes out December 7th of this year!
That is actually not far! I can see what I am going to be doing over the holidays!
I was looking at old childhood photos... Good memories
Ah yes! How did it make you feel?
I've been waiting for my husband to build my new furniture and he's taking forever!
Oh wow. I'm impressed he can make furniture! Is he busy?
He just needs to assemble it lol he's tired from work but I'm impatient!
Awww give him some time. I'm sure he'll get to it eventually.
I was shocked how nice the weather has been the past couple days
Same here, I'm in Texas. Where are you located
I just moved into my new house and I am having a cockroach problem.
That really sucks! What do you have to do?
I got invited to a party in a shady part of town but I went anyway.
That could have been a scary situation. How was the party?
It was great, contrary to what I thought.
That's good. I guess you never know what to expect sometimes.
I expected something good, that was why things are working We'll for me now
That's great news to hear. I hope things continue to stay great for you.
I was surprised when my wife left me
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that.. How long were you married?
I recently had my friend watch my house while I was on vacation.
You must really trust them. I hope it turned out We'll.
A homeless woman asked me for money and I said no.
I don't blame you. I don't like giving out money like that - you just never know what they may do with it.
Isaw the most amazing sports play yesterday! I was shocked.
Oh really, what was the play?
I went out for dinner the other night and it was at a really fancy restaurant. I knocked my drink over by accident.
Hey a similar thing happened to me! I hope no one saw!
It was a full glass, and it spilled all over the table.
Ooops! I'm sorry to hear that. I'll tell you what though, it happens to the best of us! It's just a drink.
I was up for promotion this year. I lost out to another coworker. I really thought I had it.
Oh no, I'm sorry man. Hopefully next time. Were you at least able to reach out and see what you could improve upon?
I got some good feed back. I really thought I had it though. Just a little bummed out.
I bet that is pretty disappointing. Maybe some ice cream will make you feel better.
My parents are coming to visit me for Christmas this year finally
Did you usually visit them?
I did but we usually met up at other family members houses but this year they chose my house!
That's cool! Are you gonna go all out with decorations and things?
I am a failure
What makes you think so? I'm pretty sure you aren't.

I wan't to help my fiance, she is going through so much, my job isn't paying me much and I've been working as hard as I can and I still can't do much, I wan't her to come here already because she is the only thing that keeps me sane
That doesn't make you a failure! You are doing more than enough and I'm pretty sure she appreciate every single thing You're doing for her.
When I was younger I would steal 20 bucks from my mothers purse at times.
Oh no, did you ever get caught
I did and I felt really bad because she got mad at me.
Did you learn your lesson?
I am happy right now, I have a girlfriend, a good job, and a good group of friends
Sounds like your life is perfect. That's amazing. I'm happy for you
Thank you, I appreciate that!
Where do you work?
When I was a little girl, we had a house fire and it burned to the ground.
Oh no! How did that happen?
It came from next door. Someone knocked over a kerosene stove.
That's horrible. I hope you and your family made it out okay!
I absolutely hate olives. The other day I was eating a salad I got from Whole Foods and somehow a stray black olive was in there. >:(
Eww! I really hate olives also. What things do you like in your salad?
My new neighbors slam their doors all day and night
That is very annoying. Did you talk to them?
I went to the gym today to register with a promotion were I was supposed to get 1 free month. But it turned out the promotion was expired.
Oh no! I hate when things like that happen. You can sometimes still get it if you try to speak to the manager
Hi, I promised myself I would never drink again but I drank yesterday.
It is a interesting and relaxing way to end a evening. I've been there before.
I feel really bad about it though.
Sorry to hear that.All we can do is learn from it, really.
I can't wait to travel south to get my favorite take out. Can't find it here.
That is a very long drive! How long will it take to get there?
I went skydiving a few years ago. It was a rush!
Skydiving is insane to me, how did it go? What reminded you of it?
It went really We'll! I really want to do it again. I went tandem with the instructor and really had to have faith he knew what he was doing!
It's always good to have a professional help with this kind of things, glad you had fun!
I am so thrilled that I scored some concert tickets to a surprise performance.
That so cool! For what band?
I really like the new stadium my school built.
That sounds great, it's always nice to have a new place to play like that!
I found my old diary in the basement. It brought lot of memories
How nostalgic! Was there anything in there that surprised you?
I'm jealous of people born with perfect healthy genetics.
Yeah it sucks when people just seem to have it all.
They seem to be immune to sickness, that's like the greatest trait of them all!
Are you the type that's prone to getting sick?
Yes, unfortunately.
We'll that's too bad. Yeah when you have bad genetics there aren't enough apples to keep the doctor away.
I spent 5 hours baking a cake yesterday.
That's a lot of dedication. Was it for a special occasion? And have you been baking for very long, or do you do it professionally at all?
I do it just as a hobby, when I finished this one my wife dropped it, I was so mad

Oh, I feel terrible for both of you. Your hard work lost, and she probably feels really guilty too, for something that was maybe an accident. I hope you guys were able to talk it out and not get too upset with one another after a while.
My father was diagnosed with stage 4 brain cancer.
Oh no! I am so sorry to hear that. That must be very difficult for you and your family.
I felt so ashamed the time that I took money from my parents. I couldn't look them in the eyes for weeks when I was younger.
At least that shows that you have a conscience. I hope that you made it up to them.
Yeah... I don't know. They still support me and help me, but I still feel incredibly guilty. Not sure what to do to make it up to them.
Confess to them what happened. Let them know how you have changed.
I just purchased my first home.
Wow! That's exciting! Was it what you were looking for?
My best friend from childhood came into town last week and we made dinner plans.
Oh, that sounds like fun! Has it been a long time since you have seen him?
We haven't seen each other in years. Unfortunately he bailed at the last minute.
Oh that sucks! He doesn't sound like such a good friend I guess.
My husbands open heart surgery for Monday was postponed. We have to deal with Kidney related issues now
Sorry to hear that. My parents used to struggle with health issues too, and I'd worry just as much as they would. Do you know when it may be rescheduled for?
Thank you. We have to treat the symptoms of the Chronic Kidney Disease first, and then tend to the heart surgery next. We have a long road ahead.
It sounds like You're patient and prepared to take it. I wish the best for you guys!
I was shocked in a good way this weekend. My brother got us football tickets
We'll, that's good. Sounds like you guys will be having some fun watching the game. Much better than TV!
I was devistated my my dog sammy died last week
How old was sammy?
It really annoys me at work that I work so hard , and then slackers get paid the same amount kinda makes me feel invious, like they just get to walk around and get payed for it

I applied for my dream job last week.
Oh cool! What would that be?
It was at a law firm, but I found out today that I did not get the job.
Aw I'm sorry. I'm sure you'll get something you want eventually though!

messages.content: My CGPA dropped this semester.
That must be disappointing, especially after working toward it. What pulled it down?
I was skipping a lot of classes because I was sleeping badly.
So the sleep and the attendance are connected, and neither one is really a discipline problem. Has the sleep been an issue for long?
A few weeks. It's hard to wake up for 8am lectures.
8am lectures with broken sleep is a rough combination. What time do you fall asleep now, roughly?
I was acting like a arrogant peacock today.
Why were you acting like that?
I don't know, woke up in too good of a mood I guess.
I'm glad you were in a good mood.
I was very lonely before I met my friends and current girlfriend
What is her name?
My mom recently figured out how to use a dual monitor set up at work! I told her I was proud of her.
That's awesome. I bet she is so excited.
She is. She's not very tech-savvy so I was shocked she figured it out!
I can see where you would be shocked. I'm happy for her.
My computer crashed while I was working on a project.
Oh no! Did you lose a lot of work?
I have been watch a new show. It is so scary
Oh yeah? I've been looking for a new show to watch. Which one is it?
I found a spider in my bathroom.... I've never ran so fast in my life!
Oh wow! That must have been a really scary experience. What happened to the spider?
My husband got rid of it. It was huge!
It's a good thing that he was there to take care of it. I just saw a tarantula exhibits at the zoo. Even through the windows that made me nervous.
I went to pick up my car from the mechanic and found a huge scratch on the side! They are saying they didn't do it! I am so mad right now!
Oh my gosh. I am not surprised they denied any wrong doing. I think that is typical of mechanics. What do you plan to do about it?
We recently went on vacation and it made me feel reminiscent. It made me think of the last vacation I was able to spend with my father before he unexpectedly passed away.
I'm so sorry for your loss.
My wife have been with me through thick and thin for 30 years
That is extremely loyal! You must have a really happy relationship?
Pretty sure my pet fish ran away today.
Lmao how the heck did that happen
I am going to my home town today. Will be visiting for my brother's graduation!
Congratulations to your brother! Are you flying or driving?
So my work issues laptop crashed and won't boot. But, I am hoping I can fix it myself, we all know sending it to IT takes forever!
Good luck. That sounds really frustrating. Hope everything was backed up.
I'm being induced on Monday because I'll be at 41 weeks pregnant by then. This is my first baby and I'm so scared! Labor seems impossible!
You got this girl! I was induced when I had my daughter a year ago! I was scared too but honestly don't remember much.
I'm going to eat sushi for the first time this coming weekend.
Yum! Sushi is so good, I'm sure you'll enjoy it! I like the eel roll and spicy tuna roll.
Thanks for the recommendations! I'm a bit nervous about it, but I hope I will enjoy it.
I'm sure you will! Maybe start with a simple roll like the california roll or ask the waitress for recomendations.
I just started the show Luther on Netflix.
I've heard of that, is it any good?
I am so happy with my life currently, I am able to stay at home with my children and watch them grow, I would not change it for anything

How do you feel these days?
It has gotten a little better with time, but still a pretty sore spot for me.
It must be difficult, do you think she will come back ever?
I just moced out of the city.
Where did you move to?
My boyfriend cooked me dinner for the first time. I did not trust him in my kitchen
We'll that's fun! Did he do a good job?
I went into that interview last week ready for anything they threw at me
That's awesome. Sounds like you were We'll prepared for it.
My neighbor has a dog that won't shutup
That has to be really annoying. Have you called animal control?
I didn't know I could do that
Yes, that's one way to deal with it. What did you end up doing?
My son said his first words the other day/
Really? That's amazing, what words?
My in-laws just suddenly showed up yesterday and said they were staying for the week. I had no warning at all but I guess they were trying to make it fun, ha ha.
Oh no! I would have a heart attack! Are you able to take time away from life so unexpectedly to spend time with them?
I need to replace the engine in my car.
Oh what happened? Did your car break down?
Yeah, many things went wrong. I am sure I can change it though.
Ohh I feel bad for you. I am sure everything going to be alright.
I am excited for the football season, I hope the Eagles can repeat!
I am not a football fan. What did they do last season?
I was supposed to meet up with my volleyball team today, but I'm so tired.
Why are you so tired?
Recently, my dad gave me some money to buy e-cig liquid for my vape, I am very thankful!
That's pretty cool. What flavor do you think you are going to get?
We'll, I'm thinking something fruity. Maybe berry or watermelon?
Berry sounds like it would be very tasty.
I stole candy from the store today.
Why did you steal candy from the store?
I was quite hungry. But now that my stomach is filled, I kinda feel bad about it.
Did you not have any money to pay for it?
I went on a bike ride after work today. It was very peaceful. Just me, the mountains, and my thoughts.
That sounds relaxing! How was the weather?
Saw this guy ate 3 bowls of large pho.
Holy cow, that's impressive. I bet they had to be carried back home. Did they even break a sweat?
I was talking to a British friend of mine and trying to explain why our president feels compelled to tweet
I am sure that was an interesting conversation. What did your friend think?
I miss my childhood friends. We were so close and always playing together.
I miss mine too. Where did you guys grow up?
I was upset when I saw someone had put a dent in my car door
I'm assuming they didn't leave insurance info?
Hi. I feel very alone, I haven't dated since I was cheated on...
That is understandable. You need to let it happen naturally. Be with your friends and find yourself
Thank you I appreciate that. I just yearn for that company too you know.
I understand. It will happen for you if you keep an open mind and don't rush
We went on a vacation a few weeks ago, and it really made me think back to our last vacation. It was with my father, the last one before he passed away.
Oh wow, I hope you cherished your time with him.
I did, but of course, wished I had more time. He passed away unexpectedly, so I was going over that vacation in my mind too. I miss him.
Sorry that that happened to you, I hope You're doing We'll.
My wife has a big birthday coming up and I've got a great weekend all laid out for her.
Oh how exciting! What do you have planned?
We are going to eat tonight. Then tomorrow we are having a big surprise party with her best friend. I even had a couple of her friends fly into town that she hasn't seen in years.
I bet she is going to be so surprised! Is she hard to surpise?
I paid for a certification exam and had a terrible accident that kept me bed ridden in the hospital I got out and realized I had just 5 days to my exam
Those kind of exams are really important. Did you study before the accident?
My eldest son just graduated High School I was so proud.
How exciting! That is a great accomplishment.
It's kind of a surreal feeling tho, hard to accept that he is grown. Now college is about to start.
I know how you feel. My oldest is in her sophomore year of college.
Games of Thrones is ending. Its Bittersweet
Would you believe I have never seen one episode of that show? How sad that it's ending before I even got to watch it!
I am rewatching the last season now. I can't wait to see how it ends.
We'll don't tell me what happens, I might just go watch it all now lol
My son informed me today that he was charged with possession of drugs
Oh no, that's terrible. Is he in legal trouble?
I suppose so. This is not how I taught to be and am so disappointed he has done this.
This is such a difficult thing for you to go through. I hope he learns from this and changes his path.
I feel so proud of all that my husband and I have accomplished together
Aww That's great! Sounds like you two are a power couple!
I got a new car, I am so happy.
That's awesome what kind of car is it.
I have a performance review coming up at work. I am feeling really good about it. I have been killing it everyday at work.
That's fantastic, you must feel really confident in your ability.
These people at work are so disrespectful and racist!! I can't wait till I quit! I'm an armed guard and they want me to help customers to find products and I'm not there for that!!
Hmmm sounds like an unpleasant job. Maybe they ask you for help because You're the only one around? It doesn't hurt to help those in need.
Have you ever been out to sea?
I haven't actually. Have you?
I was in the Navy, wish I could do it again?
I've heard good things about the Navy and also how tough it is.
After a few years in the service industry I decided to go back to retail. Over the years I was away things had changed so much that I have to rely heavily on my trainer.
Awww man, yeah the retail stores tend to change some stuff up, and sometimes it feels like you have to start all over again, but I'm sure you can push through!
Yes its kinda like riding a bike in some senses there are familiar parts. A few small differences and details that you have to make sure have been pointed out to you.
I'm glad it's not all different though. I'm sure the trainer will be really nice to train you because you sort of know what's going on, but just need a run down for the new responsibilities !
Everyone at work was sitting together eating lunch and talking but they didn't invite me.
That's terrible of them! I would sit with you!
I sat alone and I felt so sad. Thank you, though.
Hey that really stinks. I hope that you can find someone to sit with you.
I have a huge presentation at work this week. I have never done this before and I am not sure if I am prepared yet.
Oh no, We'll I'm sure you'll do okay if you just prepare really thoroughly.
I think its an audi but my neighbor has an expensive car
Audis are nice cars. What color is it? Does it look newer?
Next month my wife and I will take our first vacation since we got married.
That is awesome I will never forget the first time me and my wife went on vacation, where do you have planned to go?
I don't think I should get on my flight in the morning.
That sounds really dramatic! What's the matter? What's making you so unsure about it?
I just have a bad feeling and I think it'd be best if I cancel it!

I can understand trying to abide by one's intuition... Are you going on your flight to somewhere where you have something important to do or someone to meet? Perhaps it may be unfair to them or that situation if you don't go through with it. If you want to do it, try your best to think of all the repercussions, and to weigh the pros and cons, and to not let your intuition cloud your judgment.
Yesterday was my mom's birthday
How fun! How did you all celebrate?
Starting yoga recently has left me feeling a ton better about my body and the way I can move!
I really want to try Yoga! Would you say your back feels better? This sounds so fun!
My lower back feels a ton better since starting yoga, I love it!
I'm jealous! I wish I could try it out for myself. How long have you been doing it now?
Went to the bathroom and saw something you don't see everyday.
What did you see?
We'll when I went to wash my hands there was a from on the handle!
A what on the handle?
I felt pretty good leaving the gym today, hit a new PR on overhead press
That's great. You must have been working really hard.
I am so nervous. I have to go to the dentist tomorrow to get a filling replaced.
Are you afraid of the dentist?
I am! I had a bad experience with one when I was younger.
I'm sorry to hear that, I'm pretty terrified of the dentist myself. Ask for gas! Good luck, I'm sure everything will be just fine.
I started cleaning my attic yesterday
I bet you found some cool stuff
Yeah I found my old NES! I remember those days!
Oh wow! Those were fun. Did you play it?
I am very angry at the person who bred, starved and then abandoned (or maybe she broke free) the dog I have.
Animal abuse disgusts me. I don't what would drive someone to do that...
