Woah now! I wasn't thinking of a speech on that grand of a scale! I hope you blow Gimli's beard clean off his face and make 20 horns of Gondor sound!
I am pretty happy with my life right now.
That's awesome! Always good to be content with life.
You know sometimes when you just feel like you have to leave a job? We'll, that time is now for me and I can not wait for my job interview this week.
Yeah I have had that experience. One was so bad I left before getting another job. Don't recommend doing that, lol.
It is so tempting You're absolutely right. I'm going to try and hang on though, and thanks for the advice.
Stick it out until you have a backup. Your bank account will thank you!
I provide for a family of 8. It's tiring but rewarding
Wow! The struggle is real. I hope You're not too tired and stressed. I wish you luck for being so selfless!
I love my wife alot, we had a set of twin 3 times in a row so the children are 6 plus myself and her all 8
Do twins run in your family or are you just lucky? I mean that seriously, not sarcastically
Recently my husband and I were traveling home from visiting his family when all of a sudden a car cuts us off
That's annoying, I hate how little attention most other drivers pay on the road.
I have no idea how we didn't hit them but it was so scary
I'm glad that you are okay! Keep your eyes peeled for terrible drivers.
When I enter the bus, I fainted. I think that I got overheated.
That's no good. Did you go to the doctor?
Yes I did. It was so hot outside and I did not have much to drink.
Got to make sure you take care of your self. It's scary when your heat sensitive.
I'm going to a show on sunday, I can't wait
That's great! What kind of show?
Breaking ben and five finger death punch
Oh sweet! I'd love to go to one of their shows myself. I hope you have a great time.
I got first place in the karaoke contest last weekend.
Oh how cool! I bet you have a very beautiful voice. Was there any prize?
There was, a free round of beer! There was a lot of talent there so I was surprised I won!
Good job! Maybe you should pursue a singing career :)
I was so grossed out when a friend threw up on me
I don't blame you! I would have also!
We were at a party and he had too much whiskey inside him.
Nasty! Did you tell him anything?
I paid off my credit card before buying my house. I didn't realize how expensive owning would be and after some repairs I owe more than I started with on my card.
That's really good! Do you think You're ever going to use the card again?
My girlfriend always tells me what to do.
Does it bother you when she does that?
It is really crucial to being an honorable mate in your relationship.
Yes, it is important. What happened?
I trusted my coworker to type up an important report but he did not.
So did you get in trouble for it?
Yes and its all my coworkers fault.
That would make me so mad! I wouldn't even want to go to work!
Last week I had to put my dog to sleep. It was really sad because I had him for 16 years.
Oh NO. I am so sorry. That is so hard. My daughters cat got run over like a week after we had him. :( What was your dog's name?

quality_notes: Normalises without endorsing, addresses the underlying trigger, encourages company.

messages.content: I have this thing where I hurt myself when things get bad, and things are bad right now.

That sounds really painful, both the thing and what it does to you. Thank you for telling me. Are you safe in this moment?

If you feel you might act on it, please move away from anything you'd use and be around someone. Tele-MANAS in India is free on 14416, and 112 is the emergency number. Is there someone who could stay with you today?
My daughter starts playing softball this year. I tried playing when I was younger, but the other girls were mean
I had a similar experience playiing little league baseball. How is your daughter feeling about it so far?
She's extremely excited about it, but I can't help but be a little bit scared for her after my experience.
I feel you on that. I don't know if I could let my son play baseball after what I went through. I hope your daughter has a better experience.
I went to the flea market last weekend!
Oh that's neat! Did you find anything good?
I just learned that my niece was invited to the honor program in her new high school

Aw, nice! That's kind of cool, actually. I hope you really encourage her to stick to it and do We'll. Sometimes there can be a lot of expectations that come with that stuff, so whatever you can do to not add pressure to it would be great.
Do you usually take your trash out to the road every week? It is quite an awful experience, in my opinion. I feel very disgusted hauling that big ole bin to the road.
I live in an apartment so I take mine out to the dumpster every few weeks. I feel your pain though. Growing up I had to take ours down our steep driveway every week.
I know! It's physically exhausting. And when the flies start swarming, I get terrified and feel like I am going to come down with the bubonic plague.
It is daunting. I think I still have nightmares about it. I feel dirty just thinking about it right now.
My friend's dog started vomiting a lot. He's at the vet right now.
I hope he's okay. I hate when my dog is sick.
I hope so, too. We're waiting to hear back.
What is the dog's name? I'll say a puppy prayer for him
I was going through some boxes the other day. I found some old pictures of my kids I thought were gone
That is exciting! I love having pictures to look back on.
I ordered take out and got a whole lot of food for $5
Hey that's a good deal! Where was this?
I accidentally overdrafted my bank account and now don't have enough money to pay the fee or my bills. I'm scared of what could happen
I have been there, my friend. But, the good news is, if you aren't typically late for your bills, the utilities companies will often cut you a break.
Are you sure? I guess I will need to make some phone calls.
I am positive! I have been late before for the very same reason. Don't even need to make phone calls - they just give you a small late fee and that's it. I wouldn't go making it a habit, though.
I was looking at this huge croud knowing I was about to have to walk right into it.
Were you nervous and what for?
I had to find my lost buddy, and nervous is an understatement.
Oh no, how old was he?
I almost made the biggest mistake of my life and cost me the greatest thing that ever happened to me. But I sobered up and didn't do it.
Oh no that doesn't sound good. What almost happened?
I had gotten into a huge fight with my girlfriend so I went out with some buddies and started chatting and flirting with this beautiful woman at the bard.
We'll I'm glad you sobered up and didn't do anything you would regret later!
I just started going to the gym but I felt apprehensive when I first started.
I didn't go to the gym forever! I know how you feel though
I just didn't want to do something wrong and look stupid.
I know. I had an anxiety when I first started coming to the gym. I didn't know how to use a couple of machines so I stayed on tradmill the whole time
Going camping next weekend. I haven't hung out with my friends in so long.
That sounds like so much fun. I hope you have a good, relaxing time. Where are you going?
The other day I was looking at old pictures of a car I use to own. I miss that car.
What kind of car was it?
When I turned 40 last year, my kids planned a birthday party for me that I had no idea about.
Oh wow! That sounds very special!!!
It really was and just what I need as I wasn't really happy about turning that corner into my 40's.
I'm glad your family did that for you
My girlfirend is recovering from an eating disorder.
That is tough. How is she doing?
She's doing good. Just had to get away from her parents who was always pushing her to be thin when she was a kid.
That is terrible. Has she cut off all contact with them?
Made kimchi for the first time. Can't wait to see how it turns out.
I don't even know what that is lol
Haha it's a Korean dish. Fermented napa cabbage.
Sounds neat. Do you usually cook korean dishes?
My son will be turning two in a couple of months and it has me looking back.
Uh oh, are you ready for the "Terrible 2's"?
I am trying to prepare.
He will be into everything. I know what you mean about looking back. Kids grow so fast.
I tried a new grocery shopping service called Shipt last week.
Did you like it? What did you buy?
I ordered about $50 worth of groceries, just the basics. But no, they ended up coming late. And, they forgot some items.
That's too bad. I hope they didn't charge you for the items they missed.
I am looking forward to going boating this weekend
Where are you going boating?
We are going to the lake about 15 minutes away from me
What do you like to do on the lake?
I became friends with a girl in college. I was jealous of the men she dated, especially as she told me she would have dated me if we weren't friends.
That's unfortunate. Sometimes, people don't know how to make a move and are waiting for you to make a move.
Yeah sorry I didn't hit on you immediately. I wish she would have just never metioned any interest in me.
That's a good point. Now you are always going to wonder 'What if'?
I am going on vacation next week and can't wait. I haven't taken a vacation in a long time.
What will you do on vacation?
Me and my friends are going to the beach. I am super pumped up.
Will you stay in a condo on the beach?
Oh yeah. We will be able to walk right out onto the beach.
That sounds so relaxing! You'll probably sleep great.
Each month I am scared to look at my bank account.
Why do you say that?
I live paycheck to paycheck, sometimes its not enough
I am sorry to hear that. I hope things get better for you
My mom is having weight loss surgery next week, I'm nervous.
What kind of operation is it? I'm unfamiliar with weight loss surgery. But typically surgeries like that are very safe, but it is natural to feel nervous about someone you care about.
She is having gastric bypass surgery, I feel like it would be too dangerous due to her medical state. She won't listen to me!
We'll, everyone is entitled to their own life choices. I'm sure she'll be alright.
Going to church yesterday really made me feel better. I am looking forward to this week now
What church do you go to?
Marvel makes the best superhero movies! I can't wait for the next one to come out!
When is it due out?
We'll the next Infinity Wars is out in 2019 so that's a long time to wait!
Who is your favorite Marvel hero?
I have just won the lottery!
Congratulations. How much did you win?
About 10 billion dollars, I can't wait to tell everyone and the internet and the world!
That's a lot of money. Can I have some of that?
I wanted to go to Georgia but my trip was cancelled
Darn! Why did you have to cancel?
My car was in a hit and run accident as I was getting out the day before. I was ok thank god.
Oh my goodness! That is scary! I am glad to hear you are ok.
I had a wonderful holiday to Disney World when I was about 12.
That is a perfect time to go, that is when I went as We'll
I was excited when I got approved my for my vacation
I would have been as We'll, going on vacation is really fun. Are you going with family?
Yes we are going to disneyworld
That is really fun place to go with family, I was there last year and really enjoyed it
My brother recently lived , to start his life over he is finally liking the place , I have faith he will have a good future there
Oh that's great. Were you able to help him move?
During the day today, I was in an Uber when it crashed. I'm just thankful no one was hurt!
Oh my! That is so scary. Thank goodness you are ok. Was it the Uber driver's fault?
I gave my friend a makeover. I think her date will be fairly surprised.
Do you normally do makeovers?
I was at the beach one time walking by the pier and I saw a diaper floating in the water.
Wow. I hope it was a clean diaper.
Nope. It was horrifying. It changed everything for me.
Who knew a diaper would be so terrifying.
I wish my grandma was still alive.
Awwww I can relate to that. I am so sorry.
Yes, she died of lung cancer.
I am very sorry to hear that

I'm generally a calm driver. But what really agitates me--to the point of wanting to throw something at the other driver--is someone on the right side merging at full speed onto the main road I'm driving on, towards the furthest lane possible...With NO SIGNAL
I feel your pain. It's crazy how reckless some drivers can be. I was always taught the importance of using my signals.
Yes glad someone can relate. A lot of crazy drivers down here in Texas haha
Honestly in Florida I see similar behaviors among some drivers. I'm not sure if they are rushing or just don't care.
It's been a great night! I'm just relaxing with a cold drink and my favourite show!
That does sound like a great night! I think I'm overdue for one of those myself!
Yes defenitly, It dosen't get better then this! My daughter has been fast asleep since 8pm.
That's great. It's nice when we get some peaceful time for ourselves.
Probably the worst time of my life was when my second marriage ended. It lasted over 20 years and much of my life and plans for the future were intricately bound within that relationship.
I can imagine that would be very painful. Are you doing better now?
Yeah, it's been a few years and I've managed to chart a new course for myself.
I'm glad to here that, I'm sure that moving forward after something as difficult as that is very emotionally difficult.
One time there was a homeless guy running towards my car
That sounds a little scary. Why was he running towards your car?
I have all my ingredients for my dinner party and now I am getting ready to prepare a feast!
You're much braver than me. I would never host a dinner party.. Don't feel like I'm good at planning, and don't feel like I'm interesting enough to talk to a bunch of different people.
Yeah, we all have different personalities. But you would come to a dinner party if invited, right?

I think, maybe, yeah! It depends on who's there, and if I felt comfortable with the host. If I felt like I had enough people to kind of "rescue me" and who I could talk to at the party if I got anxious and couldn't talk to strangers, then that'd be alright. Other than that, I just kind of do like maybe a group of 4, max
I went to Mcdonald's and they completely messed up my order.
Sorry to hear that. What happened
I was so upset they forgot my Mcnuggets.
Sorry, I hope they apologized for that
I've been so busy packing, packing and more packing.
That sounds pretty stressful. Are you moving soon?
Yes, don't know exactly when but I hate being rushed so I've been doing what I can.
That makes sense. I hate leaving things for the last second as We'll. Hopefully you won't have to leave everything boxed up for too long.
I asked my brother to bring me a gift from his trip. He didn't bring anything.
I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe next time?
I broke my ankle right before my wedding! This is a nightmare!
Oh no! What did you do?
I tripped down my steps carrying the laundry. I wish I would've been more careful, this is the worst. I can't walk down the aisle!
How about a hobble down the isle? I'm sure it will still be just as beautiful walking down the isle or not.
I was out walking by the lake over the weekend and there shore was just covered in dead rotting fish.
What happened why were their so many dead fish?
Super upset with a company I thought was trustworthy.
Why what did they do to betray your trust?
My neighbor jokingly makes fun of me for a comment I made that came out very wrong. I turn red every time he mentions it now.
Are you friends with your neighbor
I am a failure
What makes you think so? I'm pretty sure you aren't.
I had to fend off this girl at a party.
What was she doing?
Do you go visit some place that makes you miss growing up?
Yes, I love to visit the zoo!
I recently went back to Michigan and got visit my old town and even the High school I had such great times back then.
What were some of your favorite things to do back in highschool?
I am happy about the beautiful weather today
I love it when it's nice out. Are you going to do something outside?

My parents raised me like a king and I'm thankful for that. Because although I was introverted for most of my life I was pretty confident and successful in my abilities and always did We'll no matter what I did
That is so wonderful that you give your parents the credit and are so grateful for what they did for you!
My friend is watching my dog for the weekend.
What kind of dog is it?
I always do the same, it's not had when they are perfect.
Always do the same what? What is perfect?
My girlfriend, How about you? Do you have a partner?
I have been married for 19 years and we have been together 21.
I am scared that I might not have enough money for food next month
Oh that sucks, I know how that feels, its why I got an extra job online
Thanks that might be an option.
Yea it was scary but I'm happy its not bad anymore.
Hey, how's it going? Isn't it tough meeting new people these days?
Absolutely. It doesn't help that I'm pretty introverted.
My cousin has the perfect life, sometimes I am envious of her.
Wonderful I bet she is really content if everything is perfect. Love to hear that someone is doing We'll.
I've been sitting at home bored all week so I wanted to spend some time hanging out with friends tomorrow night. But apparently all of my friends are out of town. So I'll still be stuck home alone!
That is bad. I hope you will find something interesting to do.
I have no idea what to do though. I think I've done every fun thing I can by myself already this week.
I understand. Probably, watching a new movie could be good idea.
I have an important job interview this week
I see, do you think you will get the job?
I really like looking through old pictures. Its so nice to look back on the past.
I used to enjoy doing that with my grandmother, she'd tell me all about when my dad was little. I love old stories like that.
Yeah me too. I'm a historian so I love thinking about the past.
What an interesting field - my husband would love to say that was his profession!
I lost my wallet the other day and my neighbor returned it.
Whoa, that is a good neighbor. I hope you return the favor some time!
I know! I was looking for it all day yesterday. Turns out it was at the top of a tree!.
Dang. I bet there is a great story of how it got there!
I know I will win Gold in the Olympics.
You sound very confident! What sport do you play?
My family and I were finally getting to go on vacation for the first time in 5 years, but we had to cancel because we all got horribly sick.
Wow, that is horrible, what did you guys come down with?
It was a cold and cough that turned into bronchitis for a couple of us and walking pneumonia for one of my kids. Now school starts so we can't reschedule.
Wow, I hope you guys get better if you already haven't. That's really a bummer to miss out on a family vacation!
My wife is so caring I feel blessed to have her as a wife
That is amazing. It is so nice to have someone to share your life with. How long have y'all been together?
25 years. We attended the same kindargerteen and we have been together as friends first since then
Wow! I have been married for a little over 2 years. What is the secret to a long lasting marriage?
My dog just gave me a bunch of kisses! I love her so much
Dogs really are such great companions, what breed is she?

Really not looking forward to taking my public speech class in college this semester. I feel like I'm going to get up there and vomit all over myself. Last time I had to talk in front of a group of people, I was so nervous, people were laughing because my knees were visibly shaking.
Oh my gosh, I feel the same to be honest. I hate, hate talking in front of a crowd.
Someone stole the stereo out of my car.
That sucks. Did you catch the culprit?
No, I am so mad thinking about it!
I would be too! Did you buy a new one?
I am feeling positive about the economy these days
That's terrific! Is there anything in particular that makes you feel good about it?
All the indicators are positive.The economy is triving.
But on a personal level, how do you experience that?
It was really tough to watch my father struggle with cancer. When he got the diagnosys I was devastated for him.
I am sure that was difficult. How is he now?
I am blessed to have a great family
That's nice. Why do you say that?
We saved up all year to take a nice beach vacation.
That's awesome. Was it worth it?
So worth it! It was our first family vacation, so it was really special.
I hope you got plenty of photo's?
I was just accused from my wife that I stole $10 from her Purse.
Oh wow, why would she think you stole the money?
Because she can not find it, she is the one that misplaced it, I am so furious right now, I would never do that
Would she have any reason not to trust you? I would assume you have not done anything like this before.
I got robbed, while I was alone at home
Oh no, that must have been terrible.
Indeed it was, it was so late in the night as We'll
How long ago was it, were you hurt?
So, I've been practicing holding my breath for a few months now.
For what? Are you a diver or something?
Nope. Just a regular Joe-Schmo that wants to break a world record. Never felt so prepared.
Oh, We'll good luck. Have you heard of Wim Hof? He's like a world record breath holder and he does it in freezing temperatures too.
I thought I got a job but didn't
You must have been disappointed. Did you ask why you didn't get it?
No but I'm sad about it
I would be too. But there will be plenty of other opportunities!
I start my new job next week
Oh how exciting! What is it?
It's at a law firm. I am very nervous and not sure what to expect.
Awesome! I'm sure you will do amazingly. Keep your head up! Fake it til you make it LOL
I was delighted the other day when I got to see a friend that I had not seen in 20 years.
That's great, how wonderful! I hope y'all had a good time.
I haven't made any friends since I moved out here.
What have you tried doing to meet new people?
Last week I felt all alone when the family left
Why did your family leave? Sorry that you felt that way.
A few weeks ago I ordered a custom birthday cake from somebody. The lady did incredible work on it.
What type of cake was it. I love cake, wish I could have a slice.
It is so hard to cope with loneliness. Especially after my break up
I am sorry to heard that.How long were you together.
For about 3 years since college. Loneliness is the worst that could happen to a human being
I agree with you.I was lonely for a whole year.
When my best friend passed away I was devasted
I'm really sorry to hear that. How long ago was that?
I am sad that I won't be able to buy a new car.
Oh no.. What happened? Did you face a financial loss?
No my credit is not great and they turned me down for the loan.
So sorry to hear that.. Hopefully things work out for you real soon
I have a big interview tomorrow. I feel ready. I have my resumes printed out and everything.
Wonderful! It always feels so good to be prepared and ready to crush an interview. I bet you'll get the job because of that preparation and confidence.
So, I went to a bachelorette weekend with my girl friends. All of them were doing things their husbands would NOT be happy with, but I stayed far away from anything like that.
Oh dear! What happened!?
They were kissing and dancing on other men. My husband would have been so upset if I was doing it, too!
Oh my goodness! Good for you for getting away from that trouble!

I'm going through a lot right now. I usually don't like talking about it but I felt like I really need to talk it out. Yesterday my friend called me and I just started talking about everything. It felt good
We'll, it is good you have a friend that is so close to you that you feel comfortable sharing with them.
I once drank six pints of beer in a night and ended up getting very sick.
I would imagine, that is a lot to drink!
It really is. I felt so bad about my actions, but it hasn't stopped me from doing it at least one other time.
I get that, We'll I hope you feel betternow!
I really wanted a certain job and I did not get it
That stinks, it's never worth giving up though! What line of work do you prefer?
I glad my boyfriend and I reconciled
Oh! That's great to hear. What were you fighting about?
My son is turning two in a few months and I can't help but think about when he was born.
Any big plans? My son just turned 4. I've been nostalgic also.
Just a small birthday party with family and friends.
That sounds fun! Have you been looking at the old baby pictures?
I always like to eat at my favorite restaurant a few times a week and encourage others to in the hopes it can stay afloat.
Its good that you like it so much. Why are you worried that it will close?
A bad storm with a tornado almost went through my town, I was so scared
I'm glad it's over and nothing happened. Do you have an underground shelter?
No, I live in an apartment
Oh, I would be scared too. Apartments seem safe unless the roof gets ripped of of coarse.
I never thought I would miss high school.
Oh I have felt that way before. When did you graduate?
I have always wanted to join a college faculty. I went to school to study philosophy for that reason.
Have you been applying to try to get a position?
Unfortunately not. In the end I ran out of money and had to leave that dream behind.
That's unfortunate. What are you doing now?
I am learning how to wake-board this weekend! I am really nervous though!
What is wake-board. That sounds a bit scary.
It is like water skiing but on a board! It is fun, but a little nerve racking!
I bet it is, I am afraid of water, I cannot swim so I know for a fact I would not be trying that. I hope you have fun.
I have been getting everything ready for grad school and I think I finally have all that I need.
What are you studying?
I was in a 5k marathon last weekend and I won first place!
That's pretty awesome. Do you usually run marathons?
I do sometimes. I trained really hard for this one.
Glad your hard work paid off. Was this marathon for a good cause?
I just lost my pet dog. I do not know what to do.
OH NO! I would be devastated. Did he pass, or missing?
I cannot find her anywhere, she is missing, it feels like I have a part of me missing
I am so sorry. I am sure you are. I would be devastated if I was in your shoes. Does she have a chip? Maybe someone will get her to a vet office.
My boss fired me because I kept making him look bad.
LOL! What did you do?
I outperformed him. I am so mad about it!
That's terrible! Can you do anything about it?
My new best friend has already found a better best friend than me.
That sounds bad. Do you feel lonely now?
Yes! I mean how could they move on so fast?
I agree, I guess they weren't a good friend after all
I am not sure how to address to my husband about how I feel about him getting a phone number from another girl.
I would be downright furious. Start by smacking him across the face randomly at dinner. That should be a good segway into the conversation.
My son just finished third in a jiu-jitsu competition he was in.
No way! That's awesome!! How old is your son?
He's ten. He really impressed us with how We'll he did.
I bet! That's great news though, congrats to him!
My brother passed away 2 years ago and I'm still so heartbroken. It still hurts so much
Losing a loved one is never easy , especially a brother I'm sorry for your loss
My parents threw me a surprise party today!
Woah really nice!! What and all they did
They gave me a bunch of presents and doritos! I was so stunned!
You must have really enjoyed it
I was totally comfortable last night watching a movie with my boyfriend and eating popcorn.
Really, did you get to pick the movie?
We both agreed on Fight Club.
Oh wow That's always nice when everyone can agree on the same movie.
I am jealous of my coworker, he is very smart and athletic
Some people have better cards then we do in life. It's how you play your cards though.
My cat is buts. He meows all night long. Its getting ridiculous.
Why did you get a cat?
I'm starting university in two days and I'm kind of stressed because I'll be studying with new teachers and I have no idea what they will be like
Wow, that sounds intense! I hope you'll find out there was nothing to be stressed about after all!
Yeah but I hate having mean teachers , the ones that are not open for different ways of explaining things. So I really hope I won't have anyone like that
We'll I hope you won't have any of those mean teachers! Maybe you'll have some awesome ones?
My dog pooped on the rug last night.
I hate when they do that! Were you able to clean the rug?
Yes, but I was so angry at the little runt!
I bet! Time to get him trained a little better.
My younger brother was hit by a drunk driver and injured badly, losing a leg
Ohh, I am sorry. How is he feeling now?
He continues to have problems and may lose an arm that was injured, we are all just heartbroken about it
Ohh, that's so bad. It was not even your brother's fault. I really feel sorry for him.
One time I cheated in a math quiz, I really shouldn't have
How come you had to cheat on the quiz?
My brother pulled a mean prank
What kind of prank did he pull on you?
I dropped the stromboli.
Dang, that must have been difficult to clean up, what did you eat after that?
My friend was really looking forward to it. We had ramen instead.
Ramen, ah you must be in college?
I know I broke up with my ex, but I can't help but feel irritated when he talks about going on dates.
That must be weird to talk to your ex still.
I don't get to see my only niece too often. I was supposed to babysit her recently, but it fell through. I was kinda sad I didn't get to see her.
I'm sorry you don't get to see her much. I don't see mine often either. I'm sure it did make you sad.
We just don't live super close so it always makes it harder.
Yeah, I understand that. I live about 45 minutes from mine and everyone is so busy all the time. Maybe you will be able to see her soon.
Got a pizza last night. It gave me food poison. Now I'm stilling here sick and angry.
Oh gosh, I am sorry. Did you let the pizza place know?
My dad gave me this necklace way back in the day and it is so cool. I wear it every day.
That's so sweet! I bet he is an awesome dad!
About two weeks ago my wife got sick with Tonsilitis.
