A new haircut can do wonders! I always feel like a million bucks after.
I wasn't too sure about it but all the lovely compliments really made me feel good!
I bet you looked great! Those compliments would've made me feel good too!
I am faithful to my girlfriend all the time, I wish that was not so rare
Oh, what happened?
Nothing for me, but other people are not faithful
Oh that's bad. I feel sorry for you.
My friend won the lottery whcih is awesome
That's great! How much did they win?
About 1k, it was really cool
That's good. I bet he was happy.
My dog pooped on the rug today. I was so peeved!
I hate when that happens and I don't even have a dog
My husband's sister was living with us. She was acting rude so we had to kick her out.
Oh no that is terrible. Are you guys still talking now?
My son and wife are coming for a visit. Been a long time since I have seen them
Wao That's so cool you must so excited, how long has it been?
Friend of mine just spent the last 3 days in st pete looking at houses and she bought one pretty much for cash. Must be nice. I don't blame her. I would too.
We'll maybe you can too one day , I hope you do at the very least.
Some day I'll win the lottery and be able to haha. I'm actually happy for her. Also means I can go visit and have a place to say.
That's what my friends told me when we moved to Colorado for school. Free couchrides for life.
I remember one time when I was little I was running around in the basement when I wasn't supposed to be.
Gee that sounds fun, but did you get in trouble?
Yeah, my mom had told me multiple time to not run in the basement. Next thing I know, I tripped on a lamp cord making the lamp fall and break into pieces.
Oh no! That's no fun. I hope They're not still mad at you!
I applied for a job last week.
Oh you did? What kind of job?
I felt good getting medicine today. I think it will make me feel better
That is good to hear. Have you been I'll for a while. I hope not.
Just over a week, its been rough
That's really to bad. I hope the medicine works We'll and you are back to normal very soon!
My brother got a really high-paying job and now spends all his time flaunting his money.
I bet that's kind of a pain. How are you dealing with it?
Not very We'll! I mostly just stew and complain about it and wish I had his money and lifestyle.
I bet. It's so annoying when people show off like that.
MY friend didn't invite me to her sons birthday
That must make you feel bad. Being left out by someone you do not expect to, is the worst
Yeah. I thought we were close. I don't think I did anything to her
Now you have learned a valuable lesson and know how she really feels toward you
I saw a dodge viper in the parking lot yesterday. Probably one of the coolest American made cars!
Those cars are pretty slick, what color was it?
My dad knew that I have recently hit a rough patch with my finances and gave me 2 grand. I can't thank him enough.
How kind of him! I bet that is going to help you out a lot!
It really is going to help a lot. I feel so blessed!
Dads are the best, what would we do without them?

quality_notes: Looks for the underlying need rather than the surface fight.

messages.content: We argued and said things we can't take back.
Arguments that leave things unsaid tend to weigh more afterwards. What was the thing underneath that, if you had to name it?
I've been putting off buying a computer part that I needed and just noticed it went up 10%! I'm pretty mad at myself.
Oh no! I hate when that happens... Hopefully your computers holds on a little longer for it to go back down
I hope so too! I might have to just end up buying it. My hard drive is getting pretty old and running slow.
We'll good luck! I know how frustrating that can be

Yesterday I was unloading the dishwasher and I guess not paying enough attention and dropped one of my good mixing bowls that busted all over the floor. It took so long to clean up. I was so mad at myself.
Oh no! I am so sorry!! I hate when something liek that happens. No one was injured?
They are too good to me
Hi friend who is too good to you?
We took the kids to Lion Country Safari. They had a lot of fun. It was just nice to be there with them and let them have fun.
That sounds like fun. Did you see any lions?
Yes! We always see them there!
What else do you see besides lioins?
My dog died this past December and I've had a really hard time getting over it. She was our family pet.

I am so sorry to hear that. I have been devastated by the loss of pets in the past, so I can understand what You're going through. I'm sure she was very loved and had a great life with you and your family.
Have you ever lived alone?
Yes and it was the worst experience of my life. Have you?
Yeah, just recently- I left my husband
Oh my, I hope you don't feel scared living alone
I can't wait for my baby boy. Less than 3 months to go now
That is so exciting. What have you done to prepare
You know, not much to be honest. Just a few clothes and things. Need the buggy asap
The buggy is important, I have a baby boy of my own.
My favorite watch broke today. :(
That's no good, how did you break it?
It broke on its own accord. No clue.
No good, are you going to get another one?
Its a tag heuer. I'm gonna get it fixed.
I'd buy it off you after it's fixed, I love tag heuer.
It was my grandfather's watch. I don't think you have enough money to cover its sentimental value.
I wouldn't maybe I could get some recommendations for a nice one?
Yesterday, I was caught taking the bus without paying. I felt so bad.
Oh yea I know the feeling
I had to pay a fine. Everyone was watching me. I had a feeling of guilt and shame.
Oof That's harsh I feel for you
My wife was sick all last week, so I had to stick by her side.
What did she get sick off , I'm sorry to hear that your a great to your wife
She caught a very bad cold. I brought her soup everyday and tended to her every need.
When I get married I want to be like you , and take care of my loved one

The other day I was in a building and I was heading towards an elevator. I was rushing towards it because it was closing. I tripped right as I got in and slammed my head into the wall inside, and then had to hang out with everybody afterward as it slowly went up. Felt so dumb
That must have been painful and a little embarrassing!

A little while ago, my friend went on another beach vacation. It was her 3rd one for the year. My family and I hadn't been on vacation for several years, due to issues beyond our control, so I begrudged her trip a bit.
Being jealous of another person is a perfectly fine response. Despite this, you never know what is going on behind the scenes, she may have taken out huge loans just to fund her trips.
Yes, true, I know they tend to let bills go for things like that, which I don't do.
I bet you would go on many vacations if you did the same as her. Instead, you are being a responsible person and doing what is best for your future.
I used to swim competitively when I was a kid. I started around 4th grade.
That is great. Do you still swim?
I will pass a examen next monday. I reviewed all the content for the course
Good for you! Studying can be a real challenge sometimes.
I have been having nightmares every night.
Sorry to hear that. What happens during your nightmare?
It's about life of course! I could handle it if it were demons and ghosts..But real life nightmares...Unpleasant. I want to go to sleep and get some peace from that stuff- not relive it lol
We'll I hope you can find some peace from those dreams.
I had just went on my break after a long morning at work, so I got chipotle. As soon as I stepped out of my car with my food, I dropped my bowl on the floor
Oh no! I bet you were so mad! Were you able to find something else to snack on?
I was happy to see that my son got perfect attendance for the entire school year
That is amazing!! I bet you are so proud!
Yes he didn't make a fuss a single day
That sounds like a really great kid, your doing a fantastic job!!
I was in a hurry to get home but I hit every red light and was late. By the time I got home I was fit to be tied.
Did you make it home in time?
Last week I was so upset when my dog jumped up on the table and started eating my child's birthday cake! I really yelled at the mutt!
Oh no, I hope your kid wasn't too upset. Maybe need to lock the dog in another room when food is out.
My food order today did not turn out as We'll as I had hoped.
Sorry to hear! What all did you order? And what was wrong with it?
Everything was cold. We had burgers and fries. You can't eat cold fries.
Cold fries are the *worst* b/c the potatoes are just gross at that point. Did you get your money back, at least?
When I was playing ball at the gym someone got hurt.
That is too bad. How did they get hurt?
My child is having his first birthday soon.
Congrats, how fast did it go by?
Way too fast, it was like I blinked.
Ugh I was hoping that is not the case, I would want my kid to be young forever
My favorite pizza joint went out of business.
Oh no! Do you have any alternatives?
I feel nostalgic when playing old school games with my bro
Nice, me too, are you playing Nintendo games?
Yes and also Sega Genesis. We play these on the xbox one though via emulation
I remember these game We'll, like Contra and Battle Toads.
I'm impressed with how We'll our pool is coming a long, it should be ready by next summer!
Sweet!, must be a really big pool if you have to wait until next summer.
I just returned from a trip to Canada, and I was so surprised by how friendly everyone was there!
Wow, I didn't know that! Did you have a good time?
It was a very pleasant surprise to me too! I had a wonderful time, the customer service was completely outstanding!
That's wonderful! I am so glad that you had a good time. Maybe I will visit there one day.
My dog died, I feel so lonely
I'm really sorry to hear that. How long did you have it for?
It been 2 days now :(
That's really tough right now. I hope You're doing something fun to keep yourself occupied.
I'm so excitied about going to my friend's big party tomorrow night! I really can't wait!
Parties are so much fun! Are you celebrating anything special, or is the party just a get together?
My neighbor has a dog that won't shutup
That has to be really annoying. Have you called animal control?
I hope you get it? Was the interview good?
I didn't have an interview. Did you?
My radiator broke down in my car that I rely heavily on.
Oh no! Sorry to hear that. Can you get it fixed?
I had a job interview last week
How did it go?
My son got picked to be on the soccer team that he was on last year!
Yay!! That is great news! He must be so happy he made it!
Two days left before the trip, I was beside myself.
Where did you go? You went alone?
I went to Disney world, my entire family tagged along.
That is awesome, I've been there when I was a kid and had a lot of fun!
Have you ever had a strong attachment and love for an animal? I have had several.
Yes I love animals and have 3 dogs right now.

We'll then you will understand the love I had for my pitbull named Lily. We had a special bond and when she died it broke my heart. Never leave a candle burning and leave the house. OUr house burned and she died of smoke inhalation. I will never forget her!
I'm sorry that happened to you and I will take your advice.
I was walking in to work and I slipped on some black ice
Ouch, are you alright?
It was scary I couldn
I bet. Did your work cover your medical bills?
I usually hate to ask for help, so when my friends all surprised me by taking turns bringing us meals for 2 weeks after my 4th child was born I was blown away. I was so relieved to have help.
Wow, 4 children my first is on the way and I'm freaking out. You must have great friends.
That is so exciting, congratulations! We moved 17 hours away from family, so having a great group of friends is really important to us.
Thank You. That is our next step we are moving from NYC to Miami after the baby. How can we find friends like yours?
As a kid, I was SO frightened any time there was a tornado warning. Not sure if it was the Wizard of Oz effect or what -- I just remember being frozen with fear.
Oh, wow! My son was terrified of tornadoes because of that darn movie, and we don't really even get tornadoes where we live! Did you ever live through a tornado?

That's the thing -- NO! I mean, there were some that were kind of close -- but NOTHING like what so many folks have to deal with. I just remember wanting a basement sooooo badly -- not something that's common where I grew up!
Aw, poor little thing! How did you overcome this? Or, are you still afraid of them?

My mom said the best thing once when I was babysitting and a tornado warning went off and I didn't want my own fear to affect the little boy I was with -- she was on the phone and just said "You have big plans for the future, right? Nothing is going to get in the way of that." For some reason, it worked a charm ;-)
Your mom sounds awesome! Wow, what a cool thing to say!
I cried for a week when I found out my had a miscarriage.
That is terrible, I would cry as We'll.
Yea, I do not know if we will ever have kids now.
You can always adopt, That's what we did!
I can't believe she left me.
I'm sorry to hear that. How long were you together?
I was at the store last week and slipped on some water on the floor I didn't see. I broke my leg! I was mortified!
Oh, no! That's awful! Are you still in pain?
Last week I felt ruined
Why did you feel ruined?
I performed badly in the annual presentation
What did your leaders say about it?
My daughter will be in high school next year
Oh man, I feel for you. Kids grow up so fast. Do you feel prepared for it?
I don't. She is a young woman now and its too much for me lol
I hear you. I have a 8 year old daughter and it feels like she was born yesterday.
I am going to a party this weekend
Awesome! Are you excited to go?
Yes. I already have my outfit together.
You sound prepared! I am sure you will make a good impression on the other party goers!
I recently began my own online business. I'm hopeful that my dried starfish kiosk will take off soon.
Wow, that sounds unique. What exactly do you sell?
I sell dried starfish that I find on the local beach! I figure there must be a niche for it somewhere, since I enjoy collecting them so much.
Oh! We'll duh, silly me. I thought it was food or something. Do you sell other things too?
At work, a new coworker keep looking at me in weird way. I feel very uncomfortable.
You should probably talk to that co worker and if it doesn't stop I would report it to the HR
My coworker got a raise over me.
When is the beat down scheduled for and how can I help?
So the other day at work I was walking to the kitchen and tripped and fell. A bunch of people saw. I felt like an idiot.
Oh no! Are you hurt? Don't even worry about them. It happens to the best of us.
I wasn't hurt. Nobody laughed but I still can't believe I didn't that.
I'm glad You're okay. It is so embarrassing. I've done that before but at least you got back up! Pride can heal and a body takes longer to!
I have a coworker that comes in to work late everyday and takes a million breaks
That is annoying. Did you told your manager about it?
I have. She will not do anything about it and it drives me even more nuts.
Why she doesn't want to do anything about it?
I stubbed my toe in the shower this morning...It felt like my world was coming to an abrupt end.
Oh no! I hate when that happens! Does it still hurt?
It does. It's all red and puffy. I am afraid that it's going to fall off any minute now!
Sorry to hear that! Definitely need to make sure it doesn't fall off!
That one luggage bag that my passed uncle gave me as a present when I was about to start my college life away from home, I discarded it today as it became very old. It was the only reminder of him
Oh no! Why didn't you keep it in the attic or something?
It became unusable. I just decided it was its time to be thrown. I feel my uncle was here himself, not his reminders
Oh I see. I bet it was a sad day then.
I feel ready to cook tonight!
Nice! What so happens to be on the Master Chef's menu?
Tonight it is gonna be a gourmet pizza I think!
That's sounds delicious. I am sure it'll be much better than whatever Pizza Hut can make!
I was scared the other night when I heard several gunshots in a row.
Oh wow, I hope you are fine!
I'm anxious to meet my wife's ex-husband. Hopefully it will be civil and not awkward!
I can definitely understand how you would be worried about that. I think I'd have to decline - LOL! You are a good person for being willing to meet with him.
Yeah, there is a kid in the picture so we have to meet at some point! I wish I could decline, haha.
We'll, yes if there is a child involved, then you've got to deal with him at some point. I hope it goes We'll for you though.
My girlfriend's dog was a 17 year old Chihuahua who emerged from a bathroom at a party in 1999.
Emerged from a bathroom? Intiguing. What do you mean?
He just sort of showed up and no one knew where he came from. He passed away recently after running away from our friends farm and being struck by a car.
OH - I'm sorry to hear that, but it sounds like he had a bit of character about him
I'm going for an interview for a job on Monday and am feeling nauseated when I think about it.
Hey, I bet you'll do great! Nothing to stress about.
I FINALLY get my lawn mower fixed on thursday.
That's great. I'm sure it was cheaper than having to buy a brand new one.
This time yes, you can get good priced parts online. I am strangely excited to use it and have my yard nice again!
I bet. The grass has been growing so fast right now. Your yard is going to look great again.
I've finally finished writing the book that I've been working on for the last few months.
Great. Are you going to get it published?

I was forced into covering for my coworker who was supposed to give a large speech to a packed auditorium. I had no time to prepare for it and really no idea what I was doing. I still had to somehow make my way throught the speech!
Wow that sounds pretty stressful. How do you think you did?
I feel all right about it. I tried my best and did somehow make my way through the speech. But I know it really wasn't very polished at all.
As long as you did your best, I say have no regrets. You made the most of a bad situation.
It made me mad when I saw a dent in my car door last week
Oh no, do you know what caused it?
Someone elses door
Oh god. I'm guessing they didn't take responsibility?
My marriage give me hopefulness about the life. Exactly I want to say is may not it's marriage actually it's my wife given me the hope about the life.
Wao, that sound like a great strong realtionship you have with her, so glad to hear that!
I am sick that I send Obama money for his campaign.
Oh man, why are you even still sending him money?
So I went to the gym the other day and I was using a traidmill and somebody told me "get off the traidmill fat ***
What???? That's terrible!! What a horrible person!
I was so furious! I'm not even that fat! That was so mean
I bet! I mean you pay for gym membership, you can stay on any equipment as long as you want!
I've been trying really hard to get a promotion at my company but they just hired someone to fill that spot from outside of the company.
Ahh, that's too bad, did you mention it to your boss?
My boss is pretty temperamental and doesn't like people questioning his decisions, probably a bad idea.
Oh I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe next time!
I've been letting a stranger stay with us this past couple of days
A complete stranger? How the heck did that happen? I'm sure you must be confident that it's safe, if They're staying with you.
Seems like they were really down on their luck. I felt really bad for them.
So, are they trying to apply for jobs and stuff? How long do you think you'll let them stay for?
I can no longer stand christmas, because once when I was thirteen I had been told I would be getting a playstation. Christmas came and I never got it.
Oh man! I'm so sorry! Is there any part of the season you can still enjoy?
I quit my job last week
Oh what happened?
My sister in law and her fiance are always taking trips abroad and we hardly ever go anywhere.
Why don't you join them?
We definitely don't have money for that, plus there are four of us.
Why don't you get another job?
I'm so upset me sister gets to stay out as late as she wants but I have to be in at 8 PM its not fair
Dear lord, how old are you?
Does it really matter? I mean I feel like they have always played favorites.
I was joking. I haven't a curfew since I was 17. I'm an only child so wouldn't know much about favorites.
I was driving through flood waters and my car stalled out.
Holy cow. I hate when that happens. It happens a lot here since I live near the ocean. How did it end up?
My elephant pooped on the rug last night.
Oh no! I bet it was a huge poop! What did you do with it?
I left it to fester. There is no way I'm going all Jurassic Park and moving all that dung! I harvested his tusks and sent them to the black market because I was so mad!
We'll that's what he gets for pooping on the rug! He knew better!
I have been wondering how it feels to be without someone
It must feel lonely, for sure, but maybe they cope with it in different ways.
I believe everyone should be loved by someone so that they don't stay lonely
Yeah, it is quite sad knowing there are some people who have literally no one.
On my way home I got stuck in traffic. And everyone kept honking and yelling at eachother
That's so annoying. I hate traffic! Was there an accident or was it just rush hour?
I am going to see a band that I have wanted to see for a long time.
That's awesome. What band is it?
This year has been the worst for rains and flooding. My house was recently affected and heavily damaged.
I'm sorry to hear that do you have insurance to help you?
I watched as the knife cut my buddies arm wide open.
Omg it must have been quite an experience for you
I was disraut, I couldn't believe my eyes.
I hope he is alright now
I found out my daughter doesn't even attend her college classes anymore.
Oh wow, are you paying for her classes?
Yes I am. And That's why I am so disappointed in her tardiness..
I have 2 daughters myself and hope that they get scholarships
Saw a marching band pass by my work today. Kind of miss playing my flute
That's an interesting thing to know! Have you thought about doing it as a hobby?
My husband and I are trying to have a baby
Aww! I bet that is so exciting! Do you want a girl or boy?
I can't wait til I get paid
What are you going to get
My dog died last week. I've been so depressed without her.
I am sorry to hear that.
One time when I was in Kindergarten, I needed to go to the restroom. The teacher did not let me, so I peed myself
Oh no! Did you get in trouble?
A couple months ago, my wife and I got divorced.
I am sorry to hear that, what happened?
We just grew apart I guess. House seems so empty with her and the kids gone.
Did you try therapy at all or counseling?
My dog of 10 years recently passed away.

I truly do feel bad that you have to endure that. My girlfriend and I were just talking about how horrible she's going to feel when she loses her Havanese pup at some point in the distant future, since she's so close to her. I hope you can grieve the loss of your great friend in a healthy way.
I really miss Hastings. I spent so much time in that store when I first started college. Both just hanging out and working.
I remember that store! I loved going shopping there, was it your first job?
I am waiting for my medical tests to come back.
Are you worried and nervous?
I was so mad when I failed my science test. I knew I should have done better
It happens even when we study hard sometimes!
I flew all the way to New York City to buy a designer dress for the prom.
You must be wealthy. I would love to visit NYC
I am, thanks, but I wouldn't go there... Becky STILL managed to get the same dress as me! I am so mad!
OMG! I know how you feel
I broke my new phone yesterday.
Uh oh, that's bad. Did you have insurance for it?
We took a big leap of faith with our teenage son this weekend. We left him home overnight alone for the first time.
Wow, that would have scared me, how did it go?
It went great! He's such a responsible kid, and we felt confident he would treat our home with respect and wouldn't have a party or anything like that!
That's good I have 2 teenage daughters and dread the idea of leaving them by themselves
Last night I turned 8 shades of red. I was blushing so bad
What made you blush so hard?
I felt really good tonight after I got back from the cinema.
Oh that sounds like fun! What kind of film did you see?
I'm looking forward to the future a lot lately.
We'll, we all do. I hope you achieve what you set out to do
The chain on the necklace my boyfriend gave me broke and I lost the pendant
Where were you when you noticed that is broke? Maybe it's possible to find it!
I cried all night when I found out Trump won the election.
Why he is so much better then the other option. I mean they were all crazy but I can't imagine a regime under Clinton.
They were tears of joy, trust me if Clinton had won it would of been tears of fear.
Honestly they are both crazy. It's a sad time when those two were the best we had to offer.
My grandma fell sick, and I have been the one taking care of her
I hope she gets better. It must be very hard seeing loved ones in sickness.
Oh yeah, she's getting better, she is so lovely .I love her so much
That's wonderful. I hope that her sickness hasn't been too taxing on you.
We are supposed to do the amusement park, tomorrow but I think it may rain.
I hope it's nice for you. Do you have any alternate plans?
I am about to enter the workforce again soon. Hopefully
What job are you going to get?
I haven't started looking yet. The kids are all going to be in school now and I can work outside the home though.
What did you use to do for work?

I feel like if there's one thing equal to if not greater than sex it's seeing all my bills paid, debt nonexistent, income far greater than expenses and a nice fat check from tax returns at the end of the year.
I agree, man. Almost nothing feels as good as financial security.
Exactly. Good lovin don't pay the bills
But good lovin' can be a bill.. If you know what I mean.
Today I saw the lottery was for 36 million at the gas station so I decided to buy a ticket.
Do you think you can win the lottery
I love to help my daughter with her school work and exams.
It sounds like you are a great parent. Does she appreciate all the help you give?
I am dreading the two hour trip to the grocery store this week.
Wow, yes, I always feel the same way! I would love to pass of grocery shopping to someone else.
I actually was able to keep my promise to this girl I was seeing?
We'll its always a good thing to keep a promise. Can I ask what the promise was?
She wanted me to make a date. I told her I would, but I didn't realize I would be so busy at work and it was getting late.
We'll I applaud your dedication and faithfulness in making sure you kept the promise, good job!
Thank you. I actually had to stop what I was doing and just leave. Luckily I was able to work on it some more when I got home from the date, so my boss never found out I left.
See things work out We'll when you make doing the right thing a priority. I am glad you followed through on it

quality_notes: Separates passive ideation from immediate risk by asking directly, without alarm.

messages.content: Some days I think everyone would be better off if I wasn't here.

I'm really sorry you're feeling that, and I'm glad you said it. That kind of thought is heavy to carry.

Are you thinking about hurting yourself right now, or is this more of a background feeling? Either way, please talk to someone who can be with you. In India, Tele-MANAS is free on 14416, and 112 is for emergencies.
One time I saw a creepy person run towards me in the night out in the streets
Dang, how fast did you run away?
I froze up because I was terrified. It was just my brother though
Did you tell him how creepy he is lol
Just came back from a job interview. Seem to hit it off with the interviewer.
That is great! Have you been looking for a job for long?
I'm preparing to run a marathon. I'm not a runner and never participated in any race but I think I can do it!
Oof, are you sure you don't want to try a half marathon first? You'll need to train quite a bit before doing a full marathon
I've been training for the past 4 months and I already signed up and paid for this marathon so I have no choice lol
Oh! We'll then stay hydrated! I hope you do We'll!
I was so blissful after the births of both my girls. Such a sense of peace and relief on both a mental and physical level!

I wish I could relate. I'm a male, so I'll never know the pain and/or the reward that comes with growing a human being inside your body. It's such an impressive thing to go through, and no matter what, mothers will never get enough credit. You deserve serious props. What ages are they now?
The thing the bugs me the most at my job is really lazy workers , they only work when management is around and as soon as they leave back to being lazy
We'll That's part of being in the workforce, work when everyone is looking, hang out when they are not. Most people aren't paid enough to care
I recently read a really good bock. It was so inspirining.
That's awesome, reading is my favorite past time as We'll. What book?
Hitchhikers Guide to the Galaxy. Its such a great book!
Oh I've read that, That is a really good book, I even enjoyed the movie as We'll.
I'm very happy that summer is almost over and fall is around the corner.

I used to be that way, because I love holidays and the mood it puts everyone in. But I'm starting to hate how short the fall and winter days are, and how quickly it gets dark. Now that I've been exercising outside more lately, I hate losing that time in the sun
I was the first person to receive a pretigious award at my college after years of the award being on offer.
That is great. Where is the award displayed?
Every year I get ready for hurricane season the day the season starts.
Is it that time where you live? How do you prepare?
Yeah it has been for about two months and will be until November. We stock gas and extra water and food.
Wow. That must make you nervous. Where do you live?
I have not been in the best mood today.
I'm sorry to hear that. Is something wrong?
The dog I grew up with died a few years ago. I was really sad about it.
Aaawww, I'm sorry you had to go through that
I was really upset when my daughter went into labor and I couldn't be there.
I'm so sorry but what a joyous occasion.
So, I may be in the market for a new laptop or a repair at least, thanks to a little mishap.
Oh no! What happened to your laptop? If you get a new one which one are you looking at?
Last night was crazy. I couldn't relax even though I really wanted to. I was in a house full of people screaming and yelling.
What was going on!?
I have a huge exam coming up tomorrow.
Have you been studying? That is intimidating but I bet you'll do great! What's the subject?
When my dog passed away, I felt so helpless. She was old and suffering and I felt angry that there was nothing I could do other than put her down.
That's so sad. You did your best. How old was she?
I made a list of what to bring to the waterpark. Hopefully, I am ready and didn't forget anything.
Did you get sunscreen and a waterproof belly bag and a hat?
Yep! I forgot sunscreen last time and the sunburns were awful...Not again this time!
Oh no! Yes it's the number one thing to not forget. I hope you all have fun!
My pet alligator bit me today. Never been so irritated in my life!
Pet alligator! Why do you have him as a pet, is he a rescue?
Nope! I got him 20 years ago at a Turkish Bazaar. Little tyke bit my hand clean off.
We'll, I'm not sure about that or how are you typing?!
I got a $20 gift card from the place I work at today.
I bet that was a nice surprise!
I'm really looking forward for the new Greek restaurant to open here.
I have never had greek cuisine
I was just accused from my wife that I stole $10 from her Purse.
Oh wow, why would she think you stole the money?
My son won the gold medal conducted in his school. I am so happy about it
You must be so proud, but what was it for?
I'm stoked to go to the park later today
I bet you are. What are you going to do?
I was the one who caused the car accident.
I'm sorry, how do you feel?
Earlier this summer I had to have a biopsy of a suspicious mass, to determine if it was cancerous or not. There was a lot of waiting involved which made me very nervous.
Oh, man! That is my nightmare! You must have been so worried! Are you OK?
Every night, around midnight, I hear terrible noises coming from the woods outside of my home.
That sounds scary. I couldn't sleep with that.
Don't you hate that feeling when you get lonliness and it feels like it's going to make you vomit?
Yes I do hate being all alone. That's how I feel when my boyfriend leaves town for work.
:( Long distance is hard too! I just have to remember for myself that it is better to be at peace then to deal with horrible drama.
Yes you have to do what is best for yourself. Take care of you before others.
I was so happy for my son when he won the state championship for tennis
That's great! Congratulations and We'll done. He must practice long and hard to get to that stage in the game.
He was working hard for years.
Then its all paid off and you should both be very proud. Perhaps he'll turn pro, do you think?
There was one piece of pie left in the fridge. Instead of sharing it, I ate it. I kind of feel bad.
Oopsy. I hope it was worth it.
It might not be when my wife returns and sees it gone. I look super guilty right now.
LOL! Can you run out and get another pie before she gets home?
I have a performance evaluation at work coming up soon, but I'm not very worried at all.
Good luck, are you pretty confident You're going to do We'll?
Yup, I bust my butt at work and make sure I always do my work right! I'm expecting a raise soon.
Yay! That's what makes all the hard work worth it. Congratulations!
I was in a hospital and a guy game in with some really bad burns.
Oh my gosh. What happened to him?
The door bell rang last month. I wasn't expecting anyone, but it was my daughter and her family from way up north.
Sounds like a nice surprise! My god how beautiful.
I baked recently and I was happy to find that my cheesecake was fluffy like the Japanese kind
Yummy! That's great. It's always nice when you bake something and it turns out just right.
Yes! The top kind of fell a bit flatter after, but it looked kinda like a souffle
We'll, that's okay. I'm sure it tasted fantastic.
I am so upset with my kids.
What did they do this time? Kids are always getting into stuff.
A coworker is stealing money at work. He threatened me if I said anything about it.
What are you going to do?
I am too scared to do anything.
Oh, I hope you seek help for that
We got a new girl in class yesterday and I bet my friends that I could get her number! Let's just say lunch was on them.
Wow that is really confident on your end. Are you going to do anything with the girl
My daughter is being so lazy this summer.
I think that's the usual for kids. How old is she
I stole a bottle of wine from the store.
Do you feel guilty now?
I got a makeover and bought fashionable clothes for the date
Oh that sound like a lot of fun!! Hope your date ended up being worth all that work.
I was out in the woods naked.
Oh my gosh I hope you were ok!
My brother promised not to tell my parents my secret, and of course he still did.
That was not very nice of him. Did your parents react We'll?
No, and He really shouldn't have told. He promised me.
What a mean thing to do.
I dislike customer service agents with bad attitudes.
Oh I do too, they must have been having a bad day
I really felt like a fool last night.
Oh my, what did you do, may I ask?
I am so happy with my life right now.
That must be a great feeling! Good for you! You should be proud that things are going We'll and not take it for granted.
Nice advice , thanks.I will make sure I follow the advice.
Good deal! I am happy to help!

quality_notes: Names the specific loneliness of proximity, in natural Hindi.

messages.content: मेरे सभी दोस्त बिज़ी हैं और मैं अकेला महसूस कर रहा हूँ।
लोगों के बीच होने के बावजूद अकेलापन महसूस करना बहुत गहरा अनुभव है। क्या आपने हाल में किसी से दोबारा बात करने की कोशिश की है?
I am ok with coming in third in my race.
Third is very good! What kind of race?
The father had no money to pay his fees so I helped him now he bought me a car
Wow, how did he get so much money if he didn't have money to pay his fees, and what were the fees for?
Oh he graduated and he is now working with Google, he bought me a car after 1 year of work
What a great job to get.
I just enjoyed grocery shopping for the first time in a very long time. I've found my perfect restaurant/store and spent a very happy 40 mins or so wandering around it.
That's great! Did you get anything you are especially excited about? It's a restaurant and a store?
Yes, it's both. I got a chickpea curry with basmati rice that a local Indian lady made. And a bag of dragon tongue beans, which are delicious!
Dragon tongue beans! I've never heard of them! What do they look like?
I have a hole in the sole of my only pair of shoes.
Aw, that's no good, are you going to buy new ones or patch them up?
Haven't seen my friends in a while, we had such a great time at the lake.
Nice. When was the last you have seen them?
3 years ago.
Why you didn't contact them?
I was cleaning out my closet and noticed some old photos I took of my very first car. Man, it makes me miss the days when life was simple
Those were the days, my friend. What kind of car did you have?
I had an old Ford Taurus. It was not much, but to me it was the best car ever!
Ford makes some pretty nifty cars! I have a Ford Focus myself. Not much, but it has killer gas mileage.
I have not had any sleep for the past three days only to come back home and my neighbor is having a loud party
Dang, that's not good. What did you end up doing??
I miss my dog, Baby Girl, poor thing passed away last year after 15 years.
Oh, that is SO hard. It sounds like she had a long and happy life. I'm sure you miss her so much.
Absolutely she was my favorite pet I ever had,
What kind of dog was she?
My neighbor returned my lawn gnome today.
How nice of you to loan it out! Have to admit, never heard of someone "borrowing" a lawn ornament though.
I was happy when my brother got us game tickets. It was going to be fun
What game will you be going to?
Everything is falling into place for me.
That's great to hear. What's going on?
All my cucumber plants died this week due to too much rain
Oh man. What a bummer! I love cucumbers and hummus! Do you have anything else You're growing that survived?
My tomatoes and peppers are doing really We'll for starters.
Oh good, I'm glad the entire garden didn't get ruined. I would love to plant a garden one day soon since I went vegan plant based about 3 months ago. Happy tomato eating to you!
My friends mother got diagnosed with cancer last month and its been hard on her.
So sorry to hear that. It is truly horrifying and I wish and hope for nobody to be hit with this calamity
Dealing with the passing of my mother-in-law was hard. My wife really struggled, I hope I did enough for her.
I'm really sorry to hear that. When did she pass away?
Thank you. It was just a couple of weeks ago. Still hurting here.
I'm sure with time the pain will pass. Try to stay positive!
My brother just got his dream job recently, so I am very happy for him!
That is great news! I am sure he feels a great deal of accomplisment
Yes, I think he does too. He worked hard for it, so I'd say he deserves it.
I hope he enjoys his new job and can celebrate
I love the new Tesla.
I love it too! It's really fancy.
I just had to replace one of the window panes in my house.
How come? And was it a pain to replace it?
I'm not sure what happened. I had to have a guy come out to replace it, and couldn't meet him, so my wife had to.
I hope he did a good job!
My said he did! I had quite a bit of confidence in him, based on others' feedback.
Awesome, I'm glad to hear that. Sometimes it's hard to find contractors with good reputation.
Our cat had to many health problems, so we had to put him down.
I'm so sorry to hear that. How long had your cat been with you?
I had him for 17 years, he lived a full and happy life, but I was not ready for him to go.
It's always hard to go through that. That's why I'm wary of having any pets
I went for a job interview, and it seemed to go pretty We'll.
That's great! When will you find out?
I got an item for a birthday gift from my shopping wishlist and I am excited even thought it's been 3 months
Cool what did you get?
It's sad for me to think about my parents growing old and not how I once remembered them.
I know the feeling, it makes you wish time would slow down
Right, or you could reverse it, but I guess that's life.
That's right, going through the same feeling with my son
My boyfriend had to go out of town for a few days and I was left alone in the apartment. I didn't have many friends here at the time.
I know how that feels. I bet it was boring and lonely.
Yeah, it was. I didn't have much to do all that weekend and the apartment was quiet.
Did you get out and do anything?
I found a gigantic spider in my shower!
Wow I would be so sad if I saw that
I was really freaked out. It must have come up through the drain.
Yea I would die if I saw that
I get so mad when I see or hear about kids getting bullied. It is so unfair.
It definetly is. I'm glad schools are taking a stance against it
I've seen videos on the internet where kids are crying to their parents that they were made fun of because their race and health illnesses. Very messed up.
It definetly is. I hope we move forward to eliminate this issue
I sat on the worlds scariest rollercoaster. They weren't kidding.
Wow, that sounds intense. What were some of the features it had?
It went upside down and 100m metres high. I was beyond afraid and wanted it to end soon.
That does sound scary! I hope you at least enjoyed it a little!
My girlfriend dumped me last month.
I am sorry to hear that. Was it a clean break?
No, it was terrible. I hate to be all by myself.
I can understand that. It is hard at first but then it gets better.
I am very happy that I have graduated today!
Wow, that's exciting! Congratulations, you must be very proud.

quality_notes: Separates internalised feedback from the person's actual performance.

messages.content: My professor said I wasn't good enough and I've been replaying it all day.
One comment can echo for a long time, especially when you're already trying hard. Does it reflect how you're actually doing, or do you think it was harsh?
Imagine, I started working out two months ago, only to weigh myself and I have gained some weight
I hope it was maybe the weight of the muscle that the scale was picking up.
I had to eat dinner by myself.
I hate eating dinner by myself. What happened that you ended up eating dinner alone?
I made it on time to the bus stop.
That is good. Where you running late
My dog got very sick and lay in bed for a couple weeks. I was so concerned.
That is so sad I hope your pet gets better
So...The sewer line backed up into our house last week.
Oh no! That's a smelly situation to be in. What did you end up doing to fix it?
Due to various internal problems at my job nearly all workers positions will be reassigned. In spite of this I plan to continue working for this company.
I am sorry to hear that will you still be needed for your job?
I am hoping that my versatility and ability to pick up on new things quickly will keep me employed. In which position I am not currently sure, but I like the company
That's great I am sure you will achieve success there.
I accidentally ran into a glass wall at work. D'oh :(
Are you ok?
This 8 year old girl gave a presention about her mom. We all cried.
That is so sad. What happened to her mom?
HUGS! I saw a mom and baby bunny around 8 and they were letting me talk to them. It was a bit shocking as usually bunnies take off whenever they see or hear anything.
Oh, how adorable! There are so many bunnies around right now. My parents house has especially a lot of them and they don't really run off like normal either.
Wow strange! I normally just see glimpses, I have two bunnies of my own but it was so sweet to see two just sitting and listening to me. The baby omg..So cute
That is so precious. I have never seen that before. Baby bunnies are the best! I've had 3 bunnies/rabbits in my lifetime and they were great pets. What are your bunnies' names?
Monkey Girl and Mousey :) One is a lionhead..I adore her and the other is a lop eared big old bunny, scared of everything..Including Miss Monkey Girl.
Lol, oh no! My albino rabbit I had when I was younger was like that....Skittish beyond belief! Those are adorable names!

I had been unemployed for a long time until earlier this year. I originally wasn't sure if I was going to even interview for the position I did, but I'm glad I decided to. I got a call in late may from a merchandising company. I went back and forth in my mind after being rejected from many interviews over the past couple years. In the end I went for it, the interviewer liked what I had to say, and I was hired the same day! I've been working there ever since.
Congratulations! That's awesome. Sometimes it's scary to risk rejection, but it sounds like it totally paid off in this case.
Going to get some pizza after work. I love pizza.
I'm eating some pepperoni pizza as I'm typing this.. Washing it down with some beer, my kind of Tuesday night
I stole money from my mother's purse.
Oh, goodness. Why did you do such a thing?
I needed to pay my cable bill. I am so ashamed I did that.
Maybe next time ask her. I hope you pay her back when you can.
I am so prepared the exam tomorrow!
How hard have you been studying? Exams are extreme amounts of mental crunch time!
I knew I do We'll on my work project. I prepared hard
What kind of project was it? It's always satisfying to see hard work pay off.
It was for a marketing campaign, thank you
I'm sure you'll reap the rewards at your job in the long term.
I was mad when my brother canceled plans tonight. I was looking forward to hanging out
That sucks, Did you reschedule?
Not yet, I hope we do
I hate when that happens. Especially when the same people do it over and over.
I think I aced my supervisor exam!
Woo hoo! That is awesome! Congrats! When will you find out/
I should know something by tomorrow morning. Hopefully they tell me right away.
I hope so too! I'll be sure to keep my fingers crossed for you! Good luck!
The other day after hockey I found out my cat died, pretty miserable.
I'm so sorry to hear that. I lost my cat recently too.
I got caught cheating on my test. I feel so horrible.
Why did you feel you had to cheat? I am sure you could have passed if you had studied.
My dogs come first, I make sure I take care of them before anything else
We'll that's sweet. I bet they love you
I'm ready for hurricane season. I have my kit ready and everything.
That is great to be prepared. Where do you live?
South Alabama, near the Gulf.
Oh yeah, you definitely need to be prepared. Do you think you will get a hurricane?
My little brother cooked his first meal today and it was pretty good
What did he make?
He made spaghetting and garlic bread it was very good. He is 10
That's great! Did he enjoy doing it?
I get annoyed by my brothers sometimes, but that is life I guess
How come? What do your brothers do to annoy you?
I cried all day when my grandma died.
I'm sorry to hear that. You two were close?
I;m living my best life. I could'not be any happier.
Good to know. And what makes you life so good, huh?
Family is doing great, bussines is booming
What if it all comes crashing down on you!
My niece is super talented lately.
What is her best talent?
Art, she was accepted into a special program for high school.
Does she draw or paint? How any students are in this program?
I'm afraid to check my messages. The last line I saw from my friend is "we broke up
I'm sorry to hear that, you got to check though.
I will tonight. For now, I just want to brace myself.
What happened that lead to it?
I recently got to move to the city I've always wanted to live in and I couldn't be happier!
Congratluations! I bet your full of joy!
When I was in middle school, my older sister went to college, and I saw her dorm after she moved in.
What was it like I have always wanted to live in a dorm and go to colledge?
My co-worker got a promotion that I was pushing for her to get. I am so happy for her! She really does deserve it.
That is awesome. I bet she worked really hard to get that promotion. Good for her.
I got into an argument the other day with my 18 year old son. I still feel badly about it
Did you resolve things?
My son just started a new school. The communication with them has been terrible!
Oh dear. How do they let the parents know what's going on?
I sometimes find out but it seems so disorganized!
That sounds really frustrating. I'm sorry that's happening!
I am terrified of clowns
I'm not afraid of clown myself, but I can absolutely see how they can be terrifying to some people!
Yes, I hate the makeup they wear, it is just so creepy!
I agree with you. Those painted smiles and big, red noses can be so off-putting!
I woke up one morning and found a puppy in my bed. I wasn't expecting that!

Whoa! Was that a good surprise, or a bad surprise? I could see that going either way, but at least it would be exciting! I had that happen when I got one for Christmas. We'll, actually it was in my parent's bed, and I barged into their room to ask if we could go downstairs and open presents, and I saw the one they had gotten me and had been hiding to surprise me with.
I had good vibes all through out my final day in college I was so ready to graduate
Was? That almost makes it sound like you didn't graduate or something went wrong, did you graduate?
My parents were able to pay for me to attend college, however I feel bad for those who were not lucky enough to be born into those circumstances
Don't feel bad for the opportunity that you have. Life is not set out on an even keel so we all must make the best of our lot.
That's fair, just feels kind of unfair that some people are born into better circumstances. Then again, I guess life isn't fair.
I'm happy that you have this opportunity in life. Keep at it and be thankful for it.
My mother-law-donated a kidney to her cousin, who was sick.
Wow, that was very generous and courageous for her! How are they now?
Both patients are doing great, thank goodness! We were so worried.
That's great to hear. What a great story. Very inspiring. I'm so happy they are both healthy now.
I'm doing so We'll right now. I think I'm going to start dating again.
That sounds great! Did you just get out of a rough relationship?
Last night I woke up in the middle of the night and I couldn't move! I was completely awake but I couldn't make a sound or move!! It was so scary!!
Oh no! That might be one of my worst fears! Could you sleep any more after?
I did. I fell back asleep, I don't even remember how, all I remember is waking up in the morning. Apparently it's called sleep paralysis
I've heard of it, but I can't even imagine going through it. I'm sorry it happened to you.
I am so happy for my dad. He finally paid off his student debt loans after all these years. I can see a change in his demeanor and I feel so ecstatic for him!
I bet that is so relieving! It sucks how much debt you need to take on in order to go to school these days!
I know it really sucks. I am so proud of him getting through the tough times and he finally made it.
I hope he has a great career ahead of him!
I was pleasantly shocked to get a visit from my brother the other day. Made me happy to see him after such a long time.
How long has it been?
I hurt my neck today. I must have slept on it wrong and my sweet husband gave me a neck massage to help. It was so sweet.
Ouch, I've done that before. But how sweet of him, sounds like a keeper.
He's the best. I was able to get up and get cleaning and work done today thanks to him.
Ah, so he had ulterior motives and wanted the chores done! Just kidding. Glad You're feeling better.
Me and this girl were doing really We'll on Tinder and we even started dating. It didn't turn out We'll unfortunately.
Oh.. Sorry to hear that. May I ask what happened between the two of you to break things off?
I was shocked since things were going so We'll and then she suddenly dumped me.
Sorry buddy.. Sometimes things don't work out. I know it sucks, but you are better than that.
Everytime I'm on the train I swear I'm going to have a panic attack.
Why is that? Do you not like the train?
I wish my husband didn't have to go on his business trip today.
Where is he going and for how long?
He has to go to Chicago for business for a week. I'm gonna miss him.
Oh I hope he is safe. I hear there is a lot popping off there right now!
My husband is out of town for work for the next few weeks.
Aww, that must be kinda hard on you.
Yea.... I'm not sure what to do by myself in that big house of ours.
I've definitely been there, my husband is in the military so he's away often. I find it's helpful to stay busy, trying new hobbies help!
I got parcel the other day
What was in the parcel?
Chocolate and candy!
That sounds delicious! I wish someone would send me a package like that.
I was in a bad spot when my dad died. I just felt lost
I'm so sorry, was it a sickness?
I totally thought that I aced this calculus test I took like a year ago.
Did you passed the test?
I believe car prices will go down this year. And I am thinking of buying one
Really? I'm thinking about buying one myself. What kind are you getting?
I was unable to make my full rent this month.
Dang, that's rough. Are you set up for next month at least?
Whenever we moved abroad, I learned to trust my instinct and sense of adventure.
You sound like You're embracing life!
A co-worker of mine just got the promotion they wanted so badly. I feel really proud.
It's really nice that you feel that way, even though you wanted it. Think you'll get it next time?
I went for a job interview last friday and was told I would know by Friday of this week if I got the job.
Awesome! Do you think did We'll?

Went on the very first job interview after graduating. I was nervous, but I felt like it went fairly We'll. They said they would contact me soon, but it's been a week. I'm not sure what I should do at this point, but I'm staying positive.
They probably have to interview everyone else but it sounds promising!
I loaned some money to my friend at work. Turns out he quit a couple days ago and I won't be getting my money back as I have no way of contacting him..
Wow! What a jerk for him to up and leave with no way to contact him. Was it a lot of money?
It was a medium amount of money but still, he did me so dirty.
I'm so sorry, you should see if you can find him on social media!
I rented out my bedroom to Airbnb customers and when I returned it was left smelly and diapers every where.
Oh, that is horrible. I am sorry that happened to you!
Its okay. I called a deep cleaning company to clean it up because I so disgusted by it.
I don't blame you, I wouldn't want to mess with that either.
I just interviewed for a new job after applying last week!
Oh really, do you feel like you did a great job?
I do! I'm feeling very optimistic about it
That's good, it must be relieving to feel so confident.
I am angry because I didn't get served when it was my turn
What were you expected to be served?
I was at the mall and hug my mom and said to her: Time to go Mommy! And I wasn't her, can you imagine my reaction to it?
Oh, I'm sure you were embarrassed! But, maybe you can laugh about it now?
My oldest and my husband have always had a rough relationship. I've got to believe that as she gets older, it will get better!
I'm sure it will! I didn't get along with my dad until I became an adult.
That's always good to hear. But in the moment -- argh, my *heart*. How did your mom maneuver the differences between y'all? Did that wear on her?
Yes it did. I believe she just waited it out and tried to neutralize the conversation when we were together.
I really miss my family. It's hard to be 800 miles away
I bet! Hopefully you can take some time off and go see them soon!
It's really hard to do that in a one income household.
I understand, I'm sure your family misses you as We'll. Maybe you can meet half way for the holidays.
I feel alone whenever I think about my dad, he passed away last year
I'm so sorry. You have my deepest condolences. Its hard to not feel isolation with the death of someone you are close to. I can tell you it does get better and you are not alone. He lives on in you.
Yeah.. I know.. Memories still haunt though..

Take joy and pride in the memories you have of him. They are your personal family movies in your mind. Cherish them because not everyone gets them with their parents. Its good to find support and counseling too if you need it. Take care of yourself.
I saw a huge cockroach outside my house today!
Did you call the exterminator?
My daughter said mommy for the first time the other day!
That is so beautiful! How old is she?
She is 2. My heart was beaming I was so happy!
I bet it was omg That's so adorable

messages.content: Main je-na nahi chahta.

Aap ne yeh bataya, iske liye shukriya. Mujhe aap ki safety ka khauf hai. Kya aap is waqt khatre mein hain?

Please kisi bhi cheez se door rahein jis se aap ko nuksan ho sake, aur akele na rahein. India mein emergency ke liye 112 par call karein. Muft manasik madad ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 par kisi bhi waqt call kar sakte hain. Kya aap kisi ke saath reh sakte hain?
My dog returned home after running away today.
Oh that must be such a relief.
I won a scratch off ticket last week!
That's awesome! How much did you win?
It was just $100 but it was nice.
$100 bucks still sounds great to me!
My brother is about to find out that I had to steal $20 from him to pay for gas, since I was in such a bind. He's gonna be so mad at me
Did you really steal it or was it more like borrowing without asking first?

Kind of the latter... But still, I feel grimy about it. I just had no other alternative. I'm between jobs, and I needed gas to get to a job interview. We'll see how he reacts, but he has a short fuse.
Hmmmm. With no job and no way to pay it back I sure hope he can be understanding.
I yelled at my dog to come inside. I feel so bad.
Why do you feel bad?
She didn't do anything wrong. I was venting out my impatience on her.
Oh. I'm sure she didn't mind it. Dogs seem to be a lot less sensitive than people.
I won tickets to see my favorite band in concert the other day!
That's freakin awesome! I never win anything, go you! What band is it?
There's a new restaurant opening up. I'm going to apply for a job there.
That sounds exciting, what kind of restaurant is it?
It's French. Can't wait to learn the cuisine.
OO that sounds snazzy! Perhaps that will also mean bigger tips! I hope you do amazing on your interview with them.
I just started running, and oddly enough, I was first place in last weekend's race!
Congrats, what kind of training did you do?
I knew I was going to do We'll on my test over the weekend. I studied all week
You were prepared for sure. Did you get the grades yet?
I know I did We'll
That's good! I'm happy for you!
My friend just bought a new Audi.
