Aw! Life ends sadly. Have you thought about getting another cat?
My brother got into his first choice college! It was quite surprising
That's amazing! I bet he was elated.
He was! I couldn't be more happy or him. He's always wanted to go there and most of his friends are as We'll
You'll have to congratulate him for me. What a great accomplishment.
I once ordered something online, and was waiting for it for a long time. It was kind of fun to wait for it and look forward to it coming though.".
It's always exciting when you know a package is on the way!
Yeah, I got it from eBay by bidding. They tend to have great deals if you look.
I love eBay! I just found a doll that my daughter wanted for much cheaper than in the stores.
I recently found the baby book I made for my baby when she was born... She just turned 21.
Congratulations on the good raising of the kid! I bet you were just flooded with all kinds of memories.
Yeah, it was amazing to see all of the little firsts that I wrote about.
Wow that is so sweet. Have you shown her it yet?
Yes, I did! We had a lot of fun reading it and talking about it.
That just warms my heart, thank you for telling me that.
I believe I am a really caring person, because I always take care of cats and feed them and lately they are more and more close to me
That is so kind of you, I also a have a soft heart for animals. I happen to be a dog person, but I do have a cat that was my ex boyfriends.
My garage was broken into and the thief stole my lawnmower, tools, and other items. It was not a fun thing to come home to.
Wow, that really stinks. Did you catch the culprit?
One day my 10 year old daughter came home crying after she got off the bus. A teenage boy purposely tripped her as she was getting off and she got hurt. Needless to say, I was very, very upset!
That is terrible. I don't know why teenage boys can be so mean. What did you end up doing?
I was really broken up when we had to put our family dog to sleep
Oh NO. That's sad. What was wrong?
She was really old and getting really ucomfortable
I'm sorry. That must have been hard,
I have been feeling great about life recently. My relationships have been going very We'll
Nice! Are you married?
I was happy when my brother got us game tickets. It was going to be fun
What game will you be going to?
Its a baseball game
I love baseball, who is playing in the game you are going to?
I studied for four years at the university.
Cool, what did you study?
I majored in Political Science. I will be graduating this year.
Nice, I bet you can't wait to graduate.
I recently went to a Steely Dan concert with my lady.
Oh you must have enjoyed it!!
Yeah, it was awesome reminiscing about those times when we used to get in trouble back in the day... Times were so much simpler then.
Yeah indeed it must have been then
I was so scared when I heard a gunshot sound while I was walking through the streets the other day
That is pretty scary. Did you find out where it came from?
No, I felt it would be better if I don't go looking for it. I managed to get the He'll out of there
Smart move. You don't want to get involved in a gunfight. Glad you made it out safely.
I hope I get this new job
What job did you apply to then?
I am getting ready for my mid year work review.
Do you expect it to be positive?
I was driving down the interstate and a car almost hit me going 90 mph.
Oh my gosh. You must have been horrified. I can't even imagine.
Last year, we had a trying experience during Hurricane Irma, but came out OK.
That must have been terrible. Were you okay?
I'm looking foward to my kids first day of school
When is it?
I just got home from traveling and it feels so nice.
That's awesome, where did you go?
I'm unable to clear my exam.
Did you have a hard time in the class itself?
It was terminal, and the doctor said they caught it too late.
What?! Are you sick or your family member?
It was my father who was sick. He passed not too long ago.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that, it must have been hard on you
I was happy with myself tonight. I ate really healthy
That's great! It's hard to do that sometimes, especially on the weekends!
Yeah it really is
I'm proud of you for sticking to it!
Yesterday, two gangs were fighting just in front of my home. It is a very scary situtation.
Oh god that sounds terrible! Are you okay, is everyone in your house okay? Did anyone get hurt?
In the house, no one got hurt but outside the house, many of them got hurt. They were using knifes and baseball bats.
I'm glad to hear that no one in your house got hurt. Gang crime needs to be stopped!
The day my daughter was born was the happiest day of my life
Congratulations! You and your family must be delighted to have a new member!
We are, it is for sure a change!
I am sure that you will be a great parent. You clearly show that you already love your new born daughter.
We went camping this summer and my boyfriend made fun of me for packing so much stuff.
Aww haha how many bags did you bring
I got told on short notice that I've got a bunch of people coming over to eat dinner. I just got back from the store and I'm ready to do this!
Oh boy. I know just how you feel. Could you persuade them to go to a restaurant?
At first I was really nervous about it, but I'm in a groove now and I just hope They're satisfied. Bring it on, I say.
Good for you! I'd be so busy yelling at my husband I'd forget to cook, lol. Do you know them We'll?
I certainly do, which makes it easier for sure.
We'll, that's at least something! It's when he decides to invite the boss and his wife over when you'd decided dinner was mac n' cheese - that's when it gets hairy!
My little brother dumped a glass of water on me this morning to wake me up
Oh god, that must have been the worst way to wake up in the morning
Yeah I was furious we are in some sort of a prank war
Oh, do you have any revenge planned?
I feel bad for eating unhealthy all weekend, I was doing so good with my diet!
It's okay! A cheat weekend every now and then can be We'll deserved when on a diet! Start right now eating healthy again! You can do it!
Thanks, Yeah I'm dedicated to jump back on the wagon, I already have a healthy meal planned for this evening!
That's awesome! Good luck with your diet!
I'm excited for school to start and for the kids to get out of my hair for at least some of the day!
Lol! I bet, how old are they?
I have 6 year old and an 11 year old. I'll have the mornings to myself at last!
Ohhh! Those times are nice. I only have a partner but I know I love my quiet mornings and my morning routine :)
My family loves to argue when we get together. It is annoying when we are in a restaurant and won't stop bickering.
I bet that is embarrassing for you when you guys are out in public.
I tried shopping at a new discount grocery last week.
Oh! Did you find any good deals?
I was looking at this huge croud knowing I was about to have to walk right into it.
Were you nervous and what for?
Somewhat happier today because my bank account was in the negative but I wasn't charged a fee.
I have been there, I hope everything works out for you!
It was a mistake from a company, they reversed it but you know it takes a few days to credit.I was able to settle it quickly today. Phew!
Thank goodness, that will make you stressed.
My daughter can say so many new words, love to see her thrive!
That is so exciting! Such a fun time in life to watch them discover new things and always be such a surprise with what you didn't know that they already knew! Ha ha, that's a tongue twister.
Yes, thank you! Having children is a wonderfull blessing. Couldn't imagine my life without my daughter. Do you have children?
I do! An 8 year old daughter and 5 year old son. They are my life as We'll so I totally get what You're saying. How old is your daughter?
I want to join the Army
That's a good choice. What makes you want to join?
Love for country
That's as good as any reason. When will you sign up?
I was going through my childhood photo albums the other day.
Did you cry ?
My son is in college and about to return for his Junior year. We have made sure to put back ample saving to take care of his financial needs.
Oh, wow, I wish my parents had done that! It would have saved me from the mountain of debt I have now
We felt it was best to make sure to get ready in advance and help as much as we can. But, I know all parents aren't able to do that, or feel they shouldn't, so I can see both sides!
We'll, I've always been of the mindset that (if they can) they should help the first 2 years as that's usually the break-in period. After that, the child should be able to manage
I have a pretty bad vision so I'm so scared to drive at night
Have you had it tested ?
One time while I was camping, there was a giant rattle snake trying to attack us
Did you kill the snake?
I just got the job I applied for a month ago, and they are even throwing on a bonus to my salery
You must have really impressed the company you work for. Got any plans for the money?
We'll I guess I should invest in stocks. But I wouldn't mind going on a vacation next year either.
Either of those choices sounds good. Enjoy the fruits of your labor!
I want to the store in my pajamas today
Nice! How did that feel?
I was comfortable until I saw my high school crush
Oh, how did she look? Still pretty?
I actually have no friends, can you believe that? I'm ok with it though.
Wow that's very sad! I am really sorry!
Lately I've been looking forward to what ever new dollar menu item Taco Bell is going to roll out.
Oh? Do you know what They're bringing out next, or will it be a surprise?
They still have the nacho fries, but to be honest, they've been a bit of a letdown.
Why is that? Too soggy?
I'm so shocked, my pants fell down in public
I'm sorry, did anyone see?
My cousin passed the CPA exam!
Congratulation. What is he planning to do next?
My friend got a puppy and I have wanted one forever, life isn't fair!
Why don't you get one then, so cute.
I don't have the time to take care of one and train it.
That sucks. I hope that changes in the future for you.
I used to be able to ride a bike and I enjoyed it, then I injured my leg. I miss that now.
I know what you mean. In time you will be able to ride again.
I believe in my abilities more now, I am surprised but today I managed to write amazing 3 line code to do the base 64 decode process
That is great! I'm also learning to write code.
Oh really? What language on?
HTML/CSS/Java. I'm excited about a career change.
My husband got a promotion, it's going to be great for our family!
Ooh, awesome! I bet everyone's excited! I hope the future holds many more wonderful things for you!
Thank you so much, I'm so glad he's worked as hard as he has.
Yea, some people really prove that hard work can pay off. I hope he enjoys the promotion!
I went to the bowling alley yesterday all alone - my friends ditched me.
That sucks, did you still have fun?

Just got into an argument with my long distance girlfriend because she felt I wasn't listening to her closely enough while we were on the phone. She hung up, mad. Truth is, I was trying to do some work while talking to her, but I was listening as best I could, too.
Oh no! Its always tough in relationships but when you can't go see her or make her talk to you afterwards, I'm sure its extra hard. Did you call back and tell her that?
I literally had the worst day every yesterday at work, but when I came home my entire night was made perfect! Guess what I had waiting for me?
No idea, what was it?
A spotless clean home, and HOT dinner on the table. Its priceless to get hot food when you are a mom. Lol
I love having a clean home and warm food! No better feeling. Did your husband do this for u?
My husband and I have been house hunting for a few months now.
Did you find anything interesting?
Yep! We finally found one that we love and put in an offer. Wish us luck!
Good luck. When are they supposed to reply?
I am so nervous for next weekend.
What is this weekend?
I'm meeting my boyfriend's parents
Have you met them before?
The micro brewery explosion in America has been awesome for my girlfriend and I, as we love craft beer. Until recently, our town didn't have one though.
I love beer! I wish I could try your guy's beer. Is it a hard process?
We actually don't brew our own, and hadn't been able to try many because we live in a small town. But we just got the news that a micro brewery was opening here in a few weeks!
Awesome, that's great news! Hope you guys make a great tasting one and become big!
My last vacation we went to Florida and a lot of prep work went into getting everything ready
You must have prepared really We'll. Did the trip go We'll?
Yes the plane ride was smooth and no delay's and we got a nice rental van
Sounds like the trip went We'll. I am glad you enjoyed it!
Poor service delivery by an airline staff really pissed me
I'm sorry to hear that. What happened?
My son won the spelling bee yesterday. I felt so proud of him!
That is great. Do you remember what words he had to spell?
I remember the last word was cafeteria. Which is somewhat funny because it's the word I missed when I was in my first spelling bee.
That is a pretty tough word. I am happy your son did so great. You must have been beaming.
There is nothing I can complain about. I have a nice house, a great family and a decent job. Life is good.
Hey that's awesome! Any plans this weekend?
I had not seen my best friend in over 3 years.
Sorry to hear that. What happened to him?
He had just been busy with life. But he was at my house when I got home for work.
Oh that is a nice surprise. I bet you caught up with each other.
I tried my mother in law's cooking for the first time the other day.
Soooo how was it?
It was the worst thing I've ever tasted. Really disgusting.
Oh no haha. I'm guessing you at least had to be polite and pretend like you didn't want to puke?
Sometimes I feel I have no one to turn to
I'm sorry to hear that. Why don't you join some groups so you can meet some new people.
Someone slammed into my car and totaled it while it was parked. I am so mad because I didn't have insurance on it yet since I just bought it. The worst timing ever!

I'm really sorry to hear that... That's the worst scenario too, because You're parked and probably not even there, so you were completely powerless in the situation, and then you come back to your car to just have this bomb dropped on you. Maybe there's something that can be worked out, since you just purchased it.
I've started working with a lathe and I made this wooden cup with it. That doesn't sound like much but using a lathe is so hard! So everything I drink out of it tastes that much better, haha.
What is a lathe, I am not familiar with it

Do you know how you spin clay on a pottery wheel to make rounded shapes? A lathe is sort of the opposite, it rotates a piece of wood and you use instruments to shave or carve out pieces of it. You know those rounded parts of bedstands? That'd be the kind of thing you might use a lathe to make. Or baseball bats, ect.
Oh okay, that is interesting, I will need to look into that, sounds awesome to me!
One time somebody ran into our brick mailbox with their car and knocked a few bricks off.
Oh wow, how did you feel about that?
I am a proud father of 3 lovely girls
Really sorry to be slow to respond. How old are your girls?!
That's alright, they are 8 years old and they are triplets :)
Wow! That's amazing. It must be so awesome that they have each other to hang out and have fun with.
Don't you hate it when you find hair in your food?!
I do! It grosses me out, even when it's my own.
I know. I went to this restaurant one time and when my food arrived I started to eat. That's when I noticed a piece of hair in my sandwich. I was totally grossed out and lost my appetite.
I completely understand. Hopefully the manager was able to take care of it for you!
Some of my friends told me that they had a big surprise for me. They know I hate surprises, but I complied and let the blindfold me and drive me out to the location.
That sounds exciting and scary. What was the surprise?
I yelled at my mom, because I was sleepy. I feel so bad.
What did you yell at her for?
Told her to leave me alone, when she needed me to open something for her.
Oh, that is sad, I hope she knows mistakes happen!
My family cosigned my mortgage loan, because my credit wasn't good enough
That's a very supportive family you have. I'm right there with you on the credit, mine is not too good.

quality_notes: Separates two different sleep problems the user can log differently.

messages.content: I've been sleeping about four hours a night this week.
Four hours a night is a real physical load, and it will make everything feel harder. Is the difficulty falling asleep, or staying asleep?
My son wasted juice all over my couch
Oh NO. I'm sure it was an accident. Is he young?
I took my pharmacy tech certification test last week, but almost wasn't able to because I couldn't afford the $200 fee for the test. My aunt heard and reached out and paid it for me as a gift.
We'll that's wonderful that you had a supporting aunt like that. How do you think you did on your test?
Have you ever had to file for disability?
NO. Why do you ask?
I do not want to go to school Monday. They will laugh at me.
What happened? Is there anything specific that makes you feel that way?
I never have cool clothes.
Then why don't you go shopping? Is it because you have financial difficulties?
I know you won't believe me, but I just won the lottery!
You did! - That's amazing! How much money did you win???
I won one billion dollars, and I only have to share it with five other winners!
Wow- that's a huge amount of money! What do you plan on doing with it?
I've been married almost 23 years. My husband travel so much, but we both have trust in each other to be true and loyal.
That is great, Why does he travel so much?
I didn't win the lottery last night.
I am sorry to hear that. Their is always next time.
Yeah I know that, but I just feel let down.
I know. I always get that feeling when I don't win the lottery.
I recently had a birthday
We'll Happy Birthday! Did you have a nice time?
I cheated to win the card game. I feel horrible.
What kind of card game was it? I am not even good enough to cheat most of the time.

I am not afraid to admit this: I am 32 and afraid of the dark. The other day, my electricity went out due to a storm. It was dark, I couldn't find my phone or a light, so I screamed for my girlfriend to wake up. Am I embarrassed to say that, not at all, lol
Hahaha That's funny why are you still afraid of the dark?
Yesterday I watch on tv a kid who could speak 4 different languages at age 3, I was in shook!
Wow! How is that even possible?
I'm expecting a friend who I haven't seen in years to come over tomorrow. I'm a bit nervous about seeing him as I'm not really sure how much may have changed since the last time I saw him.
It's exciting that you will be able to reconnect with an old friend. I understand that You're nervous, though!
I get nostalgic when I think about times with my parents in the past. A lot of different get togethers make me feel that way
I feel the same way. The times you spend with family should be cherished forever.
Yeah, its times like that make me who I am today I feel like
I agree, be grateful for those in your life because they help you become a better person.
Least year I took my final performance exam for my pilot's license. I thought it was going to be easy. I was wrong.
Oh man I bet that is a very difficult test. I can't believe how many instruments are in a cockpit!
I met a South Korean living in Argentina. He spoke perfect Spanish. Turns out He's fleeing the draft.
Did you find out why he was fleeing the draft?
I am in college and I was talking to my student adviser the other day about the future
Really? Do you know what you want to do when you graduate? I know sometimes it's tough to settle on a path.
I want to be one to run the office part of a physicians practice but that isn't set in stone. I am thrilled to start my new career path
That sounds like a great career plan. You will be filling a very important role in the physician's practice!
Yesterday my sister left to go back to her state
Oh that must be hard. Are you guys really close
I went out to dinner at a fancy restaurant with my husband the other night.
What did you eat?
This is ridiculous. I have to take my car to the shop again.
I hate having car troubles! What is it this time?
Some jerk rear ended me and now I need body work done. The clown didn't even have insurance! Its insane what people get away with.
My sister is recently going through the exact same thing. It was frustrating for her for a while, but things are looking up for her! I'm sure they will for you as We'll.
My team had low expectations this year, and we made the playoffs and won region
That's awesome. Was this the first year this particular team was together?
Technically no, but its high school sports so every year new players come and others go
Gotcha. Why low expectations, did you not do We'll last year?
I went to work today and someone parked in my designated spot. Turns out they didn't even work there. I was so p'd off.
That would really annoy me! Did you end up taking any action against them? I know some companies will tow a vehicle that does that.
I reported it to my boss as soon as I walked to work from a far away spot. Not sure if anything was done about it though. I hope it was...
Man, the nerve on some people. I would never take somebody's spot if they have a sign up for it!
I was so proud of my daughter over the weekend.
That's good to hear, what did she do to make you proud?
She performed her first solo dance in competition, but she had been in leg braces for the last 2 years.
Oh wow! That's amazing, I'm sure that was a really touching moment!
My hamster got out of its cage and I haven't been able to find him
I'm sorry. I hope you find it.
I got startled while walking in my yard a few days ago.
Strange place for something to surprise you. What happened?
I walked up on a snake.
Eek, I'm with Indiana Jones on this one. I hate snakes. Hope you weren't bit!
I was mad when I woke up and it was only Tuesday!
I agree, I dislike Tuesdays because they are so far from Friday!
I feel so bad that I took home a large amount of change from the cashier at the store!
Oh yea I know what you mean
Yeah I realized it too late to return it because I found out afterwards at home.
It really does feel bad tho
The day my first grandson was born was a happy time!
Oh I bet. Was it your first grandchild?
I'm feeling very positive about my future lately. Big money opportunities everywhere kaching kaching bling bling burrr
Awesome. Sounds like you are defintely on top of the world today!
Thanks. But I always am
What kind of money we talking? Lottery money?
Proud of my friend! He recently made a hockey team.
That's great. Is it his first year?
It's his first time trying yes, junior hockey./
Wow how exciting, has he been practicing a lot?
We'll I have worked hard and lost some weight and toned up a bit after a year of not working out. I finally feel good when I go out in public instead of gross
Holy cow that's amazing! Good on you! How much weight have you lost?
I have put in so many hours at work hoping to get a promotion. Fingers crossed it works
Yeah I hope you get it! I'm sure they will recognize the extra time you've been doing.
The vet told me my cat only has a few weeks left to live.
That's so terrible! :( I'm really sorry... You should do something special everyday and make memories!
My father promised to buy me a car when I graduate from university. He never did.
Are you disappointed with it?
Hi, at march break I went to Disney World with my family.
Sounds fun how long were you there
We were there for a week. A lot of the roller coasters made me nervous though.
Aw what was your favorite things to do while there
I have a job interview this week
Nice, do you feel nervous about it?
I am felling so chill right now since I have most of my bills paid
Nice! I bet you feel like a weight was lifted off your shoulders!
My kids got a ton of Halloween candy last year. Didn't think they would notice if I ate just a few of them.
I don't blame you, I would have eaten some. Did they notice?
Not at first but I kept eating them and they caught me red-handed one day. I felt so bad I had to go buy them more.
What type of candy was it? I like Sour Patch and chocolates.
I got really drunk on my birthday this year, and couldn't remember what I did. It was very awkward meeting my friends the next day
Oh no, I've had that happen before, it is the worst. I hope it wasn't too bad for you!
It wasn't that bad in the end, but it was the fear of not remembering anything!
I understand that all too We'll! I'm glad it wasn't too bad though. I've had some pretty embarrassing things happen while hungover.
I killed my family and fed them to pigs.
Oh dear. Are you ok?
My friend went on a 4 week trip around the world for his company
Wow, How lucky! I love to travel.
My aunt that I had not seen in 10 years came to visit me last weekend
Wow. What for? Had you recently talked to her?
I am very lucky to have healthy, happy children. There is so much sickness and sadness in the world today.
Health is truly a blessing! How old are your children?
Yesterday I saw a guy leave the bathroom without washing his hands.
That sounds like it would be pretty gross.
It was really gross behavior.
Definitely, I'm not a super clean person but that's a bit far.
I got really joyful when my dad got me my first vehicle. It was just a happy feeling
Yeah. I know that feeling., although I had to buy my own.
Its a good feeling to get a vehicle whenever
I know. What kind of car was it
I am going on my first roller coaster ride at Universal Studios next week and am scared out of my mind!
I have never been on a roller coaster. I would be very scared too.
Yeah, I am hoping I don't scream like a little girl the whole time!
Hahaha you are going to scream, I hope you don't puke. It should be fun though.
I just lost my pet dog. I do not know what to do.
OH NO! I would be devastated. Did he pass, or missing?
My son is taking his promotional exams I believe so much in him. He has prepared We'll enough to be the best
He should be fine if he has prepared. I hope he does We'll.
Yes he will, he's always doing We'll
That great. I'm sure you are real proud of him.
I am going to eat nachos later.
I love shrimp nachos, but any nachos are good really
Oh yes. I can't wait to devour them!
What do you put on your nachos?
There was this time that I went to eat with all my friends for a special event and I forgot to invite one of my closest friends.I felt horrible
Oh NO. Did you talk it out with them?
I was riding passenger in a car that actually rolled over!
We'll dang! Are you feeling alright?
I'm jealous of people born with perfect healthy genetics.
Yeah it sucks when people just seem to have it all.
They seem to be immune to sickness, that's like the greatest trait of them all!
Are you the type that's prone to getting sick?
Hey, so I was driving down the street the other day, and this random car came flying out of nowhere from a side-street and almost hit me, I was quite angry.
People drive more and more badly. Did you take the plate number?
I didn't get the chance this guy was going so fast, probably like 70 on a residential street!
I understand. I am happy that nothing bad happened to you.
I am an ESL teacher and one of my 3 year old students came to school singing an entire song all about the planets. It was so cute!
Awe, I bet you felt so proud and happy for them.
Yeah, it was a really special moment for me. Little kids that age are so cute!

I know, they can be amazing when they are learning and exploring the world... However, I still don't think having a different colored cup than the one they wanted warrants the response they tend to give. ( I have a 2 year old and a 3 year old son)
I knew my dad was going to pick me up last week. He was a man of his word
I love a person of their word he is a great father keeping his word.
Yeah he was very trusting
The greatest feeling in the world I have the same feelings towards my dad he always comes through we are lucky.
I'm really looking forward for the new Greek restaurant to open here.
I have never had greek cuisine
It's really good. I can't wait to try it!
There aren't many restaurants where I live. Only fast food.
I get to go on vacation with my husband and kids on Monday. I am so excited!
That's great. Where are you going?
Last week when Toys R Us closed it really made me start thinking of the 90s and my childhood
I've heard a lot of people say something similar. Did you go there a lot?
I did! I was talking to my husband about the different toys I had. Even started talking about the music and shows from that era
Where I grew up didn't have one nearby so I get a little jealous hearing about it.
In a few days I need to go to a company presentation and make a big speech!
Wow, I bet that's exciting, but also makes you a bit nervous. Congratulations though, I'm sure you are proud to do it!
I let my brother take care of my dog when I went on vacation. He is the only person who I would let take care of my dog.
Did he do a good job?
Yes he did. I think my trust paid off because my dog came back healthy and happy.
Thank god, bet You're pleased about that aren't you?
I get to go to the thrift store this weekend and I haven't been in a long time! It's one of my favorite places to shop
I love going to the thrift stores as We'll! What did you by

I am going to get some shirts. I'd love to buy even more but I really need shirts. I can find super nice brands for so cheap and new. It's better than buying the cheap new stuff on other websites that is bad quality. I love finding the deals! I am spoiled by 90% or more off.
Tell me about it!! I bought so many brand new shirts in a thrift store last year and they still look awesome because the quality was so great
I was going through some boxes the other day. I found some old pictures of my kids I thought were gone
That is exciting! I love having pictures to look back on.
Yes, definitely! It really made us all start talking about those and other memories, good times.
I love being able to reminisce on the past. Time goes by so fast.
I spilled my coffee in the middle of a busy coffee shop. It was horrible!
I am so sorry. Did they give you another one for free?
Yes and they were so understanding too. But everyone was staring!
I would feel they same way, but that was nice of them!
After graduating college I was having so much trouble finding a job. A friend of my dad's decided to give me a chance at his business. I was so thankful for the opportunity from him!

Hey there

The doctor just recommended exercise. I'm not sure if they were just busy to do anymore for her or if exercise is the best.
Usually moving your body helps but it depends on her situation... I would get a 2nd opinion!

I feel you. Some people just suck.

See, that's how I remember it to! One of the kids I spent time with that semester opened up about his dad's drinking problem and he was holding it together pretty We'll. I didn't realize that kids went through that kind of stuff, I mean I know they do but you get what I mean.
Wow That's so deep. I can't imagine having to deal with that at that age. They mustve been what like 8? That's a lot to put on a kid

Yes, we had insurance that is going to cover it, but it still sucks start from ground zero. Plus, insurance can't really replace some things.
I understand. It is always difficult to start from ground zero. Good luck.

What did they do for you to hate them?
So my dog passed away a couple of weeks ago. Its been really hard not having him around.
Oh no! How old was he?
I had him for 12 years.
What type of dog was he?
Hi friend, I recently went on a fishing trip.

Yeah, be fully committed, communicate about everything & let petty things roll right off.
Thanks for the advice. I have trouble letting the petty things go but I think I'll learn to be better as time goes by. I wish you a happy marriage!

I did thankfully! The worst part of that situation was I politely told the woman I had been waiting, and she totally snapped at me! Traveling brings out the worst in people sometimes.
I totally know that feeling. It seems that everyone thinks that their situation is more important that everyone else's.
My dog pooped on the rug today. I was so peeved!
I hate when that happens and I don't even have a dog
It is a terrible thing. That pooch needs to stop doing it or I am going to have to get rid of her...Which I really don't want to do.
Are there places you can take the dog where they teach them not to do that

Oh I'm sorry to hear that. You must be so worried.
I could not wait to see a game last week. Its all I wanted to see
What game was it?
I have a friend that I know since I am kid. He is always there for me. He is one of the few person that I can trust for anything.
I know what you mean, childhood friends are so important and treasured
It is very important to have someone that you count on in your life.
I agree, it feels great to have someone stick around for so long
I'm going to see a film tonight at the cinema.
Oh really? What movie?
Ever since my brother moved out last month the house has been so quiet
I understand! I felt the same when my son left, it's seems so much less noise and talk.
Yeah. I got used to his noise
I understand! I felt the same when my son left, it's seems so much less noise and talk.

Did you brush it right out?

I think so, but I still feel physically sick because of the devastation. I feel like I have no idea what I am going to do now

I got lucky and hit on a lotto scratcher.

A cool $100. I needed it too.

When I first saw it I felt like I had time traveled for a second. So weird.

I just finished a big project of mine and I am really happy with how it turned out!
Nice what kind of project was it
It upset me when I saw my food was taken out of the fridge at work today

Nope.. It happens all the time at work
I would go to HR about it and let them know.
I have been working on my dance moves for the last 6 months.
Oh really? That's cool! What style of dance?
We'll its for a dance off, so it's a pretty big deal I have to win this.
Wow. That's so amazing. Are you nervous?
I wish I could go back to the first date my girlfriend and I had
Why did things end between you?
Oh, they didn't end. I just miss that time, since everything felt new and alive and different
Oh, yeah I understand that, it is the same way with my girlfriend now
I won a prize at the fair, it was ok I guess.
What was the prize?
A pen
Did you keep the pen or sell it?
I felt like I can't buy a car.
Why's that? Are you worried about driving?
No the salesman won't gie me a reasonable price.
Ah-ha! Do you know anyone in your family who's good at bargaining? Maybe the sales-person is a hard-bargainer.
I am getting ready for graduate school and I think I got everything I need finally.
Hey that's amazing!! What did you major in?
MY son woke up at the crack of dawn this morning
Its summer vacation. I hope you got enough sleep or it might be a long day for you.
My son is going to be tested for school soon
Who is conducting the tests?
I remember the time when my grandfather died and resulted in a family feud. It made my life quite alone.
Sorry to hear that. What was the dispute about?

We'll, I was quite young at the time with no one I can relate to. It was very difficult to decipher, it was more of feud between aunts and uncle/dad. The life of poppop was especially not easy on them
I understand. It should have been not easy.
Waited as the numbers spinned, and finally the call, that was mine!
What game were you playing?
Lotto
Wow, I am so happy for you!
I was hungry and took my co-workers food
Did you not have your own food?
I didn't have any that day, I was also out of money
Oh no! That sounds horrible! Did the co-worker find out?
The storm is coming, I can hear it with my ears!
Oh no, I hope you are ready for it?
I am not. No storm shelter or saved up food. I hope I won't be washed away!
Yeah, I hope you won't either. Maybe find a local shelter?
I am so grateful me and my ex are still friends
I've seen a lot of bad breakups. Glad you guys are adults about it.
I am surprised, but we are. I think he may be still wishing for a make up
How do you feel about that?
Last night I heard a weird noise outside. It really scared my wife and I.
Oh, I hate it when that happens. Did you find out what it was?
I really like pickles on my burgers so I ordered mine with extra pickles today.
I love pickles and I always order extra! We must be twins!
I am happy I have a home without a landlord and can do what I want, like rescue animals.
I'm glad you can do what You're passionate about. What kinds of animals do you rescue?
Any kind that needs help and happens to fall on my doorstep. I even feed all the wild critters I can :)
That sounds so fun. I hope I can do that some day, too!
My neighbor killed his wife, a year ago. I would sleep during that period of time. I was shocked and afraid.
Oh my god, that is terrible. Has it affected you knowing you slept through that kind of event right next door?
Yes, it affected me. I had to move to another appartment to feel more confortable and forget the event.
I would have as We'll. I am sorry that happened to you and I hope you can learn to sleep peacefully again.

Oh awesome! How are they doing?
Great. We were just cracking jokes the whole time. It was good to see him.
Awesome! It's nice to see people who knew you so long ago. No friendships like those!

Have you always had this fear of the dark

How old was it ?
He was 5. He got hit by a car. I've been so distraught since then.

My husband and I are going to couples counseling.
Oh NO. I'm sorry to hear you are going through a rough patch.
I considered becoming a vegan, but I'm not so sure if it'll work out.
I have never tried and never will lol
I ordered a pizza the other day and it was delicious.
It sounds good just reading those words, what kind was it?

I was hoping to be able to go visit family soon but I don't think it's going to happen

Ahh, the joys of visiting home. My mom fixed me 3 course meal of my most favorite dishes!

I agree, always! I felt so content that I instantly fell asleep and ended up staying overnight!
Wow! That sounds like an amazing visit.
A bad storm with a tornado almost went through my town, I was so scared
I'm glad it's over and nothing happened. Do you have an underground shelter?
I am so sick of my job not paying us for the proper amount of hours!
That's terrible. Employers just don't value their employees sometimes.
It seems like it doesn't it.. I hope it gets better.
I hope so, too. Have you considered working elsewhere?
I just had a job interview and I think I nailed it. I left there feeling very confident.
That is good, that is a situation where confidence is very helpful.
I remember getting my first job and just working so hard for that first week cause it was retail
Those were the days right. I loved those paychecks no bills.... Can we go back to that?
Oh man the thing that got me was waiting for the first check to come in though. Remember that? You're very FIRST one
Yeah and I bet it was like a whole 100 or 200 bucks and we were probably feeling like a ceo.
At work, a new coworker keep looking at me in weird way. I feel very uncomfortable.
You should probably talk to that co worker and if it doesn't stop I would report it to the HR
I don't know. I don't want to make problems for nothing. He is a very weird guy.
I don't think you would make any problems. Who knows maybe he is a pervert
My daughter and her family were on their way from ohio to visit us.
Oh, that must be exciting! I bet you were busy making preparations.
I took my daughter to see a circus show at Circus Circus in Reno, and that look on her face was priceless.
Oh I've been there! So much fun!
My grandma passed away a few months ago, so we have been going through all her things.
Sorry to hear that. I lost both my grandparents in the same year.
I have just won the lottery!
Congratulations. How much did you win?
Once we were taking a drive and our dog got loose. He came home a few days later.
Oh, no! That must have been so scary!
I just bought a brand new car,
How exciting! What kind of car is it?
It is a Honda Accord. I let my brother drive even though he is not that good of a driver.
Oh sounds nice. Hopefully he doesn't have any accidents in it.
My friend recently got to meet adam scott. He is one of my favorite actors.
Wow, I bet he was really surprised he got to meet him. What did he think of him in person?
Said he is the same as on the podcasts. Funny and smart
That's great. It's good to see celebreties be the same in real life as they are on the internet or TV.
I'm feeling pretty good today.
Oh really? Is there any specific reason why?
When you took your driver's test were you nervous?
I was very nervous. I did not know if I would pass or not.
I took mine last summer I was nervous also. My heat was racing the whole time. I was so anxious!
Did you pass the test?
Hi there! I had something pretty interesting happen recently. It made me really think about how much things have changed over the last couple of decades.
Really, what happened?
My nephew just said his first words last week.
How exciting! I remember when my girls said their first words! What was his first word do you know?
He was saying da da, so we count that as dad. I love that little guy.
Yeah, that seems to be what a lot of little ones say for their first word. Something about it being easier than ma ma - congrats to the little tyke!
I became friends with a girl in college. I was jealous of the men she dated, especially as she told me she would have dated me if we weren't friends.
That's unfortunate. Sometimes, people don't know how to make a move and are waiting for you to make a move.
I went to the lake in my old neighborhood and thought about my childhood buddies.
How was that? Must have been a throwback!
It definitely was. I don't have a lot of friends now and miss them a lot.
I am sorry to hear that, hope you get some more?
I have regularly attending driving school and I am getting better every day.
DId you get tickets? Or getting ready for your licease?
Getting ready for my license. I think I am confident enough now in my abilities to pass the test.
That's awesome! Good luck I'm sure you will do great.

I was trying to take a shortcut to the grocery store lol.

I went to a job interview a few days ago, and I feel like I totally rocked it!

I'm just sitting here with my cat in my lap and thinking about all the money in my bank account. Life is good

So sad right now, my poor cat.

She really does need an intervention , and family and friends would help greatly , I hope she can get her life back together

I'm so sorry. You should talk to a therapist.
Yeah, I'm going to need to. My girlfriend said no when I asked her to marry me
I'm sorry. Maybe she just needs time to process things.
I went into that interviewing knowing I was going to answer anything they threw at me
Sounds like you were pretty We'll prepared. Howd it go?
I aced it
Awesome. Great job. What kind of job is it?
I have been stealing internet from my neighbor since two months. I feel bad about it.
Dang. Why don't you just get your own?
I feel extremely happy about my wife's promotion
That's great! It's good to be supportive of your partner
Yes I am she does better than her male counterparts
She sounds like a great person
I was recently rewarded at work for my loyalty and dedication to the company.
That's what I'm talking about! That sounds so nice. I'm a little jealous. Sounds like you deserve it, though.
You know that feeling when loneliness just hits you in the gut?
Yeah, I do. I'm in a long distance relationship. I get that everytime I have to fly back home. I hope you start to feel better, though. Loneliness can end up being a good motivator, however.
I am a proud father of 3 lovely girls
Really sorry to be slow to respond. How old are your girls?!
Someone let my dog out while I was at work! I can't believe it!
Who let him out? Did he run away?
My cat has to be put down next week.
Oh no! I'm so sorry, we just went through that with our pup. It's a hard choice to have to make.
She has been sick for a month and is not improving.
I'm sorry you are having to make that choice, but I feel it's our duty to them to help them pass on when they are not going to get better and help them not suffer any longer.
I was mad when I couldn't leave work on time
Was there too much work?

I love the goats of Anarchy owner. She gave up a lucrative career on wallstreet to save goats and now other animals that would otherwise be pts or used for meat. She dedicates everything to help them.
That is so generous. Sounds like she has found her calling in life.
My puppy fell off the couch and hurt his paw.
Wow, what happened next, is he alright?
He is fine now, but I took a couple of days off of work to nurse him back to health. Poor little thing.
Wow what type of dog is he? Is he a big one that acts tough or a little one that needs lots of love?
He is a baby Australian Shepherd. Just a sweet little thing.
Wow, I actually love them! Did you take him to see a vet? You seem so concerned about him to even take time off work.
I was very concerned. We went to the vet and she said it was probably just a sprain. Better safe than sorry, though.
I am so glad to hear that. A healthy puppy makes everyone happy.
I didn't ask the girl I like to the Prom and I really wish I had just gone for it.
What was holding you back?
We'll, I felt inadequate because it was summer school prom and she didn't have to go to summer school. I thought it would make me look stupid.
If you could do it all over again, how would you overcome , and pardon me for saying this, your wimpy-ness?
I cannot stand my sister in law. I'm literally sick over how she treats her boys.
What is she doing to boys?
My work is sending me on a business trip, but I'm really nervous about getting on the plane.
A little anxious? Have you ever flown on a plane before?
I have. I fly a lot, actually. I just really really hate it. I get so worried and afraid. Hopefully the time will pass quickly.
I'm sure you'll be fine. Statistically its safer than driving.
I found out my group of friends went to the beach last weekend and did not invite me for some reason. I don't really know why though?
That was rude. Did you confront them?
My pet rock rolled away yesterday. It was a sad day.
Are you going to get a new one?
I think so. Been thinking about going to the Rockies to find a new one.
Do you live near the Rockies?
Man, it's not easy finding good online work.
Tell me about it. How long have you been job hunting for?
I decided to ride out a hurricane in my home. It was one of the scariest experiences ever.
Oh my, it must have been so scary! Do you live in an area commonly affected by hurricaines?
I am in Florida, so yes. The sounds are the worst. The howling of the winds and the rain and debris pelting your home.
Was your home damaged? Was anyone hurt in your area? I've never seen a hurricaine, except on the news.
My aunt just call to tall me that she will be visiting next week.
I hope you guys enjoy your visit! Are you guys really close?
I am going to the doctor monday. I hope everything is okay
What do you think is wrong?
I was lost in a neighborhood I didn't know, when some guy came up to me and quietly asked if I needed a ride.
Please tell me that he was friendly and nothing creepy!
My neighbor returned my lawn gnome today.
How nice of you to loan it out! Have to admit, never heard of someone "borrowing" a lawn ornament though.

Oh, if you saw this one you would understand. I have won every Lawn of the Month award with it for 48 months straight. I was getting somewhat concerned because he is known from waltzing off on his own from time to time. But, I am thankful that my neighbor was quite vigilant!
I'm glad you gave him a chance to shine! Everyone deserves a chance to be trusted, and it's good on you to roll the dice!
Planning out my new home has turned out to be a blast!
What kind of house are you building?
I just moved in so it is already built. Just working on planning out decorating and appliances and such.
That sounds great. What are you most excited for?
My dog decided to pee on my bed when I wasn't home. Little jerk.
Oh no! And that is hard to get out! Do you have a waterproof cover on the bed by any chance?
Nope. I only discovered it when I tried to lay down on it too. So gross.

Oh YUCK! We'll, I'd suggest a waterproof mattress cover just in case it happens again. At least if it does happen again, it won't get into the mattress and you can wash the rest of the bed clothes. I'm so sorry you discovered it that way!
I looked at my childhood photos the other day. I remember alled the fun I used to ahve
Oh really, that sounds nice. I miss childhood.
I do to. It was much easier then for me
Sometimes I feel as though our generation (assuming You're a few years around 30) really got a bad deal as far as the economy, politics, and the overall love in the country is concerned.
I'm so mad my son came home late last night
Were you up when he got home?
My oldest child needed braces but her health insurance wouldn't cover the expense. It was close to 4000 dollars and we did not have that kind of money at the time.
I feel you. Last week, I spend 1000 dollars to fix my daughter's teeth. Dentists ask a lot of money now a days.
I am sure that my brother will come home from Iraq.
What kind of job does he have in the military?
He is a medic.
How long has he been there?
I just got payed yesterday , so I finally bought new clothes and went out to eat with some friends
Payday is fantastic! What kind of clothes did you buy?
Its been a fantasy since I was a kid
Oh what was was that fantacy
My buddy broke up with his girlfriend for a guy.
How do you feel about it ? Honestly if someone is respectful to me I don't care who they like , That's the way my dad raised me
My prized, Argentinian goldfish died yesterday. I've never been so heartbroken.
Oh no I am so sorry to hear that!
Thank you for the condolences, friend. He used to sing me such sweet lullabies when I was trying to fall asleep. I don't know how I will ever get any sleep at night now.
I can't imagine how much that much hurt. I hope you can at least cherish the memories you had together.
My wife's out of town right now on business. She has to go on these trips a few times a year. I miss her a lot.
That's completely understandable. Have you tried distracting yourself with hobbies or productive chores?
My little brothers team were the campions, I couldn't believe it
Good for him. What sport do they play and was it any of that state level competitions?
Hi friend. I have had a lot of problems with my girlfriend
I've been there. That must be rough. What's going on ?
I used to be afraid of the dark but now I am not so much, I had a nightlight for a long time
Why aren't you anymore?
One time I skipped my friend's birthday party to watch TV
I hope something good was on
I had a rough time in the hospital back in march of last year. I got pretty sick and was stuck in there for a week.
So sorry to hear that. What happened? Is it something serious?
It was weird and out of the blue. I developed appendicitis and diverticulitis at the same time. My bowels tried to kill me. Just very painful mostly and I had surgery.
I hope the surgery went successfully and with no hassle. I had a friend who went through the same thing. Wish you all the best
I am so mad I can't play soccer this season.
Why can't you play? That must be very disappointing.
Yes, I wish I hadn't torn my MCL.
Ouch! I'm so sorry. How long until you can play again?
I was lonely on Monday. I was sick all day
Do you feel better now?
About two weeks ago my wife got sick with Tonsilitis.
Oh no! I am sorry to hear that. Is she feeling any better?
My dog passed away couple months back.. I was heartbroken
I'm sorry to hear that.. What happened?
I found pictures of when I was young, going camping with my grandparents. Those we such perfect times.
I hear you! It's sad yet happy to think of how great it was years ago! I hope we get to keep our good memories when we leave this world
Oh man I can't wait for next week!
Why!? What happens next week?
When I hear Christmas music during the holidays I miss my family in the Philippines
Awww, when are you planning to visit them?
Next Christmas hopefully if I save up enough for a ticket
I really hope you will be able to visit them then! I know how you feel, I didn't see my parents for a couple of years
I just found out that my girlfriend has cheated on me
I feel sorry for you, how did you reacted ?
I really like to watch all of the old tv shows that were on when I was a kid. I watch them with my kids sometimes. But they usually just make me feel really old when we do this.
That's funny, it's like you can see your kids and see yourself experiencing it when you were a kid
Yeah. I'm pretty sure they think I was born in the 50s or something though. They always say the shows are really really old. Haha
Right, it's hard to imagine there was a time before you when You're little
I get to go on vacation with my husband and kids on Monday. I am so excited!
That's great. Where are you going?
We are going to Wisconsin to see my family. We haven't seen them since Christmas.
Sounds like a great trip. I hope you guys have a fun time.
I just recently took the LSAT and did We'll. I hope to be starting law school in the spirng.
I hope you did We'll and congratulations on Law School!
Thank you! I hope to get into Syracuse.
Law is a pretty tough career. You must've worked hard, and I'm sure that will pay off.
Every time my kids go to grandma's they get to eat all kinds of candies, and get new toys.
Omg, I bet they come home so spoiled.
Yeah they do! Some times I wish I got to go visit grandma's like they do lol.
Yeah, what the heck I don't remember my mom being so nice when I was a kid! Lol
I am mad at how the Eagles played the other day, they lost to the browns
What sport is that? Sorry but I don't know anything about it.
It is football!
Ok, sorry I didn't know. I hope the play better next time!
I got to visit with some of my old high school friends a few weeks ago. It's hard to believe it's been over thirty years since we first met.
I bet that was nice though.
Yeah, there's only one of them I really keep up with. I'll probably never see the other two again.
Does your high school do reunions where you could see them again?
I find queuing at the supermarket very frustrating
I do as We'll, how long does it take you to do it?
I am so funny. People say I should go into comedy. They also say I might be the next Rodney Dangerfield!
I don't think I know who Rodney Dangerfield is but hey, good for you! It's awesome when people have a good sense of humor
I was happy when the clock struck 5pm and I got out of work!
Getting out of work is the greatest feeling.
I was walking down my street and a big fly flew into my mouth. I tried to spit it out but it wouldn't leave. It tasted so nasty.
Did you wind up eating it?
There's a hard bump on my arm. I don't know what it is.
Have you made an appointment with your doctor?
I'm hoping it goes away, but You're right. Maybe I should set an appoitment.
I would just to be safe!
I just had a huge test in my Law class today. I won't know how I did until next week.
Did you study hard for it?
I did and I am pretty sure that I aced it!
That's awesome! Are you going to celebrate now or wait until the grades come in?
I am trying my best to go on a diet. It's not going We'll.
How much would you like to lose?
20 pounds. I always eat just because I have food. Maybe if I bought less food, it would be easier.
Sounds like a plan! You can also try to see if there is less calorie version of foods you like.
I went to a theme park recently and got on this roller coaster
Really! Did you have fun?
Not really. :( It didn't seem very safe.. It was a really old rickety, wooden one that looked like it was about to fall apart.
Oh no! That sounds scary. Some of the rollercoasters can be very We'll built while others are very sketchy
My dad gave me this necklace way back in the day and it is so cool. I wear it every day.
That's so sweet! I bet he is an awesome dad!
Eh he was less than awesome in some cases, but he is still my dad.
This is true. Did you have some good memorable times together?
I am so happy the kids are going back to school.
I'm sure they aren't though, hahahaha.
One of them is, the other does not want to return.. Oh We'll.
I hope the one who doesn't want to return at least gets to spend more time with their friends.
My wife and I just put a bid on a house we really want! We are fairly optimistic that we will get it!
Good luck! I hope it goes We'll for you :)
Seeing my house burn down was so scary.
Wow, I can't even imagine. What caused the fire?
My wife forgot to pay the car insurance, and I ended up getting pulled over!
That's unfortunate, did you end up with a ticket?
Yup! Of course they have to get their money, and more money out of my pocket ugh
Ouch, I hope it wasn't too expensive.
I was pissed when I saw someone put a dent in my door
Did they leave a note or anything? I would be really upset too. Were there any cameras that could have seen who did it?
They didn't leave a note, just a dent :(
That's the worst. I would feel so awful if I left a dent and fleed the scene of the crime. Hopefully the guilt is eating away at that person.
My son just left for college and I don't want to throw away his old comic books and trophies.
Aww that's really sweet. I understand being sentimental about that sort of stuff. Do you feel like you have to?
Yes I am really attached to his stuff. He told me get rid of his old stuff but I think I will let him know I just can't do it.
You should just keep it for now. He may think that stuff is corny now, but later in life he will be glad you kept it.
I am really looking forward to the upcoming NBA season.
Oh yeah, do you love basketball a lot?
Yes, I can't wait!
We'll I hope you enjoy it!

My two-year-old niece is getting better and better with his manners. We had to pull him from his parents, and volunteered to take care of him, because they were failing as parents. But he's surprisingly picking up on how to have more appropriate, normalized behavior, and I'm happy about it
Little kids are pretty amazing how they can pick things like that up in the right environment. So nice you are teaching him good manners, those are in short supply in adults these days!

Yeah, we'll see how far it goes. I'm still worried for him, since he's had an incredible lack of socialization. But we'll do the best we can. It's just important to stay patient... Because that's really hard right now.
Poor little guy. Sounds like he's lucky to have you, especially at such a critical time in his life.
My girlfriend's dog was a 17 year old Chihuahua who emerged from a bathroom at a party in 1999.
Emerged from a bathroom? Intiguing. What do you mean?
I wish people would be more responsible and would take more pride in their work
I agree. I put a lot of effort into my work and I hate when things are half done.
I have to go to jury duty later this week. I am real nervous about it
I bet you'll do great. I would be nervous too. Hopefully it won't be anything too serious and more cut and dry decision. Have you gone before?
Yeah about 10 years ago I had a horrifying experience. It was 100% their fault but they hit the water barrels and survived. They had no injuries but they almost ran me off the road.
Did you suffer any injuries?
No I wasn't hit. It turned out they were drunk. I felt guilty but realized it was his fault.
Why did you feel guilty? People really shouldn't drive drunk.
My husband convinced me that it was a good move.
What was a good move?
I really miss my family and friends.
I'm sorry to hear that. Did something happen to make you miss them?
My dogs keep attacking my poor ducks. I don't know what to do
I don't know what you can do. A duck is just a toy that taste good to a dog.
I scream at the dogs and it seems to be working but I never know what can happen in the future.
Dogs gonna do dog stuff. That's just how they do.
I was invited to a trip last week which was awesome to get invited to
NIce! Where are you goin?
South padre island in texas
That sounds fancy. I like Texas, never been there though.
McDonalds never gets my order right.
That is so annoying. Do you check the bag before arriving home at least?
I do and I always have to go inside. It's so annoying. I hate that my kids love their nuggets.
Its the worst. I would complain to management. You can't be the only one it happens to.
Can't wait to get the phone call about the new job. I fell very good about it
That's good. Your interview must have went really We'll.
It did.i felt like he was eating out of the palm of my hand
We'll I hope you get it then.
So, just the other day I decided to believe a woman I know about her renting her home to my family. I really thought it would happen, but she will not call me back and it has been days.
Oh, wow. I hate it when people do things like that. They should just be honest and upfront to begin with instead of causing drama.

That is one of my biggest pet peeves. Just tell me what your intentions actually are instead of stringing me along for nothing. It would have been more than perfect for my family. I really believed her.
I'm sorry it fell through, but hopefully you will find something even better, and bonus, you won't have to deal with her.
I am mad at my friend Eric because he lied to me
Why did he lie?
I really think I'm going to get the job!
Oh yeah? What job did you apply for?
I already booked my flight for vacation before requesting a leave from work!
Oh no! That's exciting and terrifying. Do you think it will work out?
I sure hope so! I am quite hopeful that I will get my holiday approved since I have worked overtime for 3 months!
In that case I'd say you very We'll deserve it! I hope you get it.
I am applying to grad school.
Oh wow! Congratulations! I also recently applied for grad school to study Computer Science (seriously). What are you wanting to study?
I feel so bad to see so many homeless people on the streets these days. I hope I am never homeless.
I hope you aren't and I'm not too! It would be rough living on the streets.
I think I have met the one
Really? Congratulations! I hope you guys are really happy!
He is the sweetest and y kids love hime. Total opposite of my exes
That's always awesome when the kids approve of him! I'm really happy for you guys and wish you the best!
I can't wait for the next 2 weeks. My house is going to be sold, and my wife is starting her new job! Ahhhh
That's great. You both must be excited
We are really I am just so ready for it my god I can't even wait!!
Are you moving to a better home?
I'm going to have a baby next week, , , , I think I'm ready!
That's great! Is it a boy or a girl?
It's a girl, my second girl
That's so nice! What are you going to name her?
My brother got me a nice gift. I was shocked in a good way
That is nice. What was the gift?
It was football tickets
Cool. What were the teams playing?
I have MS, and sometimes I have bowl problems.
I'm so sorry. Have you tried any natural remedies?
I am taking a trip to Disney World next month! My wife is going for the first time!
That's so awesome, I'm really jealous! I've never been either, and I'm actually saving up for a trip!
Do you want to know something incredible? My daughter is!
That's so sweet I bet she is how old is she?
She's 10 and made it through first through fifth grade with all As on every one of her report cards!
Omg I can't wait to see what that feels like as a parent congrats!
We walked, we ate ice cream, we rode a bike, we laughed a lot, we enjoyed the outdoors, we were exhausted
Who did you do all those things with? Sounds like a wonderful day!
Some guy threw up on the street last night right before me.. I was grossed out
Yuck, that is terrible. I would be grossed out too. What did you do?
I can't wait to go on my trip next week
Oh yea? When is the trip?
I will be the first in line to see the new Top Gun 2 movie.
When does it come out?
My job recognized me for my hard work I was thankful and surprised I just love my job.
Oh cool that's great! What were you doing that they recognised?
For over exceeding and helping all staff when in need, I am always just helpful but was happy to get noticed for my hard work.
Awesome. What is your job?
I do not want to go to school Monday. They will laugh at me.
What happened? Is there anything specific that makes you feel that way?

quality_notes: Refuses without lecturing, gives a real reason, redirects to a professional.

messages.content: Should I take my friend's antidepressants?

Please don't take someone else's medication. Prescriptions are matched to a specific person, and taking them can be genuinely harmful. A doctor or psychiatrist is the right person for that decision. Is there something about how you're feeling that I can help you think through?
I'm having difficulties when I think about my father. He died one year ago and it's still hurting very much.
I'm so sorry to hear about that, it must be awful. Do you have friends and family that you can talk to about this?
Thank you for your kindness. My brother is around to listen but he lives a very busy life so it's hard to find someone to turn to.
When my relatives have died, it helps me to remember the good times, and makes me smile instead of being sad
My birthday is tomorrow.
Happy birthday! Are you exciteD?
I have my final math test tomorrow.
That is so nerve racking. I'm sure you will do great.
I'm not too sure. Frankly, I am quite nervous about it since I haven't studied.
Do you usually do good in math? It is my favorite subject and always came so easy for me.
I actually was able to keep my promise to this girl I was seeing?
We'll its always a good thing to keep a promise. Can I ask what the promise was?
I was excited when I saw I got tomorrow off!
That's awesome! Do you have anything special planned?
I know how much of a chore full-time employment is. What are you doing now?
I am an officer in the United States Navy, but I agree with you. How about yourself?
I'm trying to do the whole work-from-home and be-your-own-boss thing. That contentment doesn't last long! Where have you sailed?

I have sailed all over the glove. Hit a couple of countries in Europe, a few scattered islands across the Atlantic. And the best part is, I've never been deployed! So I am truly living the dream that every sailor hopes for lol. I was very fortunate.
I feel abandon these days.
What's wrong? Did anything happen? Have you reached out to any friends lately?
My wife left me a month ago.My friends are trying to help me, but it's not working
Aw man, I'm sorry. That sounds rough. I know how you feel. Time usually helps but it's pretty gradual. Hang in there.
I'm pretty bummed out. The vet told me I have to put my dog down.
I'm so sorry to hear that. What is wrong with him?

We'll, he's small and he got bit by a chipmunk. Got some kind of incurable disease that makes me run around in circles constantly without breaking for food. He's going to waste away to nothing at this rate.
That sounds oddly crazy and wild. Reminds me of rabies? I hope you make his last days his best and glad he won't be suffering anymore.
I am ready for my vacation to Las Vegas.
Sounds great, I've never been but would love to.
It is my favorite place to go for vacation.
How many times you've been?
I've been happy with the way things have been going lately.
That's Awesome. Did you change anything lately?
I've just been trying harder with life in general.
Oh that is awesome. What motivates you?
You know sometimes when you just feel like you have to leave a job? We'll, that time is now for me and I can not wait for my job interview this week.
Yeah I have had that experience. One was so bad I left before getting another job. Don't recommend doing that, lol.
Last year during the spring, our area got record rainfall. My basement ended up getting flooded and destroying many of my childhood things and keepsakes.
That's the worst! Because now you'll be freaking out trying to think of the things you may not even remember whether or not could have been there. That must be an anxious feeling.
It really is, it just sucks losing all of those things. They were like my connection to the past.

Yeah, I'm not quite a hoarder or a packrat when it comes to those things, but I do get sentimental with some physical objects. If I lost them, I'd feel like it would be an itch I couldn't scratch, because I couldn't replace what I lost. Hopefully you can work past it somehow.
Anytime I go to Mcdonald's I never order and feel sick.
That's non fun. I'm sorry to heard that. Maybe you shouldn't go there anymore?
I got a package randomly in the mail today. IT turned out to be a late birthday gift!
Oh really? That must have been very exciting to get!
Yes I love unexpected gifts. It was a cute coffe mug
That sounds really entertaining. I've seen those fun coffee mugs with shapes at the bottom.
I went for a ride on a roller coaster the other day and it rattled me.
What coaster did you ride?
The mamba in KC.
I have never heard of that, is it twisty or a big drop?
I loved taking care of my sisters pet the other day
Nice, what pet was it?
A bearded dragon
Sounds very exquisite. You must have cared for it We'll.
My husband just bought me a new truck out of the blue! I had no idea I was going to be getting a new one.
Oh wow! Are you happy about the purchase?
I just moved back near family, and I'm feeling overwhelmed with how close knit everything is again.
Oh I feel you! Every time I go back to stay with my family it feels... Claustrophobic almost.
I'm very lucky to be back and around them though. They are truly generous people.
I'm sure they are! Itll feel more normal soon, I am sure
I'm really hoping I enjoy this new World of Warcraft expansion as much as I've been excepting to!
Ohhh I've been checking it out too! What side are you going with?
I've been Horde all my life, but I might try Alliance this time.
Lok'tar ogar! I love my undead necromancer! What race/class will you go with for Alliance?
I am so thankful for everything in my life right now.
That is good. What is going on with it?
I just have so much joy.
That is good, I hope it stays that way
I've got a fun weekend coming up, and I'm really looking forward to it!
Nice, what do you have planned?
I think I did very good at my interview. I hope they call me back!
Good luck. That's always nerve racking waiting for them to call. I'm sure you did We'll though.
I am so grateful to my family
I feel you! What do they do for you?
I had to go out of town by myself for three weeks. It was hard not being able to talk to anyone I knew.
Sounds pretty lonely. Did you meet or make some friends while out of town?
McDonalds never gets my order right.
That is so annoying. Do you check the bag before arriving home at least?
I haven't been on a date in a while. I have one this weekend.
Do you know where You're going yet?
My coworker did an amazing presentation recently. They did a good job.
That's great! What was it about?
I have been studying for my final math exam all week long.
I hope you do We'll on it! Do you feel prepared?
I feel so prepared! I am confident that I am going to crush it and get an A on this thing!
That's great! Make sure to check your answers twice!
I feel ready for my trip, tomorrow. Everything is ready.
Cool. Where are you going?
I am going to Mexico. Have you been there?
I've been to Cozumel. It was lots of fun
I was lost in a neighborhood I didn't know, when some guy came up to me and quietly asked if I needed a ride.
Please tell me that he was friendly and nothing creepy!
I wouldn't know. I defnitely didn't want to risk it and declined the offer!
Thank god! LOL I was like please tell me this was a positive experience...
My husband once let this guy come to our house so he could use his tools to fix his truck.
How did that go?
My dog got out and I haven't found her yet
Where did it go?
I'm not sure. She's probably around the neighborhood somewhere, but I haven't found her yet. I hope she's ok
I hope so, hope is still alive, and Have you search everywhere?
My family threw a suprise get together for me!
That must have been so fun!
It was. I had an overwhelimg feeling of joy. I really love my family.
It sounds like you have a great family!
Someone almost killed me the other day
What?!?! How? What happend if you don't mind me asking
I went through a divorce last year, which caught me off guard financially, luckily my mom was able to help with some of the costs.
That would be rough. Hopefully You're in a better spot now! That's awesome you had family to help you out too!
