I just saved a bunch of people on the beach this week.
Nice! I am glad to hear that you got to use your Baywatch-esque skills!
Yeah, they are saying that I will be the head lifeguard for next season. I have never been so pumped.
That's great man. You just have to wrestle a few sharks and they'll appoint you head lifeguard of the state.
My cashier gave me extra change back and I didn't say anything.
Why is that?
Because I had also stolen some candy and wanted to get out as soon as possible.
Oh that makes sense, We'll be careful
I lsot my job the other day and am pretty lost myself.

I hate sayings, but the one that goes, "Tough times don't last, but tough people do, " really applies. Life is long. You have plenty of time to change your fortune, and you seem self aware enough to do it. I hope you can work your way back up.
Wow thank you for the kind words. I will do my best :0

Of course, but it doesn't really matter what I say, or what I think. You already knew all that stuff anyway. Everyone has to have confidence in themselves. Someone else's confidence makes no difference. But as long as You're alive, you've got a chance.
I always try to be prepared before a big trip.
That's smart. You don't want to forget anything. Are you planning a trip soon?
I miss the old times when there was so much less crimes.
Do you honestly believe there were less crimes back then? Or were they just better concealed
I really believe there was less crime. My parents were never closing the exterior doors of the house back then when they were in the house. People were more trusting each other.

That's cool. I feel like that was true in your world. But as far as I knew the world was a living He'll for colored people more so then than now...But I'm positive the news today only highlights what is convenient for corporate America
My roommate and best friend just moved out.
How are you feeling about it? Are you sad?
I am really sad about it. It is so boring.
I am sorry about it, did she move close by or to another town?
I found my old yearbook yesterday
How did that make you feel
The other week, I was talking about a co-working of mine - okay, I was gossiping..
Hmm, how did that make you feel
I went into that interviewing knowing I could answer any question they threw at me
Yeah - do you think it went We'll then?
When I see my wedding picture around the house I always think back to that day.
Does it make you feel happy about your life since then?
Yeah, just makes me think back to those times and how it was so different from now.
We'll at least you'll always have your memories as time goes on.
My dog managed to slip out the door yesterday and ended up going straight for the road and got ran over. I feel so horrible.

Holy cow, that's terrible. I really feel for you. My dad had that happen to him and his dog when he was young, and he's told me about it as a warning to make sure I'm safe with ours. I wouldn't wish it on anyone. I hope you get through the grieving process okay.
It's going to be hard, and I don't think I'll be able to have another dog anytime soon. It'll take a while before I'm comfortable enough, .

I would definitely take as long as you need, so you don't put unhealthy pressure or expectation on the animal to live up to a memory it can't live up to. But if you feel comfortable with the idea, then I would consider it when the time is right. You'll know when that is.
I finished my final semester of college today!
Congratulations! Do you feel relieved to be done with school?
I saw a huge spider in my car yesterday. I scared me so!
That is frightening! Especially if you didn't know whether it was a harmful spider or not! What did you do?
One time I got pantsed in PE class. The other girls thought I should lose my pants while we were playing dodgeball.
That must have been embarrassing. Did the girls get in trouble for it?
I am in a good mood today. I think I might have found someone special.
Whoa... That's awesome. I love hearing that. Can you tell me about them?
Of course, She's super smart and beautiful - 2 killer combos.
Absolutely. I'm glad You're experiencing that. Me on the other hand, I'd be worried that I wasn't good enough for them. But I'm sure things will work out for you.
I asked a friend I'd had for a very long time to be in my wedding. She agreed and then completely disappeared from my life.
I'm sorry that's rough. Did you ever find out why?
No, I didn't. I even offered to pay for everything for her since she had to travel. I guess she wasn't as good of a friend as I thought.
I guess not, but I hope you still had (or will have if it hasn't happened yet) a great wedding!
My mother passed last week. I have been very down and have not left my house all week
I'm very sorry for your loss.

Have to go to the doctor tomorrow to see if I have strep throat. I hate when they have to swab the back of your mouth to "make sure" that it's strep so they can treat you. Really hoping to avoid that this time around.
Sorry to hear that, the trouble of going to the doctor just to "confirm" its strep throat is the worst. It's like I know I have it, just help me!

Haha, that's exactly how I feel. And then when they have to swab the back of your throat, I always gag and they keep having to do it over and over. It's traumatic almost, and I'm already sick to boot!
Hopefully you can avoid that, the swab to the back of your throat is a gross feeling!

Someone asked me how me and my fiance met the other day and it had been awhile since I had even thought about it because it was over 8 years ago. While I was telling them about it I got that feeling you get when your remembering something, almost like adrenaline but in a calm way. I don't get that kind of feeling much anymore so it was odd when I did.
How did you guys end up meeting?
My cat died last week. I feel so lost without her.
:( I am so sorry to hear that... How old was she?
She was 23 years old. I got her when I was 5.
She lived a long life for a cat but its never long enough for us who they leave behind. I hope you feel better soon...
Last week I had my bachelor party. It happened in a location I least expected it
I bet that was fun. Like where? A museum or something Lol
Children's park. It got me surprised
Oh wow that is surprising. Did you guys have a picnic?
I felt bad when I lied to my cousin. I mad up an excuse when I missed his wedding
Dang, that's kinda hurtful. Why did you miss the wedding?
I'm happy with where I am with life right now. Work is great, family is good and business is booming.
I am very glad to hear that. Do you have any children?
I have three beautiful kids and you?
I have no kids, but would love to have some at some point!
I had a huge conflict with my parents about moving to another country and I was simply enraged to have them trying to control my life.
That's a bummer. What happened once you moved there?
It was an awesome experience and after I came back to the US I felt so fulfilled and my perspective on everything has changed.
It's good to hear that your experience was fulfilling. I hope I can have a similar once someday.
I slipped an fell at work today. I felt like a total fool and had to be taken offsite to a medical clinic.
Ugh, that's really rough! You shouldn't feel foolish though, it could happen to anyone.
I'm still a little sore but I'm able to walk around a bit. Didn't see that the floor was wet at all!
I hope you feel better soon!
I found a gift card I forgot I had in a drawer!
I love that when that happens! What is it for?
I have a fishing tournament today which I am pretty certain I will win.
Are you going to be on the news when you win??
I certainly hope so, that would be awesome!
Yeah! When you win I get first crack at your autograph!
My friend recommended me for a job at his company. I am so happy he thought of me.
How nice of him!! You should be thankful to him!!
I stepped on a snake in our backyard. I screamed so loud!
What kind of snake was it? You know my mom is terrified of all snakes even the ones that aren't poisonous.
I just emptied the washing machine and was left with one odd sock. I know there was an even number when I put them in.
Hm that sounds suspicious. Where do you think it went?
Who knows? I've double checked the drum of the machine. Weird.
Do you feel afraid that there might be a ghost in the house?
I caught my boyfriend messaging another girl.
That is awful! Did you break up with him?
Last month my car threw a rod and needed to have the engine overhauled, leaving me without a way to get to work and back.
Oh no, are you able to afford the repair for it?
We'll, a friend of mine let me borrow his car for a entire month while mine was repaired. He just tossed me the keys and said bring it back when your done.
What a great friend you have. Definitly get him a gift when you are done.
My dog is sick we took him into the vet and now we are playing the waiting game
I am sorry to hear that! My dog is a part of the family, so I understand. I hope everything is okay.
Yeah it is scary to think we could lose him...
It is scary to think about, I hope for the best!
I have been eating a lot of sugar free candy recently and it made my bowels loose if you know what I mean.
Haha I know exactly what you mean! My uncle pranked his coworker once with a bag of sugar free candy. I feel for you, seriously.
It all hit me while I was walking out of an Eddie Bauer store at the mall. I had to waddle to the bathroom and throw away my underwear.
Oh man that is really bad. I feel sorry for laughing.
One of my roommates left without cleaning his room and the school charged me and my roommates 100$ each
That's extremely frustrating! What were they expecting you to do? It's not your fault your roommate left it trashed.
My stepmom called today with some bad news. News I was not expecting at all.
What was the news?
It seems that my father had a stroke. He's only 64! We are headed up there tomorrow to see how he's doing.
That's so tragic, did the doctor say what happened?
I can't wait for Saturday!
What happens on Saturday?
My boyfriend proposed last night!!
Congratulations! That's awesome! How long have you two been together?
I'm happy with what all I have accomplished this summer
Could you tell me what you have done?
I was at a gas station with my friend and we both bought a lottery ticket. She won a little bit of money! I was a little mad that I didn't get anything.
Oh man, sorry to hear that. I mean good for your friend but I feel you. I never win anything
I feel as if that is the way with me. I never win anything!
Maybe one day we will win really big! Who knows
I got mad because I was too full to finish my plate at the buffet
What kind of buffet? Did you get to take a doggie bag at least?
Chinese, but no I decided not to, don't think would allow it
I bet you wish you had that doggie bag now. My mom used to sneek food out. Lol
MY friend didn't invite me to her sons birthday
That must make you feel bad. Being left out by someone you do not expect to, is the worst
So I learned to bowl using two hands yesterday and it was my best game ever!
Wow! That's great! I bet you feel proud of it!
I thought my best friend was going to be able to visit me this summer. But it turns out he can't take the time off from work right now. I'm a bit bummed, as I haven't seen him in a long time.
Would you be able to go meet him instead?
I walked in the house and my wife was cheating on her diet with cake in her hand
Wow that sucks! What kind of diet is she on?
You ever just have a good week where nothing bad happens?
Yeah, not in awhile, but I definitely know that feeling. Are you having a great week?
Yeah it's pretty good actually! Nothing bad happened (knock on wood) and I can't really complain :D
That's awesome, I hope it stays that way!
My mom is supposed to call me regarding her test results.
I hope she hears some good news. Is it pretty serious?
She had stage 3 cancer, but she was clear last screening a year ago.
I'll be praying for her, I hope she continues to stay in the clear in the future.
I rarely pre-order video games, but recently did for one that comes out in November.
Which video game did you order?
We had a really great guest speaker at work today.
That's awesome! What did they talk about?
My wife cheated on me! It's absurd!!
That's very sad to hear I'm sorry that happened to you
Thank you, what should I do about it?
I would suggest moving on time heals all wounds
We took our girls on a surprise trip - we told them we were going to the beach but that was not the destination.
That sounds like fun! Where are you taking them? The junkyard?
Wouldn't that be a hoot? No, we took them to Disney!
Aw, that's sounds like so much fun! You sound like awesome parents :)
I accidentally told my best friend's secret to a mutual friend
You must feel awful about it! What are you going to do? Are you telling your friend?
I asked my friend to get some stuff for a party, I knew I could count on him though.
I'm jealous of you. I'm a little introverted and antisocial, and never got good at developing friendships where I could make them long-lasting and trustworthy. Good for you
My dog was my best friend, now he's gone and I feel isolated.
Oh no I'm so sorry to hear that. Are you thinking about getting another one?
I moved into this new house and was woken up with this horrible screeching noise in the middle of the night.
Terrifying! What was it?
Yes I felt prepare
When did you feel prepared?
I feel prepare at yesterday
What were you prepared for?
I was cheated on at one time, but I stayed true to him and myself . We worked through it and are good now.
I'm glad to hear that. If you can get through that, you can get through anything together.
I had a job interview today and I think it really We'll.
That's really good you feel pretty secure about it then?
The interviewer told me that I was his favorite interview so far. And I think my qualifications are a really good match for the company.
Oh wow then that is really good! For someone to say that! You should be very proud of yourself.
I'm feeling pretty good after my performance review at work.
That's great! I'm happy for you. Will you be getting a raise?
I feel great! I killed it on my math test.
AYYY that's great news! Was it a calculator test? Or a non calculator one/
Non calculator. I feel smart :)
Who needs a calculator with a brain like that ey? Good job that's amazing news
My Pet parrot died yesterday.
Are you going to get another?
I don't think so. They're quite a bit of responsibility. I'd like freedom to travel etc.
Probably best to also take time to process what happened
Bumped into this girl I used to have a crush on in High School.
That's exciting. How did that go?
I am looking forward to getting a new vacuum on Tuesday.
Oh, I love cleaning, so tools to do it with that are new are always welcomed. What kind of brand?
Hello, tomorrow I have the cooking test and I feel safe. I am sure that I will approve with an excellent rating
Oh, how nice. What are your plans in that regard for the future?
I finished last semester with a 3.5 GPA. I can't believe I did that We'll. All that hard work paid off.
You worked hard, what are you studying in school?
I was eating lunch today at school and some woman let out the biggest fart I've ever heard. I almost spit my food out.
Oh my god!! She must have been raised in a barn!
Our dog is getting older and having issues.
I am so sorry to hear that. I know what that is like unfortunately.
Thanks. It is hard when they are a part of your family.
Yes definitely. My thoughts are with you, I hope he still has many years left.
Just got my marks back.
What are those? Your grades?
My math test grades, I failed the test somehow.
Math was always my least favorite. Are you British?
I had a really fun get together tonight with all of my coworkers and my boss. The night went fantastic! I'm feeling very happy and optimistic about life right now.
That's great! It's such a good feeling working with people you actually like..
I couldn't agree more. All of my coworkers feel like family to me. So it was a very relaxing and enjoyable get together.
I hope you have more nights like it!
When I was pregnant with my first born, it was considered a high risk pregnancy. It made me very worried and anxious throughout.
I can imagine. How did things turn out?
I had to have emergency surgery in the end, but being able to hold my healthy baby was the greatest blessing I could have asked for.
I'm so glad you made it through
My daughter recently graduated from law school!
Wow that's great! She still has to pass the bar though right?
I will always believe in god.
Good so am I. God is everywhere and everything
I always pray to him when I have troubles.
People sure does that when they have trouble
Every time I go to any fast food joint like mcdonalds they always get something wrong , but that one time they get everything right I'm actually happy .... And they want to get increased in pay lol
That's why they are being replaced by machines lol
I saw an episode of lockdown once where people would go through the drive threw to order there food, they did not know it but a call center in prison was taking there orders lol
I thought I had seen every episode of lock down. I haven't seen that lol
I didn't see my parents since 2014! I miss them so much. It's so sad that I live in a different country
When will you be able to visit?
Actually in 2 weeks! I'm so excited about it. I'm going there with my son! They've never met him
Oh boy, that must be amazing for him
I drove by the town I grew up in and made a few stops. It was a good time
Sounds lovely! I bet it brought back a lot of memories.
Ever just stare at the ocean at dark? The bright moon shining into the water and into the retina of your eyes, it makes you very sentimental
Yes! I live about 30 mins away from the coast . I love going at night
It's the best isn't it? Especially here, no one goes so it's even better
Yes, I love when the water is flat and its just a glassy reflection. I also love when the water is rough and loug
I wasn't feeling We'll but didn't get enough warning so I didn't make it to the bathroom in time.
Oh no! Happens to the best of us. Are you feeling better now?
I am but I can't believe it happened in front of a room full of people, yikes!
Oh no! I would hope that people had compassion for your situation and if they didn't, We'll shame on them. I once peed my pants at a wedding I was laughing so hard.
Someone cut me off in traffic this morning.
I hate other drivers. It seems like they are getting worse every day. Did you honk at them or anything?
I can not believe how loyal my dogs are to me. I am so thankful that they will let me give medicine to them without putting up a fight.
Dogs are the best. Are they ok? What kind of medicine do you have to give them?
I ordered a beautiful gold watch from the Shopping Channel. When I received it, it looked completely different and was total junk.
I hate when that happens, especially when you have something else pictured.
I ordered takeout yesterday and I got home and found out half my food was missing.
What happened to it?
The place shorted me.
That is not good, did you complain?
Recently, I was rear ended at a stop light. The car was probably going 40 mph. Completely totaled my vehicle.
That sucks. I hope you had insurance.
Of course. The other guy didn't though. A whole lot of his problem, not mine.
We'll he was the one that caused it, so that's what he gets.
Have you ever think you've seen a ghost?
I have seen things I can't explain. I didn't stick around to ask, I ran. But afterwards I was thinking it was a ghost.
My neighbor brought home her baby and it was her first child.
Wow, how exciting. I bet it looks like a fat little old man.
Fat little old lady. I tried to help her even though she had been mean and accused me of hitting her car when I didn't
I would hit it out of spit now
I used the internet to help me write a paper once because I didn't read the literature. It was flagged for plagiarism.
Oh my...You have to be careful when you use the internet for school assignments.
Very true! I felt so bad. That was the first and last time that ever happened.
I know someone else that happened to. I wouldn't take anymore chances either.
Living out in the country when it gets dark it's really hard to see what's going on around you at nite
I imagine so, especially when you have no idea what to expect
He seams fine when I talk with him but I know he is not. H has had a problem with substance abuse in the past
That's really rough. Do you think he may have relapsed?
I was heartbroken when my pet iguana passed away recently. Izzy and I were best buds. I miss him so much
That's sad, how old was your pet izzy
He was 5. I hope he is in a better place now.
All iguana's go to heaven so I'm sure he is
So last night a cop pulled me over.
Oh man. What happened?
I took out the trash today and the bag burst all over me. I knew I shouldn't have kept 50 pounds of ramen sitting in the fridge for 2 months.
Why put ramen in the fridge?
A few years ago I lost someone dear to me tragically. It broke my heart and left me feeling like I should have been able to stop it.
I am so sorry to hear about that. It is very hard to lose a loved one but treasure the memories of that person, especially the good memories.
It's really hard. She killed herself. I feel like I failed her.
Oh dear, I can only imagine please stop blaming yourself. I feel your pain.
I am going camping tomorrow, it's one of my favourite things to do in the summer!
That should be fun! Do you go every year?
Yes, we have a very small travel trailer so it's easy.
Very cool! That's awesome you have that opportunity to do something you love every summer!
This morning I woke up and I was in such a good mood that I just started singing in the shower.
That's awesome! I wish I could wake up that way every morning. Did something specific make you feel that way?
I don't know, I think it was because I had a dream about marrying Scarlett Johansson.
Ha!! We'll I've woken up from a dream and been mad at my husband because of something he did in my dream - I guess it can go the other way too!
I knew I shouldn't have trusted my brother with my dog
Oh NO. What happened? Is your dog okay?
My dog is missing
Oh no! I'm so sorry! I assume you don't have a Chip implanted to track it? That's awful, I'd be furious!
I got my promotion results back the other day and I didn't get selected. I was so angry because I know I am a great employee.
Sorry about that. Did you talk to your manager to understand why you did got selected?
I did talk to my manager about it and he had some kind words to say. Turns out she was better qualified than I. I just have to work harder!
I hope you get it next year. Good luck.
I have a job that requires me to work out of town.
Sounds like a fun one to me. Are you happy there?
Yes , but its nice to have some one at home who will handle things while you are away.
I agree. I'm sure you get bored or lonely while traveling too.
I am very anxious about the country these days
Why are you anxious about the counry?
My grandmother showed me how to make lemon ice box pie when I was around 10
That sounds delicious, do you know how to make it now?
We have to make an expensive repair to our car.
I know! That must be frustrating. Do you have enough money to cover it?
I'm really gullible. I used to believe that a magician could pull coins out of my ears.
We'll if he was good at the trick its understandable. As long as you were a kid.
It was six months ago. I will believe anything.
Wow, you better let someone else do your due diligence you might fall victims to scammers.
I went to my daughter's awards ceremony at school recently.
How was that experience for you
I tried to be cook and do a flip and ended up splitting my head on a cabinet!
Oh man!! I hope you are ok. Please tell me someone recorded it

When I was in labor with my third child, they were monitoring me regularly in the hospital. The nurse came in and made a face and then called the doctor. In the 2 minutes it took for him to get to my room, my heart dropped and I started to panic. He told me that the baby's heart rate had dropped and they had to preform an emergency C-section right then.
Wow that's really scary! Labor is a really terrifying thing, especially when something like that happens. Did everything turn out okay?
Yes, everything turned out fine. She is a healthy and happy three year old. It was the scariest day of my life though.
I can imagine. When I was in the hospital with my 3 year old they lost all his vitals as We'll. Kids like to keep us on our toes from the start!
I love dogs as they are so caring.
Me too. They really are a man or womans best friend. Do you have dogs?
I'm sleep training my toddler, he never slept in his crib before. He is crying and it makes me feel so bad
I know what that's like. I have three kids.
How did you cope with all the crying? We've been co sleeping since birth and it's breaking my heart to hear him cry
They never slept in the crib lol. I won't even make my son get a haircut because he cries so much when the clippers get close. I'm the wrong one to come to for advice lol
In the past, I was jobless for 14 months. So now, I am putting a lot of money in my savings in case this happened again.
Sounds like a real example of learning from the past. Sorry you had to go through that. Are you better now?
I was schocked to see my favorite band wasn't coming to my city this tour
What band is that?
Coldplay
They playing anywhere close?
Hey, how's it going? Isn't it tough meeting new people these days?
Absolutely. It doesn't help that I'm pretty introverted.
Same here. It also sucks when people let you down. I once let this guy crash on my couch because he had lost his apartment, and it didn't end up good at all.
I hate when you help someone out and they take advantage of you. I could never do that to someone.
The other night I was having this dream where I felt like I was getting rained on. It was a really weird feeling.
Did the dream feel like it was really happening? Strange indeed.
We'll I eventually opened my eyes and saw my dog was licking me all over. I was so shocked I was speechless for a bit.
Hah! So all that time you were just feeling your dog licking you! Weird how that works.
A new skating rink is being built. Should be done in time for Winter skating
That's pretty nice! I haven't been skating in a coon's age. Is the rink nice?
So far, it looks pretty nice!
That's great! I may look it up and go to their grand opening as We'll.
I passed two trials that a company put me through and I only have three left.
Ooh, I bet you can't wait to finish!
You got that right! I'm feeling pretty happy about my performance and I think I'll get the job!
I hope you get it! Good luck!
I went to a Cirqe d' Sole show recently and was quite amazed by the different acts! I couldn't smiling while watching! Their skills were unbelievable!
That sounds like a lot of fun. I have always wanted to go to one of those shows.
They are definitely worth it! They take circus performances to a whole new level!
I like how colorful the whole production is. It really does look amazing.
I am going to my favorite restaurant tomorrow I can't wait
That's cool. What are you gonna eat there?
I'm glad I can trust my husband to always be there for me.
That's sweet! I have a great husband too! How long have you been married?
I went to the DMV for my drivers license. It was my first time going there.
Exciting! Were you nervous going in? Did you take your test?
I was very nervous. Yes I took the test and I passed it.
Congrats! That had to feel good! Hopefully You're happy zipping around the roads now (and safe too)!
I was looking at old childhood photos... Good memories
Ah yes! How did it make you feel?
Lot's of happy memories!
That's awesome! Did it brighten your day?

When I see old people on the road. I feel bad and I just feel I like I want to take care of them
I know exactly what you mean.
I was surprised that I was able to get into the apartment I wanted without any problems.

Nice! I hate looking for apartments. I'm in college and have looked for apartments for the past three years. It gets really old after a while, since I'm on a budget and it's hard to find something cheap but not a rat's nest. Glad you found what you wanted.
Right? I'm in the same situation and was expecting this place to be filled up since it's right next to the campus!

I live right next to my campus too! The downside is it's a building made in the '50s and looks terrible on the inside. But I can bear it since I'm saving money. Most college kids have their parents money and just choose a fancier place because they don't care about money.
I felt all alone the other day when my dog ran away
Oh NO. Did you fnd your dog?
He is still missing after 4 days

Watching my old sparring videos I'm kind of amazed at how fast and lethal I was, knocking around guys twice my size...I was only 140lbs and I'm 185 now, I wonder how I'll do in the ring :))
I bet you'll have a little extra power now
Yes probably...Might have to get the stamina back up...But I was pounding the crap out of this 300lb Everlast bag without even loading up it felt great
That's awesome! You should get back to work and kick some butt :)
My neighbour is playing loud music and I'm trying to sleep
I hope you don't have work in the morning. Whenever I can't sleep easily I just give up trying and do something else.
The college football season starts today!
Oh really? I'm not the biggest football fan
I can't wait to watch some games!
Sounds like a fun time sports can get intense
I get married in 3.5 weeks!!!
Whoa congrats. You must be very excited.
I have many health problems that have prevented me from having children
Oh my. I am so sorry. That must be so difficult. Are you exploring any other options like adoption?
If I can get my health under control I would definetly look into that. I use to be very sad everytime I saw people with their children but I have finally learned to be content in my situation

I hope you are able to have a child some day. I truly hurt for anyone that struggles in situations like this. I have to aplogize in advance. The topic I chose was about my daughter. I do not want to make you feel sad.
When my mom got sick I feel sick too. I cannot handle it
Have you ever spoken to someone else about it? It's always a relief to talk things out.
I called my brother and shared the news with him but yet I wish I can be there to care for her
She took care of you when you were little so it only makes sense that you'd want to return the favor. You're a good child.
I found out that my favorite tv show got cancelled.
What show is that?
It's that show on NBC about the family. I'm so sad it happened.
Do you watch any other shows?
I let my dog off the leash in the park the other day and he never strayed too far from me the whole time. He came any time I called him and is such a good boy!
That sounds like a great dog! What bread is he?
Wow, policy recently changed at work, not due to anything I did, and they are now paying me extra money!
That's amazing! Congratulations. What was the policy that changed?

My family is always bugging me to do things that I don't have time to do. Yesterday they wanted me to stop my work day, come home, and go to the old folks home to visit my grandma when I already go every weekend. Its like they think that my work doesn't matter and I can just up and leave whenever?
I could be wrong...But I feel like they just miss your company...And are using your grandma as a scapegoat. Don't be so hard on them They're not always gonna be around ;)
I was exposed to lice at work
That's horrible. What is your work doing to fix that?
Nothing, I had my hair up so hopefully I don't get any
Ouch, I hope you don't either. I'd keep any eye out at work from now on.
I drove by the town I grew up in and made a few stops. It was a good time
Sounds lovely! I bet it brought back a lot of memories.
It did I got to see my old school!
Do you have fond memories of it>
I went out on date. It seems I forgot to use the body odour!!
Oh man! A rookie mistake! Did your date notice the foul stench?
It felt good to get approved for a vacation
That's great! Where ya headed?
To disneyworld!
That sounds like a lot of fun! Who ya going with?
I cry every time I think of my grandmother.
I'm sorry to hear that. Why do you think that is? Is it a painful or happy memory?
I am just sad she isn't alive anymore.
I can understand that. That does sound like a difficult thing to deal with. Hopefully you have a lot of nice memories you can look back on to remember her by.
I am beyond mad. My neighbor was mowing his lawn and my car got scratched from rocks kicked out by the mower!
That really stinks! Did you complain to him?

quality_notes: Crisis response in Hindi with verified numbers preserved in Latin digits for reliable dialling.

messages.content: मैं जीने नहीं चाहता।

आपने यह बताया, इसके लिए धन्यवाद। मैं आपकी सुरक्षा को लेकर चिंतित हूँ। क्या आप इस समय तुरंत ख़तरे में हैं?

कृपया ऐसी किसी चीज़ से दूर रहें जिससे आप ख़ुद को नुक़सान पहुँचा सकें, और अकेले न रहें। भारत में तत्काल आपात स्थिति के लिए 112 पर कॉल करें। मुफ़्त मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सहायता के लिए Tele-MANAS 14416 पर उपलब्ध है, किसी भी समय। क्या आप किसी के साथ हो सकते हैं?
Seeing that my wife bought a white color when I asked her to buy green disgust me
I would be really frustrated with that as We'll. Did you exchange the colors?
She promised to go and do that since she realizes how I feel
We'll it sounds like she's listening to you at least.
I'm very socially awkward and tomorrow I'm going to have a playdate with some local moms and I'm so anxious

I'm right there with you.. I still feel pretty introverted, but since coming to college, I've been forced to socialize more, and it's help me at least "fake it until I make it." I still prefer to be alone a lot of the time, but at least I can somewhat manage without making myself look dumb. Maybe you can just think of some topics/things to talk about to have in the back of your head for the times when things get quiet?
My little brother took my bike without asking me, and he left it outside the shop, then it got stolen! I'm so angry right now
That was very careless of him, I'm sorry.
My best friend took my daughter for the weekend so that I could have some alone time with my husband.
How nice! Are you going out or are you going to have a nice night in?
She's awesome I'm so thankful for her. We are going out! To see a movie and to eat dinner!
That's great. I hope you both enjoy yourselves.
I have my final math exam tomorrow. I think I am going to crush it.
That's awesome! Good luck to ya.
I feel so bad today. My grandmother past.
Ohhh, I am sorry to hear that. I know your pain very We'll. Are you ok?
I am ok. I made a promise to stay strong. Thanks for your kind words. :)
That is good. It sounds like you were able to be with her before she left. She is in a better place now.
I can't wait til Red Dead Redemption 2 comes out! The first one was my favorite video game of all time!
That's right, it is supposed to come out soon, I bet you will enjoy it very much
I work online to make extra money for things my family wants.
That's amazing, you must be a good person
I am so happy I was able to pass my teacher certification test and become an English teacher.
That's great. Teachers are so important.
It's such a fulfilling job. The test was difficult, but I spent a lot of my free time studying for it.
I wanted to become a teacher before. I was afraid of how hard it would be.
I love roller coasters, but I hate that my favorite amusement parks close during the winter.
I hate that most parks close during the winter too. Do you have any indoor type amusement parks near you?
Not that I'm aware of. :( When February rolls around, all I can think about is how much I miss them and how I can't wait to go back.
I feel you. You will just have to go as often as possible during the other months to make up for the winter time without!
Two weeks ago my neighbour got a brand new sports car!
Oh wow, that sounds super fun! What color?
I'd love to have the same as his! Bright blue, but its so nice!
I bet. I can't imagine anyone would mind having a car like that!
I was so sick last week. But I'm so lucky to have my girl friend she stayed with me
Oh no! I am so sorry to hear that. I hope you are feeling better.
I am now, but I felt so lucky to have her
That's good. And your girlfriend sounds like a real keeper.
Remember those old AOL disc that they use to spam us with in the mail ? I saw one at a fleamarket
Oh wow! I remember my parents getting them so much. Why would someone need that now?
Don't you hate it when you are not sure you can trust someone?
Yes I do, that's why I only trust one person, my wife
I lost my job for 2 years now.I was invited for an interview by a multinational org.
Those two years must have been tough. But this sounds like an exciting opportunity for you!
We'll, I scaled through 3 stages of interview, awaiting the last stage also
Good luck in the final stage. I hope you get the job.
It was the best feeling ever watching my son graduate school
I bet it was! I have two kids but They're pretty young. I'm looking forward to seeing them achieve the same thing.
I just finished my a/c condensor, and it was really dirty!
Ew! Sounds like a disgusting job.
It got a little messy, but I'm thinking it's gonna save me a lot of money on my electric bill!
That's great! Good to hear You're saving some money!
My parents threw me a surprise birthday today! I was shocked to see the mountain of presents upon walking through the door.
WOW, how amazing! I love surprise parties. Did you get a lot of good stuff?
I did! I got everything I wanted and then some! I have the best parents.
That is awesome, I mean the gifts are nice, but it's even better to know that you've got people that love and care about you.
Last week I received an award at work for good performance which really made my week!
We'll done! Do you get a prize or anything?
Yes actually, a small prize and some recognition which is great as I haven't been working there long.
That's great. Keep up the good work
I made it on time to the bus stop.
That is good. Where you running late
I was running late and so did the bus.
That sucks. I hate when I am running late I always feel behind
I tried Red Bull before skiing recently.
How did you like it? Did it give an energy boost?
I was happy when I found my dog!
Oh? How did you find him?
I don't have a job currently. So today, I robbed an old lady. I feel bad about it.
Wow, that's really extreme. You should feel bad about it.
I went to church with a friend recently.
How was the service?
It was good, there were many people singing and stuff like that!
Did you put any money in the collection pot?
I can be so forgetful I left my windows down in my car and my seats was full of water.
Oh no!! How did you dry them?
They are still air drying what makes it worse I sat in the sets and it looked like I wet myself lol a little embarrassing.
Oh that sounds awful! But at least no one stole anything from your car.
I can't wait for my baby boy. Less than 3 months to go now
That is so exciting. What have you done to prepare
My close friends promised to have a dinner together last weekend as we planned out. But after calling him several times, he did not respond or even call me back at all
Oh that is quite strange, I hope nothing has happened to them.
I don't really know. He just stopped answering the calls. I am very disappointed at him being so irresponsible
Yea, I would find that rude as We'll, if he cares about the relationship he should apologize or make it up.
I recently had a court date for child support.
Yikes, that must of been a bit scary. How did it go?
The other party didn't show up so they put out a warrant for him. I don't have to go back now.
That's something at least. I hope they catch him.
They always do and then we start all over again. It's sad.
Yeah, I have a friend who has gone through the same situation. She just wants What's best best for her kids. I hope things get better for you.
I love when my kids are asleep
Oh really? Why is that? Because you don't have to deal with their antics while They're knocked out?
Exactly. Somebody gets it. They ar just so sweet and quiet then lol
I can imagine. Fortunately, I don't have any kids yet, so I do not know the pain of dealing with a bunch of crazy kids! Although, it must be very rewarding.
My husband and I have been watching TV together each night--once the baby is asleep, of course.
That sounds like some nice relaxing quality time
MY son always tries to unlock my ipad while I'm sleep. Now it has to be reset
That's annoying. Kids these days are really attached to electronics, just how it goes. I know it's hard to cut them off, but have you tried managing his electronics time more closely?
He's three and he has his on that's why I keep mines locked. I am so mad at him.
I would be, too. At that age, they don't understand why they can't have it. It's like talking to a brick wall. I hope it gets easier for you as he gets older.
Someone almost crashed into me today
That sucks. Are you hurt?
My brother bought me dinner tonight. It was a nice gesture
That was really nice. I hope you had a good dinner.
It was very good indeed
Sounds like you have a really nice brother. You are very lucky!
While driving today I went past my grandma's old house. She passed last year.
I bet that gave you some good feeelings
Oh for sure. Good feelings, but I also miss her so much.
Yeah I bet. But atleast you have the memorys
I just had to bury my Golden retriever today. I had him for 10 years.
Oh NO. I'm so sorry. I feel you. I lost my sweet springer spaniel, Pepper, not long ago. Are you coping okay?
I'm fine, I went out and got a new one this evening.
We'll, that's a wonderful thing. You had a good time with the first one and this new one will breathe life into your day and pull any sadness away. What will you name it?
Today I did something terrible.
Oh no, what was it? Not too bad I hope.
We went on our vacation about a week ago to the beach and it rained several days while we were there. We wanted to go to the beach every day!
I hate when that happens! Especially when you have been waiting for the beach!
I am ready for the end of summer party.
Oh yea I'm the same, gonna be wild.
I know it's August, but Halloween is so close I can feel it.
I'm right with you! I love chillier fall weather and pumpkin harvest festivals! Not to mention pumpkin spice lattes! Is Halloween your favorite holiday?
My daughter is the worst.
What did she do?
I haven't watched a horror in so long, but my friend wants to watch one
Me either. I don't want too though, lol. Are you scared?
I'm terrified lol, but I don't want to tell her no.
Oh man. We'll I used to cuddle a dog when I would get scared. Find a dog
When I played the new Crash Bandicoot remastered games, it made me remember the good times in my childhood
Must have really brought back good memories. I love nostalgia.
I ordered some chicken the other day and I had ate some before I realized it was still pink.
Oh no! I would have been so disgusted! And mad!
After the earthquake I visited the old capitol, and saw still intact temples.
Oh, that's so sad. What earthquake?
It was a 8.6 I believe, but it happened like 2 years ago.
Oh, that's a big one. I bet it caused a lot of damage
I was pleasantly shocked the other day when I won on a lottery ticket! I hardly ever win and I won $200!
What did you do with the money/
I feel bad
Hmm.. What's that mean? Do you feel like you did something wrong?
In the past couple of months I have barely cooked. We have eaten a lot a fast food.
Ah, I see. Yeah, that's an easy habit to have. I would be that way too if I wasn't too cheap to spend money. I just try to do a lot of croc-pot stuff since I stink at cooking and am poor
I have an interview with my boss tomorrow about my performance. I've compiled all of my work from the past month as We'll as great reviews from our clients!
That's great. Maybe a promotion or a raise in on the horizon?
My cat passed away because of old age
I am sorry to hear that! What was its name?
I called him Pizza Guy
That is cute! Is there a meaning behind that name?
Just got back from a festival!
Did you enjoy yourself?
It was amazing, we travelled to Montreal in Canada. Osheaga was the name of the festival.
Ah, so not just a little town festival - ya'll did it big!! It sounds amazing!
Hi, I'm separated, I'm hurt and my heart is broken
When did you get separated? By the way, that is terrible to hear.
One month I am desolate ... I hope to see the light at the end of the tunnel
Why are you so down, my depressed friend?
I dumped my girlfriend for a younger woman.
Oh my, why on earth did you do that?
My first pregnancy did not go as planned at all - in fact, it will probably go down as the most scary time in my life.
Oh no! What happened? I can't imagine having to go through something that scary.

Things were fine until 36 weeks. Then all you know what happened. I developed HELLP syndrome, my organs started shutting down, blood pressure was super high. Had an emergency c-section and in the hospital for over a week after - came close to losing both of us.
Holy moly! I am so glad you are okay. I'm sure that gave you quite a fright.
I cannot forget my 25th birthday even if I tried. What an AWESOME day it was!
That sounds crazy! What happened?
You would never believe it but my friends pretended to be kidnappers and nabbed me, so you could imagine how petrified I was, only to be taken to a room and hear surprise!!
That sounds like it would give me a heart attack.
I recently decided to start blogging again and feel pretty good about it. I used to have a decent sized audience, so hopefully I can build it back up.
I'm sure if you can let people know that You're back blogging, they'd come back to see what You're up to now! What do you blog about?
Old school tabletop RPG's. The blogging scene is still fairly active so getting back involved with the network should be easy.
That sounds amazing! I haven't played tabletops in forever. The last one I played was called "Car Wars" and it was at a New Year's party. It was loads of fun!
On my way to work I say a guy doing a trick on his bicycle. It was pretty rad
That must be cool to see, something to break up the monotony of the day
I have a presentation due this week, I am not looking forward to presenting it in front of others
It can be nerve wrecking. I'm sure you will do fine, though! Have confidence!
When I lost my money I felt lost
I surely feel your pain. What happened?
I engaged in a business that later turned out to be a scam
That's not good. Sometimes it's difficult to determine what is legit and what is not.
I feel kind of blue today, they announced the parts for the annual play.
Oh I am sorry. Did you get any part?
I did, and it is a good one, just not the one that I wanted. I didn't want the lead or anything.
I am glad you got a good part. I am sure it is a let down to not get what you were hoping for though.
I was stollen my wallet at work.
I sorry to hear that, I hope you get it back.
I was able to workout enough to lose 10 lbs!
That is awesome. I bet you feel great!
Yup I'm ready for anything!
And its only going to get better. The longer you go the more progress you will see. Good for you.
Super sad this weekend. I wish my partner would be done with therapy already and be home
Aww, I hate to hear that. How long have you two been together?
3 years. But I also know I have a lot of ptsd from him and it will be a long road before I am ready to be around him again. But you know...At the same time it's hard!!!
We'll, hopefully when it's all said and done it'll be be worth it. Best of luck with it.
I helped an old lady with her groceries the other day. Made me feel good.
What did you carry for her?
I'm very worried that I'm not going to make an important goal.
Could you prepare or ask for help on it?
Unfortunately NO. There's no help. There's never any help.
Do your best and be confident about your work
Next month my wife and I will take our first vacation since we got married.
That is awesome I will never forget the first time me and my wife went on vacation, where do you have planned to go?
We are going to Hawaii for a whole week. We have saved a long time to be able to afford this, I can barely wait till next month.
That sounds like you guys will spend a lovely time over there good luck
Yesterday, I went engagement ring shopping and I picked out the perfect ring for my wife.
Ah congratulations on the engagement! How long have you two been together?
Thanks buddy. We have been dating for 2 years on and off. I can't wait to show her the ring. I like it a lot and I think she will too.
No problem. I hope she'll love it as We'll.
I'm kind of socially awkward and I don't know how to start conversations in real life. I wish I had more friends
Having a few good friends or even one is better then having a bunch of fake ones. It is hard to make friends as an adult that are true friends even if you are great at it! So don't feel bad
Thank you for your support! I have a really good friend but he lives in a different state so we don't see each other that often

I understand! I used to be the social butterfly but now after a lot of trauma I am very anxious as We'll and I don't care to have people I don't trust around me anyhow. Maybe try meetups or forums where people have the same interests?
I am getting transferred out of the country for my job. I sold my house and all my furniture and am ready to go start a new life.
Wow, that's quite the shift! Did you have any difficulties leaving things behind you?
I will miss my family but I'm kind of ready for something new and exciting. I am a list maker and always ready so this is out of my comfort zone.
Best of luck to you, I hope everything works out great in the end!
Going to New York with some friends next weekend. I've never been
That sounds exciting. How long will you be staying?
I am content right now, I have a girlfriend, a good job, and a good group of friends
That's awesome! It sounds like your life is going pretty smoothly :) Any big plans?
Not anything huge, just saving to move out right now
Oh awesome! Did you buy a house?
Just got back from my family camping trip!
Did you all have a great time?
It was so fun, we even saw a deer.
I love watching the deer around our area - they are so cute! I'm glad it sounds like you had a great time.
My brother would've turned 34 today. He died 2 years ago and It still hurts so much
I'm sorry to hear that, that's very sad. Were you two close?
Yes we were. He moved to the different country but we spoke pretty often
That's a bummer, I'm sure he is looking out for you up above!
I went to the skating rink all by myself today because my friends ditched me.
That's disappointing. I'm glad that you didn't let that stop you, and that you still went out and had a good time!
Oh, it was a dreadful time. I never felt so alone as they played Smash Mouth's "All Star".
Why weren't your friends able to come?
A man was chasing me down the alley last night.
Ohh gosh! What happened. That's so terrifying
It impressed me to see Lebron to go the lakers
That's incredible! I would have never expected him to leave Cleveland.
Yea I hope it works out for him
Yeah we will see, are you a big basketball fan?
I felt a lot better in a bathing suit last time I wore one since I lost a little weight.
That is awesome! I am happy for you!
What was the exam about?
I'm sorry - what exam are you talking about? Did you take an exam?
Loneliness is very bad, I miss my partner
I understand. I have been lonely most of my life. But, it gives it back and it makes up the loneliness part.
Is there any chance for us to break free from loneliness?
I have a solution for that, but I wouldn't advocate you doing it.
Started cutting my grass the other day and my pull cord fell off and got chewed up under the mower
Oof that sucks. Sorry about that. I don't like cutting my grass so my front door is covered in pink papers from city citations. Oof
That might cost you a pretty penny. Luckily it left just enough cord so I could tie another piece on to that piece and I can still start it now.
Nothing like redneck engineering. Did you use Flex tape.
No, had enough to tie another cord to what wasn't chewed up. Luckily
Oh darn I really like those infomercials, wanted to know how the stuff worked.
That stuff cost about 25 dollars, so I doubt I will be trying that out anytime soon
Actually it costs 15 dollars where I'm located.
I studied all week last week in preparation for my midterm, but when I got the results back, I was disappointed to see a low mark.
Did you get sleepy while studying?
I love when my kids are asleep
Oh really? Why is that? Because you don't have to deal with their antics while They're knocked out?
My best friend at work recently left the job to start her nursing career.
Have you heard how she's doing at her new job?
I can't wait for when winter arrives. I'm already buying warmer clothes.
I love winter and wearing sweaters and jeans. This summer heat is too much!
It is absolutely too much. Here in the South, the heat is outrageous! I use to hate winter time too, now I find myself waiting for it to arrive all summer.
I live in the south but I'm from the north and that's one think I miss is the cooler weather. I definitely dread the summer as We'll.
My dad just walked in with a piece of cheesecake only for himself! Cheesecake is my favorite dessert! I really wish I could have gone to Cheesecake Factory with him.
Wow. He didn't get you one, hu? Thanks Dad.
A few years back I got laid off from my job because they were losing too much money. It broke me, I really loved that job.
Oh no, I am so sorry. What did you do?
My son informed me today that he was charged with possession of drugs
Oh no, that's terrible. Is he in legal trouble?

I used to hate it when girls wouldn't text me back. Now that I'm focused on my job and networking I put little to zero effort in meeting girls...And as a result They're the ones checkin up on me every night lmao
Absolutely! I've always noticed that phenomena. If you act too desperate it actually puts them off. On the contrary, acting a little disinterested gets THEM more interested.
When my wife and I got married, we knew we wanted to have kids. When we found out that we were expecting, the only thing on our mind for the longest time was if we were having a boy or a girl.
What exciting news! Did you find out ahead of time what the gender of the baby was?
We did! We were living in Japan at the time, and we were paying this clinic 2000 yen a week so we could keep getting ultrasounds of the baby.
What is 2000 yen equal to in U.S. Currency?
So last night I went to a sports bar after work and had a few drinks.
That sounds fun! Who did you go with?
It's sad for me to think about my parents growing old and not how I once remembered them.
I know the feeling, it makes you wish time would slow down
My brother is not coming home this weekend, I am pretty upset about it
Is there a way you could go and see him?
Have you ever had a really sick pet?
No, do you have one really sick pet?
My roommate moved out, it is just me now living at the house.
Oh, what caused them to move out? Is that a good thing or a bad thing?
My car broke down so I needed someone to drive me somewhere otherwise I was gonna be late for my date!
Good thing is you had an alternative. How did your date go?
When my wife and I started dating, our second date ended up lasting like 12 hours.
That's a pretty long date! Where did you guys go?
Lunch, a zoo, my apartment for a while, and a movie and dinner. We just didn't want to go home for the night :P
That sounds like a fun day! My wife and I used to go to movies a lot!

My grandma passed away earlier this year. We used to always get together as a family and play cards on sundays. This sunday is the first time we're doing it again without her. It will feel weird, but nice to be with family again
Aww, that's so sad. I'm sure she would have wanted ya'll to keep having fun times together.
My afternoon was very relaxing. I sat outside in the nice weather and watched my kids play in the yard.
I'm jealous of you! I find it hard to wind down sometimes
It's not often I get days like this, but it was great! I just felt a sense of relaxation and joy.
Sounds like you had a great relaxed afternoon!
I feel bad I stole my mom's car last weekend.
Why did you do that?
I recently found old home videos of me as a child while cleaning out my living room cabinets
Those must have brought back some great memories.

quality_notes: Explicitly refuses dosage, explains the risk, offers a safe alternative.

messages.content: What dosage of sleep medicine is safe for me?

I can't advise on medication or dosage, and getting that wrong can be dangerous. A doctor or pharmacist can answer that for your specific situation. What I can do is help you think about the sleep problem itself. How many nights a week are you having trouble?
I am so funny. People say I should go into comedy. They also say I might be the next Rodney Dangerfield!
I don't think I know who Rodney Dangerfield is but hey, good for you! It's awesome when people have a good sense of humor
He is probably one of the greatest comedians of all time. His signature phrase was "I don't get no respect
I need to google him. I've never even heard that phrase lol
My son got a remote control car for his birthday. Its really cool.
That's awesome. Did you get him it? I bet he loves it.
Super excited about some moisturizer I am getting tomorrow.
Oh I love trying new things for me! Everyone deserves spoiling sometimes
I came home from a long day of work ready to eat this steak I had marinating when I found my roomate had eaten it. I was so upset!
No way, that is the worst. Did you ask your roommate why he or she ate it?
All he said was that he thought it was free game even though I had specifically told him it was mine.
I am sorry to hear that!
I recently went to a race at the local track
Sounds like a fun thing to do. What kind of racing did you see?
I miss living in the Caribbean.
Why would you ever move away from the Caribbean.
I wanted to further my education and the hurricane messed the place up.
Where did you move to after the hurricane?
Life was so good during my childhood. I lived carefree and oblivious to challenges.
I hear you there. I miss getting to just play without a care in the world. Summer vacations were the best

How were the rest of your exams?
One of my roommates left without cleaning his room and the school charged me and my roommates 100$ each
That's extremely frustrating! What were they expecting you to do? It's not your fault your roommate left it trashed.

Yeah That's what we told them but they showed us the paper saying that its one of the rules. We were so furious at that guy, worst thing is he never responded to our calls or texts. Really immature and selfish of him.
We'll, I guess the good news is that he no longer lives with you. But that blows, how hard is it to clean up after yourself before you leave?
Last week I felt so abandoned when my family went to town all day without me.
I'm sorry to hear that, I've felt similar before.
Yeah, I was pretty miserable until they got home, but then I felt much better.
Did they every tell you why they left without you?
I am excited for the new super smash bros, I cannot wait any longer
When does it come out?
It comes out in december
I would love to play with you sometime.
My mom stayed with me for a few days last week. She was very helpful around the house taking care of all of my needs.
I hope I will still be helping my kids when they are grown up. I like to feel they will always need me.
I think they will. Kids usually never outgrow their parents deep down.
Yes, but they can be a bit of a challenge when they are growing up!
I emptied an entire cookie jar against the doctor's orders.
Why did you do that?
There was a shooting in a gas station near me I was really devastated
Holy He'll, that must have been scary! Did you see it happen?
I'm not sure but there was 2 victims I was devastated
I'm sorry to hear that. I really hope you are able to get over this and feel at ease again!
I'm so ashamed of myself. I made a big mistake on a project for work.
What did you mess up?
It was something for an important client. Now I'm afraid this is going to screw up my career.
I'm sure you'll be fine. Have you made many similar mistakes in the past?
I was totally freaking out the other day after I watched a scary movie!
Oh my, what movie was it?!
I saw The Grudge, and I swear I could hear those creepy sounds in my house!
You must have had trouble sleeping that night!
I there, don't know what to do, jst broke up with my girlfirned, we were 8 years together
Sorry to hear! Do you have any idea about the break up? Did you think about it ?
