messages.content: Main je-na nahi chahta.

Aap ne yeh bataya, iske liye shukriya. Mujhe aap ki safety ka khauf hai. Kya aap is waqt khatre mein hain?

Please kisi bhi cheez se door rahein jis se aap ko nuksan ho sake, aur akele na rahein. India mein emergency ke liye 112 par call karein. Muft manasik madad ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 par kisi bhi waqt call kar sakte hain. Kya aap kisi ke saath reh sakte hain?
I applied for a promotion. I hope I get it.
I hope you get it also! What type of position is it?
I find myself of people with nice cars lately.
That is good, do you like nice cars?
I am ready for my camping trip next weekend.
Are you excited about it?
I have a doctors appointment this thursday and I'm very worried about it.
What's wrong? What are you visiting the doctor for?
I came home and I quickly realized that my neighbors chopped down a tree in my front yard while I was away on vacation.
Oh man... That would tick me off. What did you do?
I haven't done anything yet because I don't exactly know how to confront him. Maybe chop one of his down? In any event, I am pretty darn upset about it.
I probably would not chop his tree down. You want to have the moral high ground. But yes I would confront him
I really wanted to try bison meet and I went all the way to that whole foods store like 57 miles away and they didn't have it, what a waste of time
That sucks, after going all that way too and you didn't even get to try it. I'm sorry.
I was ashamed when my dog started barking loudly when I was away.
Why were you ashamed? Did she disturb the neighbors or something?
Yes, my neighbors were very angry.
I'm sorry that happened. You might need to get her obedience training,
I am about to go on vacation to the beach! I am so ready!
Oh I love vacations! Do you love the water?
I do! I can't wait to see the ocean!
It's beautiful I'm sure you'll have tons of fun.
I just found out that my sister in law is pregnant which is so exciting, but she has had a miscarriage before so I'm just trying to stay positive for her and I know things will go We'll.
That is exciting! I hope everything goes We'll.
I've been dieting the last two months, and so far, I've lost aboout 30 pounds!
Wow! That's amazing! You must be proud! What is your secret?
I'm planning a surprise party for my brother. I already have all the supplies ready to throw a bash!
I wouldn't be able to keep a surprise like that!
Yeah, I have all the balloons, food and gifts stashed in my basement!
Sounds like You're ready to go!
I hate that people hit on others they know are married.
Ugh, why do people do that? It's annoying.
My dog has to have her teeth cleaned on Wednesday and I am really nervous b/c she got super sick last time afterwards
That's strange, I hope she makes it out ok this time though.
I wanted to go out but I couldn't take my small kids. I hadn't ever had a babysitter but I knew my sister would take good care of them.
I'm sure it was scary to leave your kids for the time but at least it was their aunt and not a stranger!
I started to feel panicky and breathless.
That's no good. Why did you feel like that?
My dad was in the hospital recently. He was in very bad condition and didn't look like he was gonna pull through. Thankfully he did.
I'm really happy that he made it. I bet it was a tough thing to go through.
Yeah, I can't imagine life without my dad. It'll happen someday, I just would prefer it to happen once he's lived a full life.
I know what you mean. I wish my dad were still around.
I don't have money to buy my brother a present.
Aww, that's sad. I have been there more than I like to admit.
One time I was camping out in the woods in California with some friends. I ended up getting lost on my way back to the camping spot in the middle of the night.
Wow that must have been scary!
My appartment was robbed last week. The police called me to tell me that theyprobably found some of the objects that have been robbed. I hope it is true.
Oh wow that is terrible I hope you recover everything that was taken from you
I can't wait until after work today I get to go pick up my new car.!
Oh, what kind is it?
Its a jeep, I love jeeps. 2018 compass
I've never owned a jeep, are they nice?
I spent all weekend alone, wish my family lived closer.
I know what you mean. My family is 800 miles away
My family is over 2,000 miles away in Alaska, its tough!
I feel for you. It really makes life tough when you can't just take a drive down the road and see them.
My dad was cleaning out his attic when he found a box of my old stuff from childhood
Oh, that's cool. Did you find any good memories in there?
Four more days and the kids ar back in school!! Yay
Nice! What do you plan to do with a house empty of kids?
Enjoy silence for a while. Then I don't know lol, but I can't wait!
I am glad for you. Sometimes kids can be annoying.
I am drug addict. I didn't pay my drug dealer. He came last week to ask for his money.
Oh no! Is everything ok? I hope he didn't scare you
I was shocked in a good way when my aunt made my graduation. She lived out of state
That's awesome! What a nice surprise. And congratulations on graduating. That's a big accomplishment. What did you graduate in?
It was in english

Oh, very cool. I thought about majoring in English, too, but decided to go a different route. I hope your new degree helps you land the job you want! You're now in the exciting unknown part of your life.
I really really really hope I get this job
What job? Don't be discouraged if you don't get it though! Keep trying!
I was scared to walk home yesterday
Why were you scared to walk home?
I wake up every morning and go to work.
Do you like your job or is this something you dread?
My job is what it has to be to get through the day.
We'll I hope you find something you love and You're happy to do. Still searching for that myself.
I went to Jack N The Box the other day, and there was a long gray hair in my burger!
I have never had that. We don't have them here. Good thing though lol
I just found my keys after 6 hours
I bet they were in the last place you looked
My sister lives in Utah. We had planned for her to come visit but her work would not allow her to take the time off.
Aw that's annoying. Work always gets in the way of things. Did you ever try to go to her?
I haven't yet. I would like to eventually. I'm hoping to see her soon
I'm sure it will work out! Not this time unfortunatly, but it will in the end
This morning my husband received a call, he got nervous, I think it was a woman ... Difficult
Oh? That's not good. Do you think he has lots of secrets?
I think so ... I'm a little worried, because of the situation
I'm sorry :( I do hope things can be worked out
I just moved into my new house and I am having a cockroach problem.
That really sucks! What do you have to do?
I'm just using Raid right now, but I will call an exterminator tomorrow. I hate bugs so I am freaking out a little bit.
I do too. I am so sorry you are going through this
I'm very sure that I will have straight As in the exam
That is good, have you studied hard?
Yes I have because I wanted my parents to be proud of me
That is good, where do you go to school?
I was happy when I saw I got the day off!
Congrats! A day off is always nice. Did you do anything fun with your extra time?
My mom and I haven't always had the best relationship. Recently I've had to tell myself to let her in more. It's been challenging.
I hope that your relationship continues to strengthen.
Thank you. I know that, even though it's challenging, I need to be patient in order to improve our relationship.
I agree. Life is short and having these relationships is very important
I really am looking forward to seeing if my parents will buy me a dog.
Why your parents? Can't you buy it yourself, all on your own like a grown ups?
Unfortunately, I have a disability that keeps me from leaving my home so I can't search for one myself.
I am sorry to hear that. I think you should join your parents when they go shopping for a pet to a store
I love the Dallas Cowboys!
What do you love about football season? (They're football right?)
I was walking down the street and I saw a really creepy clown smiling at me. I got so scared.
Oh man. Now I am having images of the movie "It" in my head. What did you do?
I just ran home and hid underneath my bed. I looked out the window and it was on the street still staring at me. Now I can't leave my house!
That is unusual behavior for a clown. I would say you might want to call the authorities. There has to be a law against a creepy clown stalker
I was happy when the clock struck 5pm and I got out of work!
Getting out of work is the greatest feeling.
Yes it is..
I love to enjoy my free time too.
I recently did not pay my rent. My land lord has been terrible at providing services
Oh NO. I rent also so I know your pain. My last landlord was awful. How did your landlord react?
He decided to start caring and doing his part.
Oh good, glad he did that instead of just coming down on your for not paying. Glad it worked out for you.
I like like loaning money to friends. It can ruin friendships and sometimes doesn't get paid back.
I'm always leery of loaning money to friends
When I hear 80s instrumentals and it reminds me of my family's Christmas karaoke nights, good times :))
Good times indeed! Those were the days. It seems cliche to say they were simpler times because I remember them saying that back then about when they were younger. History repeats itself.
Absolutely.
When I think of Christmas with families I tend to think about National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation. A classic.

I'm looking forward to my big break. Don't know when it is but I know it'll be in this life because I've been at ground zero and am willing to go through more He'll just to reach the decadent, prestigious pinnacle of material success in this lifetime and nothing can stop me
Sounds like a goal to me. Good luck!
Thanks for you support.
You're welcome. Goals is what makes life matters sometimes.
I just arrived in a new country after traveling for two months. There aren't many people in the new place I am staying. I am starting miss my friends and home.
What country? If you don't mind sharing...I'm in South Texas and loving it :)
I just got to Vietnam. When I was in Thailand I met so many people. Now I just can't stop thinking of home.
I'm sure you'll meet some cool people if you find a good Pho restaurant!
My childhood friend gave me a watch for by birthday a few years ago, I lost it in a move recently. I'm pretty upset by it.
Oh no! It always seems like things get lost when you move doesn't it? Is there anyway you can go back and see if its at your old place?
I've actually checked and went through all the boxes too. Here's hoping it turns up one day though!
It will probably be where you least expect it!
We walked, we ate ice cream, we rode a bike, we laughed a lot, we enjoyed the outdoors, we were exhausted
Who did you do all those things with? Sounds like a wonderful day!
I had time that I did not share with the children and that was something that was pending in my soul
They must have been really happy.
I was looking through the attic and found a box of childhood toys. They brought back so many memories!
That must have really been a wonderful surprise!
It was nice to find them all and think back to those simpler times
Yeah childhood ends way too fast it's great when we have a chance to reflect on them.
When I finally graduated from technical school it was the greatest satisfaction.
That must have felt very good. And taken a lot of determination.
Yes, thanks to my classmates, I made it out alive.
It's great to have friends in the classroom. Are you still friends with some of them?
I was watching my kids soccer game last weekend. I was floored at how much they have improved. They are passing and challenging so much better.
That's pretty cool to hear. When I have kids, I hope They're the same, and can get into sports, since it offers so much. Good for you for getting them into sports
I feel guilty because I couldn't go to my friends party
Understandable. What was the reason?
My older sister stole money from me.
Do you know it was her for sure? That is horrible that you can't trust your own sister.
Yeah, no one else in the household would ever do something like that. The worst thing is, my parents did nothing about it.
That is horrible. It sucks that you have to keep such a close eye on your things in front of family. I would be so mad.

Being a mom is such a struggle sometimes. On the one hand I really enjoy the break I get when my son stays with his grandparents. On the other I always feel a bit off kilter when he's not home with me.
I totally understand what you mean. Peace and quiet is nice but I bet you miss your son when he is gone?
I took my dress to the seamstress for alteration. I was given a date to pick it up and to this day it is not ready.
That is so annoying. Did you need it for a special occasion?
Yes I needed it for a wedding. I ended up buying another dress.
I hope they at least gave you your money back.
Just got back from an amazing concert.
That is nice. Who was the singer?
It was The Weeknd.
Are you big fan?
I was shocked by my present.
You got a present? How lovely! What was the occasion?
It was my anniversary.
We'll, happy anniversary! What was your present?
My girlfriend moved in over the weekend. We have a ton of boxes to unpack but I am thinking it should be something that can be done in the next couple weeks.
That's nice to hear. Hopefully it makes you two happy. I would just unpack the necessities first and move from there.
I have a good feeling tomorrow will be fun. We are going to a new restaurant in town
Oh yeah? What kind of restaurant?
So about a year ago now, my girlfriend decided to surprise me with a puppy!
Oh wow, puppies are nice. What kind of puppy did you get?
I would never cheat on my wife like my brother cheated on his wife
Whoa yeah That's awful, I wouldn't either
I am happy to relax on this fine day
Oh yes, what is the temperature where you are?
I was surprised when my wife left me
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that.. How long were you married?
We were married for 10 years
It must have felt unbelievably hurtful for you.. I hope you find someone very soon..
The first time I went on a motorcycle, I was scared. But I knew my husband wouldn't do anything to hurt me. I trusted him with my life.
It must be nice to have that kind of trust for someone, and motorcycles can be fun!
I just got payed yesterday , so I finally bought new clothes and went out to eat with some friends
Payday is fantastic! What kind of clothes did you buy?
Just some khaki shorts , and running nike shorts since its so hot outside, nothing huge since all my bills are due next week
Do you ever use poshmark or mercari? Those are good for deals. Sounds like you got some nice stuff! Payday is always a fun day
It was supring to see someone eat a 3 lbs burger
I have seen them eat bigger
Um ok
Why that response?
Last time I climbed Elbert I started getting sick from altitude. Heading to Colorado next week to try to climb it again.
That sounds awesome! Is Elbert a fourteener?
Yes, it's the tallest in Colorado. This will be my 3rd time climbing it. But the first time since I got old and Lazy.
Hahaha. We'll, I hope you don't get sick. Take something salty with you, maybe that will help. Have fun!
I was on my way to work and I met a stranger who offered me a ride to work.
We'll that was nice. Do you normally walk?
I applied for a job last week
What kind of job is it?
My grandpa always said he was a rockstar back in his day, but I never believed him.
Why don't you believe him? He made have been quite the big name back in his day.
My vacation is coming up, just thinking about it makes me happy!!
Hey that's awesome! Where are you going for vacation??
Ireland, land of castles.
Oh I'm so jealous! I bet that place is beautiful!!
Today is going to be awesome! We are going to the lake to see all of our family!
That sounds like a lot of fun, will you be cooking stuff too?
MY son just wasted my soda on some important papers.
I am sorry, how important were they
I have to turn them into the school tomorrow. Now I will be late for work because I have to do new ones at the school in the morning.
I am sorry, that sounds stressful
I brought home a cake for my family, but I ate all of it! Ugh.
All of it??? Oh NO. How bad do you feel right now?
I spent last weekend with most of my family, they live out of state and I don't see them often.
Did you have a good time visiting with them?
I did, Yes. Work has been hectic lately so I was really looking forward to unwinding with them.
What did you guys do?
We ate good food, drank wine and went swimming.
That sounds fun. Was the weather nice?
I was so hungry and broke. My mother loaned me some money for food and I am VERY thankful.
What a nice gesture! What did you get to eat after not eating for so long?
I got a juicy triple stack cheeseburger and some fries from a local mom n pop store. It was delicious!!!
What kind of toppings did it have on it?
A friend of mine drove me to work when my car broke down
That is great of them, did you do anything to pay them back?
I took him out to dinner later on, he's a good friend
That is nice of you, glad you have supportive friends!
I have an amazing brother. He's so great to talk to. I can tell him anything!
How old is he? Is he mature?
When I worked as a hotel rep. In Spain a few years ago I was greeting guests one morning. Suddenly I saw someone I knew - it was my cousin who decided to come and visit me. It was so unexpected!
Oh that must have been so exciting and surprising!
I won first place at the egg swallowing contest at my school the other day!
What haha that's a real thing???
My friend was telling me about teaching jobs to apply for. I didn't get hired, but she got one right off the bat!
It sounds like You're happy for her, which is commendable given you didn't get hired. Were you very disappointed?
I was kind of envious that she got the job and I didn't because it seemed like I was more qualified than she was.
That's always tough. It's so hard to tell what other factors come into play in situations like that. Are you happy where You're currently at, or still looking?
I have a phobia of water, and my boyfriend made me go out on his boat last weekend.
Oh that sounds mean. How did you do?
I am ready for the end of summer party.
Oh yea I'm the same, gonna be wild.
Yes, I will be bringing the booze.
Oh That's awesome, you are a good person, we need more booze people
I wake up every morning and go to work.
Do you like your job or is this something you dread?
M getting me some of that Costco $10 large pizza this weekend
Oh yeah baby, that sounds awesome. I don't know what it is, but those "buy in bulk" stores' food cafes always have INSANE pizza. I'm jealous!
I spilled tea over myself at dinner with my in-laws and just wanted the earth to swallow me in that moment.
Oh no, that must have been embarrassing... But it happens.
I was not faithful to her
Oh god..We'll I hope she left you and you've learned that no one likes a betrayer
Lol. I broke up because I felt bad about the lies and guilt
That/s disturbing kiddo..You lied and betrayed then you left. You have much to learn about life and how to treat others
Some of my friends told me that they had a big surprise for me. They know I hate surprises, but I complied and let the blindfold me and drive me out to the location.
That sounds exciting and scary. What was the surprise?
They had decided to pool their money together and get me one big present together. It was a flying lesson at the local airport.
That is so awesome. Did you have fun? And more important, are you a pilot now?
I found a rabbit that had been shot by someone in my yard
That is terrible. Was it dead or just injured?
I spilled tea over myself at dinner with my in-laws and just wanted the earth to swallow me in that moment.
Oh no, that must have been embarrassing... But it happens.
Yea it keeps me up a night, even thought its been a week!
Wow you might have gotten a little bit of trauma from it. But I'm sure it will fade from memory eventually.
I have to give a big speech tomorrow in class.
Oh that's always tough, are you nervous?
I recently published a research paper on vaccine safety and it was actually accepted into scientific journals!
That is so awesome and a great accomplishment do you plan to write more in the future?
I've got an employee review at work on monday.
I hope it goes We'll! Are you worried?
Yeah but not for any good reason. I do a good job.
Then everything should go fine! Good luck, I hope you get a raise!
My entire family went to Europe for the summer. It is just me at the house.
That sounds nice. How come you didn’t go with?
I have to work, there is no way I can take an entire month off.
I am with you there. I hope you get a chance to go there sometime though.
I'm going on a trip to New York City in December.
How exciting! First time there?
No, I go yearly. I already have my maps ready and color coordinated with things to do and restaurants to go to!
What's it like? I have never been there.
My dog I had for five years just passed away. He was hit by a car last night.
Oh I am so sorry. That must be fresh on your heart, may he rest in peace.
I tried to paint my house one color and it turned out another color.
That is no good, I am sorry that happened to you
Thanks, yeah its a bummer
It happens I suppose, maybe there is some sort of refund policy where you bought it from
I am applying to grad school.
Oh wow! Congratulations! I also recently applied for grad school to study Computer Science (seriously). What are you wanting to study?
I'm going to study School Psychology!
That is very cool! I don't know about you, but I have been stressed out about the whole process.
I saw an ad for Disneyland and I remembered the first time I had ever been there
I LOVED Disneyland growing up! Did you go often? How old were you and what was your favorite ride?
So I found out my dad was cheating on my mom for 3 years.
Oh no, I am so sorry to hear that. Does your mom know?
Yeah she is the one that told me. Apparently she managed to make him break it off finally.
I am so sorry that your family is going through this horrible time. Is your dad unwilling to end the affair?
I saw a colleague stealing money at work. I wonder if I did the right thing by not telling my boss.
Is there a reason why you didn't tell your boss?
I just didn't want to be labeled as a snitch, but now I'm having second thoughts.
Is there a way you could report it anonymously?
So I never win anything but yesterday I won in a lottery!! I only won 50$ but it's better than none, right
Good for you! My husband is lucky in the lottery, but I'm not. But, I would be excited about that $50 too!
I literally never won before! I felt so lucky yesterday!
You are probably like me, already figure you lost before you scratch the ticket lol. I'm glad you won!
That sounds like a wonderful time at any point in life!
What sounds like a wonderful time?
When playing a new fighting game it reminded me of my childhood and playing games with my brothers and friends from school. What a wonderful time of my life.
That does sound like a lot of fun. I miss hanging out with all of my firends
I was crushed when I didn't win the lottery
Yeah, I wouldn't get too down. Statistically, there's not much of a chance of ever winning.

I am confident in my own judgment. Because I am not just a man---I am THE MAN like that 50 cent song...I'm not perfect but I'm always confident that no matter what I do, the only person who knows what's best for me is ME and no one else
Do you trust other people at all? It seems like it would be hard to trust someone if you think only you can know what is best for you.

Nope because trusting people has gotten me mugged, stabbed, heartbroken, robbed, and rendered homeless. Every since trusting myself I've become fully self employed, make 1200 a week, drive my own car pay my own bills and find time to hit the gym 6 days a week. So life's pretty gravy tbh
That's great. It seems like you turned your life around. It just seems like it would get lonely not being able to trust anyone.
I was supposed to mail off a check to pay a bill today and I forgot to put it in the mail when I left for work.
Uhoh, I hope they don't have a late fee or anything attached to it
We lost our faily dog she had been with us since I was 15 years old.
Aw, that sucks. Did you give her a proper burial?
Yes we did my mom loved her so much especially when me and my brither moved out she is hurt and down so bad.
Awwww, I am so sorry. Have you thought about getting a new pup?
I cheated on my math test today. Feels bad, man.
I can understand that - I think all of us, at one point or another, did something we were ashamed of.
I know...I'm not sure if I will ever be able to sleep again.
I know that feeling, kinda sick to your stomach can't get it out of your head kinda thing. We all have to have a method to overcome it and move on.
I really should have switched banks a long time ago. Nobody over there knows their head from their butt!
I know what you mean. Once I had a bank where the teller's literally had butts for heads. It was so distracting trying to talk to them.
My sister just told me that she is having a baby!
It must be such an exciting time for her and your family!
My armadillo passed away today...RIP Adolph.
I'm sorry to hear that. Adolph must've had a happy life though.
My friend got us concert tickets to a sold out show. He told me he couldn't get them. I can't believe he kept that a secret until now.
Oh man, that's awesome! What concert were the tickets for?
I worked hard at winning a competition and ended up losing to my coworker, it made me pretty upset.
How close did you lose by? I bet at the next competition, you'll wipe the floor with them.
It is something that was really important to her, and I still feel bad that I missed her 15th birthday
Who is she?
I am in a very fulfilling relationship. My partner and I mesh so We'll together it brings me great joy!
That's great, I feel there is someone out there for everyone
I'm always stoked when I get a text back from a really attractive girl I didn't expect to hear back from...But I do a good job hiding it
Why do you hide it?
I had a dentist appointment yesterday. I hate going to the dentist!
I understand that completely! Did you have to get any work done?

Yes I had to get a filling in my very back tooth. THe dentist said I had a very deep cavity and to raise my hand if I started to feel anything because it was very close to my nerve. I was scared the whole time.
That sounds scary! I always avoid going to the dentist until I absolutely have to. I know that's pretty bad!

Been making a lot of money off of my hobby lately. I think this thing might take off and I can quit my day job... I had no idea that would happen, or that people would enjoy my work enough to do that.
What kind of hobby do you have?
It seems like every other family in my daughter's class lives in a mansion.
It must be nice to be rich
My niece just learned how to ride a bike!
Aw how wonderful. She must have been really proud of herself and happy.
I'm sorry to keep you waiting I had a technical issue. I just got a new deep fryer, and I fried my very first turkey today. I know it doesn't seem like much, but I am very excited about it.
I'm happy that you got a new turkey friar and fried your first turkey. You do seem like you would enjoy that.
Thank you for understanding. It's been annoying my family but I bet They're excited for me as We'll. I love frying birds that's for sure haha.
Hey, some people are on this planet to fry birds, and some people aren't. I guess that's just how it is.
Wishing that he would call me
Why not just call him? Its not unheard of.
I got a good job, a nice house, a lovely dog, and great food. Life is awesome. I am so happy.
Good for you! You are a lucky person!
Yeah I can't complain. Guess everything has gone right for me!
That's great! I'm a bit jealous.

Happy Early Birthday! What are your plans?
DRINK DRINK DRINK, hopefully not too much. I like to be in control.
Oh man, I've seen many a newly 21 year old get drunk.
Got asked to my boss' office. Thought I was getting bad news but turns out I was offered a promotion.
Nice. Did you take it?
My husband had to go out of town for work.
What does he do for work?
He builds computers. He will be gone for 2 months! I don't know what to do.
We'll you could always pick up a new hobby! What is something you've always wanted to learn?
Last week at work, I went to sit down at my desk chair and completely missed it and fell straight into the floor.
Oh my...I hope you didn't hurt yourself.
I went to pick up my car from the mechanic and found a huge scratch on the side! They are saying they didn't do it! I am so mad right now!
Oh my gosh. I am not surprised they denied any wrong doing. I think that is typical of mechanics. What do you plan to do about it?
I guess I can't do anything but write a bad review.
I think bad reviews are important though. A lot of people use those to determine where they go for service. You may save someone else the trouble you have.
Ever since my kids left and went to college I am such a loner.
I can understand you. But this is the cycle of life, right? Kids grow and they have to find their own way of life in this world
Yes you are right at least I have my cats to keep me company lol so I'm not to much alone.
Good for you. You can also call your friends to hang out if you have close ones
I lied to a friend this weekend. It made me feel like a rat
What did you lie about?
I was digging around in some of my old stuff at my dads the other day, and I found all my old paintball gear.
Oh, how cool! Dd you and your dad play together?
We have movie night on Friday
Sounds fun! What movie are you going to watch?
I went to visit my mm last weekend. We enjoyed talking and looking through old photos.
Do you guys live far away from each other? I love talking with my mom about her and my childhood.
Hello how was your day?
My day was great so far! How about you?
Yeah fine great day
That is good to hear! I'm am sure you are grateful to experience such a good day!
I think today is going to be a good day.
I sure hope so. Why do you think that it will be a good day?
My bird chirp chirp chirps all night long.
How does that make you feel?!
I got really joyful when my dad got me my first vehicle. It was just a happy feeling
Yeah. I know that feeling., although I had to buy my own.
My favorite restaurant closed down. I'd go so often after work
I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you can find a similar place around you!
I have my job interview today. I am quite hopeful that it is going to go We'll.
I hope too !! I think you will do We'll!!
Me too! I really want to be the first millionaire that works at McDonalds!
Omg!! Millionaire that works at McDonalds. I would like to see you work
I was afraid when I watched a horror film
I am sorry to hear that, they frighten me as We'll.
Some have pop ups and they are creepy
Yes, those scare me to death when they come out of nowhere.
I am so excited my friend told me last minute we are going to Las Vegas for my birthday she arranged everything.
That sounds amazing! What do you think You're gonna do there?
It made me mad when I saw a dent in my car door last week
Oh no, do you know what caused it?
At a office party, I tried to invite a female coworker for a drink. She rejected me in front of everybody. I felt bad.

Ah, that's rough. That was a very bold move on your part. But sometimes fortune favors the bold, as they say. I think you'll be happy later on not having to wonder "what if." Still though, she could have maybe been more discrete about things.
She has been mean and making sure that everyone knows. That is the thing.

Ah, I see. We'll, it's a good thing you were rejected thing, maybe. At least now you know what kind of a bullet you dodged. Plus, this is just another step in your overall confidence and character building. The next time you ask someone else out, it will be easier.
I'm taking my midterm exam this week, and I really want to do We'll on it. I've studied a lot, and taken the practice test 5 times. I'm still pretty anxious though!
Nice, I guess the only times I was nervous to take a test was when I wasn't prepared, but there's only so much preparation you can do until you just have to trust your brain or whatever
That's true. I probably have it down pat at this point. It's just it's my first graduate course, and I want to ace my entire graduate degree with a 4.0 GPA. This is my first major major grade.
Wow! You must have like every technique in your toolbox to go for that goal
Someone hit my car while I was shopping. I am so mad they didn't even leave a note.
Oh no that is terrible, I can not believe that they would drive off without leaving any contact information! How bad was the accident?
My ex and I went to Branson a few weeks ago. It was so much fun!
I have never gone. Was it really that much fun going with an ex though?
We'll we broke up afterwards lol. But the trip was still fun. There are some cool things to do there depending on where you live.
Maybe I will check it out. I have heard good things about Branson
My dog I had for five years just passed away. He was hit by a car last night.
Oh I am so sorry. That must be fresh on your heart, may he rest in peace.
It is just so sad to have my loyal companion taken away like that.
I can only imagine. I am so sorry. What was his name?
I procrastinated and didn't do the dishes for a couple days now. I think fungus started to grow on some of the old food, so nasty!
Oh no! I bet you regretted that fast!
I stole candy from the store today.
Why did you steal candy from the store?
My father couldn't stope any lower, how can someone take money from their own child
That's horrible! I'm a parent and I could never take money from my child. Did you confront him?
My grandmother became sick recently so I have taken some time off work to nurse her.
Oh no! I'm sorry to hear that. I hope she gets better.
Thank you, slowly each day she is getting back onto her feet.
I'm glad that she is getting better!
I felt heartbroken when my girlfriend moved away without telling me first
I would too why would she not tell you!? Did yall break up?
We had a fight, I never knew we were broken up though
That sounds like poor communication on her part maybe its better for you she moved. :/
I had to take my daughter to the doctor the other day. She was very sick.
Oh no! Hopefully its just the flu. What did they say?
I'm waking up everyday feeling like my life is getting more and more on track toward my goals. It's pretty great
That should be an awesome feeling. I do wish you all the best in life.
Thank you for your kind words.
You're welcome! You have your whole life ahead of you, you are a star.
All my cucumber plants died this week due to too much rain
Oh man. What a bummer! I love cucumbers and hummus! Do you have anything else You're growing that survived?
I'm going to a concert on sunday, and I'm out of my mind about it
That sounds fun, what concert?
Breaking ben and 5 finger death punch
I bet you are going with your dad?
I really wanted to take a weekend trip with my husband and my mom offered to watch my daughter. So grateful!
Mom of the year award! That's awesome, where are you going?
Last night I turned 8 shades of red. I was blushing so bad
What made you blush so hard?
I went for a run and had to go to the bathroom. I went to hide behind some bushes and someone caught me peeing. I couldn't believe it
Hey you have got to do what you have got to do. Hopefully next time You're closer to home when you need to go.
I am scared about growing up, it is sort of unnerving
That's true.. It is challenging. How old are you?
My friend is moving away, I am going to miss her so much. I can't help but cry a little when I think about it.
Aw sorry to hear that...Why is she moving
A new job offer so I don't blame her
Nice We'll if you keep in touch everyday maybe it won't feel so far
Hello ... I confess that when I see my daughter's eyes, my heart suffers.
Wow, what happened to her eyes?
They are sick
Ohhh sorry about that. It is We'll.
I'm on a diet to try and lose weight but I slipped up. I don't know what to do since my wife and I are dieting together.
How badly did you slip up? You're allowed cheat days
My friend got to go on a trip this weekend without me. I am pretty envious
Why was it without you?
I had to work
We'll that can't be helped. What kind of trip was it?
I start my last year of my Masters program Friday. I'm scared I feel like I'm all ready behind.
Have you tried to talk to your teacher?
Do you ever just feel trapped. Its so aggravating
I have felt that. It always sucks feeling like you can
They are repaving my street and I can't leave the house becasue we aren't allowed to drive on it. I need to go to work later so they better let me drive on it eventually!
That's the worst. How do they expect people to get around?
I lost my mother recently, she was sick with hypertension and diabetics
I am sorry to hear that.
I knew I was going to pass my bartender test last month. I studied so hard
Congratulations. Sounds like you aced it
I did pretty We'll so thanks
I bet you will make a great bartender, maybe one of these days you will hook me up with a free drink
I just ate a whole bag of cookies
Hahaha...I've been there and I have done that...What kind of cookies?
They were belgian chocolate ones with salted caramel
Ohhh...Fancy I don't blame you then. I would have eaten them all too
My dog died lost week. I am inconsolable now
That is spo terrible, my dpg died when I was really young, and just have never really had a dog since,
I think I won't be able to able get over him. I feel like already lost my soul
That's how I felt I cried for days, it still doesn't seem real.
So I was on the bus back from a party and a drunk guy barfed on me at a stop lol. Most of it got on my jacket and he didn't even apologize.
Oh wow! I would have been so disgusted and outraged! What did you do?
I ate at a very popular restaurant in my city last night.
Oh yeah. Was the food good? What about the service?
Everything seemed good, But I found out on the news this morning that they where not serving real meat.
Oh my gosh! What where they serving? That makes me feel sick for you. I hate being decieved!
My cat came into my life just as my dog was declining in health
That sounds very fortunate. Good timing.
My and some old friends from college recently got together. It's always great to see those guys again.
I bet it is! I love getting together with friends, especially if it has been a while...Which it seems to be the older I get.
When my children were born, it was a rejoicing time for me. I can't think of a time I felt more happiness.
Children are a beautiful thing for us parents. What a great memory you have of that.
I got a yoga mat for free at work today. I'm thinking about trying it out
Very cool! Have you ever done yoga before or would this be a first time?
I ave the worst mailman
That's no good. What did he do?
He never closes the mailbox. Sometimes my mail flies away
That is so annoying. Have you reported him, or asked him to be sure to close the mailbox?
I'm a little uneasy about making it through the last half of the year.
Why is that?
Several years ago one of my neighbors dogs attacked me and I had to go to the hospital to get stitches.
Yikes that's no good. How many stitches did you have to get?
So that new game that I've been looking forward to is coming out in a few weeks!
What is it called ?
Oh, I'm sure it's not one that you've heard of. I'm pretty excited though, I've been saving up money for it for a few months now.
Okay, We'll I guess I'm happy for you then.
Some days I listen to sad music at work
Really? Why do you do that?
I ended up staying at home for the holidays
Why is that? Comfort ?
No all my family lives out of state. I didn't feel like traveling, but I just ended up sitting at home and watching lord of the rings in the dark.
OH NICE! THAT'S SOUNDS SO AMAZING, I love watching lord of the rings every now and then, did you watch all the sequels all over again?
I came across my wedding albums the other day and showed them to my kids.
Oh wow, I bet the emotions of that came back to you.
Yes, it was so much fun to see the younger version of me and my husband, pre-kids. Very sentimental.
Yes, those memories are what make life so special.
I went fishing with my 4 year-old about a month ago.
That sounds great, I can remeber going fishing with my dad at that age. Did your 4 year-old have a good time?
The day my daughter was born was the happiest day of my life
Congratulations! You and your family must be delighted to have a new member!
My long distance girlfriend surprised me when she flew in to visit me this past weekend
Aww, that is so sweet! I'm sure you were very happy
I was ecstatic. It was before school has started, so I had a lot of free time. Couldn't have been planned better.
Oh yeah, definitely! She seems like a very good girlfriend to do that for you. Sounds like y'all have a good future ahead.
My husband says he stopped drinking but I'm reluctant to believe him
That's kind of sad. What makes you reluctant?
My boss is coming for dinner tonight with his wife.
Oh that's exciting. Are you nervous to have them over?
Yes I am. Many things could go wrong I hope they don't or I probably won't be getting a raise and worse still I will be to embarrassed to ask for it.
I bet it's all in your head. I am sure it will all good smooth.
I got my new vacuum today finally! I couldn't wait to open it up! The last one was broken...
How much did you pay for the new one?
Only like $65. This is the first new vacuum I have ever gotten! I have always had super old ones
That is a great bargain, Will you use it tonight?
My friend recently lended me their car so I can go out of town
That was nice of them. Did you have any problems with their car?
A friend who I hadn't seen since school started work at my job
How do you feel about that?
I always try to put myself before my dogs. I love them so much!
I love them too. What kind of dog do you have?
I have a Husky and a maltese Shiz Tzu. They are my little babies!
Awww, I bet they are. I don't have a dog right now but I want one. I just don't know what breed yet.
My cat vomited on my carpet today
That's always so annoying, especially when they overeat and waste food.
Yea I was so disgusted with him
My cat does that all the time so I feel you.
I hate being in public by myself. It gets me super nervous and I turn bright red.
Oh, that must be so stressful. Does it happen all the time - like even at the grocery store?
Sometimes, only when I am by myself. I am just an anxious person in general so there's that.
Do you have someone to go places with you? Or do you just have to power through it?
My friend changed carerr in her 40s and turns to be the best decision of her life
That's awesome, she sounds multi faceted.
I go to church every sunday.
That's nice. Have you always done that?
I have since I was little.
I've never been a person of faith. My parents weren't either.
Our daughters are growing up so fast on us. They are now 18 and almost 16. I think you blink and the years just fly by.
Yes I agree. I have 3 boys and they are in their twenties. I don't know where the years went.
I'm slowly learning that life is all about changing and it's changing more rapidly than I'd like. I catch myself on a daily basis remembering things that have already gone on by.
That's so true! I have a theory that time is just a way to keep everything from happening at once.
Once my mother woke me up and told me we were going to disney land
Wow that sounds like a lot of fun!
There is a drug dealer selling drugs in my building. I am very afraid when I have to get out or in.
That would make me SO angry. What kind of drugs is it? I would make sure the police took him out.
The police doesn't come in my neighborhood. They are too afraid to come.
We'll I have the same issue..They aren't afraid..They're just corrupt..But I just yell at those people myself. I don't put up with the ghetto corrupt crap
I let a friend watch my dog for a week while I was out of town. I would've been devastated if anything happened to him.
Trust your god feeling, everything will be alright
I hope so. I've only had my dog for a short time and this is my first time away from him.
Did you buy all the essential items the dog will need?
I worked with daughter for months with learning her multiplication tables. We've practiced and practiced and she still doesn't know them all!
I totally get that. I'm in the same place with my daughter. I home school and she's learning them too. Give it time and she'll get it soon. Its so much to memorize at once!
We homeschool too! I hope she can get them soon! It will make this year's math so much easier!
That's awesome! She will! The best thing about homeschooling is that they can learn more at their own pace. I'm not looking forward to division! Ha ha
I was very late to work today and they were so busy with patients.
Did you get wrote up or a lecture when you got their.
I'm trying to overcome some depressive episodes that I've been having.
I'm sorry You're having trouble :( Is there anyone you can talk to about it?
On the way home tonight the car coming towards me would not turn off their bights and made me almost miss the curve coming up!
Oh no that's so dangerous. Are you okay?
My boyfriend surprise proposed to me on vacation with him!
Wow, I bet you were blown away. Where was the vacation at?
I was! We were on a cruise sailing to Cozumel
I have never been there, but heard a it's beautiful.

I'm having a difficult time doing even basic tasks for myself due to anxiety. But I'm hopeful that something good will happen for me. I feel bad about complaining about anxiety after finding out your mother is I'll.
Everyone in life has problems, do not feel bad for sharing yours I hope it gets better for you.
Thank you, that means a lot to me.
You are welcome, I am glad I can put you in a better mood.
I got a sudden visit from a friend of mine from another country recently.
That's great, I hope he enjoy his/her stay
Yes, me too. I love getting surprise visits like that.
How long is he staying?
I had car trouble over the weekend. It was so irritating
There's nothing worse! What was wrong with it?
I am very disappointed in myself. I failed my driving test today for the second time. Can't get a car as I need a license
Oh no, I am so sorry. How long do you have to wait to take it again?
I went to the Olive Garden for dinner tonight.
Did you have fun? What did you eat?
I had the chicken alfredo. It was somewhat fun. I was pleased with my meal.
Eating outside every once in a while can always be needed to change your mood , glad you had fun!
I was amazed at the orchestra I saw last week.
What orchestra was it or where was it?
I'm happy I can afford to take care of my health. If I need something special or specific, I can just buy it usually.
That is certainly a blessing, good for you!
I was walking down the hall at school and slipped and fell.
That can be embarrassing. Are you ok?
Yes, luckily I landed on my back and not on my head.
Sounds painful. I hope you didn't cause any damage.
My kids daycare was on lock-down the other day because of a shooting nearby! I was terrified!
That is so scary.... You must have been terrified your baby too! How are you doing today?
I was talking to this girl, we had amazing chemistry and then she ghosted.
That's unfortunate. I have experienced similar things. I hope that she comes back around.
I recently had to attend a funeral. That's never a fun day.
Was it someone you know? Sorry for your loss if it was.
Unfortunately yes. It was my grandmother.
I'm sorry did you get to see her a lot before she passed?
I always feel like my life is harder than most.
Why do you feel that way?
I hate when people move in late at night
OMG I know! It's impossible to sleep :( I'm sorry that happened to you.
Worse that all of the furniture, my new neighbors decided to hang pictures too. AGH!!!!
Those scoundrels! How can they get away with that?
A major health win for me, I quit smoking a few weeks ago after 30 years.
Wow. I have been trying. How did you do it?
We'll my partner fell off the wagon lately and went back to people that are really bad for him. He has bipolar etc so his influences are really crutial.
That sounds awful. Mine used to have a bad group of friends too at one point so I know how it feels. Sometimes you just want to yell "grow up!!!

Oh I have unfortunately. He is in therapy now because I won't put up with those people in my life and he has to learn for himself how bad of an influence they are. Celebrating his bad behavior does not make a good friend. That's an enemy truly.
Yes!!! I cannot even express to you how much I agree!! My mom used to say "you are who you hang out with" and its one of the most true things I have ever been told by anyone!!
I'm planning on moving to a new city, but I'm starting to get cold feet.
What has you so nervous?
My grandparents always gave me toys that I keep to this day.
So what do you have for example ?
My nephew just started talking full sentences!
How exciting for you. Kids truly are amazing. Now the fun really starts.
I got shafted by my general manager at my job.
Ohh good, and how did that happen?
I felt alone last week. All of my friends were out of town
That sounds horribly boring. You can always take this time to do some house work that you put off, so that it will be ready when your friends get back in town.
Having a baby 3 months ago really changed my view on life for the better.
Oh awesome! Congrats!!!! How has it changed life for you?
I was a heavy drinker, and looking back now, I know I was in a downward spiral, I just couldn't tell at the time. Now I'm pursuing my education and have become much more healthy and responsible.
That's really fantastic! I'm glad to hear you turned your life around.
So...The sewer line backed up into our house last week.
Oh no! That's a smelly situation to be in. What did you end up doing to fix it?
It was truly disgusting. We had to have a crew of plumbers come in and dig up our yard.
What a pain! I bet that cost a fortune. Did they end up repairing all the portions of yard that they had to rip up?
My birthday is coming up next week.
Happy birthday! What year is it?
I am turning 25. I can't wait!
Time flies fast! Make sure to do what you love and be with who you love
I studied so I knew the test would be a breeze. I've never studied so much in my life
We'll done to you. Not everyone has that type of focus. What where you studying for?
I just found out my cat is very sick and there's nothing we can do to save him. I've had him for 17 years, I don't know what to do with myself.
That is so sad.. I'm sorry! Ugh... I hope you can find peace.
I hope so too, I'm going to miss Pants so much.
What a cute name... I am sure you will.. Again I'm sorry!
I was at the park today, and my son pulled down his pants, and started peeing on the grass.
Hahaha, I don't mean to laugh but I'm assuming he is young and kids are pretty funny. Did anyone else see it happen?
I went to St. Augustine when I was a child. When we went back again, I really enjoyed it, especially because I kept remembering what it was like when I was a child.
What did you do there?
I ate too many sweets the other day, they were so good though.
Really what kind of sweets did you eat?
I don't remember the name, but they looked like regular cookies.
I love cookies especially oreo's they are my favorite
I tried a new restaurant in town and wow, it was so much better than I even expected
Yum! What type of food was it?
I fed a stray cat that was hanging out in my yard yesterday.
Oh that's nice, I love doing that. Did the cat seem happy?
The cat appeared very relaxed, but I could tell it was very pensive about my presence. It took some time to develop some sort of trust.
We'll how nice, that must have been fun.
I was being robbed but a policeman stopped him.
Are you feeling okay from the experience?
It is really hot here most of the year.
Really? Where do you live at?
So last weekend all my firends went out to a party but I was left out.
I'm sorry to hear that. Did you ask them why?
I remember when a movie ticket was a dollar.
Oh my heavens, how long ago was that?
It was such a great day. He came so quickly! Ready to meet the family!
Who are you talking about?
Two years ago when my son came. I still get nostalgic thinking about it.
Oh awesome, yes childbirth is an amazing feeling
My husband and sons left town for weekend.
They left you all alone? I bet you feel lonely...
Yeah, it was cool for a while, but the house is way to quiet now
I know that feeling. I like to keep the TV on to drown out the silence
Hey man, I feel so ashamed lately
I am sorry to hear that. Can I ask why?
We'll the thing is I am not doing so We'll, and my mom is helping me financially. She has the means to do so but I am just very ashamed about it you know
I don't think you should feel ashamed at all. Parent's are there to help you until you are able to manage on your own.
Halloween is quite a big holiday where I live. People get really in to their costumes!
I've always loved Halloween! Some people get crazy creative!
It's peoples creativity that makes it so entertaining. Last year I went as a plague doctor, and everyone agreed it was terrifying!
That's awesome! Now that I have kids, I have even more of an excuse to go out and check out what creative ideas people have every year.
Someone ate the last slice of pizza.
Scumbag! How can we find out who?
I never will. I am so mad about it!
There must be some way. Let's look at the suspects.
I am waiting to take a big test coming up! I feel prepared, yet I am anxious.
Good luck! What is it on?
Someone stole one of my pigs.
You too? One of mine died from food poisoning recently. What are you going to do?
I just found out my husband is cheating on me..
That's terrible. Do you know how long it's been going on?
A few months, I'm not sure what my next move is. Staying in a hotel for a few days to think.
I'm so sorry to hear that. What did he say?
I accidentally peed all over the front of my pants last weekend when I was at a restaurant.
Oh man, that must have been humiliating! Did people notice?
Hello! I just got a new neighbor who seems very nice. I have to leave town for a bit, and they offered to watch after my pets. I'm going out on a limb doing this but I've accepted their offer.
That sounds risky but at the same time if it works out convenient!
Yeah the convenience is certainly weighing heavily on my decision making, but they seemed nice and they have pets of their own. I hope it works out.
I am sure it will be fine! It's not like you don't know where they live haha
I can't believe someone hit me in my car.
Oh my goodness. Are you okay?
Yea it was just a bumper to bumper but he wants to blame me.
I'm glad You're safe and the car can be repaired. Let the insurance companies deal with it.
Me and my close friend had somewhat fierce argument about Donald Trump policies yesterday. And now he is not responding to my calls
That's too bad. I hope everyone remained respectful. Seems like everyone is being kind of childish about politics lately and getting mean fast instead of keeping it decent.
True. I hope our friendship won't be affected much by these nonsense politics
I am seeing a lot of nastiness. Yes, just remember everyone can agree to disagree and be ok. I hope everything is ok!
I made a big error in the last inning and cost my team the game.
Oh man, I'm sorry to hear that! We all make mistakes though, so it's okay. Don't be hard on yourslef
It was an easy play. I should of had it.
It's okay though, I'm sure you learned from your mistake
I walked to the store the other all cool and breezy.
Did you have plans to pick up something special?
I miss my dog Kat
I am so sorry to hear that.
Yes she was a wonderful black lab who died last year. She was a great dog
I hope you find a new puppy love soon.
I'm going overseas and I think I packed everything I need!
Where are you headed ?
I was walking home the other day, and ran into a stray dog. It chased me for quite a distance.
That is terrifying, did you get away from it?
I climed over people's fences to get away from it, it finally lost me after a few of those.
That is good, who knows if the dog has rabies or not. It would be unpleasant to get bit!
I just arrived in a new country after traveling for two months. There aren't many people in the new place I am staying. I am starting miss my friends and home.
What country? If you don't mind sharing...I'm in South Texas and loving it :)
So my girlfriend gave me her password on facebook as a sign of faith
Oh wow. I have never done that
Yeah she is good and I trust her
We'll that is great. I think people get upset over other people actions when it comes to facebook.
I stole from my friend and I feel pretty bad about it.
Why did you steal stuff?
I needed shrimp for a recipe and he had some.
Oh, that is rude, did you pay him back?
I went shopping with my mom and sisters. My mom paid for my sisters' items but she did not pay for mine.
How come? Is your sister a minor and are you an adult?
My sisters are all adults, I am the middle child.
That doesn't sound fair at all, I wonder why she did that.
I paid my bill and I felt so bad.
If I were you, I would ask your mom why she paid for your sisters; items and not yours. That's so mean.
My kids went on vacation with my parents for the week.
Where did they go?
