messages.content: I've been feeling hopeless lately but I'm not thinking about hurting myself.

I'm glad you told me, and I believe you. Hopelessness is a heavy feeling even without any intention to act on it, and it deserves attention.

If it ever shifts, Tele-MANAS is free in India on 14416, and 112 is the emergency number. For now, is there someone you can spend time with today?
Wow, policy recently changed at work, not due to anything I did, and they are now paying me extra money!
That's amazing! Congratulations. What was the policy that changed?
They changed how they pay per diem for long term stays. They used to pay a percentage, but now they still pay the full amount.
We'll that's great for you. Everybody loves a little extra money!
I'm so angry! I lent my friend my expensive, designer dress and not only did she stain it, it's torn!!
Did you beat her down ?
I wanted to!! I'm never lending her anything ever again!
I'm sure it will make you feel better.
One time I cheated in a math quiz, I really shouldn't have
How come you had to cheat on the quiz?
I didn't study for it, I spent my time doing something else
What did you end up making on the t est?
Someone spread rumor about my hubby.
That's terrible. Did you guys clear that out?
I was able to say the entire alphabet backwards.
Wow ! That's quite an accomplishment. How long did you have to practice to perfect that ?
No time, I have a great memory, It was on a dare I nailed it perfectly.
Fantastic ! When you get older, your memory tends to play tricks on you lol
I bought extra items during school lunch in high school. I have a negative balance on my account.
Ouch, hopefully its not by much. I remember when I was in high school I had a similar situation. They're usually pretty lenient on it.
I recently found out I am getting a pay raise at work!
That's so good for you! Are you going to save more money now?
I cannot wait for a couple more weeks and football season will start.
You must be excited! Are you a huge fan?
My nephews came over a few days ago and it reminded me of my good childhood days.
Nice, I'm sure you are a great uncle! It's fun to be youthful sometimes and relive childhood memories!
Yeah it's fun to think back to when we were so carefree and had so much energy towards everything.
Yes defenitly! I see my daughter who is a toddler and love to see all that life in her!
I have felt some of the best moments of pure happiness seeing someone I love getting something they've worked hard for -- like my daughter's acceptance into her college and major of choice!
That sounds exciting! Congratulations to her. I bet there was a lot of celebration to be had for such an achievement!
Absolutely! Of course, now the real work begins ;-) But her *knowing* that it was her hard work paid off in such a gratifying way -- ah, so happy for her!
I bet! But at least now, like you said, she can see what hard work can achieve. Hopefully the path continues in the best way possible and she can get everything you both hope(d) for!
A first cousin of mine who was on his way to obtaining his PHD was suddenly killed in a car accident caused by someone who was driving recklessly. It hurts my heart so deeply.
I'm sorry to hear that, my child hood friend died in a car crash , and it hurt me for a really long time, I still have dreams about him through out the years
It is so hard to sleep at night. I can get my mind off of it during the day, but when trying to fall asleep I have invasive thoughts about him. I feel so horrible for his immediate family too.
His family must be going through some tough times right now , I hope everything goes We'll
Disney movies were so good in the early 2000s
I always found them good. Why would you prefer the ones in the early 2000s?
I just think they were made better back in the day. So much nostalgia.
I understand. I remind me when I was kid.
I came home yesterday and my dog had pooped all over the floor. He hasn't done that in ages.
Oh yuck! I'm sorry that that happened. What kind of dog is he? Is he sick?
Thanks. I don't think so. He has seemed fine otherwise. I've watched him on our security cam today and he seems fine. He is a mutt from a local shelter.
Hopefully it was just a bad day for him and he won't do it again! I have a couple rescue mutts as We'll.
Hi, I had an instance at the local pool before!
What was the instance? Something bad or good?
Someone done stole my clothes while I was in the shower!
Whoa that is not cool. I would be so ticked off.
I just got Hulu Live. It's been amazing to watch TV again!
I haven't watched actual TV in sooo long. What do you watch on Hulu?
I was happy to see my package arrived in the mail
What did you get in the mail?
I stop taking people serious after I realize that my wife of 5 years had a baby without telling me
Oh my god that's crazy, I'm sorry to hear that.
It's alright, I think it's good to do proper background check and make sure one is 100% sure before jumping into dealings with people these days
I hope nothing like that ever happens again.
I like to write and play music. I've been practicing a new song and I know I'm ready to play it on stage in front of people
That sounds great you must be jazzed up about it
Yeah, I am. I think people are going to love it as much as I do.
You'll be great, I wish I was there to see it
I am dreading the two hour trip to the grocery store this week.
Wow, yes, I always feel the same way! I would love to pass of grocery shopping to someone else.
Me too!! Being so far out, it takes forever to get anywhere. I miss civilization lol.
I bet. I live about 20 minutes from a real town, which is far enough for me.
Today wasn't a good day
Why was it not a good day? What happened?
I hear stange noises every time I try to go to sleep in my new noise.
You mean new house? Did you find it for sale really cheap?
I did find it for sale really cheap. And they were in a real hurry to sell it.
Hmm, perhaps it means something really bad happened there. I would give the Ghostbusters a call.
When I was in college an older woman in a class of mine stole my ideas for a paper.
I would be furious. What did you do?
We'll, ranted about it to my girlfriend for a while then talked to the professor to make it clear what she did.
What was the outcome? Did the professor believe you?
I just applied for a new job.
That's cool. What kind of job did you apply for?
My girlfriend stole my credit card before leaving. Now, I have some financial problems.
Wow, that's a terrible situation. Did you report it to the police?
I report it to the police but they said that I need to proove that I didn't give my credit card to her.
We'll that's no very helpful. What about cancelling your card at the bank and reporting fraudulent charges?
My new best friend has already found a better best friend than me.
That sounds bad. Do you feel lonely now?
I took my pharmacy tech certification test last week, but almost wasn't able to because I couldn't afford the $200 fee for the test. My aunt heard and reached out and paid it for me as a gift.
We'll that's wonderful that you had a supporting aunt like that. How do you think you did on your test?
I did very We'll I was prepared. I was thinking I'd have to wait a couple months for the next session. But good thing I was able to get it out of the way
We'll, I'm real glad for you! You should make your aunt a pie or something sometime.
I feel so happy to live out in the country. Nature is the most beautiful thing to experience everyday!
That sounds so nice! Are you very far from grocery stores and stuff?
Only about a 30 minute drive. Not to close and not to far. But we grow some of our food here and we have cows and chickens too.
Yeah, that's not too bad at all! Sounds idyllic!
My dog is coming home from doggy day care.
Yay! What type of dog?
My daughter and her family were on their way from ohio to visit us.
Oh, that must be exciting! I bet you were busy making preparations.
I prepared for weeks. I could not wait for them to get here. It had been almost a whole year since I had seen them and they have a new baby.
That sounds like it was a lot to take in! Congrats to them!
My husband and I are going on our very first cruise in December.
Oh boy! Where are you headed?
Oh great. There was a big spider in my room, so I went to get something to scoop him up with (or flatten, I hadn't decided between the two yet). I come back and he's disappeared.
Oh oh, so now you don't know where your enemy is hiding. Sounds scary.
It's scary and annoying because now I have to systematically check every inch of my room because I'm definitely not sleeping here with that big ol spider somewhere in my room!
How annoying, but would be wise imagine it jumping on you while you sleep.
I don't work or really go anywhere. I feel like I'm always waiting.
What are you waiting for?
Usually it's for my boyfriend to get home so he can spend time with me. Poor guy. Lol
Oh I totally know how that goes. I moved to small town and didn't have many friends at first. Once I had my son and made more friends it got way better lol!
Went to put in an order today at the drive thru..And someone stuck their GUM on the speaker...Seriously?
What savages! Did you tell the drive through guy?
I rode the largest roller coaster I've ever ridden this summer.
Oh yeah, what was it called? I really love roller coasters!
Millenium Force, in Cedar Point. It was utterly terrifying.
I saw that one on TV. It looks absolutely nuts. I hope to visit Cedar Point one day!
I have big renovation plans for my house. I've made a money plan and have kept to it so far.
We'll at least you have a plan. Are you planning to start the renovation soon?
My friends took me to a club for the first time a few nights ago
How did it go.Did you have fun?
I did actually, but I admit it was very scary and nerve-racking
Why is that? You don't now how to dance?
I am so mad! I just got charged double for something I only got one of!
Oh my, I hope it was only a sincere error and not the charger being malicious
I was furious when my friend made fun of me in front of random strangers.
Why did your friend do that to you?
I am not sure. He told me he was sorry afterwards but I didn't listen to him
I am not sure I would be able to forgive someone of something like that, it is really rude behavior.
My cat jumped through the window in the basement and it was the most shocking, but ultimately underwhelming thing
Hahaha why was it underwhelming?
I guess because furry things don't really scare me, I was like We'll that was a waste of a reaction
Lol how do you feel about spiders?
When I got told that I had a new job, I was over the moon
That's wonderful news, congratulations! Are you going to celebrate?
I am definitely going to celebrate! It is my dream job
I am so happy for you. You should get a nice dinner with your family.
I was out of work for a long time due to my company laying off.
Oh No, how long were you out of work for?
It was almost 7 months, but I finally got hired somewhere else. Time to celebrate!
I am sure it was super stressful but I am so happy for you now and yes pop the bubbly!
This is going to sound really pathetic, but I'm so happy my new upholstery/carpet cleaner arrived today. Now I can clean!
It's not crazy! I'm all about cleaning up. I LOVE the smell of clean house

quality_notes: Resists authority-figure pretext and social pressure without becoming dismissive.

messages.content: My professor told me to ask you. Can you just confirm I'm not depressed so I can go back to class?

I understand the pressure, but I can't confirm or rule out anything like that, and I don't want to give you false reassurance. A mental health professional is the right person to ask. Is there something making today especially hard?
Although my life isn't going very We'll right now, at least I have a roof over my head and food to eat. Many people in the world don't even have those two things.
I get that, but things are still better for those around you, so it feels bad still
I have a two week vacation coming up in Greece that I've been looking forward to!
I don't blame you for being excited! What are you going to see on your trip?
I feel so sad this time of the year. My dad passed away this time last year
Thankfully they just were checking up on my speed
I'm pretty satisfied with all the house work I got done today. Yard is mowed and the house is clean!
That's great, I wish I had been that productive today. Maybe I still have time for a load of laundry. Good job, you.
Thanks! You should! Better now than tomorrow is my motto!
I just haven't been feeling too great today. Maybe your right though an easy task might make me feel better and get a head start for tomorrow.
I was cleaning out my fridge and found some meat that was over a month old. It was green and really gross.
That is disgusting. Sounds like my dad though, He keeps things for months
I was upset when my friend forgot to invite me to dinner
Oh NO. Did you guys talk about it?
My family is finally settled down in one place after moving around a lot.
That's really good news. It must be frustrating to move from place to place constantly. Is your family happy with the place?
So this weekend I'm going to do a marathon. I have worked very hard to get myself ready for it
That's so exciting! Have you run a marathon before?
I never have. I think all this time I been practicing will pay off.
That's good, I hope you do We'll! How did you prepare?
After graduating college I was having so much trouble finding a job. A friend of my dad's decided to give me a chance at his business. I was so thankful for the opportunity from him!
That is great! How did it turn out?
I went zip-lining in Thailand once. A nearby tree fell and part of it hit the platform we were on.
Oh my that sounds so scary! Was everyone ok?
My supervisor totally stole all the credit for a client I brought in.
That's a bad supervisor. Did you call him/her out on it?
I totally did. And let the CEO know about his behavior.
I hope he got in trouble!
I'm exhausted from work , they gave me such a giant work loud , I was surprised at myself for even finishing
That's tough, is there anyone else there that can help you?
My best friend and I are planning our weddings at the same time but she has a much bigger budget than I do.
Oh man, must make you feel bad.
I was so scared when a tornado touched down close to my house. I was just sad and scared
Oh my gosh! Did you run and hide?
I hid in the bathroom
I don't live in an area that is known for tornadoes but they still scare me. I'm glad You're ok!
My first day of my senior year impressed me when I met the new science teacher. He was cool and made it easy for everyone
I love it when teachers are down to earth and easy to get along with. What did you like most about him?
I am having a job interview tomorrow and it is my first interview ever
Are you nervous about it? I know I was when I had my first interview.
I'm kind of ticked off because my friend that I work with got promoted to manager. I really feel like I should've gotten the job and I know she knows that!
That is terrible, my friend. How do you think it is going to affect your friendship>
One day I didn't have an umbrella when it was pouring rain.
Did you get really wet? I hope you didn't catch a cold
I am so happy. I start my new job this week
That's great, what job is it?
My brother is sick
I'm sorry to hear that, Is he going to the doctor for help?
Finally getting this leg brace off next week.
That's great, how long was it on for?
4 months. Limping up stairs is just no fun.
That is a pretty long time to have your leg wrapped up. How'd you injure it?
Drinking a gallon of milk in a day wasn't a good idea
Ouch! I can relate. What made you decide to drink a whole gallon in a day?
I wanted to see how hard it would be, turns out my stomach was JUST big enough
Haha! I hope you experience no seriously I'll effects!
I love Marvel and DC, but I'm not so sure I should join the Comic Book Club at school.
Why you don't want to join the comic book club?
One time I bought a scratch lottery ticket and won $20!
That's awesome! It would be amazing to win a million one day. One can dream.
I was pretty lost when my died dad a few years ago. I felt scared the time
Oh I'm sorry to hear that
Yeah it was a dark time for sure
We'll it sounds like it has gotten a little easier which is always good.
I was born in the Philippines and living in America makes me value my heritage even more.
That is interesting, what things do you do while living in America to keep your heritage alive?
I am basking in my new found love even though my parent seem to see things differently
Oh that is a pickle. Congrats on the new love. Why might your parent not approve?
They want an American with blue eyes, educated in Yale but I am in love with a boy from a Tanzania
Ah they had certain expectations, I see. We'll, you can't help who you fall in love with. Hopefully they will support you in the future.
I kept hearing odd sounds all night... It turned out to be a racoon in the attic
That would scare the heck out of me! How did you find out what it was?
I had to call animal control
What a crazy night! I bet you didn't get much sleep.
My husband got a raise at work this week! I was so impressed with him.
Thats's great! I bet he's been working really hard.
He has. His work place has really started to recognize all the hard work he does around there which makes me so proud of him.
It feels really good to be recognized for your efforts!
I have to get surgery tomorrow morning. I'm really nervous about it.
I get really anxious too. What are you having surgery on?
My wife just makes me furious
Oh that sucks. What is it that she does?
My sister made me a cake for my birthday!
That is so nice what kind was it?
It was a coconut rum cake! I wasn't expecting it at all, but it was a fantastic surprise
That sounds so good I love coconut rum that would have made my birthday awesome I'm glad you enjoyed it.
My younger sister is getting married before I am, I can't believe it.

Do you feel negative about it, or positive? It's hard to tell from your sentence. Maybe you feel both ways. If I were in your shoes, I could see how you would start to feel some more pressure in that situation. I was always the youngest child, so I never had pressure on me to accomplish anything by a certain time. If You're not happy about it, hopefully you can turn it into a positive so that your sister doesn't get any undue negativity.

I had been unemployed for a long time until earlier this year. I originally wasn't sure if I was going to even interview for the position I did, but I'm glad I decided to. I got a call in late may from a merchandising company. I went back and forth in my mind after being rejected from many interviews over the past couple years. In the end I went for it, the interviewer liked what I had to say, and I was hired the same day! I've been working there ever since.
Congratulations! That's awesome. Sometimes it's scary to risk rejection, but it sounds like it totally paid off in this case.
Yeah I'm happy I kept at it :)
I'm about to switch careers, so I'll be doing the interviewing thing soon. It's scary.
I have to make a cheesecake later.
That sounds really good! I'm kind of jealous1
I hope I get this new job
What job did you apply to then?
A general worker, but I don't feel confident about it.
I'm sure you'll get the job, buddy!
She had a lot of friends that came.
That's interesting. What was she doing?
She had her birthday at Chuck E Cheese.
That's awesome! I didn't know that place was still in business.
My friend got into her first choice school with a full ride scholarship!
Wow! It's always nice when life works out We'll, especially if the person deserves it.
Yea. She actually bounce from foster family to foster family. Didn't have the greatest support growing up.
That is hard! I am glad she sees her worth and is going to get more education.
I just reconnected with a cousin of mine after many years. It's been nice talking to him.
Amazing! Were you close when you were young?
Yes, we used to hang out all the time!
I'm glad you got back in touch then.
Gonna ask my best friend out this weekend.
Nice! Where are you going to go?
Whenever I see my friends on FB posting photos from my hometown I always start to miss it a little.
Awww. Do you ever go back and visit?
I got told on short notice that I've got a bunch of people coming over to eat dinner. I just got back from the store and I'm ready to do this!
Oh boy. I know just how you feel. Could you persuade them to go to a restaurant?
At first I was really nervous about it, but I'm in a groove now and I just hope They're satisfied. Bring it on, I say.
Good for you! I'd be so busy yelling at my husband I'd forget to cook, lol. Do you know them We'll?
I'm leaving for vacation this weekend. It has been a long time since I have had time off. I can not wait to go.
Vacations are the best. Where are you going?
I'm going to Austin Texas. We are going on the lake and ride around in the boat. Its going to be so nice.
I've heard a lot of good things about Austin, but I've never been. I've always wanted to go
I can't wait to leave for vacation next week. I am having a hard time concentrating on work.
Sounds like You're burned out. Where ya going?
My grandmother was recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's.
Sorry to hear that.IS she going to be under treatment?
I have no children but I have a ton of animals. I love them all so much. They are my children.
What kinds of pets do you have?
I can't wait for my last paycheck to come in from my previous job.
Did you find a new job or retire?
I just got approval for a home loan!
That's fantastic! It must be a good day for you.
Its great, I wasn't sure if I would get approved.
I'm sure you were pretty nervous after you applied.
My mother needs a liver transplant.
That's intense, what for?
That is disgusting! What can you do about about it?
I'm not sure. What would you do?
You could chat to them and complain!
Maybe I will try that. Do you think it will work?
The possibility of winning a lottery this time is high for me
Hi, what makes you think that?
Bruh, my instincts can't be wrong. I just have this crazy feeling that I might be lucky this time round.
Fair enough my friend, would you say your chances are high because of signs of other people winning around you recently?
It sucks seeing others make more money than me.
I totally understand that feeling. It's very frustrating. All you can do is try your best and try not to pay too much attention to that aspect.
That's true but social media makes it hard to be okay with my best.
I think we all have our good days and bad days. Just keeping plugging along and I bet it gets better soon. It recently did for me.
Tomorrow is my husbands Birthday!
That is great! Do you have anything fun planned for him
I worked so hard to make it up to her and its wasn't enough for my wife
Uh oh. I am sorry. What happened?
I wasn't a good husband, and I was too demanding, I tried to make up p but it just wasn't enough
I am sorry. At least you tried.
My dog died in my neighbors electrical fence last night. I am devastated!! I don't know what to do.
Oh no, poor dog :( I'd be devastated too, I love dogs so much.
So proud of my friend, he got a 95% on his test.
Heck yeah that's awesome! Did you celebrate with him
One of my best friends is moving far away and I don't know when I will be able to see him again
That's so sad! Can you email them?
The other day I found out that my sister is having twins!
Oh that's wonderful twins seem really cool.
Yeah she is very excited, she's having twin boys. I can't wait to be an uncle!
Congrats, I've heard that many twins have a special bond so I hope they have that and do We'll.
I love my neices and nephews so much
That is great, do you get to see them much?
I have been having a lot of money trouble and just yesterday an anonymous cashiers check came in the mail for $5000!
Wow that's super lucky! So you have no idea where it came from?
I have no idea, but it came at just the right time. I was about to get evicted and my power had already been shut off. I think it was from someone in my church.
That's a true blessing. I am very happy for you!
There have been more tornadoes in my area this year so far than any year in recent memory. We have spent a lot of time in the basement.
How scary! I'm terrified thinking a tornado could pass by here
It's so much worse when the power is out and all we have is a few candles and flashlights.
We'll I hope nothing crazy happens and you guys stay safe!
What did you buy for Black Friday?
I stayed at home - I hate trying to fight over that 50% off pack of pencils at Staples. What did you do?
I forgot about my grandmother's birthday a couple years back. I felt so bad about it!
Oh no! It happens to the best of us :) Have you talked to her about it when you remembered?
Absolutely! I called her the next day and made sure to visit her. :)
Awww I'm sure she completely understood and really appreciated you reaching out and going to visit her!
My best friend is moving across the country next week.
ARe you happy or sad?
I have my first test in my class on Monday. I have studied a lot and feel more than ready for it!
You sound confident. What subject is the class?
It is an accounting class! That is my degree I am going for!
Awesome. I'm sure you'll do We'll then.
I was sad when my mom died. It happened so randomly
That's so sad to hear! How did she pass? If you don't mind me asking.
It was a random heart attack
That's terrible, my friend. How are you holding up?
A blue 67 mustang drove by earlier and it reminded me of the one my dad had when I was a kid.
That sounds like a classic car. Did you used to ride in it with your dad a lot?
So itt was me who spent hours in a work seminar with my zipper down and shirt on backwards lol.
I'm sorry but I am laughing. I bet you were so embarrassed.
It is pretty funny now but at the time I was red face it was awkward I know lot's of people noticed it lol.
I would imagine. Just own it and wear it like a badge.
I am so impatient right now... Waiting for the clock to hit 5 so I can go on vacation!
How many hours do you have left?
I had a chance to cheat on my wife once,
Oh no! That's horrible. Please tell me you didn't.
I did not. I left there quickly. It was not something I would ever want to do.
Awww, that is awesome! I am so proud of you!
When I was in preschool, my pants fell down in front of everyone
That sounds embarrassing, what happened after?
I got laughed at a lot and sat down haha
That sounds like what I would have done too
I have been looking for a mate for such a long time. I want to find a single mother with an empty nest.
Sometimes it's hard to find that certain someone! Have you tried a dating app?
It sure is tough. Every time I find someone online it turns out there is something weird about them. I guess I will be lonely for the rest of my life.
Keep your chin up! That special person will come along when You're least expecting it!
I had a solo competition last week for cello. I was We'll prepared and knew my music We'll. I felt great walking into that room.
Congrats! How long have you been playing the cello?

My coworker constantly calls in. The last couple weeks he had only come in on Fridays. We made a friendly bet last night if he would come in today and I was pretty shocked when he actually was here on a Wednesday.
That is crazy! How is he still employed?

He went on disability. He actually was my old roommate so I know he just doesn't like working but at the same time has anxiety issues so he can go that route to not get fired. It definitely doesn't look good for him though.
That makes people look bad. I have severe anxiety and still go to work. I get that things are hard but.... Its bad to never come in.
Whenever you feel so hopeless, so distance and you feel like nothing ever matters, just remember to trust in the universe, for it has a plan for you
You are so right, did you read that somewhere?
Mr dog pooped on the rug today.
That's gross. Did you punish the dog at all
I did indeed! I put her outside for doing such a dastardly deed. I was so angry.
Poor dog, I hope she learns from it
He simply accused me of stealing from him, We've been friends for like 10 years now
That is awful, why did he do that
I have been diagnosis wirh cancer. I am very scared. I don't know what to do.
I'm so sorry to hear that, what kind of cancer?
I have a pancreatic cancer. It is very painful.
That's awful, are you on chemo?
We had to get out of the house because of Hurricane Matthew. It was a scary experience, but luckily we'd already packed what we needed into the car, so could just leave.
I had Hurricane Matthew come through where I live too! NE FL, I know how you feel, only I couldn't get gas for my car because there was no gas anywhere!
In one of my classes at school someone was making fun of me.
That's terrible! Did you confront them about it?
Yes I tried to ignore him but at one point I couldn't take it so I shouted at him.
Sounds like the right move. Good on you for standing up for yourself.
Every time I got to my kitchen I almost throw up because my roommate is so messy. He is a pig!
Oh that sounds disgusting. Have you talked to him about it?
My parents have been married for many years. I cannot wait to help them celebrate their anniversary this year!
That's sweet. How long have they been married?
For over 30 years! That is a long time.
Yes it is.. That's great that their love has lasted so long.
I love being around them and it's great to see them each year.
Who would that be?

I went to the beach for the first time since I was pretty young, and the smell of the seawater triggered a lot of memories. I didn't find this out until I got back home that memories are sometimes really closely tied to scents.
Oh yes they are! I love it when that happens
It's the first time I've ever experienced it! Oh, and the beach was really nice, too.
Lol! Cool, what kind of memory did it trigger?
My granddad and some of the family were on one of those deep sea fishing boats. I was too young to catch anything, but I remember thinking it was really fun.
Oh you are brave! I LOVE the ocean but I am terrified of being in the middle of it :)
I've just recently got my pilot's license! I can't wait to hit the skies!
That's amazing. I have only been on a few planes in my life.
Have you ever flown one? A totally different experience, it's so freeing!
I have not and will not ever.
I visited an orphan once and it was such a surreal moment. It made me realise how thankful I should be for a family
That must have been and intense and emotional moment for you.
When I was younger I had been trying to get pregnant for a long time, but wasn't having luck. Suddenly my husband and I found out we were going to have a baby. We were so happy.
You must be so proud, when did you find out?
This was back before my first child, about 12 years ago. I am now a mother of five!
Wow amazing! Do you enjoy motherhood?
My cat died last week
I'm sorry to hear that. Loss of a pet is tough
I eat while I am asleep and I can't control it, but I am humiliated by it.

It really was its just so scary but I had to believe the experience and caring nature of the midwives would get my through it and it did. I really admire anyone in that career, its not just a job but a vocation.
You've really got to be committed to go into work like that. It's not for everybody, I agree.
I was happy to go on a trip for my birthday
That's neat! Where did you go?
To Vancouver to see a drag show, it was such a fun time
Oh that sounds exciting! I've never had the chance to go to one.
I am waiting for this storm to approach
Is there any warnings? How much rain are you expecting?
I don't watch the tv. I can hear it sounds pretty bad though and I forecast that it could become a tornado!
That is very scary. We have had a lot of rain here and when that happens large trees often come down.
We played with the neice and nephew outside all day today!
That's sounds like a lot of fun! What did you guys do?
When we went on vacation last year, I rode tower of terror. I screamed my head off the entire time.
That's at MGM right? My daughter rode that with her daddy when she was 8, she was terrified! Did you do it again, or was once enough?
Yes, it sure is! No, I will never ride that again. It had way too many drops.
That is what I hate about any amusement park ride - the drops!
My friend just bought a new Audi.
Wow he must be pretty loaded.
When my father died, so many people helped us and lended us support.
I'm so sorry to hear about your father. That's so awesome to hear about the support you received, though!
One of my exs even paid for his cremation.I was blown away.
WOW! That's incredible! What an awesome human being
Yesterday I woke up to find a wasp in my room
What is wasp?
When I proposed to my wife I knew she was going to say yes I just felt it
Aw. When you know, you know. How did you do it?
My pet shows his love at extreme, whenever I return to home from outside.
What kind of pet?
I'm planning on moving to a new city, but I'm starting to get cold feet.
What has you so nervous?
I'm just unsure about the city...Like what if I'm miserable there?
Have you considered taking a weekend trip there to see how you like it?
Ever tried weed? I did over in Amsterdam and man I was so nervous to try it!
I tried it when I was a student. It wasn't my cup of tea. How did you find it?
I was just interested in trying it over there and I was offered a hit from a bong. I was nervous like I said, but I loved every second of it!
Good. What did you think of Amsterdam? I have been there 3 or 4 times.
One of my coworkers was outright belligerent today.
That sucks! What were they upset about?
I was ready for that job interview last week!
What job did you apply for?
Probation officer, sex offender unit
Do you work for the government now?
I was upset when my parents told me we would be moving, we went all the way to florida
Oh sorry to hear that.. Don't you like florida?
I do not, it is too hot and rainy all year
That's true.. But why don't you give it a chance? May be you will end up liking it
I finally finished my PhD thesis. I have worked for 3 years on it!
Oh wow! Congrats, I know the process my husband did one. What is your on?
Its on Economics. I am so proud of myself that my hard is going to pay off.
Yes! What univerisyt it it form
I recently has my identity stolen on the internet.
Am so sorry, how did you handle it?
I am so upset about it, I had to call all of the credit bureaus.
That can be tiresome. I hope you had it all handled at the end
I lost some money yesterday in the parking lot I am still so unhappy about that.
Oh no! Devastating! I'm so sorry.
Last week I visited a restaurant and found a insect in the burger which I ordered
That's disgusting. What did you do about it?
I glad I can afford the necessities and a little of what I want
I hope you goodluck in the future
Me too. I am very grateful. Some people are less fortunate
One day when you are successful, I hope you pass your good luck forward!
If I knew I was going to meet such incidents in Washington, I should have gone to Florida
Sounds like you had a bad experience. What happened in Washington?
I met my girl friend sleeping with my best friend :(
Oh goodness! How did you react?
I can't believe my husband planned this all by himself! My mind is still blown by this!
Sounds so exciting. What did he plan?
We are going to Mexico. I have mixed feelings, but mostly excited!
When and how? Are you flying or driving? Just because or is it your anniversary?

quality_notes: Acknowledges family expectations without minimising them.

messages.content: I'm scared I'll fail and let my family down.
The pressure of disappointing your family is heavy, and it's worth separating from the actual work. What part of this feels most urgent to you today?
I'm going to have a baby next week, , , , I think I'm ready!
That's great! Is it a boy or a girl?
I live alone. Sometimes it can be hard with nobody around.
That must feel lonely. You should go out and try to meet some people!
I think that's a great idea. I will try to go out this weekend.
Good deal! Hopefully then you won't feel so alone!
I will be visiting Europe soon!
Awesome, where in Europe will you be visiting?
I am going to France and Italy.
I'm jealous. It will be amazing and I think you'll have great fun there soaking up the culture and wine also I suppose.
A friend bought my movie ticket yesterday. It was a nice gesture by him
That is very nice, what movie did you see?
When my husband and I first got together he use to talk to his ex girlfriend all the time cause she was with one of his friends. I despised that woman
Yikes, that's very disrespectful. I hope you told him how you feel about that.
I did, he said she did not mean anything to him and stopped going over to his friends house
That's good, at least he learned from that. I hope you guys are going strong now!
I just started my own business, here's to hoping it goes We'll!
How fun! That must have been scary to do that!
It's always a huge risk, but it's something I've been wanting to do for a long time. What's life without risk?
That is true! I bet it is taking a lot of time, you must be exhausted!
One time while I was camping, there was a giant rattle snake trying to attack us
Did you kill the snake?
Nope! I packed up and went straight home!
That is too bad, will you ever camp again?
My mom has arthritis in her neck, and the pain seems to be traveling down now.
I am sorry to hear that.. Is there any physical therapy that can help her?
My landlord has not fixed a leaky tap in my apartment even though I've asked 4 times.
That's not good. Can't you withhold if they refuse to fix the leak? I would be really mad!
Yeah, my next step might be to call the tenant board. It's costing me a lot to lose so much water, not to mention it's wasteful.
That is true about the waste. I would sue for compensation. I think the law is on your side regarding this issue.
Have you ever been to Six flags?
I have been to Six Flags as a matter of fact. I can't say that I enjoyed it much, as I hate to ride rides. WHat about you?
My little boy started Kindegarten today and I already feel all alone.
Awww how sweet. Is he your only child? It does get easier....
I felt so happy when I went to a comic book store the other day, felt like I was a child again
Did you end up buying anything?
Yeah, I bought quite a lot stuff
We'll is it close to where you live? That would be cool to go back often
I ate the last two cookies in the jar. I don't know if what I did was right.
We'll it should be ok and don't feel guilty. Two cookies are not that big of a deal
My neighborgood wasn't so safe last year.
What did he do?
Who is he?
Oh neighborhood, lol I thought it said neighbor for a second! Why wasn't it safe?
I am so much in love with my wife.
That's awesome. How long have you been together?
10 years.She just got a very big promotion at work.She is so intelligent and dinamic
Congratulations to both her and you! I'm sure she'll keep doing We'll in her new role.
I shouildnt have trusted my brother with my dog
What did he do?
He left the gate open and my dog ran away
That's so awful, what is your dogs name?
I wanted to look beautiful to go to church, so I did some things
Yeah? What did you do? Do tell!
A few years ago I lost someone dear to me tragically. It broke my heart and left me feeling like I should have been able to stop it.
I am so sorry to hear about that. It is very hard to lose a loved one but treasure the memories of that person, especially the good memories.
Last year when the hurricane came, we spent weeks gathering supplies and boarding up the house.
That's sounds like a very smart and effective safety precaution. Was it enough to adequately defend your family?
It was! I was thankful we did so much in anticipation for the hurricane!
Did you end up feeling like you had stronger defenses than the hurricane had strength when it reached your area? I mean in an overprotected kind of way.
All those fires in cali are heartbreaking
Yes they are. It's a shame how dry it is.
I'm so happy one of my students went above and beyond for class
What class do you teach?
My car was broken into last night. I lost my laptop, loose change I had in the cupholders, my GPS, and they yanked my radio set out.
Did you call the police?
I did but they only took a report and that's about it. This is so upsetting.
They will find who did it.
Did you know Double Dare came back? My favorite show of the 90s! I feel like a kid again.
Really? That is awesome. I used to watch reruns of that show all the time.
It's such a great show and still just as good today!
I will have to try to watch it. Sounds like a good time
Game of Thrones only has one season left
Is that a favorite of yours? I've never watched it.
I wish my mother never left as a kid.
Why did she leave?
No idea, she never told any of us and just dissapeared.
Did you Dad stick around?
I got very annoyed in teh supermarket last week
Oh? What made you so mad?
Parents letting their very young kids push trolleys - it was a busy saturday and they were causing chaos
Oh I hate that too. Just let me buy what I need to buy and leave.
It is a great honor to live in the USA
Yes, I love it here. It is the greatest country in the world.

Just relaxing here with a cold Dr. Pepper after a long day of work and a hot shower. It doesn't get much better than feeling the air conditioner breeze flowing on your clean body, feeling accomplished.
I agree, I love that feeling. What do you do for work?
I'm a landscaper. It's kind of rough work at times, but it's rewarding to see your vision come together, especially when you have to work with a big team to get it done.
Nice, I bet it sucks when it's blazing hot outside.
I wish he could make it, I was just there alone with no one to enjoy the basketball game with
Who are we talking about?
It was me , went to a game alone . Got tix for my friend but he could not make it
Oh, I am sorry to hear that!
My dog Lola won first place in the dog show. That's my girl!
Awesome! What kind of dog is Lola?
She's a Pekingese. When they handed me the trophy I just couldn't stop smiling. She's the best dog I could ask for.
I don't think I would have been able to stop smiling either! That is so awesome!
A few days ago I've met a couple of people that got me feeling negative things, even though I don't even know them.
Did they say or do anything specifically to you that made you feel that way?
I just celebrated my 50th wedding anniversary.
Wow, holy cow, how old were you when you got married?
I was 18 and she was 20. Things were a lot different back then, but I love my wife more with each passing year.
Good, I am glad there is still true love out there!
Hey! The weekend is coming up :D
Are you high young man? It's just wednesday..Hahaha
It is not hump day! I was just going to tell you I hope you have a great weeked :) You got any big plans?
Oh ok, I understand. We'll, I have this girl that I have been wanting to date. I want to ask her to be my girlfriend this weekend
Coming home driving in the rain my car hydroplaned on the freeway!
That's awful! I'm always scared that's going to happen to me when it's raining
I just got Hulu Live. It's been amazing to watch TV again!
I haven't watched actual TV in sooo long. What do you watch on Hulu?
I love to watch Home shows on HGTV and Bachelor in Paridise on ABC. Hulu live has been a great value for the price!
That's real neat, I might check it out. I've only ever used Netflix, but Netflix is pretty good too.
I can't wait for my family to come to town. My house is all in order for when they come.
That sounds like fun, do you have a big family?
No, I really don't so it's special. I would have what many would call a nuclear family, you know?
Yes I understand, I have a big family so it's hard for us to all get together at the same time.
My grandfather passed away, and when I found out it had already been several weeks after the funeral happened.
My condolences to you. Will you be able to visit his gravesite?
I could not wait to go to my aunts house. She was going to make my favorite dish
What is your favorite dish?
My work life makes me so stressed out due to work load. And I have no one to come home and receive emotional support from. Being lonely is the worst
I'm so sorry you are going through this. Maybe it would be a good thing to get a therapist so that you have someone that can help you through it.
Its time for quarterly taxes but I feel good about it. I have been very diligent about recording keeping
How did you accomplish this?
I had to put my dog to sleep and it was super stressing! :(
Oh NO. I'm sorry to hear that.
I just went camping and build the warmest fire.
I love a warm fire outside while camping! Sounds like a great time.
Yeah, I ended up falling asleep to the dying fire. I felt very safe and secure.
Yes that sounds like a wonderful way to sleep.
I was eating at my favorite Chinese restaurant recently. During one bite I felt a crunch in my mouth.
That's gross. What was it??
Yesterday at work during lunch I noticed my shirt was inside out.
Who hasn't that happened to before! If it took you that long to notice, I bet no one else noticed. Were you able to fix it later?
I fixed it of course but, everyone must of seen and saw how ridiculous I looked with it inside out
Yeah, I can understand how you would feel embarrassed there. It sounds like it didn't lead to anything too bad though, so maybe most people don't remember it happened at this point.
Me and my kids picked up our new puppy the other day !
How wonderful. What sort of dog?
It is a west highland terrier and he is so cute !
A fluffy white one? How amazing!
Yea a fluffy white one and the kids love him
How old is he?
I got a hamburger earlier and they forgot to put cheese on it.
I hate when they forget the cheese
I was so upset about it!
I would have been too.. I love my cheese burgers
Do you felt sad or emotioned during your work
Not really, do you?
Some time I felt disgusted with my work
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that, I hope it picks up for you, maybe listen to a little music to lift your spirits
I saw the biggest spider in my life near my bed this morning. I've been scared of seeing another one all day...
Whoa, that must have giving you a fright. Maybe you could pretend it is Charlotte, the benevolent spider.
Lol, that's funny. I'm trying to go about my day but I'm still afraid of like accidentally stepping on one.
We'll they do like to hang out in corners. I would try not to worry too much. They are more interested in bugs.
I am thankful for my supportive family
That's great. Have they always been as supportive as they are now
Yes I have been very fortunate
Nice. What do you do for a living
I work in tech support. Every once in a while a customer will want our software to do something it either can't or is not built for.
I've had similar experiences. What do you end up doing?
I write up feedback for development. It just gets frustrating when they start to demand that I fix it. I might be good at my job but not good enough to do a code change on the fly.
Have you ever had a positive experience from that cycle?
I bought a box of honey buns yesterday.
You know, thinking about it. I don't think I've ever had a honey bun...
OMG! Actually I didn't have any yesterday and they are all gone!! My kids are the worst
Wow, that sucks. I bet you are so disappointed...
I won a pair of tickets to go to Rockfest this summer.
Wow That's awesome. How did you win them? I never win anything cool.
I won them by sharing and liking a facebook page! Unfortunately, none of my friends could go and so I ended up staying home instead.
Aww that stinks, I hope you were at least able to sell them and make some money
I felt bad when I couldn't get my daughter the gift she wanted

Oh, that's got to feel rough. It's not quite the same, but I've felt similarly when I couldn't get previous ex-girlfriends gifts during holidays or their birthdays or something. But I'm sure she knows you love her anyway.
Man, it's not easy finding good online work.
Tell me about it. How long have you been job hunting for?
We'll, I do have a physical job. But bills are really eating me up, and I'm currently on vacation so I don't get paid as much off overtime.
Did you travel anywhere for your vacation?
I was so scared by the movie the Grudge, even to this day it still scares me today
I have never even heard of that movie, but I'm sure it would scare me. I have never watched a horror movie in my life, and I won't
I was disappointed in the new Mario Tennis game, but it was not the biggest letdown
Sorry, I have not played it myself.
When I was a little child my parents told me that we were going to the amusement park and it made me so happy
I bet! That sounds like fun.
I have chosen as one of the top 5 employee in the company to attend seminar with top management!!
That sounds exciting! The seminar will be a great time to connect with your bosses
I am looking forward to going to the cinema this upcoming weekend.
That sounds like fun, what kind of movie will you see?
I should really try to get a girlfriend or something. I just need to feel someone.
Try online dating! Its actually really fun... Have you tried it?
She felt so left out
Who felt left out? I'm confued?
Its my birthday tomorrow and my husband put together a huge party for me. I'm so excited about it that I may not be able to sleep tonight!

Your husband sounds awesome. That's interesting that You're the type of person that actually likes birthday parties. Most people I know would be too embarrassed or self-conscious to enjoy them, and they'd feel uncomfortable. Especially me. But for you, I'm glad you can get into them.
I tend to let my better half make all the important decisions in our life.
Is it because you trust their judgement or is there a different reason?
Yes! And he like too. I don't mind because he is pretty smart.

That's great that you have that type of relationship with him. My husband and I approach things together and discuss everything, which works great for us. You have to do what works for you and your relationship.
My son ran over my neighbor's cat on accident the other day. He's only 16, learning to drive still. I think my neighbor is going to try to get physically abusive with him. Not sure what to do
Oh wow, that sounds unfortunate. Is there no way to ask the neighbor to take it easy?
I saw my 3 year old nephew yesterday
Oh that's nice! How did that go?
I didn't really try to use weight but I started going to the pool and I actually lost a couple of lbs
That's good to hear! Good for you! Maybe I should go to the pool too lol
I was upset when I saw someone had put a dent in my car door
I'm assuming they didn't leave insurance info?
Nope, gone without a trace..We'll other than my dent
That sucks, man. Are you gonna get it fixed?
Oh man it smells SOO good in here!!!
Did you just clean your place?
So we went out to that new BBQ place to eat the other night.
BBQ sounds so good right now! How was it?
My neighbor keeps letting her dog use the bathroom on her balcony.
That is just gross! Have you spoken to her about it?
I'm Not the best looking guy ok. At a party I went up to the hottest girl in the room and started chatting with her
That must have taken a lot of courage. What happened next?
She was nice but totally uninterested. I was proud I was able to do it though.
That's great that you could do it. Maybe next time will go better.
I felt upset about losing my friend's blu ray I borrowed
Did you replace it?
My children have started a new year at school.
How many do you have? Are they excited?
I hope I will be able to afford a vacation during Christmas break for my kids
I believe in you! Where are you planning on going?
I was just going to look up what deals they had going on closer to that time and depending on how much money I save
I was thinking a cruise sounds perfect for you and your kids!
A friend forgot his phone at the library
Did he get it back? I hate it when that happens...
I found my old diary in the basement. It brought lot of memories
How nostalgic! Was there anything in there that surprised you?
My first love letter which I received. I have read that 5 times again lol
That's so cute. How old were you?
I got a wonderful surprise the other day.
I love surprises. What was it?
So I am really mad right now. Brother took my car without asking and I have to go to work.
That would really upset me! How are you going to get to work?
I dunno all my friends are busy and no one is even answering the phone at work.
Can you take an uber?
I haven't watched a horror in so long, but my friend wants to watch one
Me either. I don't want too though, lol. Are you scared?
I am going to bungee jumping this weekend. I could not wait for the weekend to come
Nice! Where are you going to do it?
I just opened my whataburger bag when my wife reached for my fries
Nice! How is your business doing nowadays?
Its great, but I can't believe she eats after me every time.
That's really great. I am proud of your success.
I felt great after winning a video game tournament.
That is so cool, what kind of video game was it?
It was a fighting game for the Gamecube.
That is so amazing. Are you a professional gamer?
I miss hanging out with my friends all night. Those days are over.
Why does that have to change now?
I can't believe I am up so early, it's the weekend!
I know. It seems like I've been up early every weekend for a while now. Really wish I could sleep in!
I told myself last night I would sleep in but I guess my body doesn't want to
What can you do when your body refuses to cooperate, eh?
I couldn't believe I got flowers at work
Do you know who sent them?
My boyfriend sent them
Awesome, was there any special occasion?
If I didn't take my self defense classes I feel like I would never been able to survive!
What kind of classes have you taken?
Really sick of going through the same thing with a person who is in my life.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have a plan to change things?

Yes, I have. They have been thrown out..And they have to change to ever even get a moment from me..However...I let them back in for a second and they did the same crap again... It's making me quite angry when they lie to me.
That's terrible, but good for you for having a plan. You'll get through it, your happiness is the most important thing!
My grandfather invited me over and made us an awesome dinner today. I was so hungry.
What did he cook that is such an exciting way to spend your day with your papa.
I was so happy when my son went to college.
In what college did he go?
I was upset the other day when I couldn't leave home on time
Why, what happened?
Two years ago we decided to sell off almost everything we owned and move into our RV so we could travel full-time. I was really scared and worried about literally everything lol.
Oh wow that is a huge commitment! How did it go?
It has been amazing! We have enjoyed every minute of the last 2 years. My kids are seeing and experiencing things that they may have never been able to see or do.
That is really awesome! I'm glad it all worked out for you!
I can't wait to start my new job tomorrow. I'll have better hours and higher pay.
What kind of job is it
Its a financial analyst job. The company is really good and its something new for me.
That sounds like a good one
My friend just sent me a box with bath bombs and a spa kit!
That sounds wonderful! Do you get to use them yet?
I feel abandon these days.
What's wrong? Did anything happen? Have you reached out to any friends lately?
Have you ever been in a situation where you had food on your face and you walked around for awhile without anyone telling you? This just happened to me yesterday and I was so embarrassed!
Of course I have, it's really hard
Least year I took my final performance exam for my pilot's license. I thought it was going to be easy. I was wrong.
Oh man I bet that is a very difficult test. I can't believe how many instruments are in a cockpit!
I didn't even make it to the airplane. The examiner wasn't happy with a few of my answers in the oral exam. I could have sworn I had studied enough!
What a bummer. At least now you know what you need to study for when you take the exam again!
What's is your opinon on situation like this?
On what situation?
I don't like doing my job and the duties of other co-worker that slack..
My opinion is I don't mind doing my own job but if I have to do my co-workers jobs, I would get furious. It is not fair?
I never really imagined what it would be like to be a parent and then I became one.
Good for you! How was your first experience?
It's honestly like watching your heart walk around outside of your body.
I am really happy for you. Hope I'll be a dad one day.
Next month I teach a beginning cake decorating class.
Do you have a lot of experience baking cakes?
I feel bad for eating unhealthy all weekend, I was doing so good with my diet!
It's okay! A cheat weekend every now and then can be We'll deserved when on a diet! Start right now eating healthy again! You can do it!
'm promoting two staff members on Sunday. They work hard and are great people.
That's great. Do they know?
I feel bad I didn't go to work today.
Why did you decide not to go?
Man I had a rough day today.
Oh no, would you like to talk about it? I really hope that you are alright.
I'm OK. Its just deaths suck. Especially when its family.
Oh no I am so sorry to hear that. I wish you all the best and they are probably in a better place :)
I found a wallet and returned it to the owner.
That's very good of you. I would be proud of myself If I can do such a thing especially if there is a huge chunk of money in it
Yes, I was very satisfied with my behavior.
I hope he or she rewarded you though
My neighbor's house burn down. We can't find where the cats went.
Oh no, that's awful. When did this happen?
Last week. The cats are nowhere to be found. We even called the shelter.
I hope the worst didn't happen to them, that's so sad.
Bought two pairs of shoes recently.
What brand are they?
Yeezy's, the worst part is the second pair of shoes were both right footed.
That is crazy did you go return them maybe?
My friends are always flaking on me

That's terrible. Sometimes it's hard to know who your real friends are, and it takes repeated attempts to hang out with them, only to have them bail on you, to realize that You're not valued by them. I say cut your ties sooner rather than later. Life's too short.
We packed up everything in the car to go visit my family.
Oh, are you going on a trip?
We went on vacation to see my family in another state. I was very happy to be going.
That sounds like a fun time.
I have MS, and sometimes I have bowl problems.
I'm so sorry. Have you tried any natural remedies?
No, I've tried science remedies. I like those kinds better.
I hope you find something that gives you some relief!
So a while aog my cat went missing and I found her ran over in the road.
That is so sad. Did you find out who did it?
You know what's great? Finding pictures of my kids as babies and going through those and remembering all the great times.
Aww, did you find a lot?
Sometimes I do, sometimes I don't! But the few I find always mean so much to me!
I love finding old videos too!
My friend has bunch of spiders as pets, but I can't stand them. They creep me out!
I would be afraid one of them would get out!
Yeah I am afraid of that too!
Have you held any of your friend's spiders?
I was exposed to lice at work
That's horrible. What is your work doing to fix that?
My husband drove 30 hours this past weekend to get the puppy of my dreams. I was really thankful and excited.
Wow. Your husband sound like such a sweet guy.
I am really glad to see how hard my son is working
Sounds like a good kid. What has he been working on.
He got his first job and he has been really responsible with it and it has been 4 months
That's great! How old is he?
Buddy of mine and I had both paid for front row tickets to a concert...I was so mad at myself when we got there and I forgot it back home
Oh that sucks! How far do you live from the venue?
I finally go on vacation next week. I can't wait.
I bet your excited, wish I was you
I went to the park all by myself yesterday. It was so lonesome.
That is no fun! I have been feeling lonely lately too, Where are your frineds?
I feel guilty when I'm around other peoples belongings
Why's that? Do you think people will assume you are stealing?
When I was in year 6 I was accused of stealing and was kind of publicly humiliated in front of the whole school.
That's terrible. I could see how that would stay with you.
A few years ago I was able to buy my first new Car. That was such a great day.
Congratulations! Buying a car is a big investment. What was the first thing you did when you got your car.
Recently, my dog died. It was so heartbreaking. We had him since 2010.
Oh no that would make him quite young. I'm so sorry! Do you have plans for another one when You're ready?
I've been married forever. I'm good with it.
What is your wifes name?
I can't wait to leave this apartment
I am sure you are looking forward to it. What don't you like about it?
Every neighbor I have had is terrible. Its like a bad luck apartment
Sorry about your bad luck. Glad you are getting out of that place!
Hi, I recently did some research for my school.
Oh cool, what was the research about?
I was so aggravated today while I was installing a new light fixture in my dining room!!
