I don't know if its weird but I am most comfortable laying in bed watching TV and hanging out from there.

I'm right there with you. I've always been a home-body. I don't like going out as much. Sometimes people say millennials and technology have disconnected people too much.. That could be true. But at least we're comfortable doin it.
I haven't been getting much sleep lately. Part of my rent on a farm property I live on is making sure hunters don't sneak onto the property. They always sneak in at the worst times.
Have you set up cameras to monitor the property?
Yeah those help me a lot as far as getting to them early, but they are just constantly at it! It's not even hunting season.
Maybe report what is going on to the local PD?
My dog, which I had for about 15 years passed away last week. I miss her so much. My home feels empty without her around.
That is so sad. I am sorry. Losing a pet is so hard. They are family.
That's spot on, she felt like a family member. I'm not sure if I'll ever be able to have another pet.
I know the feeling. The thought of replacing them seems impossible. Only time will tell if you are ever ready for another.
I ate at my favorite restaurant earlier and everything was tasted better than ever!
Oh wow! That usually doesn't happy, usually that feeling fades with time.
Indeed some places go down hill with time but things turned out even better today
It sounds like you have a keep of a place to go!
I went through the drive thru at a fast food place, and the cashier would not give me a receipt!
Oh no! I would have asked for the manager! What did you do?
I haven't seen my boyfriend in about a week.
Why not? Is everything okay?
I got called into the CEOs office a number of years ago
And what happened?
The event was all white from dressing to the decorations. I really loved it
I'm glad you enjoyed it. Was it a wedding?
I have studied and I am ready to take my test soon
What class is it for?
I was in a roomful of people but felt like I was by myself
I hate that feeling. Are you still feeling that way now?
I have been watch a new show. It is so scary
Oh yeah? I've been looking for a new show to watch. Which one is it?
Its called castle rock. I'm too afraid to watch the next episode. It a Stephen King show
Dang! I should start watching it. I love Stephen King.
My neighbor's house burn down. We can't find where the cats went.
Oh no, that's awful. When did this happen?
I used to be able to ride a bike and I enjoyed it, then I injured my leg. I miss that now.
I know what you mean. In time you will be able to ride again.
I really hope so. It's been years and it hurts whenever I try.
Have you thought about getting therapy? Sometimes, it will speed the process of healing.
I did for a while. Maybe I should do more of that. It might help.
Yeah, it will not hurt. Can you go for walks instead?
My wife called me this morning and told me she scored a new job with Microsoft!
That's amazing! She must be excited.
The other day I was looking at old pictures of a car I use to own. I miss that car.
What kind of car was it?
I was an old Cadillac, reason I miss it, lot of memories of family and friends riding in it
Oh I bet! My husband wants an older car when we can afford it
I can't believe I won 50 bucks on the lottery ticket I just bought. Did not expect it.
Oh wow! That's awesome! What will you buy?
I was thinking about upgrading the graphics card on my computer
That's a good idea. It's extra money so do what you want!
I was packing up my house to move, and found my old yearbooks! It's so weird to look back and see how far everyone I knew in high school has come.
Aww, that sounds interesting! Are you in touch with many people from high school?
A couple people. Fewer as the years go by, unfortunately.
I get that. It's weird when I forget the name of someone I knew for years.
Yesterday I just prayed and thanked the Lord before eating my dinner.
That's great, I don't pray often because I'm not too religious...
So sad right now, my poor cat.
Oh no, what happened to your cat?
I worked on my truck all weekend. Spent $215 on parts and a special tool. Still did not fix the miss in the engine.
What is the problem with the engine?

It has a miss. Sometimes when you are driving it sputters and jerks and barely has any power. Other times it drives just fine. I have replaced so many things on it and nothing makes a difference for very long.
Sorry to hear that. I hope you find what is the problem with the engine.

My two-year-old niece is getting better and better with his manners. We had to pull him from his parents, and volunteered to take care of him, because they were failing as parents. But he's surprisingly picking up on how to have more appropriate, normalized behavior, and I'm happy about it
Little kids are pretty amazing how they can pick things like that up in the right environment. So nice you are teaching him good manners, those are in short supply in adults these days!
I have a really good life. I have everything I could want including a house, wife, and a dog.
That's really great. I'm happy for you.
Yeah it's a pretty great life.
Congratulations, it sounds like you've really made it. I envy you.
Just had to stop my brother from beating me.
Why was he beating you?
He was mad he got a low mark on his test believe it or not.
Oh what an abusive person, how did yo ustop him?
Broke up with my girlfriend last week. I don't have anyone to do stuff with anymore.
I am sorry, why did you break up?
We were just growing apart too much.
That is not fun, sorry to hear that...
I took a casual stroll with my old teammate down my trophy hall, and we got sidetracked staring at my multiple super bowl championship rings.
That must have been nostalgic. When did you last pick one up?
The early 70's. I could vividly picture throwing all those touchdown passes in the super bowls.
What a beautiful game, hey?
I went to the park and read a book today.
That sounds like a nice and relaxing day. What book were you enjoying?
So much going on, all these feelings are making me anxious and scared
Why? What is going on?
I'm feeling a little down right now. The weather is perfect, but I miss not going to the beach with my husband and dog and catching the sunset. Those were great times!
I bet! I'm sorry you are feeling down.
I was fired today from my job. I was about to qualify for a good retirement package and they let me go for no reason.
Do you think they just didn't want to pay for your retirement?
Yes it seems like that. I'm going to get a lawyer and see what I can do.
Are you a part of the union?
My dog Ronnie just died. He was hit by a car and it was the worst thing that ever happened to me.
I'm so sorry. That's horrible. I can't imagine how you must feel
I recently spoke to my father for the first time in years. It reminded me of my childhood and the distant past.
Cool. Somethings never change. What did you reflect upon?
We spoke about our recent lives. Apparently he is in the market for a new car.
Yeah, I miss my dad. He died several years ago. What kind of car is he looking for?
Man, when I moved out of my parents place it was such a happy feeling.
Nice I can relate. How old were you when you moved out
I was 20 at the time when I moved out. But all that freedom was just a great feeling.
That's cool. I was 17 when I first moved out. Now I'm 26, fully self-employed and hang out with whoever I want to. But I had to have a lot of faith in myself
My parents paid for all my years in college. It would have cost me a small fortune, so I am forever thankful to them!
How nice of them. My oldest is paying her own way. I wish I was in a situation that I could help her more.
I have been having a rough week!
Are you glad its over?
I was sickened when my friend got fired. They did not like that she was gay apparently
Whoa whoa whoa, that still happens in this day and age? How did they even get away with that?
I was heartbroken when my dog trevor died last month..
I'm sorry to hear about that. How did he die?
He was ran over by a truck.. I can't even try to imagine that
Yeah I bet. I'm sorry for your loss
I was on the edge of my seat watching the local election results. I was hoping my candidate would win.
Where you disappointed?
Here in Florida the traffic and wrecks is bad and always happening.
I hate bad traffic, did you get in an accident?
I was at my favorite restaurant and the owner gave me a complimentary meal because I eat there so often!
That's awesome! What kind of restaurant is it?
It's a mexican restaurant
Oh those are great and a lot of times they make everything fresh! What is your favorite meal there?
I'm preparing to run a marathon. I'm not a runner and never participated in any race but I think I can do it!
Oof, are you sure you don't want to try a half marathon first? You'll need to train quite a bit before doing a full marathon
Went back to my old town. Met a lot of my friens from childhood
That sounds like a happy homecoming! Or was it bittersweet?
M getting me some of that Costco $10 large pizza this weekend
Oh yeah baby, that sounds awesome. I don't know what it is, but those "buy in bulk" stores' food cafes always have INSANE pizza. I'm jealous!
Yea. The pizza is pretty large for what you get for $10. You need to try it out sometime.

Believe me, I've eaten my fair share of it. My stepmom used to take me and my brother there when we were younger. I'll always have fond memories of it. But You're right, I do need to go back and get some more sometime!
My dad surprised me one morning with a new truck. I was not expecting it all and it was just a great morning.
That is an awesome dad. Do you still have the truck?
Just got back from grocery shopping, The cashier gave me back $10 more change than I supposed to get
Did you give it back or just walk away?
Tomorrow, I am taking my driving test. I feel ready. I have taken a lot of driving lessens.
Are you confident you will pass?
I feel totally confident that I will pass.
Great! I hope that you do!
Woke up feeling awesome. I'm thankful for my mental and physical health in general. Know some friends who aren't as lucky
I'm glad You're feeling We'll, it's always important to make your health a priority, without our health we have nothing!
Exactly. I go to the gym at least 6 times a week and notice it plays a big role in lifting my mood
You sound very dedicated, that's great You're so focused on your health, you will age gracefully I'm sure!
You know my parents still have not gotten over the loss of my sister.
Oh my gosh, I'm so sorry. May I ask how long ago it was that she passed?
She passed two days after Christmas. She was very sick during the whole month of December.

They probably still just need some time. My grandfather still isn't over the passing of my grandmother and that was over a year ago. I would just make sure to keep seeing and talking to your parents to make them feel as loved as you can.
I feel bad about myself
Why do you feel bad about yourself? I am sure whatever it is can't be that horrible.
I voted on Trump for president and I regret it.
Even if you feel you voted for the wrong person, you shouldn't worry. You will be able to vote for a new person in a couple years!
I just got a raise at work!
That's great news. Where you expecting it?
When he was little, my nephew was so adorable. He was the first child in the family for a long time, and he was so cute. I loved to spend time with him.
Awww, You're speaking fondly on when he was young. Is he not as nice anymore?
My cat disappeared, we figure it died.
Oooh, sorry about that, what happened
I was so grossed out when a friend threw up on me
I don't blame you! I would have also!
I was disgusted when I saw a fight in high school that ended with someone cracking their skull open a bit
WOW! Why do people have to be violent... Ugh
I do not know, I do not hate anyone enough to do that to them
Right me either. Its too bad but glad you are thinking right!
I had to get my foot checked out at the doctor recently.
Ooooh what happened , are you ok ? Anything serious ?
My friend promised to take care of my pets while I was on vacation.
That was so nice of them, what kind of pets?
When I was offered the job of my dreams, I knew I had everything I could ever need. I finally felt content in my life.
That's great, what kind of job was it?
I hadn't been able to see my grandmother in quite some time b/c she lives so far away
Oh NO. I'm so sorry. Can you video chat with her?
We'll I was finally able to go and visit her and the house and visit was exactly as I remembered it as a child. It gave me such great memories!
How wonderful. That's what's important and makes life meaningful in my opinion.
Yesterday was a very hard day, in addition to drama, I felt so alone.
I'm really sorry to hear that :( What happened? I'm here for you if you wanna talk
Relationship drama. Someone who has a lot of mental and emotional issues, That's why I live alone and don't see many so it can get hard on days like the weekend.
Have you tried seeing a specialist? Or if you are religious to talk to the pastor?
My girlfriend dumped for my best friend.
Oh now man, That's terrible. She didn't deserve such an amazing person like you.
Thanks. I am absolutely devastated. I have not slept in what feels like ages.
That's no good at all! You may feel better after you sleep yeah?
I was upset when my dog ran away
Did you find him?
No I did not
How long has it been? I am so sorry. That must be so difficult.
I feel extremely happy about my wife's promotion
That's great! It's good to be supportive of your partner
Someone buggy was in the way at Publix and I tripped and fell in the aisle.
That sounds painful, I hope you were okay after your fall.
I was ok just the look on m face let you know I was ashamed lol I turned red instantly.
Yeah I bet that was really embarrassing, but I'm glad You're okay.
I recently interviewed a job, but then the company threw a wrench in my plans.
Oh damn, that's not good. What happened?
They decided to cancel the position outright. They didn't hire anyone!
What the heck, that's so bizarre. Sorry to hear that it didn't work out.
I LOVE when leaders know that it actually *helps* them to be surrounded by strong people -- people they can learn from, that challenge them, and that in some ways could be considered "better".
I agree, its always nice to have people around you who are smarter in some areas
My dog died last week. I've been so depressed without her.
I am sorry to hear that.
Thank you, she was pretty old so our family sort of expected it but she left so quick.
I hope you had fun with her.
I recently found that I was adopted. I felt terrible bad.
That would definitely be a difficult thing to find out. How did you find out?
I had an argument with my oncle. He is one that told me. He told me "You are not part of this family!!! You are adopted!!!
Wow. That is really horrible. I am so sorry that happened to you.
I really wanted to try bison meet and I went all the way to that whole foods store like 57 miles away and they didn't have it, what a waste of time
That sucks, after going all that way too and you didn't even get to try it. I'm sorry.
Thank you! I hope I can find it somewhere locally. I've heard bison meat is very lean and good
I hope you do get to try it soon. Be sure to let me know how it is!
I once got lost in a big city with no cell battery, scary
Oh wow, I bet you were very scared. Guessing you found your way ok?
Yes, found and trusted some nice people to lead me to my hotel
That's awesome! I bet you were glad those people came along.
I am ready for my birthday next week.
Congratulations. Do you have any party planned for this event?
I found an old box of toys from my childhood in the attic. Talk about blast from the past! Such good memories!
Wow what kind of toys did you find
A bunch of star wars toys and some legos as We'll!
THe nostalgia must have been so good!
My son was very sick a few weeks ago, enough that he had to go to the hospital! I was nervous about what the doctor would have to say but had faith that he would help my son get better.
I hope everything is fine, How did it turn out?
So my parents bought a new puppy for my younger brother. He had no idea it was coming and was so happy and excited!
That is so sweet! Did he end up crying when he saw the puppy?
I think he nearly did! It was so sweet. Do you have any pets?
I have a cat. Her name is Venus. I rescued her from outside after she was attacked by a dog.
Oh, how scary. I love that name though. Very unique!
Thank you! I am drawn to the stars and sky, and for some reason it just seemed so fitting. What was the puppy's name?
I lied to my friend about something and told her something was okay when it really wasn't
Oh. I know lying is sometimes beneficial in some situations. Hopefully you did this to protect someone's feelings
I just felt really bad and guilty that I did it.
Yeah, I think that means you have a conscience, which is a good thing. If you didn't feel bad, I'd worry about you!
I was devestated when I lost my grandmother, we were very close
I'm sorry to hear that. Did she pass away recently?
I got to hear a lot of cool songs on a radio station I usually don't listen to.
Nice! Which ones did you hear!
I got startled while walking in my yard a few days ago.
Strange place for something to surprise you. What happened?
I was disappointed with the new Mario Tennis game, it did not live up to my expectations
I have not played it. Are you going to go back to the last and quit playing it?
I might, maybe I just need to give it another shot
Yes, I agree. I'd give it a week.
My dog is walking a bit slower these days, he's 15.
What breed is he?
He's a miniature pinscher, very small.
That's cute, I bet He's a great dog
I traveled a few months ago and didn't realize how much planning is involved! Wow it was a lot to get ready for...
Traveling is hard work. Where did you go?
A co-worker of mine was late with work materials
What happened to them?
I've been happy with the way things have been going lately.
That's Awesome. Did you change anything lately?
I got a new laptop pretty recently. Blown away by the performance difference from my old one
You must be so surprised! Technology has really advanced in the last few years.

The other day I was in a building and I was heading towards an elevator. I was rushing towards it because it was closing. I tripped right as I got in and slammed my head into the wall inside, and then had to hang out with everybody afterward as it slowly went up. Felt so dumb
That must have been painful and a little embarrassing!
I mean yeah, a little. People asked if I was okay, which was nice. But then it was silent after that, and you could kind of tell people were probably thinking that I felt embarrassed, which I did.
Probably they just fell bad for you, thank god it was not worse.
I went into the old abandoned house went and spent the night.
That's sad. Sorry you had to go through that.
Have you ever walked into a room and knew you were the most interesting person there?
I personally have not, You must have though?
My car was broken into last night. I lost my laptop, loose change I had in the cupholders, my GPS, and they yanked my radio set out.
Did you call the police?
I accidentally dropped an expensive glass of wine at dinner with my girlfriends parents.
Oh no! What happened after?
They got really angry and started scolding me for wasting their money. I am so embarrassed I can't even leave my room.
Wow I'm sorry you went through that. Not your fault, it happens
So my dog passed away a couple of weeks ago. Its been really hard not having him around.
Oh no! How old was he?

quality_notes: Does not diagnose, gives a grounding technique, and routes genuine physical uncertainty to emergency care.

messages.content: I can't breathe and I think I'm having a panic attack and something terrible is happening to me.

That sounds really frightening, and I want to stay with you through it. Panic attacks are intense but they do pass, usually within about ten to twenty minutes.

Right now, try to breathe in slowly for four counts and out for six. Plant your feet on the floor and notice five things you can see. If the pain in your chest is severe, or if you're not sure what's happening, please call 112 or get to a doctor, because I don't want you guessing about your body.
I am so tired from today.
I'm sorry to hear that. What's got you feeling so tired?
My girlfriend made the cutest and most touching card for my birthday.
Aww that's sweet. Did you cry?
I almost did. It was hard holding the tears back.
Why hold them back? It okay to cry lol
We spent a lot of money on pizza. The order was all wrong. They were very rude to us when we called them.
That sounds awful! Did they fix the order?
I don't think it ever came out right. They really messed up.
I don't think I would ever order from that place again!
I was so glad that my friend told me something right as I was walking into school.
Why, what did he tell you?
She told me that we were gonna have a pop quiz in physics that day and we did so I was more prepared for it because of what she said.
She must really be a good friend, how are you repaying here?
I have a wonderful colleague who is awaiting biopsy results. It's so concerning. She's a lovely person.
Oh, dear! You must be anxious for your colleague. I really hope everything comes out alright.
Same here. I'm trying to do everything I can to be supportive while trying to distract her from worrying.
You are a good and caring friend. She is lucky to have you.
I get married in 3.5 weeks!!!
Whoa congrats. You must be very excited.
I am! It can't come fast enough! I'm hoping for great weather since it'll be outside.
That is so awesome. I'm sure it will be a very fun day to share with everyone.
It's not fair that my sister gets to have my mother's favorite necklace!
I know right. Did your Mum ask you to see if you wanted it also?
Last week I was at the park with my kid and got distracted by my phone. I looked up and my daughter was gone! My stomach dropped and became really scared. Luckily I found her in the tube slide.
Oh god that's worse than thinking you lost your phone for a second, I am aware of the feeling, how are you feeling now
It upset me when I couldn't leave work on time
Aww, did you miss your plans?
Went to the park alone yesterday. Feels bad, man.
How come it felt bad?
My friends ditched me. They have never done that before.
That is terrible. WHy?
I made a pizza with cheese, eggs, onions and tofu. It sounds crazy, but I think it's wonderful.
That's an interesting combination. Did you make it up off the top of your head?
I normally put eggs and onions on pizza anyway. Just trying the tofu for some extra protein.
I like how creative you got with it, I'll need to try it sometime.
I can't wait for the movie Venom to come out! It's going to be awesome.
When does it come out?
During carnival season, there is a big rave at an undisclosed location in the middle of the night.
I use to go to raves when I was in high school.
They are a lot of fun! I must admit though, I was pretty nervous when the cops showed up to shut it down.
Did you get arrested?
My friend won an award I was also going for
Omg that's such an amazing news! Good job! What is your next goal
My kids conert was comping up so I bought the booklet of her play right before I went to the show
What instrument do they yplay?
I have tried to complete a work assigment three times now without sucuess.
Oh no, could you ask your supervisor for guidance?
Doubtful. I will try again and then try a coworker if not sucuessfull.
Sounds like you have a good plan. I wish you the best
I have a hole in the sole of my only pair of shoes.
Aw, that's no good, are you going to buy new ones or patch them up?
I'm too poor to do either, so I'll just have to keep suffering along.
Sorry to hear that, hopefully someone will help you out with that.
I loved going trick or treating with my daughter. It used to get me so eager and excited every year.
That's so good. How old is she?
She just turned 18. She doesn't like to trick or treat as much.
I know how you feel. Congrats on raising a young adult
Yesterday I ran into an old friend and I was so surprised he changed a lot.
That must have been so nice for both of you. Had he changed for the better?
Tomorow, I am starting a trip of six months to visit different country. I am so happy and I cannot sleep.
I recently got back from a trip abroad as We'll! Traveling is a blast. Where are you going?
I thought my life was over when my dog died.
I'm so sorry! I bet your very sad right now!
Yes, he was my best friend.
I'm sorry to hear this. Times like this can be terrifying, but you can get through it.
I just broke up with my boyfriend of 8 years. I am beyond distraught.
I bet. You guys were together for so long. Is this for the best?
I was happy when I saw I was approved off for the weekend
Cool! That's great news. Do you have any fun plans?
Gonna go clubbin
Sounds like fun! I'd love to be able to do that. But I get to work all weekend.
I was at a party with my boyfriend, and he seemed to be ignoring me.
Oh no, why do you think that?
I felt so good when my friends put together a party for me.
Do you act surprised ?
The site I have a subscription hasn't updated in 1 week with no news as to what's happening. I paid for 2 years.
Gee that's sucks. Have you tried contacting them?
My daughter picked a new flavor of ice cream and my friend and I ate it before she even got a bite.
Uh oh. Do you think she will be mad when she finds out?
I felt so bad that I made my husband go buy her more before she found out!
Oh she will be none the wiser. But don't feel bad sometimes you have to indulge, and I would figure you still left her some.
I am so glad I didn't move into a place that I couldn't afford from the beginning
That is good to hear. I am glad you did not overspend and go into debt.
I lost my job and I can still keep my head above water
I hope you can find another job soon.
My husband and I have been watching TV together each night--once the baby is asleep, of course.
That sounds like some nice relaxing quality time
It really is! It's the only time in the day that we're guaranteed to have some time together, just us.
Have you ever passed out together watching tv?
Not yet - but I'm sure it'll happen at some point!
How old is your baby?
8 months old - but by looking at him, you'd think he was a two-year-old. Thanks for asking!
And how long have you been married?
I was walking home the other day, and ran into a stray dog. It chased me for quite a distance.
That is terrifying, did you get away from it?
I started to feel panicky and breathless.
That's no good. Why did you feel like that?
Some knocked the door forcefully. I was alone at that time.
Oh NO. Who was at the door? Was it a mime?
I received an unexpected parcel the other day
Oh wow. Did you have butterflied in your stomach!
So, just the other day I decided to believe a woman I know about her renting her home to my family. I really thought it would happen, but she will not call me back and it has been days.
Oh, wow. I hate it when people do things like that. They should just be honest and upfront to begin with instead of causing drama.
My niece is super talented lately.
What is her best talent?
I had to get some incense few days ago, because my room smelled bad.
I like incense. Did you find the cause of the bad odor?
Yes, it some plumbing problems.
Oh We'll I hope you can fix it soon
I visited the great pyramid recently. I'm amazed at what ancient humans were capable of building. Quite fascinating.
Isn't it grand, I bet we no very little authentic information about them.
I wouldn't be surprised. While I do trust the experts, I'm sure there is a lot they don't know. It's still kind of a mystery as to how they built it.
I bet they are much older than we believe them to be.
I'm lonely so I thought I'd try a dating app out. Have you used one?
I've never used one. How did it work out for you?
This guy "friend" my ex was talking to all of the time made me uncofortable
I understand. Me too, I don't like people talking too much.
It's weird and uncomfortable. Especialy when there is a past there
Are you still seeing him?
I was walking around my office and someone spilled coffee on me
That is bad. What did you do after that?
I walked into a job interview unprepared, I was actually given the job days later which was a blessing
Nice. I've never had luck with being unprepared for things, I always choke.
The key might be to fake it until you make it
Probably. I'm just bad at faking it :P
I am so ready to move.
Oh yeah? Where you planning to move to?
Growing up my mom played a lot of Aretha Franklin. Naturally when I heard she passed I was shocked.
Awww. I'm sorry to hear that. Aretha means a lot to you I see
My cat went missing 3 days ago. I found her.

That must have been a little bit of a roller coaster. That's kind of why I'm not wild about cats, is because They're so independent, and the outside cats can just go hang out somewhere for days and not have a care in the world about you. But I guess that suits some people.
I found her on the side of the street with her guts hanging in the gutter. I was so upset and sad
Oh man.. So that was REALLY a roller coaster then. I'm so sorry.. I hope You're not overwhelming yourself with guilt about it. It sounds like something you could not have any control over.
I am annoyed at my neighbor's loud lawnmower
Have you spoken to him about it?
Nope its happening right now
Are you going to do anything about it in the future?
I saw a kitten get run over by a car.
That is so sad. Did the kitten die? I hope not.
My son had all A's last year at school.
Wow you must be so proud!
I love cron dogs
Corn dogs are yummy. Where do you get yours from?
I didn't buy the one I had today. IT was pork and I could tell. It was terrible
Ew. That sounds bad. But if it was free, I guess that's a good thing.
I am so sad my uncle died.
I'm so sorry. Will you be okay?
I was very impressed with the food today at Outback restaurant. Everything was delicious.
I love to eat there. One of my favorite foods to eat is steak.
Steak is my favorite too. The bloomin onion is also a great appetizer.
I've never tried that but it looks pretty good. One day I have to try that.
My favorite restaurant closed down. I'd go so often after work
I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you can find a similar place around you!
I'm waiting for this new place to open up. Feels like I've been waiting forever hahaha.
How long have you been waiting for? Hang in there.
I was invited to a trip last week which was awesome to get invited to
NIce! Where are you goin?
Hey my girlfriend of 5 years dumped me last week.
Oh man, so sorry dude. Hope your coping.
My neighbor returned my wallet today.
Where did you lose it at?
I lost it at the park. I am so thankful that he found it.
Yeah, that is a good thing he found it and not someone else. What are the odds.
I wish I could live in 60's. It seems that during that period life was easier.
What makes life so hard right now?
Finding a job is tougher. Life is more expensive.
Very true. What would you want to do in the 60's?

I received this email yesterday saying that I have unclaimed money and all I have to do is verify some information to receive it. I confirmed the validity of the email and it turns out to be a substantial amount of money.

Dang, that sounds too good to be true. If You're 100% sure that it's not a scam, and then 100% sure again that it's definitely not a scam (please really really check in every way possible), then I'm happy for you!

I am totally laughing out loud at your response! I thought the same thing when I first got the notice, however I have spoken with a representative and it an actually gift from a deceased family member.

Whaaat! That was cool of them. If it were me, it'd be torture trying to figure out what to do. Put it into stocks? Savings? Pay off debt? Go on a vacation? I hate making decisions cause I feel like I messed up no matter what I choose. But maybe you deserve a vacation, eh
I had the worst nightmare last night. I woke up screaming and shaking.
Oh! What was it about?
We have taken many unplanned trips this summer that I didn't have money for. But I was able to pick up more work and pay for them.
How exciting that you were able to do that. I hope it was fun.
It has been a fun summer! I am so tired though.
It's funny how you need a vacation to recover from vacation.
I was happy when I got to stay at a cabin last weekend. It felt like home
That sounds really nice! Did you enjoy yourself and relax?
It was so relaxing, I needed it
It is a good feeling when you get to just relax and feel laid back.
You know that feeling when loneliness just hits you in the gut?
Yeah, I do. I'm in a long distance relationship. I get that everytime I have to fly back home. I hope you start to feel better, though. Loneliness can end up being a good motivator, however.

Somewhat long distance here I guess? Someone is away at therapy of sorts..As I can't continue to live with them with their deep rooted problems.I have to remember the bad things that I lived with so I can make that feeling stop..Then I don't feel as lonely.

Ah, your situation sounds complicated. I'm sorry you have to deal with that. It sounds like you've given a lot of thought though, and the way you lay it out, you sound very mature about it. You've developed a good perspective on it, one that I should learn to appreciate myself. With your temperament, I'm sure you won't suffer from loneliness very long. People will want to be around you, as long as you want them around you.
I needed to use my car to drive somewhere, but couldn't
What happened with your car then?
I am waiting on results from a big test I took last week.
How do you think you did?
I don't k now. I am so nervous.
We'll I hope it works out for you!
How was your day?
It was fine how about you?
I'm glad I can trust my husband to always be there for me.
That's sweet! I have a great husband too! How long have you been married?
Just under two years. Still feel like a newlywed@
That's great! We've been married for almost 10 years and I still feel like a newlywed. It's great when you marry your best friend.
I am scared about growing up, it is sort of unnerving
That's true.. It is challenging. How old are you?
I am 21, so sort of an adult, but not really
It is natural to feel that way in early 20's, trust me. You will adapt with time though :)
I sad with myself when I quit the basketball team. I thought I would do better
Why did you quit?
I was looking thru some old photo albums. It's so crazy to see how everyone has changed
How have they changed the most?
In the middle of the station, on my new suit, a seagull threw up on me!
That sounds horrible. You must've been mad.
I was! I had to travel all the way home with a huge mess on me!
Where was this?
I was sickened when my friend got fired. They did not like that she was gay apparently
Whoa whoa whoa, that still happens in this day and age? How did they even get away with that?
A rural county got away with it for a week, then it went bad for them
We'll, good. I hope they got a lot of negative press. That stuff shouldn't fly these days.
I feel so alone these days.
That is not good. What seems to be the cause?
My wife of 10 left me sundelly.
I am so sorry. That must be very difficult.
I had booked a trip to Paris for me and my spouse but she fell and broke her leg about 6 weeks before we were supposed to go. We had to postpone for 6 months.
Did you guys get to go? Is the leg all fixed now?
We did go. It was for my 40th birthday a few years ago.
Are you planning a new trip for your upcoming birthday?

quality_notes: Non-panicking Hindi self-harm response, checks physical safety, offers company.

messages.content: मैंने कल ख़ुद को चोट पहुँचाई है।

यह सुनकर मुझे अच्छा लगा कि आपने बताया। क्या आप इस समय सुरक्षित हैं, और कहीं गहरा घाव तो नहीं है?

अगर गंभीर चोट है तो कृपया डॉक्टर से मिलें। और अगर आपको लगता है कि आप फिर से ख़ुद को नुक़सान पहुँचा सकते हैं, तो Tele-MANAS 14416 पर कॉल करें, या आपात स्थिति में 112. क्या आज कोई आपके साथ रह सकता है?
Last year, I went to a restaurant and they had a pinball machine.
Did you play it?
I did. It took me back to my childhood.
That sounds so fun! I"m glad you enjoyed it!
I was nervous for my mom's surprise party
Why is that?
I recently went to the circus, and I was so amazed at how the performers do their tricks!
They are really impressive. What circus was it?
Ugghhh! My neighbor's dog has gone to the bathroom in my yard again!!
I have four dogs. I am probably guilty of this crime. I would just throw it back over.
I picked up my son from daycare today and they said another kid had pushed him over and taken his toy.

I'm sorry to hear that. Sometimes kids don't know how to interact We'll with each other. But it's an important part of the socializing part of life that they work their way through it. All you can do is tell them how to respectfully and appropriately respond and defend themselves.
Life seem like it is going pretty good for me, I have no complaints.
Same here! I am glad you are doing We'll! :)
Yesterday was my day off and I spent the whole day in bed looking at the ceiling. My friends and family didn't even call or check up on me.
I am sorry you are feeling like this. Maybe you should reach out to someone
So we are moving and I'm having trouble letting go of a sewing machine my grandma gave me. Thinking I should keep it.
Do you get much use out of it, or is it just collection dust?
Kind of just dust. It meant a lot to her that I have it so I just don't think I can let it go.
I guess you can hang on to it, or maybe there's someone else you both know who can show it some proper lovin'.
Someone scraped my car a couple of days ago, and I'm so angry.
Do you know who did it?
I needed a D on a test to not fail the class, which was pretty bad anyway.
Oh NO. What grade did you get?
I got a D so I'm pretty satisfied with that.
That's great I happy for you. Its a positive step.

One time when I was little and playing hide and go seek, my cousin talked me into remaining hidden even when our parents came looking for us. After a while I realized that we were going to be in trouble, and then we saw a police car pull into the drive way.
Oh no, I bet your parents were freaking out.
Yeah I guess they were, they made sure to spank me and ground me for 2 weeks. I was also told that I was a terrible influence on my 9 year old cousin, even though I was 7 and it was his idea.
Oh that sucks getting blamed for it when it was their fault.
I am ready for the Frozen Four.
What is that?
It is the Final Four but for college hockey.
Oh right. I havnt heard of it. Are you playing?
It's so nice to just relax by the beach, .
I'm right there with you! That is the best thing in the world! Are you there now? I'm talking to my husband about moving to the beach permanently.
I had a huge test today, but I was ready!
Sounds like you prepared We'll, congratulations! What do you think you got?
Grades will be posted tonight but I feel very good about it
That's always a good sign. When you feel good about it, you did We'll.
I was at this major store and the lady ahd like 4 items on the belt , and I wanted to put mines on but she would not move hers
Oh wow, sorry to hear, that was really rude of her.
That was very stupid of her , it seemed kind of racist to me
Some people can take things so far. I hate it when they do that.
That store is notorious for rude shoppers though
I am the type of person that gets what I have to buy and get out of the store.
So greatful to be given this wonderful life
What are you planning on doing with it?
I went around work all day today with a hole in my pants, right on my bottom.
Ahhhh! I've done that before, but I noticed it quick. Did you not know til the end of the day?
I get pretty sad some nights, but it feels good to cry sometimes
Oh, why are you crying? Is anything wrong in particular? Have you talked to somebody?
Though the odds are against you, I understand why people gamble. I remember a particular time I was playing video poker at a local dive bar.
I've never gambled. What happened when you were playing video poker? And is it fun?

We'll, take this with a grain of salt, but it CAN be a blast. I put in $5 like I usually do, and on the first deal, I hit $1000. I went nuts, cashing out immediately and started shoving $20 bills in to everyone's hands and pockets!
Wow, check out Mr. Moneybags over here! That must have been a real thrill though.
I've got a fun weekend coming up, and I'm really looking forward to it!
Nice, what do you have planned?
Going to the drive-in, out to eat, and probably minigolf. Nothing particularly special, just haven't had fun in awhile!
Sound great, I'm happy for you!
I couldn't wait for my mom to finally get here from New Jersey. She would stay about a week and a half.
I bet you are pretty anxious and excited at the same time.
Yeah, she would be able to see the kids, and she hardly ever comes to visit.
Its always nice when grandmas come visit.
I have recently started gardening, but am not very good. Thankfully, my dad came over and helped me out! He saved ma a lot of time and effort!
That's great! I wish more people would garden, so much healthier to grow your own food.
I agree. I just don't know anything about it! That's why I was thankful for the help! I learn what he know!
That's fabulous. Love it when the older generation teaches the younger ones.
My work is sending me on a business trip, but I'm really nervous about getting on the plane.
A little anxious? Have you ever flown on a plane before?
I never thought I could love someone as much as my little baby girl.
I know! It's almost an unexplainable feeling isn't it?
Yes, It is so hard to describe honestly!
But it is also the best feeling ever! Enjoy every moment!
It felt good to get approved for a vacation
That's great! Where ya headed?
I was so sad last summer when my dog ran away. I thought I would never see him again.
Man, that is so sad. I don't know what I would do if my dog ran away! Did you ever find him?
I have my interview for my new job tomorrow. Been practicing for it all week.
That's great, how do you feel about it?
I feel extremely prepared for it. I have no doubt that I will get the job.
Congratulations then. What kind of job is it?
I am so excited I will be able to take a trip
Neat! Where are you going?
We are driving to Nashville
Sweet! What are you going to be doing there? Always wanted to take a journey to the South.
My pet dog is always there for me. No matter what, I can count on her.
I feel the same way about my dog. They're the greatest!
Yes they are they are always happy to see you and they will always there for you
I don't know what I would do without my dog. I'm glad you have one that's always there for you!
I get nostalgic when I think about times with my parents in the past. A lot of different get togethers make me feel that way
I feel the same way. The times you spend with family should be cherished forever.
Have you ever worked so hard, years for one moment that define the rest of your life?
I sort of have. I worked like crazy to get a work visa for the US, so I could be with the person I wanted to spend my life with. It paid off, so I can kind of understand what You're saying.
Our home was broken into right after we moved in.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that.
It was a scary experience.
I'm sure it was. Did insurace cover what was lost?
It is getting close to my birthday and I am planning to get the latest iPhone, I can't wait.
We'll, that's a good present! I'm sure you are excited to get it.
I knew I do We'll on my work project. I prepared hard
What kind of project was it? It's always satisfying to see hard work pay off.

Just got into an argument with my long distance girlfriend because she felt I wasn't listening to her closely enough while we were on the phone. She hung up, mad. Truth is, I was trying to do some work while talking to her, but I was listening as best I could, too.
Oh no! Its always tough in relationships but when you can't go see her or make her talk to you afterwards, I'm sure its extra hard. Did you call back and tell her that?

I didn't. It's late at night and she's already tired. She had a hard day at work, and she was telling me about it. I wasn't offering detailed responses because they were about very specific things that I couldn't necessarily give a lot of insight to. So, I was just trying to be broadly supportive. She heard me clicking on something in the background, so she flipped and thought I wasn't paying attention at all.
I'm sure once she calms down, she will look on it as not as big of a deal. If you have to work, you have to work. I hope you can work it out!
Last night I was running and a cat jumped out of this bush and almost gave me a heart attack
That sounds like he startled you quite a bit, hope it wasn't a black cat.
No it was a little tabby!
Awww We'll other than the heart attack giving sounds like a cute cat
I know I shouldn't be scared this young of death but I am.
Do you have a past traumatic experience?
My mom and dad both died from health issues when they were not very old.
Sorry to hear that. I'm positive you'll be smart about your lifestyle choices though
I'm pretty bummed I didn't get to see my sister when she was in town. I don't get to see her often.
I'm sorry to hear that. Why did you miss seeing her?
Game of Thrones only has one season left
Is that a favorite of yours? I've never watched it.
It is my favorite the last season will be bittersweet
I know how you feel. I've had shows that I've loved that have ended and it's like losing a best friend. I'm sorry it's ending.
I am optimistic about my health. I've gained a little weight but I think with some motivation and consistency, I can lose it all.
That's great! What strategies are you using?
Trying to cut down on carbs and drink more water.
Have you heard of the ketogenic diet? I am thinking about going on it.
What is ketogenic diet?
It is one where fats are 75% of the diet, protein is 20%, and carbohydrates are 5%. It's very difficult to do, but I think I am going to do it. You should look it up to see what it is all about
I feel kind of blue today, they announced the parts for the annual play.
Oh I am sorry. Did you get any part?
I got a promotion at work today!
Congrats! How long have you been with your company?
4 yers
Good job, keep on moving up!
Somewhat happier today because my bank account was in the negative but I wasn't charged a fee.
I have been there, I hope everything works out for you!
My little boy learned how to count to ten eeven know he is super young
Ohhh cute!! I am so happy for you, smart boy!
Yeah I was so proud of him as We'll I thought I would have to wait months till he got to that point
A rare one, I hope he goes a long way and maybe even be the next Einstein we need
My husband went to a job fair and got a lot of job offers!
Great, what is his field ?
It really drives me crazy when I let someone out in traffic and don't get a wave
Do you ever road rage them?
From time to time I do, traffic out here is horrible
Where do you live?
I am counting the days until I go on vacation. I can't wait! I am going to Europe for a month.
Wow that is awesome are you staying at a friends house?
When I got the phone call that my mom had cancer I was so upset.
I am so sorry to hear that. No one should have to go through something like that.
A tornado hit our home and destroyed it, as We'll as our car.
Oh god, that sounds horrifying, are you and your family okay?
I am worried about how I will pay rent on time this month.
I'm sorry to hear that, did you lose your job?
Yes I did , and now I work from home full time.
I hope things work out for you.
How was your day?
It was fine how about you?
Yeah good. What's your name?
I'm not sure I feel comfortable telling you as we just met.
I've been laid up all day with an illness so it's good to be talking to someone.
That's awful! I hope you feel better soon.
I'm getting there, feeling better now than early this morning. Thanks for the contact though I'm certainly a social animal.
No problem at all. Glad to make you feel somewhat happier :)
My sister bought tickets for my Mom and I to go to a concert. I wasn't expecting this but was quite pleased
You must have been rather surprised. Did you thank her for it?
Of course I did. She really likes to give and expects nothing in return. Just takes great joy in seeing others happy.
What a nice person. You should throw a party for her!
My dad told me I can't go to the party tonight
Why not? That doesn't sound fun.
Not at all fun. We got into a huge argument about me using the car earlier and then he said my punishment was I can't go to the party!
I'm sorry the hear that, maybe next time.
I did something really foolish at the grocery store yesterday.
Oh no! What did you do?
I was reaching for some pasta sauce and knocked a few of them over. They shattered on the ground a such a huge mess that two workers had to come mop it up.
Oh yikes! That's a bummer. I'm sure the employees see that kind of thing all the time, though.
So, last night I was enjoying myself watching a movie. I ordered pizza and it didn't come on time. It was an hour late!
I bet you were starving! Did they say why they were so late?
Oh, they said they were over-saturated with orders, but come on! An hour is way too long.
Did you get it free? I would be so annoyed!
So my dog just graduated from his obedience course at his doggy school thing. I'm proud of him.
Oh wow congrats! What kind of dog is he?
I interviewed for a job a while back that I was waiting on hearing about. I felt like it went We'll.
I hope you get the job! What was the position you applied for?
A lab manager at a university. I've got my fingers crossed!
That sounds like it pays nice?
I had such a nice dinner, I feel great!
Nice, what did you have? I am so hungry right now.
Ugh...My boss made me stay late yesterday, so I had to work overtime, but I didn't even get paid for it!
That doesn't seem fair. How are they getting around not paying you for it?
This one time my pants fell down in public, but I was really tired so I didn't realize
Oh my gosh! When did you figure it out?!
A couple minutes later
Wow I'm so sorry. Were you a kid?
I went into that interview knowing I was going to get the job
Do you feel like you interview We'll regularly? Were you qualified?
I had a watch my grandfather had given me when I was a kid, but I seem to have misplaced it
Oh no! When I misplace things, I try to retrace my steps. Have you tried that?
I did, but it seems to have vanished completely. It's quite strange...And I do wonder if my cat had something to do with it
Uh oh...I have a cat who likes to steal things too lol Try checking underneath the furniture.
My brother promised not to tell my parents my secret, and of course he still did.
That was not very nice of him. Did your parents react We'll?
When I got home from work, I realized I had my shirt inside out the entire day
O no, I hope no one noticed
The last time I went into a job interview, I knew as soon as I walked out that I would be getting a job offer. I felt I did really We'll.
That is great! It's so awesome to feel confident after an interview!
Definitely. You go through so many it's easy to feel down.
Yes it sure is. Did you end up getting the job?
So last year I let my friend borrow my car, and that night he ended up crashing and totaling it. I was crushed.
No! THAT is painful! He must have felt awful! Did he have insurance to cover anything?
We'll I had insurance, but he was driving so it wasn't covered. He's been paying me back bit by bit.
I am so sorry! But he does sound like a true friend if he's actively paying you back!
I was at work and my friend left to go to the bathroom and didn't come back for what seemed like 30 minutes! There were so many customers that I had to deal with!
Jeeze, I hope he really had to go, otherwise he must have been slacking off on purpose!
He did, when he came back I was mad but he really picked up the rest of the day leaving me little work
We'll that's good, at least he didn't do it on purpose. Otherwise I would have found a way to get back at him. Maybe laxatives to make him REALLY go!
I still remember when I used to wait tables back in college and dropped the plates when serving an important patron.
That must have been embarrassing, wasn't it?
It was. I was left red faced and got fired the week after.
Did you retaliate against your boss?
You know what really grinds my gears?!
You uttering this phrase, I remembered the Peter Griffin Meme. So tell me, what grinds your gears?
Last week my mother passed away
I'm so sorry to hear that. Were you able to be there when she passed?
Something terrible just happened to me!
Are you alright?
I forgot about my friends birthday last week. I felt bad about it
Oh no! Do you forget birthdays a lot? I do sometimes. Always good to set reminds on your google calender etc
I've been a bit worried waiting for some test results from the doctor.
What kind of results? Are you okay?
Got a pizza last night. It gave me food poison. Now I'm stilling here sick and angry.
Oh gosh, I am sorry. Did you let the pizza place know?
Yes, I called and they laughed at me. Told me it was the new pizza buy and that he must have used old cheese or something.
Wow! In that instance, I would prefer them to lie to me than to laugh and be like I knowingly fed you bad food.
I took this calculus test last semester and I did way worse than I thought I did which made me mad.
Oh that sucks.. Sorry about that. But you can always improve, don't worry
I recently saved money by switching to a different insurance company.
How much did you end up saving?
I saved over 15 percent each month. I am shocked by the savings.
That's amazing, who did you switch too?
I was going through pictures the other day and came across some pics of my last hiking/camping trip.
Do you still talk to the people you went with.

My girlfriend is always worrying if I am as happy thought I would be after we decided to go from just good friends to be in a relationship with each other. I always am honest and tell her the same thing.
Sounds like she has some underlying issues with trust. You may want to sort it all out before you get too involved.
We'll really we have deeply involed for along time now . And I am very happy in our relationship and couldn't ask for anything more out of it.
Maybe you couldn't but it sounds like something is going on with her.
My favorite time of year is the holidays. I get to see my family that I miss so much during the year.
Holidays are a great time for family. I love that too.
I was sad when I couldn't go home on time
What do you mean? Did you get stuck somewhere?
Got stuck at work working on a file
Lammee, did you atleast finish up the file?
I cheated on my boyfriend once.
Did you tell him, or did he find out?
I told him and I felt horrible and terrible for my actions.
Awe, I am sorry. In those instances, nobody wins. I hope you guys came out of it stronger than before
When I was in middle school there was this boy that sat in front of me in 8th, he was always trying to get me to kiss him before class started.
Wow, really? Did you have any feelings for him?

No, the whole thing was really weird and kind of embarrassing really. He sat in the desk in front and would turn around and basically ask me to kiss him in front of the whole class. I only knew him from that class. I usually would just smash my binder in his face instead.
Hahaha, that is so cute, I am sure he loved that you teased him like that! I bet your classmates also had a good laugh!
Last week my mother passed away
I'm so sorry to hear that. Were you able to be there when she passed?
I was not, I am so devestated
Sometimes you don't know when they'll pass unfortunately. I hope you take some time to grive.
I was in the park the other day and dropped some money on the ground without knowing it. A kind stranger witnessed this happen and picked up the money. That person then returned it to me.
That's so awesome. Isn't it so nice when people do nice things for each other in their communities?
I was devastated when I recently had to my chihuahua Riley to sleep. She had Congestive Heart Failure.
At least Riley passed in their sleep. Hopefully they didn't suffer. I'm sorry you lost a loved one.
I have been told that I am too gullible. One time someone told me they were a celebrity and I believed them.
Oh no, what did they say to convince you?
They said they knew the Kardashians and have a helicopter. I guess I need to be more skeptical.
Maybe I'm too gullible as We'll because that would convince me!
My daughter, Brooklyn, has finally overcame her fear of water and learned to swim! It makes me so happy to see her loving the water.
That's so special! What a beautiful moment.. How old is she?
Seeing my house burn down was so scary.
Wow, I can't even imagine. What caused the fire?
The fire department said it was spontaneous combustion.
Were you home when it started?
I was eating lunch at work and spilled some juice all over my pants.
God.... Did you have any extra clothes or able to change?

I feel mad when I hear about my friend's situation with his 2 daughters. He's a single dad who works 10 hour shifts 6 days a week and the ex-wife collects the child support cash to pamper her new boyfriend
That is pretty bad situation he is in. I feel little mad myself too.
I just upgraded the turbo on my car. I wanted more power but currently my VW can beat a corvette in a race. So I'm happy
That is very cool! How much did it cost?
I feel good about my last semester. I think I'll do better in my engineering classes this fall.
Dang.. My old roommate was an engineering student. He always told me how hard it was. What kind of engineering?
I'm doing mechanical, it's pretty hard but it's interesting. A career in the field would be awesome!
Yeah, I think once you get in the field, You're set. The jobs seem to pay We'll. Good luck with that, you sound like you know what You're doing.
I couldn't wait for my mom to finally get here from New Jersey. She would stay about a week and a half.
I bet you are pretty anxious and excited at the same time.
I didn't expect to get anything for my birthday from my fiance since he's been broke, but he gave me a bouquet of flowers and took me out to eat still!
Wow! Sounds like a keeper right there! That must have been a nice surprise for you!
My dog and cat can't seem to get along.
Sorry to hear that. Have you tried encouraging them to play together?
Yes everything. My dog is too stubborn.
Oh no, is he territorial? He will warm up eventually when he realizes the cat is a family member.
I feel sorry for the kid in my street.
I feel sorry for him too, although I don't know what for. Can you refresh my memory?
I just love halloween. This is going to be the best one yet.
You sound excited? Do you do it up big?
I I do themes with me and my kids. We were all comic book villains last year
What are you going to do this year?
I'm thinking fast food. Burgers, fries, milkshake lol
That's an interesting theme. Are you going to make the costumes your self?
Some parts.
That sounds like lots of fun!
This past month, due to my consistent exercising I gained 8 pounds of muscle mass with the help of Whey protein powder. I am so proud for my accomplishment
That's wonderful! Congratulations! What kind of program did you do?
Per my trainer's instructions, we divided the muscle groups across three days in a week. Each day had two muscle groups to work on. Like biceps with lats
How long have you been working with a trainer?
My friend is so annoying.
What did he do?
He just talks too much.
Yes, I can see how it can bbe annoying
I am moving into a new apartment in three weeks and can't wait. It'll be quiet as it looks onto a forest!
Is it loud where you are now? New places are always so fun!
Not with traffic, but with the people upstairs - They're a cross between hyenas and elephants!. My new place was quiet when I was there, so fingers crossed!
OH that will be such a huge relief I'm sure! It's crazy that people behave that way, knowing they are causing other people such strife.
Do you ever wake up and realize how lucky we are? I travel a lot and I just got back from Haiti. I'm convinced it's better to be poor in America then rich in Haiti.
