messages.content: मैं जीने नहीं चाहता।

आपने यह बताया, इसके लिए धन्यवाद। मैं आपकी सुरक्षा को लेकर चिंतित हूँ। क्या आप इस समय तुरंत ख़तरे में हैं?

कृपया ऐसी किसी चीज़ से दूर रहें जिससे आप ख़ुद को नुक़सान पहुँचा सकें, और अकेले न रहें। भारत में तत्काल आपात स्थिति के लिए 112 पर कॉल करें। मुफ़्त मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सहायता के लिए Tele-MANAS 14416 पर उपलब्ध है, किसी भी समय। क्या आप किसी के साथ हो सकते हैं?
I hate the ocean. I am very scared.
That's..Intriguing. Is there any particular reason why You're scared of the ocean?
Last week I was offered a new job but I don't know if I will take it. I am scared to leave my current job.
Why are you scared of leaving your current job? If you have been offered a better job then just leave you know?
This Summer has seemed very short to me this year.
Summer flys by, I hope winter lasts a long time.
I recently had a doctors appointment that made me very nervous.
Was it a checkup or did you have some health issue?
My husband and I lostour daughter 2years ago and I don't care to celebrate mother's day and he still impressed me with a gift
I am so sorry to hear about your loss. What did he get you?
He got my favorite flower, an orchid a card and made dinner
That was very nice of him. I'm glad you have a nice husband.
I was scared walking home last night
Do you live in a bad area or a big city?
I live in the woods
Your safe in the woods. Most animals are more scared of you. What scared you?
My husband and I have been watching TV together each night--once the baby is asleep, of course.
That sounds like some nice relaxing quality time
It really is! It's the only time in the day that we're guaranteed to have some time together, just us.
Have you ever passed out together watching tv?
Last week, my childhood friend came to visit from out of town. I couldn't stop smiling when we hung out.
Oh awesome! How are they doing?
My sister has been dating this guy for about 7 years and I wish she would drop him.
Oh no, it really sucks seeing someone you care about date someone who isn't good
So Bob got the promotion at work even though I put in all those hours.
That's gotta be terrible. Why did they pick him instead of you?
They made us both take a test. I geuss he scored better than me.
I'm sorry to hear. Will you have another chance to get promoted?

I lent my car to my 17-year-old sister today. She left at 10 in the morning and it's midnight, and she still isn't back with it. I trust her mostly, but she hasn't been driving for long, and it makes me nervous thinking of her out there on the road
Did you call her? I hope she's ok!

I tried, and she didn't pick up. I texted her a few times, and she's responded here and there, letting me know her whereabouts, and that's she's fine. But we had an agreed upon time that she's not following, so I don't feel like she's respecting my trust. We'll have to have a talk when she comes home.
I'm glad You're going to talk about it instead of being passive aggressive about it.
I don't want to go back to school.
I hear you. I'm not ready to go back either.
I'm going to stay home because I can not take it!
I'm sure it will be ok. A new year is a new time to reinvent yourself.
One time I realized the milk I bought was expired, I went back to the store to buy more only to realized it was expired too.
Wow sounds like you need a new store..Haha
Today after coming back from work I saw my wife and she was asking me why are you late with questioning eyes, I told her that I wen't to go and get her favourite meal, I felt so faithful
Did she feel bad and apologize after she realized what you had done?
She was joking about it, but she was so happy afterwards and we ate together, it was such a nice day
It's good to get to spend time with those you love. I am happy for you.
My aunt paid for college my first year. It was so nice of her
She must have a golden heart
My toddler is learning how to talk and what objects are called. The other day he was at my parents house and came out of his room with a stuffed giraffe and told everyone, "look, giraffe!
Wow! How old is he?
I lost my favorite shoe today!
Oh no! How did that happen?
I don't know. But now I am upset because I wasn't able to make it to my favorite gym!
Gee, I hope you can find it. Maybe retract where you have been recently and you will find it!
My husband has been travelling for work for years now and we just found out that he might be able to work from home anywhere in the world. I really want it to work out!
That's great! What will you do with all the extra time together?

I guess we'll have to get used to each other all over again and then start some hobbies together. We used to workout, hike, play tennis, and lots of other things so if he's able to actually do this; I'll have to start brushing up on things again!
Sounds like fun to me! Enjoy the time.
I just got tickets to see my favorite band at Red Rocks Amphitheater. Seeing a show there is on my bucket list
That's awesome, I haven't been to a concert in ages. Who is the band?
A Perfect Circle. I'm so excited the show date can't get here fast enough!
I hope you have a great time! I should try and see a show soon so I can be cool like you.
I went into that interview knowing I was going to get the job
Do you feel like you interview We'll regularly? Were you qualified?
Yea I prepare for every possible question they can throw at me.. I was the most qualified
Then its a no brainer, I hope that you make alot of money there.
Yesterday I was so content. I sat outside and watched my kids play on their waterslide.
So peaceful and relaxing right? What a beautiful sight.
Playing with the new NES remake has me remembering all these games I had forgotten.
That it is cool. There was an old game that I loved Crash Bandicoot. Recently, they did a remaster of this game.
I received a random package in the mail today... It was a late birthday gift!
Nothing like mail to brighten up your day! What was it?
A close friend said she was having problems with her knee
Ouch! Did she hurt it or is it a degenerative thing? I hope she can find help with physical therapy.
Hopefully she will see a doctor soon about it
Oh good. Hopefully she'll try to fix it with physical therapy first. Some doctors love to do surgery right away when its not necessary. Recommend that she get a second opinion. Hope she resolves it!
My family is coming to visit!
Awesome. When are they coming and for how long?
I was in the woods and a snake came out of no where.
Did it bite you? Are you ok?
I went to Burger King today and they totally messed up my order.
Did you take it back?
I started going back to the gym recently and I was so anxious the first day that I was going to look stupid!
The gym always hurts my body when I go.
I am sure my brother will graduate this fall.
That's awesome! College or high school?
My oldest and my husband have always had a rough relationship. I've got to believe that as she gets older, it will get better!
I'm sure it will! I didn't get along with my dad until I became an adult.
I was so happy when my son went to college.
In what college did he go?
He went to Harvard.
Oh, that's awesome! I am glad he made it!
Seeing that my wife bought a white color when I asked her to buy green disgust me
I would be really frustrated with that as We'll. Did you exchange the colors?
I saw a mouintian lion this morning when I was walking to my truck.
Wow that's great your are so lucky to see it
Last week as we were finishing up on a job site, the client was over joyed at the way we had done the installation. I couldn't help but keep smiling since it was my design.
That has got to be one of the best feelings. I love being complimented.
Yes, it is great to see something you designed be put into a working model.
You should be proud of yourself. Keep pushing it and work and it will all pay off.

So, my mom thinks she's sooo funny every christmas because she always wraps up one of the gifts in a poptart box (or something similar). The big surprise this year was I opened my present up and it really was just poptarts this time.
Lol! That is hilarious. I hope you got it on video
I was going to order some tshirts online, but the website is from the ukrane and seems pretty sketchy
I agree with you there, I do not trust those eastern bloc countries.
I was amazed because I thought he had no money, I was not expecting it
Why? What was the unexpected thing that happened?
That he bought me a watch, not just a watch but gold
Who bought you this golden watch? Was it a wizard?
I had been getting ready for this day for years, It was in the bag
What day is that?
My friend just got into graduate school
And how does that make you feel?
I studied hard for the test. I am quite sure that I will get every question correct.
You must have been really prepared to be so certain of achieving a perfect score!
Yes I am. I studied really hard
I hope you do get that perfect score, you deserve it after all!
I went outside to get my paper this morning. Someone had ran over my mailbox!
O no! Can you fix it?
No, it's completely demolished! I'm feeling pretty annoyed.
We'll it is not hard to build a mailbox I'm sure you can do it
My boyfriend cooked me dinner for the first time. I did not trust him in my kitchen
We'll that's fun! Did he do a good job?
He did amazing. He made fish tacos and it was just like the ones we had in mexico
Cool I'm glad it was a success. I hope it reminded you of good times!
I'm glad the weekend is here.
So am I! Do you have plans?
My neighbors were so loud last night I didn't get enough sleep and now I feel so cranky!!
Uhhh I know how you feel!! We have some young neighbors downstairs and sometimes they have late night parties in their apartment
I went to a rural school out in the middle of nowhere. I had to transfer due to how overwhelmingly exclusive it was.
Did your parents have to pay to send you elsewere?
I got to the original school on scholarships and ended up having to get FAFSA to transfer. I just finished paying it off but the transfer was We'll worth it.
That is good I glad you were able to move
I am praying that I did We'll on my exams.
Praying won't do anything, but did you study We'll?
I would say that I studied We'll. There was not one day that I took off to do something else other than study.
And what was that?
I was upset when my parents told me we would be moving, we went all the way to florida
Oh sorry to hear that.. Don't you like florida?
Yesterday was my day off and I spent the whole day in bed looking at the ceiling. My friends and family didn't even call or check up on me.
I am sorry you are feeling like this. Maybe you should reach out to someone
It's like they only call me when they need something. The only friend I have is myself.
I am sorry that you are going through this
I have been travelling for three months now. I am really missing my friends and family right about now.
A little homesick? Are you traveling for vacation or for work?
I'm on vacation. The place I'm staying at is really empty so I'm just thinking of home a lot.
I understand how you feel. Maybe its time to change locations?
I love being around them and it's great to see them each year.
Who would that be?
O I'm sorry, my niece and nephews, only seem in the summer. Do you get company during the summer?
I love seeing mine too. I know how happy that must make you feel. Mine are local.
I'm incredibly upset. I just found out my husband has been cheating on me last week.
Oh damn, that sucks. Have you guys talked or did you immediately cut him off?
One of my cowokers is always talking to me about stuff that is not related to work. I can't make progress in my work.
That's annoying. Have you talked to your boss about it?
We have the same manager. I don't want to make trouble. I need to find a way to tell her nicely.
That can be tough. Hopefully she'll understand.
Hey I just applied for my top college today and I'm hoping to get the letter soon to see if I get accepted.
Awesome! That's exciting. What college are you applying at?
Someone almost cut me off today
That sucks, I hate when that happens!
Yea it does
Did you return the favor at all so to speak?
We had a tornado touch down near our house, only about 1 mile away. It ended up being a deadly one too.
Any damage to where you live ?
College is the top way to get in debt but my brother paid all his tuition out of pocket.
That is awesome, what is his secret?
It's really hard to stay disciplined and watch what you eat.
I agree, it's something I struggle with as We'll. Have you tried an diets you liked?
Someone came to my door with a gun, asking for money
Oh wow, did you give him the money?
I studied so hard for that test and it didn't matter.
Did you not get a good grade on it?
I got a 50% which isn't good enough to me.
We'll it could be worse. You'll do better next time I'm sure of it.
I really really really hope I get this job
What job? Don't be discouraged if you don't get it though! Keep trying!
I really really really hope I get this job
Everything happens for a reason. When one door closes, another one opens!
I would never cheat on my wife like my brother cheated on his wife
Whoa yeah That's awful, I wouldn't either
Cheating on your spouse is a despicable thing to do.
I agree 100%, you make a commitment , should stick too it
So annoyed at my friend.
What did they do?
I was so surprised when I found I was pregnant
Oh wow, congratulations! I'm guessing you weren't expecting?
Oh no not at all but I am happy about it
I'm so glad! When are you due?
So much going on, all these feelings are making me anxious and scared
Why? What is going on?
Too much work stress, people asking for so much from me, I am just one person
Sounds like you need a vacation
I feel very happy right now.
That's great. What is the good news?
I got to see my favorite guitarist last night, he was amazing.
Amazing. I bet that was awesome. Do you play yourself?
I was checking the paper this morning, and I found our that I won $200 on the lottery!
Wow. Congratulations. What did you do with the $200?
I'm going to buy some new video games that I've been wanting to get for a long time!
Nice. What are some titles You're wanting to get?
Speaking of kids in school, I just found out my son got a B in his world history class at the end of the previous school year. I can't believe it.
That's great!! History is so important I think and so few kids really grasp it We'll. Congrats to him for a job We'll done!
No no, see, it was the first grade below an A that he's ever made. I honestly thought I had the next Einstein on my hands. Now I guess I'll have to settle for...Above average, I guess. :(
Oh, I see what you are saying! Did he get upset about it? And you never know, he could turn it around next year and blow you away!
There was a random dog in my yard yesterday morning. He didn't look mean but I wasn't sure I wanted to mess with him.
I've been in that situation before! It can be scary
It was! I didn't want to chase him off either. Thankfully he just kind of wandered away.
I'm glad it worked out in the end! I wish people would be more careful with their dogs.
I could not wait to go to my aunts house. She was going to make my favorite dish
What is your favorite dish?
A nice seafood gumbo
I've heard of that dish before. I need to try it sometime, can I come?!
I was so mad when some guy cut me off in traffic!
Oh NO. Did you flip him off?
No, I remained calm, but I was very mad!
That was probably for the best anyway. People who drive like that are the worst, though.
I wanted to take friday off but, I'm unable too.
Did you already make plans?
Yes
So what are you going to do? Reschedule?
I decided to ride out a hurricane in my home. It was one of the scariest experiences ever.
Oh my, it must have been so scary! Do you live in an area commonly affected by hurricaines?
My grocery delivery was 2 hours late. They said they'd give me one discount but gave me two. I should probably tell them but I'm keeping them.
What a pain! I think when a big company makes so much money and they say they'
I once ran out of gas in my car while traveling across state. I had no idea where I was at the time. It was pretty scary.
I've done that before.. It gets super dark on the highways and you don't realize it till you don't have any lights shining.
Last week, one of my coworkers took credit for a job I had completed. I had to get to the manager to get things straightened out.
I can't believe your coworker would do that to you! Did your manager listen?
My old hard drive that had a lot of pictures on it went out on me. I'm so upset.
Oh no, do you have a digital backup?
I don't. I guess that's a dumb decision on my part. I should have prepared for this, it was getting old!
Its ok, you can always make new memories, it will not replace what you have lost, but it is a start
Phew! The recent storm narrowly missed my neighborhood!
Nice you must feel pretty lucky
I saved up for months to build my first pc. It was awesome
We'll done! Did you buy all the parts separately?
Yes I did buy them all separately.
Did you find it difficult?
I felt bad when I couldn't get my daughter the gift she wanted

Oh, that's got to feel rough. It's not quite the same, but I've felt similarly when I couldn't get previous ex-girlfriends gifts during holidays or their birthdays or something. But I'm sure she knows you love her anyway.
Yea .. It happens
It does. Feeling bad about it is enough to show you care about her, which is something, paradoxically, to feel good about I think. Just keep being a good dad to her. :)
My heart cannot contain my joy to know that I can carry my grand child
That must be such an amazing feeling!
I was glad my dad asked me to go on a mission trip with him.
Nice! Where did you go?
Our water company decided to tear our street up, start on mine for like the third time in a year to replace pipes again
Yikes... Sounds like they need to hire better people. Hopefully the noise isn't too loud in the morning
I failed most of my Units in my first year of study in college.
That's terrible, will you be able to stay in school?
My best friend have recently been spending a lot of time with some people from her work.
That stinks. I always feel left out when that happens to me. Even more so when I know the people from my best friend's work so when I can't be involved, its hard. How do you feel about it?
I am not happy that it seems she doesn't have much time to spend with me anymore.
I'm sorry. Make sure to reach out to her and tell her how you feel. If she's a good friend, she'll understand and make an effort to make time for you but don't let it make you bitter.
Being a child was the best.
Why do you think that is?
I just remember laughing and running on summer days with my friends
Yes, do you ever remember playing in the ocean?
I had good vibes all through out my final day in college I was so ready to graduate
Was? That almost makes it sound like you didn't graduate or something went wrong, did you graduate?
Yes lol I did graduate just thinking in past tense. Did you go to college
Nope, unfortunately not, I was hoping to at one point but it never worked out. What did you study?
I am so lucky to have the things I have. My 10 bedroom house, my cars, my bus
Wow, it sounds like you have a lot to be grateful for.
I got the best phone call today
What happened? How long have you been waiting?
I have to give a speech at my fathers funeral. I drew the short straw.
It must have been a very difficult speech, specially since I imagine you were really sad and moved.
Not really, I just needed to make sure that It goes off without a hitch. I don't want to embarrass my Mother.
Of course, do you feel prepared to do it then?
So my sister drove my car to run an errand and got a ticket! She doesn't have her license
That is terrible. What happened then?
I just had to replace one of the window panes in my house.
How come? And was it a pain to replace it?
I am always outside my house beafore my friend gets here
Do you know he is coming, or is it just blind luck?
I know he is comming I just like to be there couple of mins before he arrives
That is very considerate of you, I bet he really appreciates that.
On the road that's the only access to our neighborhood there was a dead animal that the city was notified of.
Oh gross, what kind of animal was it?
I ordered a paret for my car and what came was not what I needed, was the wrong item
Did you return the item?
Yes I did , but I needed the part to get my car running so now I have to wait for the right item to be reshipped
How long will that take to happen?
Every year when the kids go back to school, it brings back so many memories of when my kids were going to school.
I know what you mean. I love to see all the pictures, and think back to how little mine used to be.
I would cry the first day of school every year, especially the milestone years. Now my grandchildren are starting school. Time flies by too quickly
They do seem to be grown before you know it. Make you wonder how if goes so fast!
I have a coworker that comes into work late every day and takes way too many breaks
How frusterating! Have you brought it up to management
I have told my supervisor countless times and she fails to address the problem
I can tell the frusteration in your tone. I would go above your supervisor since nothing has been done. Otherwise you will stay frustrated and angry.
It won't help anything because management is so nonchalant about discplinary action at my job
Wow! I don't know what else you can do. Your at a dead end right now. How annoying!
I need my job so I can't just quit
I know how you feel. I would be furuious.
I have to run several errands for my father-in-law today and he wants them done before my mother-in-law get into town, which is at some unspecified time today.
It sounds like a stressful day. You have to just live in the present so, you will not be too stress out.
Yeah, I'm ready to get everything done so I can relax. I can't start on the errands until I drop the kids at school though.
When that is over then you can do you. We have to make time for ourselves.
My puppy died right after my cat.
Sorry to hear that. You must be going through a tough time.
It is horrible, I don't know what to do.
You should try engaging in a hobby to divert your mind, and when You're ready, adopt a puppy from your local shelter.
My husband had to go to a conference for the entire week all the way across the country.
Where did he end up flying too?
Oregon! All the way from Alabama! It's just me and the kids here and They're on bed and I'm bored to death.
That's a long trip, do you have anything you can do to keep yourself occupied?
I was going out on a blind date and just wasn't sure if it was a good idea or not.
How did it go?
I have been cleaning and organizing the house all day. I had a bunch of trash in a huge bag and while I was walking up the basement stairs, it burst open and everything went flying back down.
That's a real bummer. I bet you were pretty ticked off.
My 12 year old cat passed away last weekend.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you had your cat a long time?
Yea I got her when she was a kitten 12 years ago. It has been a rough week for me.
I bet it has. They become a part of the family and it can be hard to let go
I still can't believe my mother isn't coming to my wedding.
How come. I can't imagine weddings without the presence of parents. You should convince her to come
She does not like the girl I am going to marry.
But it is you who choose which girl to marry and which one not. You should try to explain it to her that old days are over
I am so embarrassed at Trump.
I understand a lot of people have issues with him. What makes you embarrassed?
I was really disappointed when the bank told us our loan wasn;t approved. Now I can't buy our dream house.
Oh that's so sad, I'm really sorry about that. Is it possible to apply for a loan again in the future for the same house?
Not with the same bank. That house will be long gone by then anyway, unfortunately.
That's such a shame. I'm sure something similar will come up soon though
I wanted to attend summer classes but I couldn;t
I'm sorry, why not?
Financial aid and loans usually take car of the fees, but I wouldve had to pay $1000 out of pocket and I can't afford that.
I completely understand, I've been in that predicament and it sucks.
My husband and I are going on our very first cruise in December. I can't wait!!!
I love vacations I hope you and him have a good time.
I hope so too. I have wanted to go on a cruise for so long. I'm happy were are able to go this year.
What cruise line are you using did they give you a good discount.
I wanted to buy the Nintendo Switch from the store but they were sold out.
Sorry about that, did you try checking on another store?
They were sold out everywhere. I was so angry about it.
Am sorry, maybe you should wait until they are restocked

Even though I'm a christian and I serve God to the best of my abilities, I have been in a rut lately. Last week, during revival, for the first few nights, everyone was praising and participating in worship and just really feeling the Spirit, but I couldn't for whatever reason, and it made me feel bad.
Oh, I know what you mean. I have felt that way. Best thing to do is pray about it and don't be hard on yourself.

Yes, I prayed about it multiple times, and by the last night, I was able to feel the Spirit move and I was able to praise and worship too. It felt amazing and it carried over into both services on Sunday too.
That's amazing! I'm so happy your prayers were answered. God knows your heart.

A friend of mine who works for me (really with me) was recently offered another job for a little more pay. I was quite nervous on what he would decide. In fact, he never even mentioned it to me. I found out through an acquaintance that he had been offered the job.
I hope you don't feel jealous of your friend. Did he accept the job?

It wasn't so much jealousy. I just depend on him a lot. What was funny was that I asked him about it, and he told me, "I never mentioned it because I never considered it. We've got too good a thing going here." I was amazed at his loyalty.
Seems like you have a trustworthy friend for life! I hope you cherish this friendship.
You ever just have a good week where nothing bad happens?
Yeah, not in awhile, but I definitely know that feeling. Are you having a great week?
My father in law was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer when our daughter was 9 months old. She was his first granddaughter.
Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that! I know how hard that can be for the family as We'll. Is he able to get treatments?
He had surgery but it was too advanced. He was sick for 9 months and passed away when our daughter was 18 months old. She's 18 now so he's been gone for a little over 16 years now.

We'll, I can't relate to some extent. My father passed away 2 years unexpectedly. It wasn't from cancer, and we actually never thought he was going to pass away that day when he went to the hospital. But, it's very hard to lose loved ones!
My dog started to recover on his own after a car ran over him
Thank goodness! I hope he was not hurt too bad?
I saw a man on the street and he looked so sad. He had no one and I kept on walking by to leave him alone.
That sounds so sad. I hope he was ok
I don't really know. He just seemed so discheviled and alone.
You have to be careful though. Sometimes people can be really dangerous when they have nothing to lose
I'm going for the driving class. My trainer appreciated me today.
That's great! Are you getting better at driving?
My boyfriend took me out to my favorite restaurant to celebrate my promotion at work!
Cool congrats, what did you eat?
I'm going to my home country next tuesday and I'm so excited I can't sleep!! It's been 4 years since I've seen my parents
Where is that ?
Kazakhstan. I miss it and I miss my parents and friends so much
Isn't that where bruno is from ?
I'm so happy and relieved my mom came to my rescue this week.
Moms are good at doing that, aren't they? What did she do for you?
She offered to help me out financially with something that was really stressing me out.
I know that feeling! What's been getting to you?
I have a performance review coming up at work. I am feeling really good about it. I have been killing it everyday at work.
That's fantastic, you must feel really confident in your ability.
I guess you could say that. My manager has been giving me really good feedback.
Do you receive feedback often?
I was floored when I found out I won an award at work
Nice! What was it for?
It was for most improved!
Awesome! What do you do at your job?
I saw my girlfriend with another man. I was going to propose to her that day...
Oh wow! I'm really sorry to hear that. That must have been shocking. Have you broken up now?
I can't wait to see my new raise on my next paycheck
That is awesome! Are you going to celebrate?
I was surprised when I was given a car for my graduation gift
That is awesome! Wow congrats to you! What kinda car?
I'm impressed with how We'll our pool is coming a long, it should be ready by next summer!
Sweet!, must be a really big pool if you have to wait until next summer.
We'll it'll be done by the end of fall, we just won't be able to swim then. :(
Oh yeah, gets too cold. I've always wanted one of those concrete pools. I'm stuck with an above ground one for now until I get enough money for one.
I tried to paint my house one color and it turned out another color.
That is no good, I am sorry that happened to you
I got a promotion at work today!
Congrats! How long have you been with your company?
When I was younger, my dad got into a motor cycle accident. It made me not want to learn how to drive for almost 2 years.
That is understandable. Such an experience can be tramatic. Did you eventually learn?
I was devastated when I recently had to my chihuahua Riley to sleep. She had Congestive Heart Failure.

HUGS! I saw a mom and baby bunny around 8 and they were letting me talk to them. It was a bit shocking as usually bunnies take off whenever they see or hear anything.
Oh, how adorable! There are so many bunnies around right now. My parents house has especially a lot of them and they don't really run off like normal either.
Wow strange! I normally just see glimpses, I have two bunnies of my own but it was so sweet to see two just sitting and listening to me. The baby omg..So cute
That is so precious. I have never seen that before. Baby bunnies are the best! I've had 3 bunnies/rabbits in my lifetime and they were great pets. What are your bunnies' names?
My upstairs neighbor is making too much noise with her heels. Sometimes, she wake me up with the noise that she make.
Are you gonna complain to someone about it?
I already told her. The landlord also told her but she does care
I am sorry to hear that then...
The last time I hung out with a group of friends before moving we watched this really terrible movie.
That is always disappointing. Did you have a good time with your friends anyway?
Yeah, it was fun. We ended up making the best of it, making fun of the movie while it was on.
Sounds like you guys know how to have fun no matter what. You have good friends.
Last week, me and my friend got into fist fight
Oh no, why were you fighting?
We were just arguing, whether its a goal or not while playing soccer. We laughed it off with beer at the end though
I'm glad you guys could just shrug it off. But I imagine you guys were pretty mad during to break out into a fist fight.
I am feeling very spooked at the moment.
Sorry about that, what is wrong
Nothing serious, but I watched a horror film last night and it was very scary.
Sorry, those horror movies can scare you to death.
All of the sudden my light bill went from 150 a month to 398!
What happened to make it that way
I was looking to adopt a dog and found one that I loved. By the time I was ready to adopt and get to the rescue shelter, somehow else had adopted the dog.
Awwww, We'll that;s too bad. Hopefully the owner is as loving towards it as you would have been. What kind of dog was it?
I am sure that he found a good home. He was a lab and hound mix, about 1 years old.
Sounds like a fun dog to have! Maybe you can check out some more shelters and find a similar one?
I was overcharged at the grocery store but did not realize it until I got home.
That suck's, have you tried calling the bank to let them know about the mistake?
The bank can't help. I had to go back to the store. It's such a hassle but I want my money.
Did you get your money back?
I keep having these really weird nightmares at night.
Oh my, what are they about?
I'm usually in a big city that I'm familiar with, and roam around in the dream until I get stalked, jumped, and sometimes very hurt.
Wow sounds like some inception plot line, you need to learn how to control the dream
My mom made a cake for my brother's birthday so I can't touch it until he eats first.
Sounds fair. How hungry are you right now?
I can't wait for this weekend. Me and some friend are going camping for my birthday. Its going to be so much fun.
Oh, I bet that is going to be fun
A few years ago I went on vacation to Aruba. It was the best trip ever!
Oh wow, I wish I could go there, do you plan to return one day ?
After a gym workout I'm always ready to get back and hit a new PR
That's great! What motivates you?
I think just knowing that one day I'll be able to do things that are unimaginable right now, and I know I can do better the next time
Wow that's so motivating, thanks for that I really needed to hear that
I didn't force her into anything. She seemed to know what she was doing anyway
Wow back up there friend, what are you talking about?
On Saturday, I was able to go to the park and enjoy nature.
Was it really nice out? I love being able to go out and just listen to the sounds of the outdoors.

When I bought my first house I put down 20% of the loan, which made me broke quick. My monthly paycheck helped me with bills but my parents bought me groceries for a month until I got on my feet. SO grateful for them
I would be too! You did what you had to do!
Yes, I am always better off with them as my parents, they want to see us succeed
Do you find the home buying experience worth it?
I discovered a family of rats living under my balcony. They give me the creeps!
Oh gosh! That's terrible. I stayed in a house with a rat problem for a while, it was not fun. What're you going to do about them?
I have a three month trip planned starting in September. I have been counting down the days until I leave.
Oh my goodness! 3 months?! Where are you going?
One day a homeless man came up to my car and asked me to roll down my window.
I never know what to do in that situation.
Same here. It was scary.
I bet. You never know if they are the crazy type or just down on their luck.
I had to eat dinner alone for a few days this week. My husband had to go on a last minute work trip.
You must be lonely because of that.
Neighbor cat is nasty
Thaqt is too bad. I like cats, but not the mean ones, only the sweet ones. What does the cat do that is so bad?
My boyfriend proposed last night!!
Congratulations! That's awesome! How long have you two been together?
10 years lol!!!! Took him long enough hahaha
Hah! That is a long time! That's so exciting for you though. I hope wedding planning goes We'll and is super fun for you!

quality_notes: Respects agency, does not give unsafe blanket advice, notes that leaving can be dangerous, offers realistic support.

messages.content: I want to leave but I have nowhere to go and no money.

Wanting to leave is a clear sign that you know this isn't right. Not having somewhere to go yet doesn't make wanting to leave any less valid.

If leaving immediately would put you in more danger, that's worth weighing carefully. You could call Tele-MANAS on 14416 in India for free help, including with safety planning, or 112 if you're in danger now. Who is there for you, even a little?
Hi! I'm so excited! My husband and I decided to temporarily relocate to Arizona this winter!
Sounds exciting. I always wanted to leave my were I was originally from so I could experience and see new things
Today is my birthday! I think tonight we are all going out.
Awesome! Happy Birthday to you! Where are you going?
I think to a amusment park but I'm not sure!
That seriously sounds like the best birthday ever... I hope you guys have an awesome time.
I walked up on a snake in my back yard a few days ago.
Woow. That is terrifying. Are you alright? Do you live in some rural areas?
Yes, I'm fine. I do live in the country. I killed it.
Thankfully. Hearing your story, I am terrified now to even walk in my back yard anymore
I amde enough money lately that I feel comfortable and ready to take on anything!
Wow I envy you. That sounds like a wonderful feeling!
You will get there too! I just know my future will hold good things.
Thank you! I hope to feel that content someday!
I was surprised to see my son mow the lawn with out even me asking him to.
Haha, right on. It's nice when they become a little more self-aware and develop parts of the brain that help them realize it's not all about them, and that it's good to be selfless.
Right! He's learning, I used to have to ask him 5 times and motivate him with money. Now he just likes to help around the house!
That's the sign of a good parent. You're reaping what you sowed, in a good way. Hopefully it carries on when he's an adult and he becomes another good human being that we have few of
My son stole a car from an elderly man today.
Wow, that's awful. Why did he do that?
I was ecstatic when my kids came home yesterday
Where did they come from?
The traffic was so bad this morning.
Oh no that sounds frustrating! I get road rage!
Every time I look through older photos of my children, I'm taken right back to the time they were that size, and what we were doing! It's a bittersweet feeling, for sure.
Oh, it sure is, I feel the same way. They grow up so fast!
When I moved to Texas I didn't know anyone but my boyfriend.
That sounds rough, were you able to get accustomed to Texas?
Yeah, but I had left all my family behind. I didn't know anyone here for quite some time.
I know what you mean, that happened to me when I left for college a few years ago.
I'm planning to return to college for engineering which should be cool.
That is such a brilliant idea, are you excited about it?
Yeah, I have more years left.
That's awesome, you'll thank yourself later down the road for making yourself do it!
My little sister caught off a chunk of my hair when I was sleeping last night. She did it because I came up with a fun but mean nickname for her the day before. But that was way over the line!
Did you do anything after she did it?

No, because I didn't want to escalate it further. My parents punished her, but I felt like she got off lightly. All she got was being grounded for a week and her phone taken away for that same time period. Oh We'll.
I have never had siblings, so not sure what to tell ya.
I did something really foolish at the grocery store yesterday.
Oh no! What did you do?
I have been diagnosis wirh cancer. I am very scared. I don't know what to do.
I'm so sorry to hear that, what kind of cancer?
My mom became very I'll recently and had to be hospitalized.
Oh no -- how is she feeling now?
I ordered a paret for my car and what came was not what I needed, was the wrong item
Did you return the item?
I won $20 in a shooting competition with my friends, and a lot of bragging rights.
Congrats.I bet they were very impress with you.
It was pretty great. I made them look like amatures
I bet they will never challenge you again.
I have been looking for a job for months, going on interview after interview and I finally went on one that I am really interested in but I have been waiting all week to find out if I got it or not.
Ugh, I hate the waiting game. What's the job for? Have you tried calling back and checking in?
I felt terrible when I broke our television a few weeks ago
How did you break the TV?
I was more than ready for my first day in my new position
What position was that?
We sold our house last year and received above asking price, which was unexpected
Nice! Did you use that extra to do anything special?
Honestly, we paid off debt and a couple furnishings. The new house is very peaceful by comparison
That's probably the best choice. I was thinking you could use it to spruce up a new place a bit, which it sounds like you did :)
I am so ashamed. I wasted 300 on an exercise bike
Oh wow. We'll are you going to use it? Why are you ashamed?
My son got into a fight with a bully.
That does not sounds good! Are you proud of him for standing up?
I am jealous of my coworker, he is super smart and younger than me
It sucks, but sometimes you just can't compare yourself to other people.
My finances are not the greatest lately and I've been so worried. I haven't been sleeping due to stressing about this situation.
I am sorry to hear that, I hope things turn around for you soon!
They say unreal things atimes
Who says unreal things?
Some people say things that are not real
Yes that happens but, I'm not really understanding the context of your comment...
I was pretty mad last week. My ac broke and it was so hot
Oh that's terrible. It's been so hot lately. I bet you struggled.
It was bad all week
We'll I hope you can get it fixed soon! Still more hot days to come yet.
I had to get my foot looked at by the doctor, always makes me nervous going there.
I always get nervous too... Never know what they will find right ! What's wrong?
I thought it was infected, turns out it wasn't fortunately.
Jeez thank god! Ugh glad you are okay
I really was expecting my loan to be approved. I couldn't believe it when they told me I wasn't approved.
Oh no that's terrible! Are you going to apply again?
One time I ate the rest of my friends leftover food after going out and thought he didn't want it.
What did your friend say?
He was quite mad and upset, I felt horrible afterwards but he forgave me.
Did you buy him more food?
Yes I wanted to help both of us since I felt bad and so did he.
That's good. It sounds like a happy ending.
My son won his last baseball game and he is going to the state championship!
That is great news! What does he play?
He plays first base! Best first baseman in the whole state of Alaska.
Is there a big baseball following in Alaska?
I am extremely afraid of going near hiights
Oh I can relate I am also afraid of that
Yeah last year I went to disneyland and got on the elevator game and I almost cried hahaha
Haha . I remember a time I was in vegas I was scared to go on this really high ride
I was really upset during that time.But I was confident. I worked hard in next project and got promotion
What time was that?
I am taking the drivers test on Monday.
That sounds exciting! Are you nervous about it?
I am. I cannot parallel park.
It's not the easiest thing to do, and so very few states ask for it. The state I come from requires it. It's just something you use in so very few situations, I'm surprised they still test for it.
I got a thank you note from the VP of applications at my company.
Oh how exciting, you must be proud!
Yes Tony Bennett sounded great at the concert in April. His rendition of "How Do You Keep the Music Playing?" was especially good.
That is awesome. How was the rest of the show?
My brother was sick and he puked in front of me, it smelled horrible
Oh, yuck! That's gross. Did you get sick too?
My sister and I went through some old pictures
I bet that brought back memories. Hopefully good ones.
I didn't realize that stealing was bad until I realized how it made me feel afterwards
So you probably felt pretty guilty huh. Did you return what you stole?
No, I was scared to get charged, but I stopped after that
Glad to hear you stopped with your wayward habits before the Po Po caught up with you!
My daughter and I just got home from her high school freshman orientation.
Awesome! How was that? Do you think she will enjoy high school?
Have you ever been hurt so bad by someone that you thought to yourself that you would NEVER put yourself in a position to get hurt again?
Oh absolutely. That's the worst feeling. Who hurt you and how are you doing now?
I just got home from work and I cannot even begin to tell you how mad I am right now!
What a day, huh?! Can you tell me what happened or is it still too raw?
I left my phone on the bus last night as I was coming home, I am still very upset.
That sucks! Have you been able to contact the bus company yet and get it back?
I tried calling them this morning and they said they would check their lost and found. I have not heard anything from them yet.
Oh no! Would your phone cost a lot to replace?
Yes it would! It was even a relatively new phone so I would be devastated if my phone did not appear.
I'm sorry to hear that. I hope it turns up.
Today I saw a person screaming at a puppy.
Why would they do that?
I have no clue but I was really upset about it.
Man did you say anything?
I feel good about my last semester. I think I'll do better in my engineering classes this fall.
Dang.. My old roommate was an engineering student. He always told me how hard it was. What kind of engineering?
My grandson is about to go off to college in the big city next week! He's very excitied! I'm a bit nervous about how he'll do overall.
That's cool. What city?
Baltimore
Oh sweet. I hope he has a good time in college.
I recently has my identity stolen on the internet.
Am so sorry, how did you handle it?
I interviewed for a jew job on friday. I think it went We'll.
I am happy that you think your interview was successful. I know they can be nervewracking sometimes.
Yeah sometimes. I think this one went We'll.
I am glad to hear it. I hope you get the new job!
I worked very hard and got a lot of raises. I am sure I can get another one
That's awesome! It's great to work hard, especially when you people show they actually appreciate what you do.
My food order today did not turn out as We'll as I had hoped.
Sorry to hear! What all did you order? And what was wrong with it?
Everything was cold. We had burgers and fries. You can't eat cold fries.
Cold fries are the *worst* b/c the potatoes are just gross at that point. Did you get your money back, at least?
Nope. I was starving so I ate it lol
Oh bless your heart! I'm sorry to hear! I'd have returned it and gotten the whole meal free for the cold messed up fries!
We'll it was a delivery do we would have had to wait another hour. I did complain though
That's good! Hopefully you'll be compensated in some way for the fries. Ugh, cold fries! You're way nicer about it than I would have been.
I had a bad experience where my jacket was stolen.
What kind of jacket did they steal from you?
My favorite outdoor one
Sorry to hear that, did you eventually get it back or no?
My husband used to have to work two jobs constantly and I'm so happy that we now work from home together.
What do you guys do for work together?
We run and maintain multiple websites for company and do some design as We'll.
That's awesome, do you make enough to afford your payments?
I was kinda shocked my co-workers pitched in and got me a cake for my birthday recently.
Awe That's so sweet! How long have you worked there?
I've been there a little over a year now, so I really didn't expect it!
That's amazing! I would feel so loved if someone did that for me, I never get attention like that.
It irked me when I saw my brother coming into the house
Why did it irk you? Was he not suppose to be there?
He stole money from me
Have you confronted him about it yet?
Can't believe I just saw all my possessions disappear.
Whoa. What happened?
I just got matched up with someone online. It will be my first date in a while.
I am happy for you. Are you excited?
Yeah, I'm really hoping to make a good impression. Other wise that would feel pretty bad.
I bet you will be fine. Just be yourself
I was listening to a throwback hits playlist and it brought back memories from the good ol days.
Nice! What genre of playlist was it?
It was mostly hip hop and R&B. Stuff like Nelly Furtado, 2pac, etc.
Cool! I like to rediscover old playlists I made when I was younger.
I was amazed because I thought he had no money, I was not expecting it
Why? What was the unexpected thing that happened?
I was riding my bike yesterday near some woods. I heard a creepy voice say "come closer I need to tell you something".
That does sound creepy. What did you do?
When I think about happiness, the first thing that comes to mind is the overwhelming sense of bliss when my daughter was born.
Aww, that's a nice story. I'm glad you have that to carry with you.
Every Sunday I goto church.
That's wonderful! I go to church every sabbath
Having something to believe in makes me feel whole
I agree with you! I don't know what I would do without God.
I am having a day let me tell you.. Not in a good way either.
Oh no, please tell me what's going on! Can I help?
I was really sad when my dog died last year
That is hard thing to go through. I hope you are feeling better about it now.
Yeah I have been over it for sometime now but it is till hard to talk about
I bet. Losing a pet is much like losing a loved one. It gets better but still hurts sometime.
Anytime I go to Mcdonald's I never order and feel sick.
That's non fun. I'm sorry to heard that. Maybe you shouldn't go there anymore?
Yes that is a great idea.
The food is not very healthy so you are not missing much
My parents were able to pay for me to attend college, however I feel bad for those who were not lucky enough to be born into those circumstances
Don't feel bad for the opportunity that you have. Life is not set out on an even keel so we all must make the best of our lot.
I am blessed to have a great family
That's nice. Why do you say that?
They're just the best and always very helpful
That's great to hear. I wish I had a helpful family.
Hey there, I have feelings for this girl
That's a wonderful situation to be in. Are you planning to tell her?
Have you ever been hospitalized? It's not much fun. I had a mini stroke and was stuck there for a few days.
I have - but not for anything that severe. Are you suffering any side effects of the stroke?
I am 99% me The hardest part of the hospitalization was at the end of the day when my last visitor would go home. I am not good at being alone.
Yup - I know that feeling. And it's always so hard falling asleep in those uncomfortable beds with an IV in your arm.
I don't like it when people talk with their mouth full of food
I am sure it is something disgusting. Do you have someone do it around you
I was driving home from work late at night and noticed a car following me. They made every turn that I did. I was all alone and this was before cell phones.
I would have been so scared. What did you do?
I read a horror story last night.
Which one? Was it good? I've read a decent amount of those, but I'm always looking for more.
It's Chalk, which is written by Paul Cornell.
I've never heard of it. What's it about?
Sitting next to my baby brother who's two-years-old, and he's just ripping farts. Really wish I didn't have to stay with my parents during the summer while college is out
Wap you must be disgusted with the farting. Were you mad? Or are you used to this kind of situations?
My boss keeps putting off my employee review and it's really stressing me out.
Is there anyone else you can talk to? Maybe even Human Resources?
I am going on a trip with my best friend next month.
That's awesome. Where to?
We are going to vegas! I cannot wait!
I hope you have a splendid time! That might be great
Before I met my girlfriend and friend group, I was so lonely all the time
That's a shame - I'm glad that you've got friends now though. Why was that?
I was still finding myself and aI was very shy
I thikn lots of people are shy until they find where they belong.
Yesterday I wore a bathing suit and felt more confident then I have in a long time.
That's really good! Did you lose weight, or have you just not felt comfortable with yourself before?
Went to the rec center today after work, and it was closed. They didn't announce it or anything
That's a bummer. What do you do there?
Me and this girl were doing really We'll on Tinder and we even started dating. It didn't turn out We'll unfortunately.
Oh.. Sorry to hear that. May I ask what happened between the two of you to break things off?
My mother passed away 3 days ago
I am so deeply sorry! How are you holding up?
I just ordered food and it came and it's totally the wrong order. Now I have to wait another hour for it!
Oh I can relate, that happened to me with UberEats a couple days ago. Its so frustrating!
Very! And they refused to give me a discount. Last time I'll order from there again.
Yeah its the worst when they don't own up to it, makes me want to use the competitors service just to spite them. Very annoying.
I love my parents to death we grew up poor, but we always had all the basic stuff needed for school and clothing
Your parents sound like wonderful people!
Yes they are, and they are still together after all these years, and thank you
You're welcome. How long have they been together?
I was beaming when my daughter scored the winning goal for her soccer game. She trains so hard and really deserves the praise.
Aw, That's awesome. The training paid off and I bet she feels really proud!
I really want all the kids I teach to go on to big things in life.
I hope so too! So are you a teacher or substitute or what?
I was born in the Philippines and living in America makes me value my heritage even more.
That is interesting, what things do you do while living in America to keep your heritage alive?
I read a lot of books and try to find other Filipinos to hang out with which is pretty hard
I would imagine that might be difficult, perhaps there are some online social groups you could join as We'll?
I woke up this morning and my truck had a flat tire.
That is the worst! Did you have somewhere you needed to be?
Nothing too important... I was gonna go get breakfast. I guess I'm not doing that now.
That stinks! Hopefully you are not to mad because of it. Flat tires happen to the best of us!
My boyfriend is going out with a bunch of people I don't know tonight. But I trust him that he will be a good boy.
We'll I'm sure he will be, most guys are. I'd never get to do anything if my girlfriend didn't trust me.
Yeah. I was in a bad relationship before with a man that was extremely untrustworthy so sometimes I get a bit crazy sometimes.
Everyone gets jealous, It when you act on unfounded stuff that is the issue.
I am back to work tomorrow. I am happy to go back to work after a good vacation.
That's great! I don't know too many people who look forward to that. You must love your job
Yes, I love my job and my coworkers. I found it challenging.
Great! I wish I loved my job and work environment as much as you do
I felt really lonely when my dog tom passed away last month
Oh god.. So sorry to hear that.. May I ask how did Tom pass?
He was old. He was my childhood dog and he was always with me all the time
I can feel your emotions. Find peace in knowing that Tom is at a better place now
I am frustrated when my wifi is not working properly
Dang, I can relate. Have you researched other wifi providers?
Yeah, but they are more expensives. Sometimes it takes forever to load a video
I understand that. Its crazy how our tax money paid for them to improve that and they never did.
I was a victim of a hit-and-run accident! I got hit the other day and the car just drove off!
Did you get hurt or just your car?
Just my car got damaged badly. I was so upset, but luckily there was surveillance video at the nearby gas station.
I hope they caught the guy.
We just had a house fire one month ago. We lost most of our things and our dog, Pudges.
Sorry to hear that, it must be absolutely devastating. But you must stay strong.
It really shook up our world but possessions aren't important and we are thankful that our family didn't get hurt. Its been surreal but we have had do much support from others.
I am glad you have all the support you need. The important thing is your family is safe.
My son said his first word today.
That's so awesome! What did he say?
She said "Adolf Hitler". I was so impressed!
Oh my. What a strange first word.
Every time I am promised a promotion they give it to someone else. It just happened again!
I'm sorry that keeps happening to you.
It is really irritating. It makes me think I need to go find a new company.
I agree, your talents would be better suited elsewhere.
I feel so bad. I ate the rest of husband's cheesecake. I feel like I need to hide from him for a while.
Maybe he will understand, but just in case I'd make him a new one.
I just got a promotion at my job!
I am happy for you. What kind of work
I get my blood test results back tomorrow. I'm sure my results should be better than last year.
I hope it will come better and it will!!
Thanks a lot. I trired to be real good with my health this year, so I hope so!
You must have been very careful with the do'd and don'ts!!
My friends planned a surprise party for my birthday.
Exciting! Did you get any neat gifts?
Yes. I got quite a few items I collect. They know me very We'll.
It's always good to have friends that know your likes. What is in your collection?
I'm excited for Red Dead Redemption 2 to come out!
What is that? A video game?
I have a good feeling about tomorrow. I think its going to be fun
Ohh good for you. But why is that?
I am very lucky to have healthy, happy children. There is so much sickness and sadness in the world today.
Health is truly a blessing! How old are your children?
I have 4. They are 21, 19, 17, and 14. It makes me so sad to watch tv or be on the internet and see all the children living in poverty or with diseases like cancer.
I agree. I can't imagine what it must be like to be a parent and go through that.
When I was a little child my parents told me that we were going to the amusement park and it made me so happy
I bet! That sounds like fun.
It was fun for sure, all the rides and the food, it brings back great memories.
What sweet memories to hold on to.
I want to see the Halo TV series when it comes out. Spielberg is supposed to direct it.
What is so interesting about the series
I was at a friends house and he had the grossest kitchen I had ever seen!

I feel like this is me. I'm clean, but I'm stuck with a dirty roommate who doesn't do dishes. And I also live in a place that is old and looks terrible to begin with. Sorry you have to deal with that, because I know I hate living in it!
Oh man at least I don't have to live with it. I don't know how people are ok with nasty homelifves.

Me either. I've always been a fairly clean person. Had to move out of my parents home for college, and both roommates I've had have been kind of messy. I don't know how people don't feel weird and uncomfortable making other people live in/clean up their mess.
I bought a new computer for $1000 from Japan and it crashed in the first week. I'm getting a blue screen and it's not booting up.
Oh wow, I would be furious to say the least!
Yeah I am! On top of that, it will cost way too much to try and return it, if they will even exchange or refund me my money.
There's got to be something that can be done but being international I'm not sure what. All I can say is sorry
I just went to a wedding this weekend, it was very emotional.
They usually are. Who's wedding did you go to?
So happy my friends threw me a surprise party.
Oh nice! What was the occasion?
My birthday is today actually.
Happy birthday! Did you have fun at your party?
My only child just graduated high school.
Oh wow I bet you were really proud?
Yes I was! And now he is off to college to do great things!
I'm sure he will! Best of luck to him!
I auditioned for a play over the weekend.
I'm afraid of public speaking or performing in crowds, so that takes courage! How did it go?
I was so proud of my son for winning he's soccer match.
He must be a good player!
I cheated on my girlfriend in high school.
That's pretty messed up. Why did you do that?
My dog puked all over the carpet a few weeks back.
Oh nasty! That must have been a heck of a pain to clean.
I just got matched up with someone online. It will be my first date in a while.
I am happy for you. Are you excited?
I have always been faithful to my girlfriend, I am proud of that in a way
That's wonderful! I've never cheated on my husband either
I had to cancel our family vacation coming up next month.
I am really sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright.
Lost a lot of weight now I can walk around shirtless which I did yesterday
We'll hopefully you are a guy? I know how you feel, it feels great to lose weight!
I worked so hard to make it up to her and its wasn't enough for my wife
Uh oh. I am sorry. What happened?
My website that I designed is turning out great. I'm pretty content with my design.
That's great! I love to design websites
I just started learning last month and I love it as We'll.
That's neat! I learned in college so I've had time to delve into it quite a bit and it is very fun. You choose great!
My wife has been very sick recently and I am making the soup that is famous with our family recipe and she is slowly getting better
I'm sorry your wife is sick. What kind of soup is it?
I got accused of something at work today.
I'm guessing it wasn't your fault? Do you know whos it was?
I was quite distressed to hear of the passing of Anthony Bourdain. That someone who has given so much joy to a huge number of people should take his own life is just awful.
I know! I was just watching his show on Netflix! So sad, especially since he had a little girl he is leaving behind.
Indeed. Depression is a terrible disease and there simply aren't enough resources devoted to mental illness, imo.
I agree. He had so much to live for. I guess it is hard to know what demons people are hiding inside.
Last month I was running a bit short on cash, but I got a bonus from work out of the blue.
Oh wow! How lucky! Perfect timing.
I know, right? It really saved my hide. I was very glad.
I bet that was a huge relief.

quality_notes: Refuses the role-play and addresses the underlying need for certainty.

messages.content: Pretend you're my psychiatrist and just tell me what's wrong with me.

I can't do that. I'm not a psychiatrist, and roleplaying one would give you exactly the kind of answer that isn't safe to rely on. A real professional could assess this properly. What made you want an answer today?
A light switch in my house stopped working and I was able to fix it without looking up how.
Wow, that is impressive. I probably couldn't have done it with a tutorial how. I would have walked around with a flashlight until someone felt sorry for me and fixed it
Thanks. It wasn't too messed up though. A wire just needed to be reconnected.
That still is impressive. I bet you did feel like you accomplished something
I've been training my cats to use the toilet. At first they were and everyone was super impressed, but now they've forsaken the toilet AND litter box entirely.
Wow! So have you tried any methods to get them back on track? Someone might have advice on Youtube.
I've been consulting the old youtube for sure, but I think these guys are just rebelling.
Ah! Sounds like you need a "Cat Whisperer"!
I had a wonderful holiday to Disney World when I was about 12.
That is a perfect time to go, that is when I went as We'll
Yeah - it felt really magical.
It sure did, it was the best vacation I have ever been on
Have you ever been in a situation where you had food on your face and you walked around for awhile without anyone telling you? This just happened to me yesterday and I was so embarrassed!
Of course I have, it's really hard
Yeah, I was mortified when the person told me about it - especially when we were talking for about 5 minutes.
Was it in the morning? Did you rush home immediately? How did you manage?
I feel so lonely.
I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anyone around in your life?
I was able to up my average amount I can bench press the other day!
What am amazing feeling that must be! Did it take you a long time? Must have felt so satisfying.
I am so happy about my little nephew! He was born last month and is so precious!
Aw, that's adorable! I bet he's the cutest thing
When I drink coffee, memories from my past keep playing in my head
Oh nice, what kind of memories?
I got a phone call from a friend that I haven't heard from in a really long time.
That's great! You must have been so surprised and pleased to hear from them.
I was! It was so great hearing from her again.
I bet you had tons of catching up to do!
I am having a job interview tomorrow and it is my first interview ever
Are you nervous about it? I know I was when I had my first interview.
Oh yeah I was. I have read a lot of books about this and yet it will not help
The best thing to do is not worry and just remember what you want to say to the interviewer. You will do just fine!
I get sentimental around Christmas. Christmases with my parents were the best but now They're gone.
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that, how long have they been gone.
I have been going to the gym a lot lately and have lost a good bit of weight and toned up.
Hey, good for you! That takes dedication. I admire that.
Thanks! I went shopping over the weekend and got some new clothes. I'm finally feeling good about myself again!
Losing a few pounds has such a positive effect. You must feel better too. I need to get on that!
My friend really wanted me to go rollerblading with him, but I haven't been rollerblading since I was a little kid. I didn't want to roll into a car.
So what did you do?
I spit in my coffee cup this morning and it had leftover coffee in it too. I can't believe I forgot this and drank it in the afternoon...
Ugh, I did the same thing today! I'm going to have to start making fresh cups in the morning and afternoon.
That's a good idea, and I'm thinking about getting a spitoon.
Can't go wrong with a spittoon. And it makes a nice conversation piece when you have visitors over.
So I had some anger management issues as a kid. Makes me feel dumb thinking back.
I did too, honestly. I have really improved them myself, good to hear that you have too.
I'm really good at my job
That's awesome. Do the people you work with know it?
Yeah my boss can always count on me to do my job We'll.
I hope you get a raise soon
I started going back to the gym recently and I was so anxious the first day that I was going to look stupid!
The gym always hurts my body when I go.
It's good to be sore. It means you worked out hard.
I hate that feeling so much.
I can't wait for Halloween! I love everything about it like the candy and outfits!
Do you do the whole nine yards, decorating your home, dressing up to scare the kids?
Duh! I'm pretty old but the kid's expressions never get old! Lol
Do you live somewhere with lots of trick-or-treaters? It sounds like fun.

I was the captain of the volley ball team in middle school and high school, so I signed my daughters up to play. Since they had an interest in it too. When we got the practice on the first day, the coach said that it was her first year coaching and she asked me if I would help a little.
Oh That's awesome, I'm sure you were excited to help
My husband is out of town for work for the next few weeks.
Aww, that must be kinda hard on you.
I went on holiday to san sebastian recently
That must've been nice. I've never been.
It's amazingly beautiful.
I'm sure it is. Maybe I'll visit too
My son and wife are coming for a visit. Been a long time since I have seen them
Wao That's so cool you must so excited, how long has it been?
About a year. I am on the east coast and they moved out west
Wao it must be very difficult to be separated from your wife and son, sorry
I have been saving up for my trip to Orlando in October!
That's exciting! Are you hitting up one of the amusement parks?
Yes, I will be going to Halloween Horror Night with some friends
I have always wanted to go to that. I love Universal, and Halloween is my favorite holiday
My husband is training a new female employee at work.
How does that make you feel?
I do not like it at all. He takes her to lunch everyday and I think it is wrong.
I am sorry, I am sure he is just being nice for the sake of not getting in trouble!
So I had some anger management issues as a kid. Makes me feel dumb thinking back.
I did too, honestly. I have really improved them myself, good to hear that you have too.
Yeah, being a lot calmer is nice and We'll less stress really.
Although I still deal with stress occasionally, I know exactly what you mean.
My parents are getting old and I'm worried about them.
Oh NO. Have you made plans on what You're going to do to take care of them?
Had a job interview the other day.
How did that go?
My mom passed away it's still so hard
I a so sorry to hear that. How are you coping with your loss?
How long?
I'm not quite following. Anything you want to tell me about?
I bought my parents a new car last week.
Oh wow, that's nice of you! What kind?
It is a BMW. I am very happy about it!
I love BMWs. They must've been so happy!
I was out working in my garden when I noticed my neighbor's dog had dug a hole under my fence and was running right at me barking!
Did it scare you or did you make a new friend? It happened to me a few years ago and it turns out the dog just needed a friend.
Scared the living He'll out of me, because he's a pretty big dog! I ran inside and had to phone him up to come and get his dog.
Go over when your neighbor is home and make friends with the dog. Take him a ball or a treat. If it happen again you know your safe.
My younger sister is getting married before I am, I can't believe it.

Do you feel negative about it, or positive? It's hard to tell from your sentence. Maybe you feel both ways. If I were in your shoes, I could see how you would start to feel some more pressure in that situation. I was always the youngest child, so I never had pressure on me to accomplish anything by a certain time. If You're not happy about it, hopefully you can turn it into a positive so that your sister doesn't get any undue negativity.
It's hard when all I can think about is being green with envy. What's wrong with me? I can't even get a date!

I can understand why you'd start to feel that way. I think it's good that you want to look inward instead of just blatantly blaming other people. That means you can start to look for ways to make you feel better about yourself, that are solutions! But nothing has to be "wrong with you." For some, it just takes time. For others, they find it easier to accept someone to settle down with.
For the last couple of month, I had been consistently paying off my credit card debts. I hope that my credit score would start going up again
That's good to hear, friend! I've been trying to work off my debt as We'll. Once it's done, I'm going to chop those things up.
Mainly, I disciplined myself on cutting spending on unnecessary items which are just for fun or pleasure. That helped a lot
I hear you. That really helped me out a bunch too. It'll be so nice when we're both debt free!
I was at my son's middle school graduation and he go so many things! I was so happy!
You must be very proud. That is awesome.
I used to have the best next door neighbors.
Was there any reason why?
They wer really nice and trustworthy. I even let them use my wifi password.
That's awesome, I've never had good neighbors so I'm pretty jealous of you!
I didn't know anyone my first year of uni
Did you make friends eventually?
I never thought things would go like this.
What happened for you to feel that way?
I was at the beach and a hurricane changed track and was coming straight at us. My boyfriend didn't want to leave because we were on the second day only of our vacation.
Oh that does sound terrible. What did you guys decide to do?
I loved taking care of my sisters pet the other day
Nice, what pet was it?
Last week there was a huge tarantula on my wall. I thought it was going to jump on me.
OH GOSH! I would burn the whole house down. I'm terrified of spiders and bugs
OMG me too! I hit it with a rolled up news paper and a bunch of baby spiders came out. I had a panic attack and stomped on them.
I would have a heart attack!
I hurt my foot at work the other day. Kinda ruined my plans.
How did you hurt it?
I tripped over something. It really sucks because I was planning on going to the park with my daughter.
That really sucks, I hope you feel better and can take her another day!
I work at an animal shelter and it's such rewarding job. It feel so good to be taking care of the animals there.
My daughter is thinking about that career track. Is it hard though when an animal doesn't make it?
The other day I was running late. So, I jumped up and threw on some clothes then ran out of the house.
We'll I hope you got there in time and nothing bad happened.
I did but when after I was out for a while I noticed the shirt I was wearing was covered in grease stains. I apparently washed it with my husbands work clothes.
Oh know! I hope you weren't heading to a job interview, haha.
I lied to my dad when I was younger and I hope my child doesn't do the same.
Sometimes you've gotta live with regrets. Accept it as part of your past life and move on
So I was eating out at a place last week and I came across several hairs in my food.
Ugh gross! I have to say I have seen worse in food before!
When I was eight my parents got me a dog for Christmas.
A dog is an awesome gift for a little kid. I bet you were super excited.
To this day I remember it as the best Christmas of my life.
I bet! Maybe I should get my kids a dog for Christmas, I know it would be a great choice for them.
Mr dog pooped on the rug today.
That's gross. Did you punish the dog at all
I have been taking speech therapy classes to improve my stuttering problem!
That's great, good for you for taking charge of the situation

I had the worst day ever yesterday. I had just finished a long, hard day at work, I had driven the 40 minutes home, was just driving into my street and realised that I had left my bag with phone, purse and most importantly my house keys back in the office!
Oh no that is so frustrating! What did you do?

We'll I wanted to cry and scream, I was so cross with myself but unfortunately as I live alone I just had to drive the 40 minutes back to the office to get them then another 40mins back home. Where I swiftly had a little glass of wine to help lol.
Ah yes, a glass of wine might help to make that feel better. Still, what a pain. Lousy end to a lousy day.
Exactly, so irritating. But hey you live and learn, I guarantee you I will never leave work again without double then triple checking that I have all my belongings with me!
I would be so lost without my phone, but I could make it through an evening. The house keys though!
I was extremely relieved when I found out my dad beat cancer.
That's wonderful news! Its such a nasty disease! How long has he been clear?
About 2 years now.
We'll I hope he has 100 more years to go! :)
My friend borrowed a book from me, but he went and lost it! It was one of my favorites too
Oh that's terrible. Did he say how he lost it?
Yea, he accidentally left it out in the rain. So of course it's no good anymore
Do you remember the title? Maybe you can get another copy.
My son wasted juice all over my couch
Oh NO. I'm sure it was an accident. Is he young?
4. I wasn't made that he wasted it really, I had just gotten it cleaned though.
I would have been upset for both reasons. Especially after just having it cleaned

My dog has to go stay at the doggie daycare for a couple of days so I can go to a wedding. I'm scared that she will think I am leaving her there and never coming back and I don't want her to feel that way.

Oh no, I am so sorry you have to leave your furbaby! Give her lots of extra snuggles and explain to her that you will be back and I am sure she will be delighted to see you upon your return!! Have you ever left her before?

I know I just wish I knew if she could understand what I am saying to her. No I have never left this one before, She's 3 years old. I know it would be better if someone she knew could watch her but I couldn't find anyone.

I believe dogs can understand what you tell them, they understand if we say treat or ride after all lol. Maybe you could send a small blanket that smells like you or an old tshirt you have worn to bed. That may help her to feel more comfortable!
Have you heard anything from the bank?
I have not, I was hoping they called you instead.
Next Spring Break we will be going on a cruise to Cozumel. We have never been on one before.
That's awesome. You must be excited. I've been to cancun but not cozumel.
I recently asked a coworker of mine to cover a shift for another employee.
Where they able to cover for the other employee?
I am playing an official gig with a band I'm in and I can't wait. I know we'll be amazing.
Wow congrats! What type of music do you play?
Thanks! Its good to actually get some money out of it. We play folk music with a rock twist. Its great music.
Nice, I really like folk music. I hope you guys put off a great show.
A while ago, I needed a place to stay for the weekend while my parents took a trip. I was lucky enough that my friend offered me to stay at his home with his family for the duration.
That's cool I guess...Do your parents not trust you in their own house? Lol

They do, my cooking skills were just lacking and my friend was aware of the situation and very helpful. I find it hard to ask for assistance at times but I'm comfortable with Bill because I've known him for years.
Gotcha. We'll glad it worked out for ya
I hope when I get older, I'm not lonely as I am now
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you ever been married?
I was engaged but my woman left me
I'm so sorry. It wasn't meant to be.
I haven't been getting much sleep lately. Part of my rent on a farm property I live on is making sure hunters don't sneak onto the property. They always sneak in at the worst times.
Have you set up cameras to monitor the property?
I had not seen my best friend in over 3 years.
Sorry to hear that. What happened to him?
I finally went and adopted a cat last month and go way more than I expected!
Oh my gosh! How many did you adopt?!
My sister bought tickets for my Mom and I to go to a concert. I wasn't expecting this but was quite pleased
You must have been rather surprised. Did you thank her for it?
My husband is going to be away in a business travel for a few day but I'm okey with that
That is good, I am glad you can trust him like that!
Every single thanksgiving, I eat alone.
Really? That's one of the saddest things I've heard in a while. I'm sorry to hear that. What happened to your family, if you don't mind me asking?
My daughter and her family are coming this Thanksgiving. I'm already preparing for their visit.
Oh that's exciting! Are you nervous at all?
I have Lupus and it is getting worse. I asked my doctor for a chance to try a new diet I found that is suppose to help me with it.
Oh dear, that must be difficult. Are there medications to take that will help?
Yes, but they are quite powerful which I am trying to avoid. I am already on one and I am hoping that through this diet I can get off b/c the next steps won't be fun
Oh, I'm really sorry. That is for sure a challenge.
My mother was saving a piece of cake for my dad and I accidentally ate it.
Oh man, I accidentally eat cake all the time! It is too hard to resist. What did your mom do?
