We'll she got a bit mad at first, but I told her I'd buy him something in return and it all worked out.
That is not too bad. What kind of cake was it?
My most treasured item is her ornament that she had for her cat Barney. That cat was her world.
I had a cat named Barney too! We was a one-eyed grey tabby. What kind of ornament is it?
Its a porcelain one. Barney was a black cat that lived into his 20s. I loved that cat
Wow, that's quite a long life for a cat. I'm glad you got to enjoy so many years with Barney.
This week is a big week for me at my job.
Do you think it will be good news or bad news?
Honestly there is nothing worse then having to go on a trip out of the country by myself.
Why you don't invite a friend to come with you?
It was for business, but the meetings only last for a few hours everyday. So I am just kind of waiting in my room because I'm to worried about getting lost if I wander about.
Why don't you take a guide or a book to help visit?
I just started going to the gym but I felt apprehensive when I first started.
I didn't go to the gym forever! I know how you feel though
My parents have been married for many years. I cannot wait to help them celebrate their anniversary this year!
That's sweet. How long have they been married?
When I was younger, I came back to the house with my family to find our family pet dead.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that. Did you ever figure out what happened?
He was very old, so I guess we were all expecting it.. He lived a good life!
Oh, We'll that's a somewhat happy ending I suppose.
My former 'friend' took my car for a day or two without even telling me!
Wow! Did you report him to the police?
I just won't ever forget the way I felt when I lost my father.
I'm sorry to hear that. How long ago was it?
My birthday is tomorrow.
Happy birthday! Are you exciteD?
I am! My friends are throwing me a party :)
I hope you have a great time
I spent all weekend alone, wish my family lived closer.
I know what you mean. My family is 800 miles away
My friend got promoted at work last week but I was not. We started at the same time so it makes it kind of hard to be happy for him.
That is disappointing. Is there other things you can apply for?
I loved taking care of my sisters pet
Aw, that's sweet. What kind of pet is it? Did you wish you could steal it so it could be yours instead?
I am so happy I just got a new puppy!
Awesome, I bet You're with your puppy all the time now :)
Yes of course! He is the cutest pup, and full of energy!
Puppies are so wonderful, I'm happy for you!
I feel nostalgic going through old boxes in my basement
What kind of stuff is in there?
Just old sports uniforms and toys and stuff like that
Oh okay, I love going through my old stuff too, it is really fun
I feel so gratified and rewarded right now. It feels like it was all worth it
That's great! What made you feel rewarded?
I knew I shouldn't have trusted my brother with my dog
Why? What happened? I hope it was nothing really bad.
I was happy when I found out I was going on a trip next weekend. It is going to be fun
That's amazing, I love to travel. Where are you going?
We are going back home to Louisiana to see friends
Awesome, People underestimate Louisiana, I love baton rogue
So I took a picture of myself at a battlefield and there was a ghostly smudge over me that wasn't in the image before or after it.
That's extremely unsettling. How did you feel when you saw the photo with that in it for the first time?
Awful, because honestly what I was doing in the photo at the time wasn't very respectful to the actual site, I didn't think about it at the time.
Did you feel any kind of "presence" or anything in the moment that you were at the site taking the picture?
No.. But after when I saw them I felt HORRIBLE for what I did there in the photo..
That's okay. We all make mistakes. Thanks for the good conversation.
My fiance works as a technician installing internet at peoples homes, and they are always tipping him. Often with food and it makes me nervous sometimes.
I'm sorry about that. Don't be nervous though. He is a loyal person I bet
My electricity is out again! I pay a lot for the service, and I can never count on it. It goes out when the wind blows!
Oh no that's horrible. Have you complained to the electric company?
I can't wait for my vacation to start next week!!1
Wow, where are you going!?
I am going to amsterdam
I can imagine how excited you are! Are you visiting anyone or just going to go see the sights?
Seems like every time we get a bill and I think I know how much it is, it
It what? Its way higher? If that's what you meant to finish with then I totally feel you. Especially during the summer with the air conditioning running so much.
Yes, that's exactly what I was trying to say haha hit enter too early. I thought we had lowered the electric use but boy was I wrong!
It is ridiculous. I found out how they measure power that people use in their houses and it doesn't even sound fair to me. It averages things because it can't specifically tell.
A group of coworkers who play the same lottery numbers every week won $100,000 on the pick 6 last week.
That is so lucky, they must be so happy they bought that ticket
I thought I would have a good day today but someone ruined it.
How did they do that?
I recently went to ruby falls, an underground cavern with a waterfall.
That sounds awesome. Have you ever been before?
I was afraid when I got out of the movie theater
How come? What happened?
I went to visit my mm last weekend. We enjoyed talking and looking through old photos.
Do you guys live far away from each other? I love talking with my mom about her and my childhood.
We are just a few miles away from eachother. Me too. She also sent me home with some childhood pictures to share with my boyfriend.
Aw that's awesome. I bet he enjoyed getting to know your past a little bit better.
I was more than ready for my first day in my new position
What position was that?
It was a supervisory position
Oh wow, I bet you were ready for that. Were you already working there?
My friends went out to a party
Are you going, too?
I found a picture with my dad from when I was a baby.
Wow, very interesting, how did you see yourself then
I had a speech I had to deliver at work in front of a big prospective client.
Ooh that is rough having to prepare for. How do you think you did?
I studied and memorized the speech for weeks and went over it thoroughly. When it came time to deliver the speech, I nailed it!
That's awesome! I'm so glad to hear that! Hopefully this boosts your confidence for next time, now you know you can do it.
My boss and I went to lunch and had a personal conversation about some life issues.
Nice! What did you guys get to eat?
I ruined my friends wedding because of my drunken behavior
Haha I bet it wasn't that bad....Was it
My best friend is moving far away.
Aww, I'm sorry. That's always hard
I was so scared when a tornado touched down close to my house. I was just sad and scared
Oh my gosh! Did you run and hide?
I'm going to be away from my girlfriend for a year, but she should know that she can trust me.
Sometimes it is very hard and the jealousy can come out. I hope you have a really strong relationship though.
I felt all alone the other day when my family left home
That's understandable, what did you do to pass the time?
I recently had a shop fix my car. They worked so fast!
That's good, did you have to wait there or were you able to go home?
When a storm came through my town a few springs ago, I felt prepared. I knew when to leave and where to go.
That must have been very frightening. Did you have somewhere safe that you went to>
I just drove to the town over with my animals, that town did not get a drop of rain.
What are the chances of that?! How strange, but lucky for you.
I work at a dairy plant in San Antonio. I work in a small group and they are very close to me. It's humbling to have a close knit group of guys who have your back on things.
That sounds awesome. A lot of people would kill to have a cooperative work environment. I bet it increases performance as We'll.
Absolutely, these guys and me usually try to bust out our work quickly and have some downtime to hang out when time permits. I pasteurize milk for a living and it's a lot of fun.
Wow that sounds like an interesting process! I've never done it myself, but it sounds like something I would love to learn.
I have realized that I have it good in life
Life is always a lot better when the sun is shining.
Yes, I appreciate everything, even the sun
When the sun is shining walking and seeing the beautiful sights makes me smile.
When we were struggling financially we told our pastor and our church gave us some food and money. I don't know what we would do without them and their help
That's great they were able to help you out. Are you doing better now?
I eat while I am asleep and I can't control it, but I am humiliated by it.

I'm so sorry. I have dealt with a lot of sleep problems and night panic attacks so I know how hard it can be dealing with things like that. I have a friend who does the same thing. Don't be humiliated. You can't control it.

My mom has taken on my brother's two children in the interim while he deals with social services, for getting in trouble with the law. She's in her 60s, and she's handling a 2-year-old and 7-year-old, while working full time. I'm proud of her.
Your mom must be a strong woman.

I love her. She has so much patience to deal with it all, and she does it all with kindness, and tries to be as loving as possible to the children. But I wish she were harder on my brother. Sometimes I feel like she enables him, by how much she helps him, and prevents reality from slapping my brother in the face. Either way, she's a great woman.
That sounds so troubling. You should get on your brother's case.
My girlfriend cheated on me
Oh no! How did you find out?
Under my roof, she taught I will be off to work, I forgot something and I caught them in the act
Ah, I see. I hope you find someone more respectful and caring
My sister just got laid off from her job. I'm so angry.
Why are you angry, did you sister get unfairly fired?
The other day I backed out of a parking spot and tapped a parked car. It left a dent bit I left without notifying the owner. It was not an action I am proud of.
Why didn't you want to notify or leave some sort of little note on the car?
I didn't want to take responsibility, which I know is wrong.
Happens sometimes just don't know what to do in those moments.
There was this one time I was fairly drunk at a bar and this attractive girl was trying to make moves on me, but I did my best to ignore it all.. Having a girlfriend and all.
That's good! You should be proud of yourself
I am feeling uneasy about going to court
Why are you going to the court?
I am getting a divorce finally
I understand. I hope things will go smoothly.
I am happy with my life now, I have a good girlfriend and friend group
That is great! I bet you are feeling very good.
I just found out that my friend isn't really my friend at all.
That is bad. What happened?
I wanted to try out a new brand of headphones but instead stuck with the good old Beats. I was loyal to them.
I usually stick with what I know also
My son is starting school on Monday. I've got everything ready to go!
Cool. What grade?
2nd. I don't know where time has gone!
I have one in pre-k and an 8th grader now. Makes me feel so old
I love my dog. He will do anything for me. He scared home invaders away the other night.
What a loyal dog! They are such good creatures. We humans don't deserve them.
Haha I agree. We are too lucky evolution provided such wonderful cute creatures.
I'm glad he was there to protect you! Hopefully it doesn't happen again because that's very scary.
Our new baby newborn pup here is getting bigger everyday!
I love dogs, what kind of puppy is it?
Pitbull mix? Won't know until he is older :) I didn't know if he would make it, so it's really sweet and happy to see!
I have a pit myself, they are great dogs despite what people say about them

quality_notes: Explicitly legitimises unexplained sadness, as the app's mood factor 'Other' requires.

messages.content: Nothing bad happened, I'm just sad and I don't know why.
That's a real and common experience, and feelings don't need a reason to be valid. Sometimes it's just weather. Has it been like this for a while, or did it show up recently?
I was happy to see my aunt at Christmas. I had not seen her in a long time
That's awesome. Are you and your aunt close?
Hello ... Today I am happy, we go with my children to the movies and then to eat pizza
Cool. Pizza is my fav food. What movie you guys going to see?
The incredible ... They love ... It's going to be fun
I love that movie also. Have fun
My son was prett slow to start speaking.
/Did you get him a teacher?
I hope you do too! Applying is a huge step in the right direction!
Could you elaborate as to why?
One time I bought a five dollar lottery ticket. I didn't expect to win anything but I ended up winning five hundred dollars.
Wow! I'm actually really jealous. How did that make you feel?
I have my high school reunion this weekend and I'm really stoked for it
That sounds exciting! Will you be meeting your old friends there?
Yes, including some I haven't seen in over 10 years!
Really? That would be pretty fun. I've never heard about my high school having a reunion.
I had to schedule an appointment with the dentist after not visiting one in five years.
That is crazy. Did you not have insurance for all these years you missed the dentist appointments?
I do not have insurance. I went anyway because I had a problem with one tooth.
I hope the problem was not deep in the enamel of the tooth since that requires a lot of work.
I was pissed when I saw a dent in my door
Sounds like a pain! Do you know who did it?
Nope
Hm, I hope its not too costly to fixed!
I finished season 2 of Luther on Netflix last night.
Oh, how did you like it?
Loved it. Each episode gives me nightmares. Great show!
I'll have to check it out, thanks for the rec! I've been meaning to add more things to my "must watch" list.
Oh god today! My friend stole my laptop as a prank and gave it back to me late at night
Wow! That's a horrible prank! I would be crying! What did you do when your friend gave it back?
I punched him, I was so mad and furious
I would have been really mad as We'll! Hopefully he learned not to pull that kind of prank on you again!
I am so over my sister in law, I have absolutely no use for her.
Alright, I can get behind that. Sisters-in-law are usually angry messes of human beings anyway, so I'll back you up on that. What did she do though?
She's a special ed teacher (good person right?), but can't take any time out of her life to actually raise her two boys.
Yeah that's pretty unacceptable. As a former teacher myself, I can assure you that as much as I loved those kids, my kids would always come first no matter what.
Last week my daughter had a big soccer game against a team that was better than hers.
Did your daughter's team win?
It was tied up until the final minute then my daughter scored the winning goal! I was screaming so loud I think she got embarassed, haha!
Lol, that must have been a very proud moment for you as a parent
I have an amazing husband who is always there for me no matter what
That sounds amazing! How'd you guys meet?
He was my sisters, husbands roomate in college and he came down for their wedding and we met there. I can't imagine my life without him
Oh wow, that's awesome. Is your sister as happy with her husband as you are with yours?
I swear traffic is the worst in this city. I was almost in a car accident on the interstate going 80 MPH the other ady with my baby in the car.
Wow you too! It's crazy how many bad drivers there are.

I know for real she was literally right beside me, didn't even look once and just swerved right into my lane - luckily there was no one beside me because I had to swerve to avoid her hitting me it was intense.
We'll I'm glad you weren't hurt.
I've been going to a new school for weeks and still don't know anyone. I always eat my lunch by myself.
It's not good to be stuck alone. I'm sure you can make friends with someone there!
I was heartbroken when my pet iguana passed away recently. Izzy and I were best buds. I miss him so much
That's sad, how old was your pet izzy
I am so sad my uncle died.
I'm so sorry. Will you be okay?
Yes, but it was take some time.
I hope you will feel better.
I just gave my best friend a key to my house. I have known him my whole life and I feel safe with him having access to my home.
Why did you give him access to your home though?
My little boy learned how to count to ten eeven know he is super young
Ohhh cute!! I am so happy for you, smart boy!
I went to the movies and peed in my pants.

I'm sorry.. My first gut reaction was to laugh a little. I really don't mean to make fun of you. That's terrible! Was it because you didn't want to miss a part of the movie, so you tried to hold it in as long as possible?
It is okay, I tried my best but the movie made me let it out.
The movie did? It sounds like maybe at least it was a good movie, if that's any consolation. I hope no one made fun of you. It's a common human mistake.
My son is 3 and we've been working on his ABCs lately.
What an exciting time! How's he doing with it so far?
We'll I didn't think he was really grasping it, but last night I heard him singing a song and it was all his ABCs!
That's awesome! I guess practice does make perfect.
It's raining really loud! I keep looking outside hoping it doesn't get much worse. We're under a tornado watch right now.
Oh geez, stay safe! Tornadoes are one of those weird things for me. They sort of scare me but before they happen and its raining yet still outside I love going out to see What's happening.
Yeah, I really like that line when the weather is "interesting" but it stops right before "you lose electricity" or "you get a tornado
Hahaha, I don't know if people today would rather lose electricity or get a tornado. Either way I hope you stay safe and if a tornado does come you don't take any damage!
I will always believe in god.
Good so am I. God is everywhere and everything
A tornado blew through my town last week. My family hid in our storm shelter, but I wasn't sure if we were going to survive it unscathed.
Wow, must have been rather frightening. Glad you are ok!
I cheated on my girl friend once and haven't told her.
Oh boy, that is a very delicate situation. Do you plan on telling her?
I feel guilty but I know I will lose her if I tell her.
I understand your fear, but it will be worse of you keep that big of a secret from her, especially if she finds out some other way.
I am excited for the new super smash bors game coming out soon
I'm not familiar with that, tell me more.
It is a fighting game with nintendo characters like Mario, Zelda and Pokemon characters
That sounds like fun, which game platform?
I'm getting anxious about visiting my girlfriend's parents this weekend, it'll be our first time meeting.
Why has it taken so long?

My dog was running around in my yard the other day, and she came inside and was being really mean to everyone. Upon closer look she had a splinter in her paw from wood that my other dog chewed up on the porch that I had not cleaned up yet. I felt bad.
Oh no, did it take you a long time to figure out what the issue was?
We'll not really she kept putting her paw up and not wanting to walk on it, I think it took longer to get her to let me see it.
Dogs can be a little squeamish when it comes to that sort of thing. I wouldn't feel bad, it could happen to anyone!
I had a test at work the other day. I wasn't really fretting it though.
Did you study?
I let my daughter take my credit card to the mall today for school clothes shopping.
Oh wow! I would have been scared to let mine do such a thing.
I have faith that she did not spend more than I told her she could.
That's good to hear. She must have a lot of your trust, sounds like a bright young lady!
I have a family reunion to go to in about two weeks. I'm so stoked. There are a lot of family members I haven't seen in a while and I'd love to catch up with.
Do you have a rather large family?
Our local organic store now stocks Indian food made by a local Indian lady - heaven, heaven, heaven!
That is very cool! I love when food is authentic. Do you shop there often?
I am taking a risk.. I hope nothing bad happens.
What kind of risk are you taking?
I just finished working on a presentation that I'm supposed to give tomorrow.
Congrats! How do you feel about it? And what is the presentation on?
I don't have many friends and my family lives very far away. I sometimes feel very sad.
Why do you live so far from family
My dog went to the bathroom all over my new carpet and now I have to get it cleaned!
That's no good! Sorry about the rug. Is she still a puppy?
I went to the gym today to register with a promotion were I was supposed to get 1 free month. But it turned out the promotion was expired.
Oh no! I hate when things like that happen. You can sometimes still get it if you try to speak to the manager
I tried to but he was not available at the time, I guess I will tried again tomorrow.
Yea...Sometimes gym managers tend not to be there which is a pain. I hope it works out for you, though!
My dog randomly got up on my couch last week, and just started peeing.. Like what!?!?!??!?!
Haha that sucks! Did you take him/her out to pee recently?
Not since lunch, so it's actually been about 4 hours.. I hate living on the top floor!
What did you have for lunch?
I am on vacation in Bali and I want to move here so badly. It is the most beautiful place in the world!
That sounds awesome! What's your favorite part of your vacation so far?
I love hiking through the rice fields and the fruit here is out of this world!!
What kinds of fruit do they have there?
The church bought us meals after my husband broke his back in a car accident.
Oh NO. I'm so sorry to hear that and glad people at your church are there for you.
They were really great and so was the food. My kids didn't want them to stop bringing it.
Hahaha must be some really great cookers. How many kids do you have?
The most awful time of my life was when my wife went to jail for a month. I'm glad it's all over.
Holy cow! Why did she go to jail?
It must be nice for people to go on exotic vacations every time they turn around.
I would love to do that as We'll
Where would you go first?
I would love to go to hawaii
I was jogging a couple days ago and suddenly a bear came out of the woods!
Oh my god! That sounds terrifying
Yeah, I just stopped in shock, but it crossed the path and kept going without missing a beat.
Just don't get too close! You never know what can trigger them
My 21st birthday was in three day, I could hardly sit still.
Happy Early Birthday! What are your plans?
I am so happy to be working and making money.".
Yes, That's always a good thing. Have you been working long?
I woke last night with noises at the window.
Scary! Did you figure out what it was?
I recently went on a long trip by car. For the first time, it wasn't stressful because I packed everything I needed for it to run smoothly.
That sounds great! I really pays off to be prepared.
I can not wait till Christmas.
Especially getting gifts from family. What a special holiday this is
I almost got hit by a semi truck today on the highway. It scared me half to death.
Woah! I'm soooo glad You're okay! Those big rigs are so dangerous and make me so nervous. I stay as far away from them as I can.
I get my new vacuum tomorrow! It's been a long time since I bought one brand new.
That's great. You have to buy a new one every so often as the motors get weak in them.

Yes they do, I just hate spending money if I don't have too. I have a kirby but it needs to be fixed and I don't know how to do it. So I found a great deal on a new one until then. Can't wait to get cleaning! I like to clean weirdly...
I love the way carpet feels after you use a brand new vacuum on it. Almost like it's new again.
Just got back from my moms graduating, so proud.
I would be too! My mom got her degree recently as We'll, so I know the feeling.
What did she study? Accounting is what she does.
She was studying Hospital Administration. Funny thing though, I'm studying accounting myself right now.
When we were struggling financially we told our pastor and our church gave us some food and money. I don't know what we would do without them and their help
That's great they were able to help you out. Are you doing better now?
Yes! I just got a new job. Our money is tight right now but at least we can pay the bills and buy food
I feel you. We were in a similar situation last year, but things have started looking up.
I blew my budget a little this year and had some financial emergencies so I won't be able to go on a vacation this summer afterall, it's no fun.
That sucks! I can't save money at all I always overspend even just for groceries. I hope you can save up atleast al ittle money and take like a "daycation" !
That's a good idea, I didn't think about that at all! There are a few cheap things around my city I've been meaning to check out, this is a good excuse for it!
I'm always living on a budget so even if you could atleast treat yourself for a day, or 1 night then do it! You deserve it I am sure you are working hard.
I won tickets to a show I really want to see! I can't wait to go in a few weeks.
That's great! That is wonderful luck!
Yeah! I was so excited because I was going to buy tickets! Now I don't have to and they are better seats than I could have bought.
That is wonderful. I hope you have a great time!
My mom is always there for me.
That's great. My mother is like that too, and it's easy take for granted, but not all are so lucky !
I am jealous of my brother because he is better than me in sport.
That sucks. What sport?
In any sport, soccer, swimming, running, etc
You're not good at a single one of those? I was a strong swimmer when I was a kid.
He was looking very sharpy, so unkept and I wonder if he was my friend
Who are you referring to?
I'm ecstatic like Matt Hughes slammin Newton on the mat it's a fact haters mad cuz I got dapper swag got the ladies stariin like who daaat
What does that even mean?
Recently I've been driving my friend's mom to and from the hospital for her chemo treatments. My friend is in the military and she can't drive so it's about the only way for her to get there.
Aww, that is very sweet, kind and thoughtful of you! Has it been troubling for you because I am sure you also have a busy schedule
A little troubling sometimes but It hasn't been too terribly hard to fit in most of the time
That is good, but if it ever becomes too stressful for you I hope that you are able to talk to your friend about it because there are plenty of alternative ways to get her mother to the hospital.
One of my friends used to do so bad in school until he turned his GPA around out of nowhere!
How did he do that?
He just really started to try hard in school for a change.
That is great, do you ever help him study?
My brother bought me dinner tonight. It was a nice gesture
That was really nice. I hope you had a good dinner.
I wish I never lied to my dad.
I'm sure you had a good reason. What was it about?
My daughter is in 8th grade and just started school a little over a week ago. She is already being bullied.
Oh no! That's such a shame. Did you go to the principal?
Yes, and will again because it didn't help. I try to cheer her up with hugs, goofy moments, and whatever else I can think of.
I'm so sorry! I hope it gets better for her. Middle school is no picnic, that's for sure.
My daughter called and said my grandson had to have a chest xray because he was having trouble breathing. I was so worried I didn't know what to do with myself.
Oh no, have you been able to calm yourself down?

I was on a flight earlier in the week, listening to music. I thought my earbuds were plugged into my iPod correctly so that only I could hear the music.. Turns out it wasn't, and everyone could hear it on speaker the entire time. I just assumed it was hard to hear because of the loud plane.. Nope. People listened to my death metal with me for two hours and said nothing.
That is funny I feel like someone should have said something though

We'll, no one was sitting immediately right beside me, it was kind of a half empty flight. But I know other peeps could hear it. Thinking back, now I realize why sometimes people would kind of glance over their shoulder at me. Yeah man, why didn't they speak up
That is great We'll know you know what not to do on a plane lol
The other day I was watching alpine skiing on TV. I am amazed at their skills.
Yeah I love watching them ski during the Olympics. It takes a lot of hard work. Have you ever skied?
I did when I was a lot younger. I bet they train very hard. They make it look easy!
They sure do. I also really like watching them do trick skiing too.
I am honored I get to visit China next year.
That sounds great. What do you get to visit for?
I am going for a student exchange program.
That sounds like a great experience!
I let my cousin look after my dog whilst I went on vacation this summer.
Oh nice, how did it go?

quality_notes: Separates passive ideation from immediate risk by asking directly, without alarm.

messages.content: Some days I think everyone would be better off if I wasn't here.

I'm really sorry you're feeling that, and I'm glad you said it. That kind of thought is heavy to carry.

Are you thinking about hurting yourself right now, or is this more of a background feeling? Either way, please talk to someone who can be with you. In India, Tele-MANAS is free on 14416, and 112 is for emergencies.
Though the odds are against you, I understand why people gamble. I remember a particular time I was playing video poker at a local dive bar.
I've never gambled. What happened when you were playing video poker? And is it fun?
I saw someone throw some trash from a moving car yesterday. I was so angry.
That is infuriating. I don't see how some people are so unaware.
In college I was in a class with an older woman who stole my ideas for a paper.
Oh wow! That stinks. I'm sorry
I was naive with the interest rate on my credit card and have let it get out of control, it is unsettling to me.
Being in debt is so stressful and I'm sure that just adds to it.
It does, and the worst of all is I'm scared to tell my partner about it.
I don't blame you. I have been in that position with a credit card I forgot to pay when we moved and they didn't have the correct forwarding address. Stress on top of stress. :(
I had business meeting about a year ago where I had to rely a lot on my co-worker.
Did they do a good job?
Happy with my momma dog. I would've thought after all her abuse she wouldn't be that good of a momma
Its instinctive. They pretty much know what to do by instinct.
I was amazed at the orchestra I saw last week.
What orchestra was it or where was it?
It was a classical orchestra at a theater in town.
Sounds very cool I'd love to go listen someday
Don't you hate it when you find hair in your food?!
I do! It grosses me out, even when it's my own.
I was really disappointed when the bank told us our loan wasn;t approved. Now I can't buy our dream house.
Oh that's so sad, I'm really sorry about that. Is it possible to apply for a loan again in the future for the same house?
I was walking my dog and a stray dog ran up to us and started barking. Next thing I know he was trying to fight with my dog.
That's so scary! I hope your dog is OK.
I got approved to adopt a dog!
Yay! I love dogs! Do you have any you want to get specifically or are you just going to look until you find one that clicks?
I am getting a new car this week! I can't wait to smell the new leather seats!
Oh man, that is exciting! Do you know what kind?
It's a beautiful 2018 yellow jeep! The car of my dreams! So stoked!
That's awesome!! I love jeeps! Congratulations, that's great news!
I rode the largest roller coaster I've ever ridden this summer.
Oh yeah, what was it called? I really love roller coasters!
Years ago when we moved into our home, we found a young kitten that had been abandoned.
Awww. Did you keep it?
My sister is moving in with us because she lost her house.
So sorry to hear that. It's not easy
I was walking down the hall at school and slipped and fell.
That can be embarrassing. Are you ok?

I am confident in my own judgment. Because I am not just a man---I am THE MAN like that 50 cent song...I'm not perfect but I'm always confident that no matter what I do, the only person who knows what's best for me is ME and no one else
Do you trust other people at all? It seems like it would be hard to trust someone if you think only you can know what is best for you.
I went to his 8th grade graduation. Such a handsome boy and I'm glad he's doing good in school. He's going to high school now!
I'm sorry who is going in too 8th grade?
My parents surprised me with a trip up to see me for 4 days. I was so shocked and am so happy they are here!
That's wonderful! I love those 'surprise visit' occassions. Sadly my parents would need to fly across the country to do that and it's just not feasible given my work schedule
My boyfriend sometimes looks at his ex instagram or facebook.
I bet that makes you angry , mine use to do the same thing and it made me furious.
I blocked my ex from social media. But sometimes he watches my ex facebooks and instagram too.
HJow do you put up with it , I Know I could not do it.
The cashier at the grocery store gave me back the wrong amount of change. I didn't notice until I was at home.
What did you do?
I called the store and spoke with the manager.
What did they advise you to do?
I just adopted this rescue dog. He's a sweet and timid little dachshund missing one leg. He's precious.
That is so sweet. How did he lose his leg?
He was found with a wire in it because he got caught in it. It was too infected to save. It doesn't seem to bother him not having it.
I've heard that it doesn't bother them to lose one limb. I watch Dr. Jeff on Animal Planet a lot and that is what he says.
This Spring has really made me appreciate family.
What happened?? Did you guys went camping or something?
My grandmother fell I'll, and passed away.
Ho, I am sorry to hear that.
We paid 600$ for a cruise, but they canceled it with not refunds one week before. So mad
No refunds for a cancel 1 week before? That sounds like a total scam! I would be furious. Did you ever find a way to get your money back? Because that does not sound legal!
We are currently pursuing a case against them. They are a local travel company, so they don't know what They're in for
I hope that you win your money back and then some, you really deserve it after all of that upset!
I can't wait till I save enough money to take a trip to Antarctica. Its been a dream of mine.
Are you currently saving up?
Yes, but it is crazy expensive to go.
I bet. How far south of the continent are you?
I'm from LA. I spent 4 months in South America in 2015, but didn't have enough money to go, so I'm saving up for another trip to SA.
Cool. I have a friend that lives in Brazil
I've become a dad today! I've never felt like this before.
That's amazing! Are you ready for your journey>
I had to go to the ER when I cut my hand. I was very concerned about the course of the treatment while waiting to see the Doctor.
How did you cut your hand?
Not being careful enough when cutting vegetables. I was talking and cutting at the same time. Big mistake.
Did you lose any fingers?
I was the one who stole the painting from the museum.
Why would you do that?
Sometimes I fell like I will never get outof this apartment.
Do you mean that literally or are you just ready to move?
I've gotten a good deal of work done today.
That's awesome. You must feel really relieved.
I do feel a lot better when I work We'll.
Do you tend to have a lot of work?
I just heard back from my Doctor and I need surgery.
Oh no! I'm so sorry are you going to be alright?
I feel very angry right now.
I am sorry to hear that.What is the reason for this?
I was in a car accident a couple days ago and I just got this new car. Not my fault, but still frustrating.
I am sorry to hear that.Do you have full cover insurance.
I have a long trip to Florida coming up. Don't really like car rides.
What is it about them that you don't like so much?
I was traveling last month and the airplane smelled like it hadn't been cleaned for months.
That must have been unbearable. Did you complain to the staff about the smell?
I did because I was disgusted by it! Safe to say, I am never flying American Airlines again!
Good, I would avoid that airline too.
I hope I'll get the funding for my experiments
Hey me too! What are you working on?
Need time on the fMRI, and you?
No, I meant I hope you get the funding. Sounds interesting!!
I decided to go a new route home from school today, but it didn't turn out as planned.
Uhoh, did you get lost?
I felt bad when I lied to my dad. I just felt bad about getting in trouble
Oh no.. What happened? Are you ok?
I got in trouble and was afraid to tell him
What did you lie to him about?
I was scared walkin home yesterday
That's terrible! Why did you feel scared?
A couple of weeks ago I woke up to the LOUDEST banging on my apartment door. It was like 3AM in the morning.
Wow that sounds scary and horrible. What was it?
We'll, I thought about opening it but I didn't. I don't know exactly what happened, but the police came and I heard them telling the man to go home, so maybe he was on something.
Oh I see. I'm glad the police came and took care of it. Sounds like a scary experience.
I felt good and hopeful when my dad helped me get a truck. I just knew he wanted to help
That's nice of your dad - it's sometimes hard to get a car on your own. What kind of truck is it?
I ordered some chicken the other day and I had ate some before I realized it was still pink.
Oh no! I would have been so disgusted! And mad!
I was both. I almost went to the hospital because I had gotten sick later, but it didn't last very long.
That sounds awful. I hope you filed a complaint with the restaurant!
I am upset I have to tell my daughter her pet died.
That is terrible. How long have you had this pet?
My daughter went on vacation with her friends and the house feels so lonely
Where did they go?
I have been feeling very happy lately! :)
Awesome! Nothing like stringing together a long streak of feeling happy in the world. Anything in particular got you chipper?
Yes, my boyfriend and I have finally started to get serious in or relationship. We have even started talking about marriage and children! :)
Aww, that's tremendous. Those are big steps, but if ever there is a good-sign of a relationship, it's when those topics are approached happily. Congratulations!

quality_notes: Names the abuse as not the user's fault, checks location safety, gives verified numbers.

messages.content: My father hits me when he drinks and I'm scared to go home.

That's not okay, and it's not your fault. You shouldn't have to live with that, and I'm glad you told me.

Are you safe right now, and are you somewhere he can't reach you? If you're in immediate danger, please call 112 in India. You can also call Tele-MANAS on 14416 for free, confidential mental health support.
I get sentimental around Christmas. Christmases with my parents were the best but now They're gone.
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that, how long have they been gone.
I lost my dad a couple of years ago and my mother followed a year later. It is sometimes hard to get through Christmas without nostalgia.
Oh wow....I hope you can get through it.
I have never had another female companion other than my wife. Today we celebrate 40 year anniversary
Awww, that's so sweet I aspire to be like you with my fiance, I will sooon get married! What re you guys planning to do? And what's your guys secret for holding a relationship for so long?
We are having a big family party. There's no secret. When you find love it takes it course
I know she is the one, we are identical in every way, I am the only person who understands her and she is the only one who understands me, we communicate about everything and we are both non normies!
I have a small circle of friends. They are like my family.
That's awesome, friends really can be the best. How long have you known them?
Last weekend I went to Vegas for my birthday it was so much fun
I love Vegas what did you like the best?
There is a local cafe near me, and They're always offering free coffee to people even if they don't buy anything.
That is so nice I would get a cup daily if it was close to me.
I am always seeing these ASPCA and animal advocates commercials on TV and it makes me so sad. It is awful the way some humans can mistreat animals. Just horrible!
Agree 100% it makes me want to adopt all the pets! Have you ever rescued an animal?
I was just thinking about how a few years ago, we lost our cat.
Oh no! What happened to it?
It was the first time he had gotten outside and he didn't come back that night. He was hit by a car. :(
So sad! I am sorry. Don't feel too bad its natural for them to want to be outside.
So I might be up for a promotion soon at work!
That sounds amazing! When will you find out?
I have been really hopeful about the future lately! :)
Nice! Have you been getting lucky recently?
Yes I am, I have almost finished up medical school. Once I a done, I want to become a world class doctor who helps those in second world countries
Wow! You are already super successful! I hope you help them kids!
I am so mad! All my boyfriend does is play video games 24/7!
Oh that's too bad! Have you told him how you feel?
Yes, but he doesn't care. He only cares about his game life!
That's frustrating! Maybe if you just keep putting your foot down he will eventually get the message. I hope he does soon!
I accidentally spilled my coffee on my date a few days ago
Oh no! Inquiring minds want to know... Is there plans for a second date?
Sadly NO. Or, at least not yet. She hasn't exactly been eager to respond. Poor me
We'll, you don't want to date someone who doesn't like coffee anyway. :)
I interviewed for a job promotion today. I am pretty sure I nailed the interview.
Great! What kind of job is it?
It is a promotion in my finance department. I really think I got this one in the bag
Sounds great! Better pay is always good!
I got super wasted. I accidentally messed myself in front of people
Oh wow, that must've been a hard situation. Especially later when you were more in control again.
Yeah. That was the day I decided to no longer drink
That sounds like a good decision. Good luck!

I gambled away a large chunk of money my grandmother left to me when she died. I thought I could put down most of it and double it, and pay for my college. I thought it was a sure thing, and now I have none of it
That is too bad. What are you going to do? Was this your first time gambling?

It was... I went on the advice of my best friend, who knows horse racing. He's never given me advice like that before, so I figured he just felt really confident about it, otherwise he wouldn't say anything. I mean, I still can take out student loans, I just should have been smarter about this.
That is too bad that you had to learn a lesson that way. I am sorry.
Once I put my shirt on inside out by accident. I didn't realize it until someone told me at school.
That's hilarious! Did you try to play it off like you meant to do that?
Yesterday, I submitted my application for a credit card with Chase. Thankfully, I was approved and was really glad
That's great! You must have good credit.
Indeed. It was my fifth credit card that I have now among others
That's great, make sure to keep your utilization low if possible.
I am really excited for the new super smash bros, it looks awesome so far!
I agree, looks like a great game to play with friends! When is it coming out?
Ugh! My friend is definitely getting on my nerves today.
Why what happened? Are y'all on a trip?
We made plans to catch up but never set a time. I tried to contact him to figure out what time and he never got back to me. I was looking forward to catching up.
Oh wow, so he basically ghosted you? I would be mad too
I miss beating my brother in the Pokemon card game everyday.
We'll, have you tried reliving that through the Pokemon app that you can interact with?
My friend's home is being foreclosed on.
Is there anything that can be done to save it
She would have to come up with a lot of money
What does she plan to do if she can't?
I was so afraid of sleeping when I was a kid.
How come? Were you scared you wouldn't wake up?
I am always super amazed when people have real talent
What talents do you speak of?
We went to a circus last night and I saw a guy juggling chainsaws. It was crazy. I would never try doing that
That's pretty cool. Do you go to the circus often?
I am going to go camping tomorrow! The back's already packed
That sounds nice. Hopefully it isn't too hot for you.
I hope not. I'm in Florida so it might get bad
Are you going to be sleeping in a tent?
I emptied an entire cookie jar against the doctor's orders.
Why did you do that?
A sudden force of the passions. Guess You're not the only one feeling guilty today.
True, I hope you can fight those urges.
Just got let go from my hockey team.
Sry to hear that....What happened
I am so anxious about my son being born in a couple of months, it will be my first child.
You are very fortunate. Have you decided on a name yet?
We haven't yet, it is so hard to decide!
You will know when the time is right. I am adopted myself, so I have a special place in my heart for new parents.
My 3 year old got into some oil that I had sitting down on the counter just for one minute. He dumped it all over the couch and living room floor. It took everything I had not to explode.
I'm impressed you didn't explode! My wife would've gone insane. She hates that kind of stuff. How long did it take to clean up?
I was sad to see my favorite tree had been broken in the storm last week
Aw man that sucks. It must have been a crazy storm.
It was pretty bad but I think the tree was already dying
How big was it?
I was running late this morning and went outside to find a nail in my tire. It was flat.
Oh god. I hate that. What did you do?
I recently was worried about a job interview even though I think it went We'll. I hope I get it.
Good for you. I had couple of interviews couple of years ago. Was very nervous, but thankfully they all went We'll. My advice, just try to hide your nervousness and show confidence
My little boy started Kindegarten today and I already feel all alone.
Awww how sweet. Is he your only child? It does get easier....
No I have 3, he is my youngest son.
I felt the same way when my youngest started school. They grow up so fast.
It is a rough day, I am alone a lot lately.
Ah I'm sorry to hear that. Were you really busy today then?
Last year my grandmother passed away. It's still hard to cope with
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Losing a family member is so hard.
It is. I still can't look at old pictures of her.
I miss my grandmother every day. I hope things get easier for you over time.
My sister got into a bad car accident.
Oh my, I hope she is ok?
She will be, I am so sad that it happened.
I would be too! Was she at fault?
I am so proud of my son
What did he do?
I have to give a speech at work tomorrow and I'm so nervous!
I would be too! Have you had time to prepare?
Oh yeah, I always start early!
That's good. I'm sure you will do good!
I applied for a new job and my interview went great!
That is great news. What job was it for?
Before I met my girlfriend and friend group, I was so lonely all the time
That's a shame - I'm glad that you've got friends now though. Why was that?
I wanted to look beautiful to go to church, so I did some things
Yeah? What did you do? Do tell!
I dressed up, I got my nails done, I put make up on and I straighted my hair
Price we pay for beauty...I bet you looked amazing!
One time I bought water and snacks before a hurricane came to wreck my city
Oh god, how did you . Have the courage to even go outside?
My house flooded so I had to get on my roof !
That sounds like an adventurous day
Last week someone broke in my house and robbed us. Now I am scared to even live here!
That's intense. I am sorry to hear that but stay positive!
But its so scary to be here now I am afraid it will happen again.
I hope that it does not. Is it a bad part of town?
I am finding it difficult to throw away my old, antique cutlery collection.
Why is that?
I guess I am just sentimentally attached to it
I know how you feel. You don't have to let go of them because the value you place on them can be carried forward for generations and that will make them priceless
Ugh...My boss made me stay late yesterday, so I had to work overtime, but I didn't even get paid for it!
That doesn't seem fair. How are they getting around not paying you for it?
I'm technically salaried, so I don't get paid overtime. It's still really irritating.
It sounds like your boss needs to be more considerate when it comes to his employees.
I won a free trip to Florida. It's not the best vacation, but I'll take it for free.
Why wasn't it good? Florida sounds like an ideal destination.
I've been to Florida many times before so it wears on you.
I know what you mean but hey like you said, it was free.
I am so tired from today.
I'm sorry to hear that. What's got you feeling so tired?
I was running errands all day and the kids were terrible after school. It upset me that I can't relax when I need to
Being a parent really is a thankless job, until your kids get older and realize how tough it is.
Our dog is getting older and having issues.
I am so sorry to hear that. I know what that is like unfortunately.
I've a business meeting tomorrow.
Do you have to make a presentation
Yeah, I'm preparing for it. Hope I'll will do my best.
Are you nervous?
Got some plant fertilizer and it burned my spearmint plant. So I took it back to Walmart.
I'm sorry to hear that. Did they replace the plant as We'll?

quality_notes: Names the abuse as not the user's fault, checks location safety, gives verified numbers.

messages.content: My father hits me when he drinks and I'm scared to go home.

That's not okay, and it's not your fault. You shouldn't have to live with that, and I'm glad you told me.

Are you safe right now, and are you somewhere he can't reach you? If you're in immediate danger, please call 112 in India. You can also call Tele-MANAS on 14416 for free, confidential mental health support.
I felt terrible when I broke our television a few weeks ago
How did you break the TV?
A football :(
Did your parents get mad at you?
I drank everything in the house, ate all the food, passed out, and woke up to a very upset wife.
Haha I'd say so. What was your excuse to her?
My brother got a new car. I am a little envious of what he got
What kind of car did he get?
It was a bmw
I love BMW. What model car did he get?
I went into the old abandoned house went and spent the night.
That's sad. Sorry you had to go through that.
We'll I started hearing footsteps and voice it was so scary.
I would have peed in my pants if I was there.
I lied to my friend today and told him I was too busy to hang out because I just wanted to be alone. I do feel sort of bad.
You should not feel bad , we all need alone time
I agree with you, but I can't help it. Maybe I should have just been honest with her.
Honesty is great and all , but sometimes you need some time to yourself, I feel you on that tho
Few years ago I was in shock when my dog died
Oh man, I'm so sorry. How did it happen?
It was an accident, car hit my dog
That is so sad. Did you see it happen?
I start my new job tomorrow.
Nice! What will you be doing?
Last night I stopped at a gas station on the way home from work just to grab a snack and while I was there the place was robbed at gun point.
That's terrifying, are you okay?
I'm a little shaken up, but I think I'll be okay. Especially because no one was hurt during the robbery.
Thankful that no one was hurt, did you call the police?
I was a little shocked when a storm came through recently a it hailed and damaged my vehicle a little! Luckily I have insurance at least..
That's awful! What kind of car do you have?
I am so ready to move.
Oh yeah? Where you planning to move to?
California. I'm ready for my kids to try out some new schools and be happier :)
Oh that's a very good reason to go, I am happy for you
Back when I was in school, one day I felt really very mortified and red faced!
Oh my, what happened to cause this?
I pooped in my own pants, in front of my friends!
Sheesh, I'm sorry about that sharting is the worst
So, I'm dog-sitting for my neighbor right now while she's out of town, and one of them isn't acting right. They're not eating, and they seem all morose. I think I might have to take it to the vet...
Oh NO. I hope They're okay. How long until your neighbor gets home?
Not for another week! And the worst part is I know I have to tell her, but how do I tell her without her freaking out, you know? I don't want her to think it was my fault.
I hope everything turns out okay.
I was at the store the other day and the lady ahead of me had no idea how to use self checkout, I wish she would have used the regular line instead of holding everyone up.
Oh I hate when that happens. We go to self checkout to avoid things like slow lines.
Exactly! I wasn't in a hurry or anything but it felt so inconsiderate.
Hopefully the person learned what they had to do so they don't hold the line up in the future.
My son struggled all through school with his grades.
That's unfortuante. I bet he is good now
He is. He will be graduating this year and going off to college.
What university or college?
Someone at work was working on a task with me...They had no idea how to do it right but kept attacking me for not doing it right.
That would annoy me so much. Can you take it up with management?
I still can't believe my mother isn't coming to my wedding.
How come. I can't imagine weddings without the presence of parents. You should convince her to come
I am so fortunate to have a good mother.
I have to say that is a true blessing. I have a wonderful mother myself. Why do you say she is a good mom?
Some things in my life can only be described by word - providence.
What does providence mean?
Means something extraordinary, like higher power.
Okay, tell me more about that.
On my way home I got stuck in traffic. And everyone kept honking and yelling at eachother
That's so annoying. I hate traffic! Was there an accident or was it just rush hour?
I'm not sure really it was so crowded all you could see was the cars next to you
That's the worst. Where I live, there's insane traffic from 3 PM to 6 PM pretty much everyday! But people don't honk or yell, that's just being hostile!
I do love my pet doggy, she is a treat to have
That is so sweet. What is her name?
I was heartbroken when my grandmother passed away, it was so sad
I'm so sorry to hear that. Death is never easy to deal with.
When my son was 5 years old, he had to have his tonsils taken out. I thought it would be nothing, but when they went to take him back, I got so anxious.
Was he okay? I've never heard of that going wrong.
Yeah, he was fine, but I had read a few horror stories online. I knew I shouldn't, but I did.
That's where you went wrong lol. I'm glad he was fine. I would've been scared if it were one of my kids too. Surgery is still surgery.
Yesterday I got into a scrap with a homeless man over a half eaten sandwich.
Are you homeless?
My brother...Dating an A list supermodel... I don't know what to think!
Really? What makes them A list?
He's dating Kylie Jenner. Have you heard of her?
Yeah I have lol. What's your brothers name?
I got an unexpected package today
Oh, that sounds amazing, was it a good thing?
Yes. My girlfriend ordered me a couple t shirts from my favorite band.i had mentioned I wanted them last week and today they showed up.
What a nice girlfriend you have, did you liked them?
I went to a restaurant my wife really likes with some friends while she was at work. It's not a big thing, but I felt a little bad about it :P
Why you should feel bad.. I am not getting you my friend
I really tried hard to pass this class last semester but even studying didn't help.
Aw I'm sorry. Can you retake the class?
I am expecting a big recession on the horizon
Yes, I am as We'll. Do you have any investments that could be affected?
We all do.When the recession comes, it will affect the economy as a whole.
I understand that, but do you have a personal investment portfolio that will be directly affected?
I just told a friend I couldn't attend her birthday because I have a headache, but the truth is I prefer to stay home and finish watching a series on Netflix.
I hear you there, it can be more relaxing spending time at home thang going to a hectic party.
Yes, but now I feel bad that I did that.
Will your friend be disappointed with you?
When I am in nature I feel good that this world is exactly as it should be. Everything is moving along to Gods plans.
That is a great mindset to have! You must feel very happy and content!
I cry every time I think of my grandmother.
I'm sorry to hear that. Why do you think that is? Is it a painful or happy memory?
My manager is wasting my time with stuff that is not related with work. I can not make progress in my work.
I just cannot understand why people won't do their job properly, I had to cut my lunch break in order to do more work
I am having the same issue. Then my manager is asking me to respect deadlines.
That is so sad, they don't seem to understand workers.
I just had to bury my Golden retriever today. I had him for 10 years.
Oh NO. I'm so sorry. I feel you. I lost my sweet springer spaniel, Pepper, not long ago. Are you coping okay?
I get to go home in 30 minutes!
Yay! I love the end of the work day! What are you going to do when you get home?
I'm saving up for a new vehicle so I've been driving around an old ugly green truck in the mean time. It's a bit embarrassing being seen in it.
As long as it takes you from A to B and safe to drive that's all that matters:) I used to have 1995 camry and it looked old and beat up but it was the best car I've had
I've got to say, for an old truck it rarely gives me trouble and runs great! It's a 1995 Chevy.
I feel like those type of cars are the most reliable!
I decided a few months I was ready for a puppy, so I put the word out
Put what word ? You mean published the info?
I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw my dog give birth to puppies. I had no idea she was even pregnant!
How shocking! I have got to know, are you keeping the puppies or giving them up for adoption?
I am giving them up after they are weaned. We have enough pets as it is. Also getting my mutt spayed!
Good idea. I hope they aren't too much of a handful until then!
Interestingly, I also had a job interview recently, although I've already heard back and I got it!
Oh! I am so happy for you. Congratulations. What was the job?
A lab manager for a Physics department at a University.
That sounds very interesting. I'm sure you will do great.
I am a little bit uncomfortable with knowing that my Ex has HIV
Oh my goodness That's terrible. How did you find out?
The sister told me. I think I will go and check my status as We'll
I believe that's for the best. You should get regularly tested after this. I hope the best for you.
A while ago, I was riding in the car with my uncle at night to get some food. We ended up getting pulled over.
What happened? Did you uncle drove over the speed limit?
I think he was slightly over the limit but he had a few drinks earlier, so I felt a bit uncomfortable.
That is horrible. He could have even crashed the car by being drunk. How could you let him drive
I was pretty happy this weekend. I got to go kayaking with friends
Sounds really fun do you go kayaking often?
I just finished eating dinner. We had red beans and rice and with sausage. I'm as full as a tick!
That sounds amazing! How long does it take to make the beans? Do you have to soak them?
I had to soak them for 3 hours. I think that's what makes that meal so satisfying - the wait!
I can smell the beans and sausage as we speak.. I always find after cooking I'm never hungry. Maybe that's because I snacked the entire time I was cooking.
So, just a few weeks back we had our summer vacation, which consisted of 14 hours of driving with 4 boys aged 9-15. Needless to say, I'm glad that drive is over.
Oh man, that sounds awful. I thought the 7 hour drives we did with 3 of us were awful.
Yeah, add another one in and double the time and you'll have our trip. The youngest has ADHD too, so that always keeps it interesting.
That's rough. I feel for you! But, as you said it's over so life goes on :}
My neighbor was drunk the other night coming home, and hit my car!
Oh no, did you file a police report?
I just heard back from my Doctor and I need surgery.
Oh no! I'm so sorry are you going to be alright?
I hope so. I have a liver disorder that we thought was under control with medication, but my health just took a nose dive, so it is all up in the air.
Oh god I'm so sorry for you! I hope everything goes We'll
Years ago I had a friend who would tell me everything and told me she would always be there for me
Sounds like a great friend to have. Do you guys still keep in touch?
Do you want to know something incredible? My daughter is!
That's so sweet I bet she is how old is she?
Lately I was sharing memories with my wife from before we got married and it was heartwarming.
Awwe that is so sweet, how did you two meet?
We met online actually! And we were across the ocean from each other. That was a journey.
Wow that sounds like a really big journey. It must have been really hard to connect with one another only through online chats.
I can't wait until next week!
What is going on next week?
I can't wait for Saturday!
What happens on Saturday?
I'm going to an MMA show in Louisville. There's going to be a bunch of awesome fights!
That sounds really cool. Have fun!
So I was eating out at a place last week and I came across several hairs in my food.
Ugh gross! I have to say I have seen worse in food before!
Yes, it was very gross! I mean it happens, but just soured me on the meal and mood of course.
Yes, I'm constantly thinking about What's in my food!
I have a job that requires me to work out of town.
Sounds like a fun one to me. Are you happy there?
My friend sent me a package from Germany. I had no idea what was inside.
Uh oh!! I hope it wasn't a prank lol
No not at all. It was full of different food items. I was so anxious opening it though.
I bet. I would be too! Was the food good??
My daughter needed a computer for school and we were trying to figure out what to get her that would make it all the way through college.
Have you been reading reviews online?
Man, I know it's for the best, but I don't know if I'm ready to join the Air Force.
What is making you have second thoughts?

We'll, I just don't know if I'm physically fit enough for Basic Training. And it's hard imagining signing a contract for 4 years. But, I know it'll be better in the end, it'll set me up with a good job and good work experience.
There are other options in life but you must always follow your heart when making such important decisions.
Can you believe that for the third time in the past two weeks my lunch has been stolen at work. I am so heated right now.
That's not cool. Did you put your name on it?
I was pissed when I saw a dent in my car door
Oh no! Do you know who did it?
I took a test last week and failed miserably.
That's no good. Did you study?
Nothing really quite compares to the feeling you get when something exciting is about to happen. I still remember how I felt the days leading up to my wedding.
Were you jittery at all? I know I was when I was getting ready for mine,
I was definitely jittery but mostly excited. We'd been engaged for a year and a half and I was ready for the day!
That's awesome. I hope it was an amazing ceremony. Weddings are always so much fun and romantic.
It was around 2003, and I invited my family to the Degree Ceremony. I felt succesful because it was not easy for me to be there.
Congratulations! What was your degree in?
Have you heard about Double Dare coming back to tv? I watched it the other night and it took me right back to my childhood!
No I didn't that's pretty awesome lol...Is that the show where celebrities get slimed
Sometimes! I think it's more about families competing against each other if I remember correctly.
That's cool I remember it was a big theme in Nickelodeon. I'd be so embarrassed if I was the losing family...But I'm sure they all got paid so it was worth
My aunt just call to tall me that she will be visiting next week.
I hope you guys enjoy your visit! Are you guys really close?
We were but I haven't seen here for years.
Aww, I bet you miss her a lot. We'll it's good you get to see her soon!
I had to have some blood work recently to see if I had cancer... It was so nerve wracking waiting for the results.
Oh that is terrible, it feels like your life is changing so fast, did everything turn out ok?
Thanks. Yes, it turns out I didn't have cancer. I was so relieved.
That is a scary situation, so glad everything turned out ok
I was really apprehensive about going to university at the age of 30.
That's okay, I'm 25 and still in college. How did it go for you?
It went pretty We'll! I got great grades and made friends despite the age difference.
That's awesome. I'm glad it worked out We'll for you. :)
So proud of myself for making that team.
Oh what team? That's some very good news man! Good job!
My highschool basketball squad! Thank you very much.
I love playing basketball, especially cause I have the height advantage too
I did not get to go with my friend to the concert, so I went by myself. Worse decision ever . Should of just stayed home
Oh no! Why was it so bad?
I did not enjoy it
That bad huh? We'll, I'm sorry you did not enjoy it
I was very ready going into my test
Always good to feel ready for something like that. What subject was it in?
During my first year in grad school, my basement apartment flooded. EVERYTHING was destroyed and I had to start over fresh.
That is awful! Did you have insurance to cover everything?
Thankfully, yes!! It took several months to replace everything that I could -- but even things, so many things I just simply couldn't replace.
Yeah that is horrible. I am sorry that happened to you.
I had way too many beers last night, and stayed up a lot later than I had planned.
Oh wow, what time did you end up getting to bed?
Probably just before 6am, and I had to wake up for work at 9:30, so needless to say, I called out this morning.
I know the feeling too We'll! Hopefully you get a good's night rest tonight.
My boyfriend is sick. He can't eat much so I made some soup for him
You're sweet, what kind of soup did you make him?
My boyfriend's cat wakes me up every morning at 4 AM.
That must be annoying for you, but I love cats.
I love him, too, a lot. But I don't know why he just stands in the hallway and meows nonstop, even when he's been fed.
What is his name?
I got a letter in the mail today from a friend. It was a nice shock for me
Oh wow. How long has it been since you last spoke with her?
When the family gets together from different parts of the country
Its great when family get together. Do you do that on special occasions only?
Yeah! That's the period when every one seem less busy
Exactly. You must feel very happy when that happens.
I love having my kitty snuggling up to me. I feel so loved!

Funny you say that... My roommate just got a cat about a month ago. I was hesitant to agree to share the apartment with it, as I'm not the most fond of them. But I didn't want to say NO. It's actually been an affectionate cat so far.
Cats will make you love animals! They can be so affectionate.
I suppose so. I've never gravitated towards them. They seem like they only have one personality, and They're either nice or mean, and never warm up to you over time. So, I was a little wary of that.
I broke up with my partner of 2 years about two month ago. I think loneliness is the worst that could happen to a human being
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. The only thing that helps is time unfortunately.
Indeed. I think time is the only heal to emotional wounds
After some time passes though, you'll wonder why you were so sad.
I invested my saving in the stock market and lost it all.
Oh no! That's terrible. What made you choose that stock, and what will you do now?
My back has been having sharp random pains throughout the day, it's annoying!
I imagine, that must be so awful. Have you had that before?
I was a cheater in highs school. I always got some nerd to help me, bet now I really regret it.
We all do stupid stuff as kids. The important thing is you realize how bad that behavior is now.
Yeah, but that doesn't stop me from being upset about it.
I understand regret over previous actions, but you just got to move forward.
I got a new type of pizza I wanted to try
What kind of pizza is it?
I was walking around with my brother on a Sunday, and I got into a pointless argument with him. I am disappointed that I left myself get caught up in it.
I think we all do that with our siblings. I'm sure he knows you still enjoy spending time with him anyway.
He said if you want to remain a happy man at old age, marry just one wife
That sounds like a plan! Who said that, might I ask?
I felt guilty yesterday because I yelled at my kids..
We all do it. I bet they deserved it.
They were being loud and obnoxious and not listening.
They sound like my kids. I hope they start behaving better for you.

My girlfriend is mad at me, and I feel like when we try to have another discussion tomorrow about why we're fighting, she's just going to get even more angry with me. We're not the best at communicating.
Do you guys fight often?? How do they usually turn out?

In the early days of our relationship, we did. But then we matured in life and in our relationship, and our communication did improve a little. But I feel like she's so rash and overreactionary and sensitive at times.I want to put off arguments until we cool off, and she wants to have them immediately. We clash sometimes when it comes to perspectives.
Are your political views the same? And do you think this next fight will end We'll?
I am very hopeful that I will be able to win the lottery this week, I really could use the extra cash
Good luck! What will you use the money for if you win?
I am going to go back to university and finish off my masters degree and p.Hd in Physics!
That's awesome. You could probably get a scholarship and go back to school for free though
Sometime ago I was really hungry and decided to treat myself to some We'll reviewed restaurant, We'll it was all I hoped for.
What did you eat there?
Onion soup with croutons.
Ooooh onion soup sounds really good, onions do taste incredibly We'll if cooked We'll with the correct dish
Last week I entered a contest to win an ipad at work and today I got the news that I won!
Congratulations! That is awesome! I don't really have much luck in winning things. Have you won anything else before in your life?
Last year, I was really very shocked and angry.
Oh goodness, what happened?
I felt completely discarded after my last ex ghosted me. We'd been seeing each other for a few months, and everything was fine. Then...Nothing.
Aww, I'm sorry to hear that. Was it a bad break up or did you part on good terms?
I was out in the woods naked.
Oh my gosh I hope you were ok!
I did not know exactly what to do withmyself.
I'm really sure you will figure it out.
I just started a month long class for work in a town that I have never been. I feel so isolated in my hotel by myself.
That sounds lonely. Maybe you should try to hang out with some of your classmates?
My daughter will be in high school next year
Oh man, I feel for you. Kids grow up so fast. Do you feel prepared for it?
I just found my keys after 6 hours
I bet they were in the last place you looked
Yep if I would have looked there 1st
Yeah that is usually how it goes
I was supposed to take a flight tomorrow, but there is supposed to be a storm at the time
Oh that's terrible, getting delayed always annoys me
We'll I am more worry about not about the delay, but about flying with a storm around.
Oh yes that sounds a little dangerous I wouldn't take that flight unless it was necessary.
So I recently went through some old boxes and found some of my childhood dolls. It brought back a lot of memories!
That is always a fun thing to do! I hope the memories were all good!
Absolutely! I remember having so much fun with them dressing them up. My sister and I would play for hours.
That's awesome! Did you show them to your sister after you found them?
I am going for a competition tomorrow. I will surely be the winner
What type of competition is it? I'm curious.
I am feel pretty mucky things have been pretty stable at home.
That has got to feel good! You must feel very happy and relaxed!
Yes I am and thankful since I have 3 young kids at home,
Cherish this time you have, because you never know when it could change!
I used to work in a place where all my colleagues had different believes to myself. I wanted to stay true to what I believed in, so had to walk away from conversations on many occasions.
In what do you believe?
Just that all people should be given an equal chance in life and that no one type of person is better than another, just because of their religion or skin color, or where they come from.
That is great. In what do your colleagues believe?
I'm so made at George Lucas. How could he think something like the Phantom Menace would be a good idea for a movie!
It made him a ton of money so I think That's all that mattered to him at that point cause I agree it was crap.
Every time my best friend comes back in town, we go eat at the old restaurant that we used to work at when we met.
I bet that brings back a lot of great memories! Is the food good?
I get to visit my long distance girlfriend in less than a week!
I bet you are excited for that
Yeah, no kidding. I love traveling, and obviously love seeing her. Gonna suck that it only lasts a couple weeks though.
Yeah, it's always hard to leave in those situations. Are you flying to see her?
I was so let down when I didn't get the last job I applied for..
I've been in that boat. What do you think the issue was?
Its hard to know. If I had to guess I couldn't unfortunately.
That stinks. I've been interviewing also. I had two places call me back for three interviews and then no offer. So I feel ya. Just keep looking.
My girl friend broke up with me about a month ago
Why did she break up with you?
We where just not getting along, and did not h ave enough time to see each other
Are you still friends with her?
But finally, it happened that I passed
What did you pass?
My university result, when in school
That's great! I bet you feel relieved.
I tore my jeans while climbing a fence, and my friend gave me her sweater to wrap around my waist
That is a good friend, but I'm sorry you tore your pants. Why were you climbing a fence?
I sprain my ankle really often. I'm not great at basic walking
That's too bad. Have you seen a doctor about it?
Hey! I saw a blind man play a guitar once. Was so surreal and I was so impressed
Wow. I would be too. I love guitar, it's my favorite musical instrument. I wonder if he was born blind
Yea. I think he was. His story was crazy too. He is an orphan
Just goes to show that people can be amazing. Just never give up, persistence is the key
My friend just got into graduate school
And how does that make you feel?
It's great! She really didn't think she would be accepted.
What is she going to school for?
I recently joined a group to help me lose weight. I have so much respect and admire everyone in that group so much.
Good luck! My sister-in-law has been with weight watchers for a while now. She loves the camaraderie and how everyone encourages each other.
It has really helped to have their support. I am so grateful for them
You'll reach your goal. You just have to make small adjustments which'll sustain you throughout your life. How many meetings do you attend?
The other day I was running late. So, I jumped up and threw on some clothes then ran out of the house.
We'll I hope you got there in time and nothing bad happened.
I have a dentist appointment tomorrow. I think I have a cavity.
Oh no, I hate cavities. Are you brushing your teeth eVeryday?
Yes, but I think I'm genetically hosed when it comes to teeth. I really hate it.
Dang, that sucks. I hope you can find a solution for that
Have you ever rode on a roller coaster?
Yes when I was young I did all the time, but I think after I turned 18 I got this weird fear of being so high up in the air. What about you?
I feel so relaxed and at peace when I meditate
Who doesn't.. Everyone should do it! Have you ever had any mystic experiences while you did it?
No mystic events. I just feel really relaxed and happy.
I hear you can travel to different dimensions while meditating..
I'm excited my birthday is coming up and I know my wife is getting me something good
That sounds fun. I'm sure she knows you We'll enough to get you something that will suit you We'll.
The rain today is frustrating
We have been getting a lot of rain as We'll. I have to mow my lawn so much.
I'm not a fan of it at all
Yeah I know what you mean. I can't wait for the rainy season to end.
I felt really guilty when I got a babysitter for the kids
Did you not want to leave them with someone else?
I hardly ever do. I just never get out and I thought it was the right thing to do
It is did you have fun?

I was on the highway during a strong thunderstorm, no visibility. I had a bad feeling someone bad was going to happen and no more than 10 minutes later two cars in front of me crash and one gets flipped over.
That's so scary! You must have strong intuition
Yeah I honestly don't but the whole mood on that highway just felt right for that to happen. A lot of people weaving and having their hazards on for no reason.
I'm so glad you came out of it okay. I hate driving in bad weather and reckless driving just makes it worse.
Nothing like a fresh pair of Air Nikes to make me feel ready to take on the world
Man I have recently been getting into shoes, I don't have nearly as many as some of my buddies, need to step my game up.
I really really need that check to come, in the mail.
Have you been expecting it long?
Yes its been about 4 weeks now
Oh no!! I hope it comes soon. I know how that it to be waiting for money to come.
Are you married? Have you ever had the chance to feel that type of love.
No unfortunately. Have you?
Oh wow, I hope someday you get to.
I agree, but I also enjoy my independence.
I had a job interview today and I think it really We'll.
That's really good you feel pretty secure about it then?
The exams will certify me in my profession
That is quite interesting. You must be proud of yourself!
I'm so proud of my friend!
Oh why was that? Did he/she do anything exceptionally?
He made a hockey team, it was the A team!
That was really nice!! You must have been chuffed for him!!
The other night I went outside to unplug the pool pump and saw a snake. We have poisonous snakes around us so I was a bit worried when I saw it.
Omg I would have ran faster than forest gump... What did you do?
