I am so happy that my daughter is doing so much better in school
That's great to hear , getting along better with the other students ?
I've got a doctor's appointment tommorow that I've been worried about all week
Oh NO. What's wrong? Why are you going?
I'm having some health issues that have me really worried
I'm sorry I hope it nothing serious. I hope it just seems bad but is easily fixable.
I am an ESL teacher and one of my 3 year old students came to school singing an entire song all about the planets. It was so cute!
Awe, I bet you felt so proud and happy for them.
I found some photos of my father from when he was my age.
That's awesome. Do you look like him?
I dropped my friend's birthday cake.
Oh man! I bet you felt bad.
I still feel terrible. I'm gong to make it up to her though.
I am sure she understands it was an accident.
I can't wait till I save enough money to take a trip to Antarctica. Its been a dream of mine.
Are you currently saving up?
Yes, but it is crazy expensive to go.
I bet. How far south of the continent are you?
I was supporting so curious of being alone at home Cox I wanted to see a movie
What do you mean exactly?
I am taking a vacation to Orange Beach, Alabama in a week! My wife and I visited the area about two years ago, and we loved it!
Oh man, I bet that will be fun
We can't wait! Have you ever been to the ocean?
I have, I love going when I can
My best friend moved away. I was not happy.
Oh no, where to? That is hard.
Yes, and he may never come back.
Oh no, where to? That is hard.
Sitting next to my baby brother who's two-years-old, and he's just ripping farts. Really wish I didn't have to stay with my parents during the summer while college is out
Wap you must be disgusted with the farting. Were you mad? Or are you used to this kind of situations?
Kind of used to it.Comes with the territory of being with a kid brother. How about you? Any siblings?
Yes I do have 2 siblings, older brother and younger sister, but we don't fart in front of eachother, I love them!
When my doughter was born I knew she would change my life.
That is amazing. Those moments are wonderful and priceless! How old is she now?
I am waiting to see if I got that new job I applied for
Best of luck to you. The tension and nerves must be killing you!
Ok... So I am feeling great about the decisions I made.
What did you decide on?
I decided to pursue my dreams in a fantastic way.
That is a good thing to do, I'm sure you feel empowered because of that
For my camping trip, I brought with me my tent, camping chairs, mattress, sleeping bag, pillows, med-kit, bug spray, food and beer.
That sounds like quite the checklist. I'm glad you brought the beer you might need it haha!
I'm excited for tomorrow morning! I have a big presentation at work and I think my boss will love it!
That is awesome! Do you think you are prepared?
I found a Christmas ornament my daughter made for me when she was younger
How precious! How old is she now? What does the ornament look like?
She is 13. She was 3 when she made it. Its a clay stockin that they got to paint themselves
What a wonderful nostalgic piece. My daughter is 8 and growing up way too fast. I have a hand print ornament she made and I can't believe one day she'll be 13!
I found a spider crawling on my bed.
Damn.. What did you do?
Killed it then took stripped my bed apart to look for his friends.
Haha.. Did you find the friends?
My aunt died last week
Oh man! I am so sorry! You must be devastated.
I don't like people kiss their dogs on the mouth. I find that disgusting.
I totally agree with you! They lick their private parts and eat stuff from the floor, why would you wanna kiss them
I don't understand why people don't think about that before kissing them on the mouth. It is a stupid thing to do.
I know. I don't kiss any animals, no matter how much I love my pets I won't kiss them
I was on a train in Sri Lanka. I asked the passengers if I was at the right stop. They told me NO. Turns out I was at the right place.
Oh dang. Do you think it was intentional?
Are you in the US? We have a thing in the UK called Prime Minister's Question Time which is like a debate shown on TV of our parliament. It makes me very angry.
I am in the US. Why does it make you so angry? I've never heard about.
The politicians just spend the whole time shouting at each other and laughing at their own jokes. It's pathetic. You should youtube it.
I think I will, I'm very curious now. You think they would want to use their time more wisely.
My sister has been dating this guy for about 7 years and I wish she would drop him.
Oh no, it really sucks seeing someone you care about date someone who isn't good
Yeah, he's a bum! He mooches off of her, she works and he sits home and drinks.1
I bet if you say anything about it, You're the bad one too
I get to fly up and see my girlfriend in a few weeks!
That's great. How long have you been apart for?
My daughter made us late on the first day of school
What did she do? Woke up late?
My family is coming to visit!
Awesome. When are they coming and for how long?
They are coming next year from africa!
That's a long trip. I hope they have a good time
My boys made me so happy last year. They both came 1800 miles away to visit me at Christmas.
That was super nice of them, I bet it was a big surprise as We'll.
Yes, it was. It was one of the happiest days of my life. My one son also got me a kitchenaid for Christmas.
I love my kitchenaid. It has to be my most used appliance. I can see why you were so happy.
I am looking forward to the next season of Game Of Thrones.
I've never actually watched that show myself. But I've heard so many good things about it!
My grandmother was diagnosed with stage four cancer. I feel helpless.
Oh no, I am so sorry to hear that. That is awful and makes me sad. Have you talked to anyone about it?
I have spoken to our minister about the situation. It's hard to watch her go through this and there isn't much I can do. I can just love and take care of her.
That's what you need to focus on is just giving her all of your love, she will cherish it. I'm so sorry You're going through this, I hope that you can find peace with the situation.
It was so relaxing and contenting to watch my kids play on the waterslide while I grilled yesterday.
I would have had a great time eating your food.
Lol, yes you would have. We made hamburgers and brisket and chicken.
I do not eat chicken, but I would have loved the brisket!
When I got through shopping there was a scrape on my car door where someone had banged their door into it. They didn't leave a note and I was enraged.
I would be pretty furious as We'll, those can be expensive to get removed!
My husband and I went to dinner tonight and were looking at pictures of our kids when they were really little.
How sweet! How old are they now?
They are 18 and almost 16, they say the days go by so slow but the years fly by - and they are right. I can't believe they are not that little anymore.
This is true for me as We'll, I have a 17 and 19 years old. I can't believe it, and just turned 40 on the 5th.
I got to hear a lot of cool songs on a radio station I usually don't listen to.
Nice! Which ones did you hear!
Mambo #5, Missy Elliot, and Ricky Martin. It really took me back
That one is a zinger! I remember listening to that when I took my grandma to prom!
Having a child changed my life. I never imagined I could be so protective of something.
I have heard the same thing from my friends who have kids! They say it's like a force takes over as soon as the baby is born
I was out walking by the lake over the weekend and there shore was just covered in dead rotting fish.
What happened why were their so many dead fish?
I don't know, that's what I would like to know! The best I can imagine is that the water quality dropped, and they died. I imagine it was pollution.
I hope they are not using the lake for drinking water .
I have pain in my stomach for about a week now. By reading what is on the internet, I am very worried.
What is going on? Have you seen the dr?
Watching old black and white western tv shows really brings back good memories of my grandparents
That must make you feel good. Any favorites?
My grandmother is the person that taught me how to cook.
Nice! What is your favorite dish that she taught you?
I FINALLY get my lawn mower fixed on thursday.
That's great. I'm sure it was cheaper than having to buy a brand new one.
She sure does. I am not putting up with that, lol.
I would not put up with it either
I love the rain. It makes everything feel fresh.
I love when the rain his the soil in the open field , the smell of wet dirt is just refreshing
I got really drunk on my birthday and was horrible to one of my oldest friends, I felt awful
Did you apologise to him? Maybe next time try to not drink a lot so you can control yourself?
I was cleaning my basement. I found lot of toys and books from my chidhood
Aww that's awesome! Did you take a day off and go through them for the memories???
A while back my loud upstairs neighbors went away for a week. My life went from night to day. It just felt as if all was right in my world.
Did you think about moving after that?

I watch my girlfriends dog every once in a while and she just isn't getting potty training. She is a little over 5 months old and some weeks she does a great job and the next week she'll go to the bathroom everywhere but outside.

That's super frustrating! I've only ever had outside pets so I can't really offer advice, but it's one of those things where your anger is all misplaced because you know you can't really be upset with the dog since it doesn't know any better.
I feel down in front of my students during games.
Oh really? That's sad, why is that?
I tripped over and fell down, and the students laughed at me.
Oof that sounds quite embarrassing, hopefully it doesn't keep you down too long
I'm travelling to Costa Rica next month for the first time. It's going to be awesome!
That sounds very exciting. I am sure you will have a great time.
I'm frustrated by all the other drivers on the road lately
What have they been doing?
Just generally driving poorly and not using signals
Do you honk at them?
I'm waiting to hear back from the nursing program I applied to for my degree
That's exciting and nerve wracking at the same time I bet. How do you feel about it?
Hey, I have some good news.
What is that?
Harvard rejected me last night,
Oh no! That's not your journey then. Do you have other places you applied?
My dad has early onset dementia
I'm sorry to hear that, its very hard to cope with
I am so lucky to have someone like my fiancee
I am lucky to have someone like my fiancee too! What makes you so grateful about your fiancee
That's great! Just the fact that she is always there for me whenever I am in need.
It's probably the best feeling on earth right?
I realized yesterday I was pregnant, I was in shock!
Woah, that is huge news. How are you handling the news.
I am still in awe, I think things will turn out fine but it was definitely not expected.
I am happy to hear that you will be ok. Enjoy having no kids while you can!
I took a trip over the weekend where we stayed at a nice hotel with a balcony overlooking the pool.
That sounds really nice! Did you stay near the ocean?
Yes in Biloxi. The balcony had a downside though. The seagulls would always try to steal your food.
I remember throwing food over and watching them catch it as a kid.
I was really sad when my dog died last year
That is hard thing to go through. I hope you are feeling better about it now.
My daughter scored the winning goal at her last soccer game. I was so happy that all her hard work paid off!
That's great. Does she practice a lot?
Yes, she practices almost every day after school with her friends and also with her team. She says she will be a professional player one day!
You must be very proud. I hope she's successful.
My wife and I were taking a break for a little while, but we found a spark recently
That is awesome. Stay positive I hope things will work out.
Yea I was shocked when she came over the other day, but then things really started clicking. I think things are really turning around
I'm so glad. Marriage is tough but when you love each other it's work the effort.
Went out to eat with my boyfriend the other day. Saw our waiter pick his nose and wipe it on his shirt.
Oh gross, I would lose my appetite
My friend's at the hospital after a pretty bad car accident. We finally got news she's woken up after being asleep for 6 days.
Sounds terrible, how did she get in the accident?
Some drunk driver hit her.
What did she say after waking up?
I am feeling bad because my grandchild wants me to play all the time but I have to work a lot.
I know how you feel. I'm working right now :(
I don't know who keeps double parking at my workplace.
That is the worst, I hate when people can't park
I just don't like inconsiderate people. Like they own the world.
I know the feeling, there are a ton of people like that too
I remember being in Scotland and arranging a trip to California to see my then boyfriend. I was so very happy to be seeing him again!
I bet! Is it hard to have a long distance relationship?

Very hard and this was before the days of smartphones and FaceTime. We spent a fortune on telephone calls. But it was so worth it to speak to each other and I was lucky I could afford to fly out to see him.
I can only image how hard that was before the days of smartphones! I'm glad you were able to visit him!
I loved taking care of my sisters pet the other day
That's nice! What kind of pet was it?
School starts next week and I am all ready to go!
Oh nice! Are you taking any cool classes?
Do you like to organize your house. My mother-in-law recently surprised me recently with some organizing stuff b/c she knows how much I love it!
I'm trying to get into it. We have our first baby on the way and need to reorganize everything. Do you have tips?
Labels and Bins can be your best friend! Especially with a new baby.
My big thing is I'm like O' I may need that leave it out of the tote box. Before I know it I have more stuff laying around then when I started.
I have a coworker that comes in to work late everyday and takes a million breaks
That is annoying. Did you told your manager about it?
I lost my job because my company didn't pay rent at our location.
Oh that is so wrong. How are you handling it?
I'm sure our dance show will go We'll. We've practiced for months.
That's awesome. You must have trained really hard.
I've got a business meeting on Friday this week, and it's with a big client for my company, so I really need to make a good impression.
I bet you've had to do a lot of prep work. Do you feel ready?
I just got the job I applied for a month ago, and they are even throwing on a bonus to my salery
You must have really impressed the company you work for. Got any plans for the money?
So my little brother barely passed his finals to become a cop! I could not beleive it.
That's great that he passed though! ARe you happy about it?

I'm going through a lot right now. I usually don't like talking about it but I felt like I really need to talk it out. Yesterday my friend called me and I just started talking about everything. It felt good
We'll, it is good you have a friend that is so close to you that you feel comfortable sharing with them.
Yes! I feel like we got closer to each other. I finally found somebody I can really trust
Trust is a hard thing to find, I am so glad you found this bond with this person.
My brother passed away 2 years ago and I'm still so heartbroken. It still hurts so much
Losing a loved one is never easy , especially a brother I'm sorry for your loss
Thank you. I'm sure it will get easier with time. It was just so tragic, he was so young
I can't imagine the pain you went through, I have 7 brothers and the taught of losing one of them scares me
My dog randomly got up on my couch last week, and just started peeing.. Like what!?!?!??!?!
Haha that sucks! Did you take him/her out to pee recently?
So I was driving late the other night and I saw a BEAR crossing the road.
Did you stop for him?
Yeah I stayed my distance. He didn't even acknowledge me or the other car.
Did you take a photo of the bear?
One quiet night, I watched a movie on TV.
That sounds fun. Was it a scary movie?
The airplane smelled like it had not been cleaned. And I had a 8 hour flight non-stop.
Oh that sounds awful! What did you do?
I just have to suck it up even though I was disgusted and had to hold my nose the entire time!
At least once it's over, it's over. I would consider other airlines next time! I would also write a complaint letter.
I was in total shock the night my fiance proposed to me at a concert.
That sounds like a great place to propose! How did it go?
Planning out my new home has turned out to be a blast!
What kind of house are you building?
I saw my ex-girlfriend on a date with my best friend.
Oh man. I'm sorry. Do you still have a cordial relationship with your ex?
My sister just passed away.
Wow, That's unfortunate. Sorry to hear. Were you close?
We were, it's so tragic. Cancer spares no one.
I hope you are finding ways to cope with your loss. That can't be easy to deal with.
My sister's cat got sick and had to be put down last week. Feels bad.
That sounds terrible. But hopefully it isn't suffering any more.
I was pissed when I saw someone left my gate open
Oh no! Do you have any pets that could get out?
My teacher said If I do what she says she can guarantee I'll pass
We'll it's a teacher's goal to make sure his or her students succeed. She wants you to do your best.
My uncle is going to come after me. I didn't graduate.
Why would your uncle be upset? And how do you feel about the situation? It sounds like there's a lot to unpack there.
You are right but my unle is a simple man and he gave me a warning about me not graduating.

I see. We'll, what's most important is your reaction and feelings around the situation, and what you plan to do about it. The only one that can affect the outcome is you. It's disappointing to deal with your uncle's negativity, but you can't let it distract you from moving in a positive direction.
I lived through a home invasion. Several masked burglars broke into my house and totally ransacked it. I was home at the time. I hide under the bed during the whole ordeal.
Oh my goodness, that sounds absolutely terrifying. Do you think they would've hurt you if they found you?
My son hit a home run at little league tonight.
Wow! Impressive! He must be beaming and you must be so proud!
I was very proud of him. It was his first one ever and he didn't even know it went over the fence until he had run all the bases.
I bet his face was priceless when he found out! Those are the best times in life! Take him out for vegan ice cream!
My sister talked me into going on a roller coaster with her.
Oh yeah? I'm guessing You're not a big fan of roller coasters?
Someone cut me off in traffic today
What did you do after they cut you off?
I ordered food almost two hours ago and it's still not here, ugh!
That's the worst, when they take forever.. Have you called them up?
We had a group meeting at work and there was some leftover pizza. While everyone was getting ready to leave and they weren't looking, I snuck the rest of the leftover pizza in my purse and slid out!
Haha... You little thief! (joking) That must have been some good pizza!

It was not bad.. From a local place. New York style, which is my favorite. I'm sure they didn't really care in the grand scheme of things.. I just hadn't eaten all day and still felt like a hungry pig even after we had some during the meeting. Someone mentioned they wanted to take the leftovers home to their spouse too, so that made me feel a little bad
Ahhh, oh We'll. Don't beat yourself up. I am pretty sure that I have done something like that before too. I think it was with birthday cake. I love birthday cake!!!!!
My grandson was admitted to the hospital the other day. It's so hard waiting around for test results.
I can only imagine! How is he now?

quality_notes: Respects agency, does not give unsafe blanket advice, notes that leaving can be dangerous, offers realistic support.

messages.content: I want to leave but I have nowhere to go and no money.

Wanting to leave is a clear sign that you know this isn't right. Not having somewhere to go yet doesn't make wanting to leave any less valid.

If leaving immediately would put you in more danger, that's worth weighing carefully. You could call Tele-MANAS on 14416 in India for free help, including with safety planning, or 112 if you're in danger now. Who is there for you, even a little?
I know its probably too soon to tell but I am afraid my daughter is going to be a difficult teenager!
Hah... I have a teenage sister. I can agree. But they can have their good moments. I hope for the best for you.
Thanks! That's nice of you.
With the way you sound, I'm sure you'll have the patience and the wisdom to raise her the right way through the teenage years anyway.

I once had a long walk home from the railway station with two very heavy bags. It turned out that another person had also missed the last bus and had to walk much of the journey with me as his home was in the same direction as mine. The two bags I had had some expensive DJ equipment but they were VERY heavy so when they guy who had to walk home the same way said he would help by carrying one of the bags I trusted him! He didn't disappoint, he helped me get home earlier and without a bad back; while the kindness of strangers made what a potentially bad night to a reasonably pleasant one - all down to trust!
What a nice guy. There are fewer and fewer of those every day.
I dove into the pool this past weekend and my swimsuit fell off!
Uhmnnn! So what then happened after that?
Everyone was staring and laughing at me
So how did you respond to that?
Someone slammed into my car and totaled it while it was parked. I am so mad because I didn't have insurance on it yet since I just bought it. The worst timing ever!

I'm really sorry to hear that... That's the worst scenario too, because You're parked and probably not even there, so you were completely powerless in the situation, and then you come back to your car to just have this bomb dropped on you. Maybe there's something that can be worked out, since you just purchased it.

Thanks. Yeah, I'm trying to figure out what kind of coverage I have if I just purchased it. It might have still been on the other persons insurance. I had to take off work and am losing money all around.

There has to be something. It can't just be this weird vulnerable loophole. I really hope so, for your case, because that's just unfair. I'm sure your work will understand, but it's still a crummy situation that is probably affecting all areas of your life. Transportation gets taken for granted. Hope things get better soon.
I have a goal I want to get on here tonight but my dog really wants to play. I feel bad that I'm not playing with him but would really like to hit my goal before I do.
Oh, I bet you are really torn.
I am, I would think I'll be done pretty soon and then take him for a nice long walk.
I'm sure he will love that. I bet you will see the joy just shining in his eyes.
I've been letting a stranger stay with us this past couple of days
A complete stranger? How the heck did that happen? I'm sure you must be confident that it's safe, if They're staying with you.
I used to be soooooo territorial of my boyfriend (now husband of decades!) when were dating.
I'm like that too, so I can totally relate. Were you able to talk to him about how you felt?
Yes, but when we were younger -- he didn't really understand. And truly, it was more about my own insecurities than about him, you know? As I grew more into myself, the jealousy loosened its hold.
I've felt the same way. As I have aged and become more comfortable and secure in my marriage and in myself, those other insecurities and fears dropped off. Good for you for conquering that challenge!
I've been feeling a bit nervous about my next decisions in life. How do I know what the right thing to do is?
I know exactly what you mean. It's really tough but when I make decisions I try to stand on them and be willing to pivot if necessary.

I think the right thing to do is, if people around you know what you should be doing or where you should be going, they should tell you plainly. To not do that is providing them plausible deniability if you screw up.
That sounds right to me. I actually have a few people around me that give me straight forward advice like that.
I stole money from my friend.
Oh.. Why did you do that?
Yesterday was my mom's birthday
How fun! How did you all celebrate?
Yeah! I went to her house yesterday (she lives about 30 mins from me) and I cooked her a catfish dinner!

It sounds like You're talking about two different people there instead of just one person. I'm a little confused.
I watched a horror movie yesterday.
Did you enjoy it?
No I scared and become petrified for a moment.
What was the movie about?
I'm very worried that I'm not going to make an important goal.
Could you prepare or ask for help on it?
I provide for a family of 8. It's tiring but rewarding
Wow! The struggle is real. I hope You're not too tired and stressed. I wish you luck for being so selfless!
I knew I was going to pass my bartender test last month. I studied so hard
Congratulations. Sounds like you aced it
My wife is going to divorce me.
Why she want to divorce? Did she tell you?
I was at the mall and I smelled the sweet smell of cinnamon rolls. It reminded me of home
That is awesome. Where is your "home"?
It's in a country called Bulgaria, my mom used to make homemade cinnamon rolls
That is amazing. My mom never really cooked for us but she was a great mom. I bet you miss home.
I put in vacation request months ago and am now just being told they can't grant it.
Oh no! Why did it take them so long to get back with you?
I don't know really, but I think that's my last straw with them.
That's horrible! Did you already have plans made for the trip? I hope you can work it out with them, but if not maybe finding another job that is a bit more accomodating would be beneficial.
I don't like joining it when people talk about someone that's not there, just like what happened yesterday.
Yep I thinks its disrespectful and petty. What happened?
He was talking about my other friend who is a bit annoying sometimes. While I may agree I just don't like talking behind someones back.
That's good. I am amazed by people who think its okay to do that.
I am ready for the last day of work.
Are you quitting your job?
No I am retiring.
That will be a nice change of pace! Do you have plans for retirement?
I got accepted into my first choice university
How exciting for you. Were you surprised?
Kind of. I didn't really expect to get in since the uni require amazing grades to get in and mine aren't the best
Sounds like it will be a lot of hard work to attend such a school but We'll worth it in the end.
I was looking into the early works of da Vinci.
What works in particular?
The Caesarean womb section. I have to say, the genius and inventive mind of such a great individual is quite breataking.
I agree wholly, quite an impeccable spectrum. I read online on 4chan that da Vinci was likely an alien from the future.
Its good to appreciate people who have helped u in the past
Very true. Who has helped you out recently?
I ate so much I broke through my Lap Band.
Oh no!! When did this happen?
It was about 6 years ago. It was a real turning point in my life. I knew I had to change, and it was really embarrassing to have to tell my doctor.

Oh, I feel you! I used to be a food addict as We'll when I was younger. It is a hard habit to break! It's amazing how far you have come though! So many don't realize that fresh real food make a difference and you feel so good when you get real nutrition!
My upstairs neighbor is making too much noise with her heels. Sometimes, she wake me up with the noise that she make.
Are you gonna complain to someone about it?
So, I asked my 7 year old what 12x12 was the other day, and he gave me the correct answer without hesitation.
That's impressive, sounds like a smart young man.
Thanks, I'm really proud of him. We homeschool so I guess I'm doing something right!
Sounds like it, Good for you guys!
When I hear some songs I remember my time in high school
What was high school like for you?
So everything for a party I'm throwing this weekend is ready and everything is paid for. I have it ready last week so I wouldn't stress.
It sounds like You're quite the organized person!
I broke my phone today.
That's no good. How did that happen?
I got in a heated conversation and threw it lol
Dang. We'll I bet that really worked to get your point across haha
My sister's been going through a bit of a hard time lately, so today I baked her a big ol pumpkin pie.
I love me some pumpkin pie, What's she going through?
She was laid off recently and her guinea pig died, which she had for a pretty long time. And yeah, I made a pumpkin pie because that's one of my favorites.
I'm sorry to hear that, I love animals. I hope she cheers up.
I have a table that is somewhat unsteady, I put my computer on there because I have no where else to put it.
Have you figured out what's the problem?
I have not, it seems to do ok except when my son puts his foot on there even though I tell him repeatedly not to do that!
Sounds like maybe one of the legs on the table is bent?
I aced my final math exam today. I was so hyped.
That's awesome! Math is pretty tough.
It is! I studied a ton though. It looks like it worked out.
Glad all that studying worked out!
I had just washed my car last week because I was supposed to drive it through the parade.
That's good. What kind of parade was it?
The parade in the County Fair. When I got home from the car wash I noticed that the car wash had stipped my car's paint!
Oh my gosh! I would have been so mad. Did you call them and complain? They need to fix it.
There was a new resturaunt that opened up around the corner and everyone was raving about it
Oh yeah? Did you go give it a try?
I did! It was terrible! I was so upset! It was expensive, small, and bland!
That's a shame. I hate it when a place doesn't live up to the hype.
Man, I know it's for the best, but I don't know if I'm ready to join the Air Force.
What is making you have second thoughts?
I failed my final exam for math last semester. I all set to graduate but now I have to repeat it. Its horrible.
That is terrible, I am sorry! Hopefully You'll be able to get it taken care of this time.
I just feel so bad for not passing. It has really set me back.
What type of degree are you getting?
Just moved to a new city, new work, and I've got no friends.
Have you tried making any?
I have, but it's pretty tough with my schedule.
Maybe try going out to concerts or clubs or sporting events, somewhere you can find people with common interests
I was supposed to be responsible for the powerpoint slides for our presentation, but I accidentally deleted it.
Oh no! So what happened?
I explained it to the professor, but she said we'd get a letter grade deducted from whatever we earn.
I hope you get an A at least then

My dog has to go stay at the doggie daycare for a couple of days so I can go to a wedding. I'm scared that she will think I am leaving her there and never coming back and I don't want her to feel that way.

Oh no, I am so sorry you have to leave your furbaby! Give her lots of extra snuggles and explain to her that you will be back and I am sure she will be delighted to see you upon your return!! Have you ever left her before?
A new restaurant opened near my house, and it turned out to be really really nice
What kind of food does it serve? Sounds wonderful!
My cousin passed the CPA exam!
Congratulation. What is he planning to do next?
She's already working at a Big 4 firm so she's just going to stick with that for a few years. I'm proud of her, it wasn't easy!
Good. I hope it will help her in career growth.
I got shafted by my general manager at my job.
Ohh good, and how did that happen?
She decided not to answer her phone for two days after we had people quit on us, So I had to open to close 9 am to 3 am two days in a row.
Ohh that's bad though. Why don't you meet her?
My favorite store is going through some tough times. They're trying to find another distributor so they don't have to raise prices and lose their customers.
That sucks. What store is it?
It's a Asian store that carries ingredients I can't find anywhere else unless I order online.
We have a lot of those where I live.
I woke up with a pimple on my face and brother won't stop teasing me about it!
I know that feeling! Maturity I suppose
Perhaps so, but I wish he would just be quiet and stop pestering me.
Its that feeling you have to live with for now.. Lol!
I was only asleep for an hour last night and I jumped out of bed! There was this smacking noise on my window it freaked me out!
Yikes! Did you figure out what it was?
You'll never guess haha! It was just a twig. The age old branch slapping on the window in the wind.
It must have been awfully windy.
I can't wait to relocate and move again. I am so ready.
Wow! Have you been to many places?
New York, VA, FL... How about you?
I've been in the same place. DC and then its neighbor, MD.
My friend helped me move to uni last week
Awww that's so sweet of them, are you guys close?
I was soooo excited to take our kids to Disneyland for the first time!
Ooo they are gonna love it, just its expensive, I remember when it was only $20 to get in.
Same! I was excited because I grew up going there. My grandparents lived in Tucson, and we would spend the summers with them -- the most exciting part being our drive to Disneyland each year!
Which one are you going to California or Florida ?
My girlfriend is the only girl on her speech team. She'll be gone with her team for 2 weeks
Oh no, are you worried about her? Do you think she will be faithful?
I'm worried the guys will try something, but I totally trust her.
Yes I agree, guys are a little let reliable sometimes.
I was happy to go on a trip for my birthday
That's neat! Where did you go?
I wrote a 20 page paper for a class. I walked away from the computer for a second and when I returned I had lost all of my work.
Oh my, do you have a draft saved. Or was that the only copy?
I have been jobless for 14 months. Last week, I finally got a job. I am so happy.
I'm very happy for you, thank God you could get a job, that's good!
My friend left my front door open when she was house-sitting for me. My cat snuck out and was killed.
That isn't good. Are you mad at your friend?
I was sad when I had to put my dog down last month
Oh no, I'm so so sorry. I've always had at least one pet throughout my life, and They're truly part of the family.
They are very much family. I cannot believe we get so attached.
Yes, They're honestly more dear to me than my friends. I hope You're doing okay - I'm sure your dog was very loved and had a wonderful life, so try to take comfort in that.

Since last year hurricane Irma hit my area pretty hard. Before the peak of hurricane season this year I have already gotten extra tanks for my grill, a small generator and a weather radio just in case.
Sorry to hear that. Did you have trouble getting the extra precautions?

Last year, yes it was too late, there was no gas left in town or bottled water and certainly no generators when everyone was looking around a week before it hit here. I won't find myself in that predicament again!
We'll, I hope everything turns out okay for you.
I'm so mad. I bought a used car for my son and found out later the odometer had been rolled back.
Wow, that is sleazy, what did you do?
I have to give a speech on Thursday.
Are you prepared?
I found old family pictures... It's so bittersweet looking back.
Yes I know that feeling We'll, were you happy to look back?
Yes I was, it brought back so many good memories
That's awesome, I am happy for you, sometimes the past seems like better days
Last night I woke up in the middle of the night and I couldn't move! I was completely awake but I couldn't make a sound or move!! It was so scary!!
Oh no! That might be one of my worst fears! Could you sleep any more after?
I am currently dealing with epilepsy unfortunately, and the doctors have not found a treatment yet.
That is unfortunate. I hope that it is able to be treated We'll.
Thanks. I have to go to a Monitoring Unit in two weeks where they will induce seizures to see if they can pinpoint their location. Not going to be fun.
I hope it goes as smooth as possible. Hang in there.
I was sad to hear my mom is in the ER again
Oh no, I am sorry to hear that. I hope she is okay.
My husband is going through the process of quitting smoking on top of dealing with drama from his parents. He is having a hard time.
I'm sorry, That's awful. Its a shame his parents aren't being more supportive
They aren't being supportive at all, but that's not surprising, that don't support him very We'll in anything. I just wish I could make it better for him, but I can't
I'm sure he appreciates having you around though
I think my daughters boyfriend is so respectful. I really like him.
That's good. I hope she found someone who treats her We'll.
So I came home yesterday and my lovely dogs greeted me all happy.
Aww, that's sweet. I love animals! They love you unconditionally.

quality_notes: Suggests shrinking scope, which is concrete and non-clinical.

messages.content: I keep starting things and giving up before they stick.
That pattern can be frustrating, and it often means the goal is set at a scale that isn't sustainable yet. What's the smallest version you'd actually be happy to repeat?
The pen is really lovely
What kind of pen are you talking about?
My parents are getting old and I'm worried about them.
Oh NO. Have you made plans on what You're going to do to take care of them?
We'll, there's not much I can do. My Mom's already in the nursing home, and my Dad's married (with me as the outsider)
It sounds like a tough situation. I feel for ya.
I can't even explain how much I care for this cat I have, it's like my best friend!
I am sorry. What happened to the cat?
Nothing bad, just love that I have it and would be sad if I didn't!
I hope you have pet insurance, you never know what can happen.
I used to hang out with my best friend everyday and now I have no one to hang out with.
I'm so sorry, what happened?
She moved far away.
You must be missing here very much.
My cat vomited on my shoes
Eww, did you get angry with her?
Yea I was mad and disgusted
I hope you didn't abandon her.
I have a job interview scheduled for Friday. I really want the job. It is making me so nervous.
Been there myself, the anticipation can really get to you. What kind of job is it?
Its for a financial analyst position. I've been pacing around like crazy.
Finacial analyst, sounds impressive. Good luck, I hope you do We'll and get it.
Now that I am married I no longer feel I don't have a companion
I'm sure that you will find another soon
We'll, I don't feel lonely anymore because I just got married buddy
I'm sorry, I read that wrong. I am very happy for you!
A couple years ago where I live we had Hurricane Matthew aiming directly towards us. I was so worried, I was glued to the TV until we lost power, then to the radio!
Oh, what a worry that must have been. Did you have to evacuate?

No I did not, we were not mandated to, but there was a voluntary evacuation in place and my neighbor left and asked us to watch her house. Her entire shed blew away leaving her lawnmower just sitting there in the middle of her yard.
That must have been awful! Friends in Florida had to evacuate. When they got home their house had feet of mud in it. Did you have much damage to your property?
My son just finished third in a jiu-jitsu competition he was in.
No way! That's awesome!! How old is your son?
I just finished my a/c condensor, and it was really dirty!
Ew! Sounds like a disgusting job.
One of my friends used to do so bad in school until he turned his GPA around out of nowhere!
How did he do that?
HUGS! I saw a mom and baby bunny around 8 and they were letting me talk to them. It was a bit shocking as usually bunnies take off whenever they see or hear anything.
Oh, how adorable! There are so many bunnies around right now. My parents house has especially a lot of them and they don't really run off like normal either.
I got a job interview for a very prestigious company. I spent weeks studying and researching them then had my interview this morning.
Great! You must be We'll prepared. Are you nervous?
I found out that a friend of mine from high school passed away recently.
I'm sorry to hear that, are you alright?
Yeah, I'm doing okay. It hit pretty hard because we were pretty close back then, but had drifted apart the last few years. I wish I hadd taken the time to do more with him.
That's understandable, life goes so fast that it's easy to lose touch with people you care about. All I can do is try to limit that occurrence.
I got to go to the park and read a book today after a tough week of work.
What book you reading?
Although I was running late I was still made it to the Black Friday sale and was able to get in the front of the line still to get the tv I really wanted!
Why do you have to stress so much to get black Friday sales
Oh I wasn't stressed. It was amazing to get the tv for a great price when I was really short on cash that year.
Okay. I think you need to find a better source of income so that you will not have to wait for black friday to get what you want
I had to eat dinner alone for a few days this week. My husband had to go on a last minute work trip.
You must be lonely because of that.
Yeah a little... He'll be back tomorrow morning finally
Where did he fly off too?

quality_notes: Moves toward a small, concrete action instead of generic advice.

messages.content: My friends are all busy and I'm spending most nights alone.
That can get really quiet, especially at night. It's normal to wish for more contact. Is there one person you've been meaning to reconnect with?

Don't you hate when you have to give stuff away and then can't? We'll, that happened to me recently. I was going to give away some of my son's old toys, but started looking at then and realized that I need to keep them for no other reason than that I was being sentimental
That's too funny. You know, I'm the exact same way.. I get so nostalgic with my old things. Can never throw them away!
I know! I am always like I need this notebook that has my 3rd grade handwriting back from the 90s because it will be very useful someday... Lol
Yes, someday... Haha. I love looking back at those kinds of things. It brings back so many good memories. Such a good feeling
I'll get to go on vacation tomorrow. Been working really hard to get things clear up so I can enjoy myself.
Awesome! Where are you headed to?

I was forced into covering for my coworker who was supposed to give a large speech to a packed auditorium. I had no time to prepare for it and really no idea what I was doing. I still had to somehow make my way throught the speech!
Wow that sounds pretty stressful. How do you think you did?
I really miss the holidays when our family got together
The holidays are a great time for that sort of thing. What did your family do together?
I had to give a presentation in front of my entire University class last semester. I hate presenting things.
Oh, that is nerve wracking. What did you try to do to cope?
I just went through my daughter's ballet shirts from the time she was 2 until now - she's 15.
Oh geez. Did you get any tears in your eye?
Definitely - it reminded me of how little she used to be and how much longer I've got until she goes to college. The shirts will be made into a quilt for her.
Awww, that's so sweet. I remember when my little girl was taking tap dance classes. So precious!
I really don't like randomly pumping into old friends, it get's me nervous, and I saw one of my old friend's today and I was surprised, to say the least
Yeah it can be akward some times specially if you don't know what to talk about
My son is in the Army and recently he graduated first in the class from recruiting school at Ft. Knox.
That is awesome! I am so proud of your son, you should be proud as We'll.
Yes, I am. He was such a slacker in high school, but now he is thriving.
I can just imagine how you feel. It is so nice when our kids make us proud.
I was anxious when I applied for graduate school
Did you get in?
I did, I was very lucky!
When do you start?
One of my friends seemed so bad with women but then randomly he got a girlfriend.
Where did he meet her?
A few weeks ago, so it was pretty jarring.
Not when, where I asked?
I let out a moist, hot, smelly, loud fart in front of all my co-workers today. I don't think I can ever show my face again.
That's awful. I hope you can find a new job.
Me too, considering I am bound to get fired, since two of my co-workers were rushed to the ER. I thought I was going to die myself.
That a fart can hospitalize anyone is pretty impressive. Did your story make the local news?
I found this old mix CD I made a long time ago. It really brought be back to when I first made it.
What songs were on it?
My sister talked me into going on a roller coaster with her.
Oh yeah? I'm guessing You're not a big fan of roller coasters?
Not at all. It was so scary. I hated it!
Aww I'm sorry you didn't like it. Roller coasters can be pretty scary, even for people like me who enjoy them.
After the hurricane last year my town was really damaged and it caused a lot of problems
I can only imagine the destruction and how horrible it is to deal with that!
Yes, my town was flooded from the surge, and the winds ripped alot of roofs off
I am very sorry to hear that. I hope for your sake that things are getting back to normal and the destruction is being taken care of.
Me and my kids picked up our new puppy the other day !
How wonderful. What sort of dog?
I get sentimental about my family, they mean a lot to me and I do not know what I would do without them
That's really sweet, I think most people feel the same way as you. Families are really important.
Next Spring Break we will be going on a cruise to Cozumel. We have never been on one before.
That's awesome. You must be excited. I've been to cancun but not cozumel.
We are so excited. My parents are taking us and my sisters family is going also. It is going to be so much fun.
You're not worried about the bad booze or kidnappings?
I look at my old facebook photos a lot
Oh yea I bet that brings back a lot of memories
I invested my saving in the stock market and lost it all.
Oh no! That's terrible. What made you choose that stock, and what will you do now?
I someone advising me who did not know what they were doing. I will have to try and save that money all over again.
You'll earn it all back, don't worry. For next time, though, don't listen to people who know nothing.
I remember one time when I was little I was running around in the basement when I wasn't supposed to be.
Gee that sounds fun, but did you get in trouble?
My older brother always makes promises he can't keep.
That is disappointing. I wonder why he's like that.
I am applying to grad school and I am hopeful I will get in.
What is your field ?
Hi, My girlfriend was recently let go of her job, but she put so much work in to finding a new job and got one with better pay!
That's great! It was meant to happen then
My girlfriend didn't want to go to dinner with me. She went with another guy instead.
That's awful, I'm sorry. Does she want to be with the other guy instead of you?
I'm not sure. I was so angry though. I really hope she explains it to me once she gets home.
I hope it all works out with you and your girlfriend.
A blue 67 mustang drove by earlier and it reminded me of the one my dad had when I was a kid.
That sounds like a classic car. Did you used to ride in it with your dad a lot?
I did, we worked on it a lot and took it street racing on the weekends. We had to hide it from my mother lol
Haha that's awesome! Sounds like you had a fun time with it!
Have you ever tried to steam clean an antique rug?
I have not, I feel like it should be done by a professional.
We'll I figured that out. I cleaned mine last night. They are clean but now they smell horrible!
Oh no! Probably tons of years of dirt caked into the rug. Did you use the right cleaner?
Probably not. I wish I would have just left them dirty. I have them airing out outside now.
Maybe the dirt adds to the whole antique feel of them.
My grandmother became sick recently so I have taken some time off work to nurse her.
Oh no! I'm sorry to hear that. I hope she gets better.
I lost my job last year and got really angry.
I am sorry to hear that. Did it happen out of the blue?
I just got home from vacation and there was an awful stench in my house. Turns out I forgot to take the trash out before I left
Oh that's not fun! I hope it cleared when you took it out!
When I finally realized what it was, I took out the trash then lit every candle I have and opened the windows
It should have cleared it. I once left bread for two weeks when I went home for winter vacation.
I am very satisfied with the way things are at work
I love to hear that, positive stuff! I'm glad for you.
I just bought a lawn mower because mine broke and the grass was getting so long. I barely had it 3 days when my shed was broken into and it was stolen! I'm so irate!
That is terrible. Some people ar just no good.
On a whim, I decided to buy a $1 lottery ticket, and to my surprise, I won $2 from that ticket. It was a small win, but I was very happy about it.
I can see why you'd be happy about it, I mean you doubled up even with it being a small amount! Where did you buy it?

I happened to stop at a gas station, and was planning to only purchase gas. However, I was thirsty, so I actually went into the convenience store and saw the lottery sign, which motivated me to buy a ticket.
Wow, I mean everything happens for a reason.. That's great!
I was going on a weekend to the lake but ended up getting sick.
That's unfortunate. Did you have the flu?
A really bad cold/cough. It definitely has me in bed. I was so looking forward to the fun time.
Your next adventure will go much smoother. I once got a really bad rash in Hawaii when I visited.
I'm going out of town next week, I think I have everything ready.
Did you remember extra underwear and your toothbrush?
Yes LOL thanks for the reminder!
Awesome, where are you going?
My grandmother was diagnosed with stage four cancer. I feel helpless.
Oh no, I am so sorry to hear that. That is awful and makes me sad. Have you talked to anyone about it?
I have spoken to our minister about the situation. It's hard to watch her go through this and there isn't much I can do. I can just love and take care of her.
That's what you need to focus on is just giving her all of your love, she will cherish it. I'm so sorry You're going through this, I hope that you can find peace with the situation.
Thank you for the kind words. It gives me hope for the future.
I am glad, I hope you have a great day today!
I was anxious when I went to the theme park
What about the them park made you anxious?
The roller coasters
They can be really scary for people who do not like them.
Oh, I am so sad that my family could not come and visit me. I miss them all so much. Why is life so busy for everyone these days?
I sure wish it wasn't. I live far from my family and they can't even make time for me to go to them. So I feel for you, it is very sad.
I just found out that my friend isn't really my friend at all.
That is bad. What happened?
She stole money from me!
Wow. Did you call the police?
I'm prepared tell my girlfriend's parent how much I love my girl
Oh that's exciting! Are you gonna propose or what?
Yes buddy, we have been friends since first grade and now it's time I take it to the next level :)
That sounds so nice, I wish I had a long term relationship like that!
Proud of my friend! He recently made a hockey team.
That's great. Is it his first year?
So okay, hear me out. I was at the post officer the other day and I had to wait in line for the ONE pen the post office seems to have. Why only one pen?
As we say around here, you ain't lying! How long were you waiting?
I'm feeling good about my math test.
That's always a good feeling. If you don't feel confident going in, You're in trouble!
Am so thankful to come home to a nice clean home
Did you clean the house yourself or hire someone to do it?
I accidentally dropped an expensive glass of wine at dinner with my girlfriends parents.
Oh no! What happened after?
I met this girl at a party one time and I totally thought she was into me, though I had no reason to really think so.
Oh really? Why is that? Seems like you were aware of it
I went to the Olive Garden for dinner tonight.
Did you have fun? What did you eat?
I was disgusted when my dad left me
Why did he leave you?
I'm not sure. I guess he just didn't want anything to do with me.
That's awful and there has to be another reason for it. I can't stand fathers who behave that way, despicable.
My daughter just competed in her first dance competition.
Oh how exciting! How did she do?
She got first place! And she was eve competing against much older girls.
Amazing, you must feel really proud!
I was so mad when I found out our dogwalker used to torchur my dog
Oh wow! I am so sorry that happened to you.
I was so excited about moving to the new house with my wife two days ago.
That is something to be excited about. How far away are you moving?
Last time I was at my parent's house I went through some old photo albums and started reminiscing.
What did you think about?
I just thought about how easy and carefree life was when I was a child. I was never alone and always had something to do.
Glad to hear you had such a carefree childhood. Do you have siblings?
I am going to a concert tomorrow.
That sounds like so much fun. What concert is it?
It's a Journey concert. I am so hyped!
Don't stop believin. I bet you'll have a great time!
My daughter is such a talented and creative young artist. When she was nominated to be 'Most Artistic' at school, I felt very secure she would win, because she really is amazing!
That's awesome. Did she?
My wife called me this morning and told me she scored a new job with Microsoft!
That's amazing! She must be excited.
She is so excited. She's even making more than I am.
Must be nice to have more income coming into the family.
My family threw a suprise get together for me!
That must have been so fun!
I am having my first baby; a boy. I hear all these different labor stories that aren't exactly reassuring!
Congratulations! If it helps at all, my wife and I have two young boys and both of her deliveries with very smooth! She said it wasn't as bad as she expected.

Aw, that's so neat. I would love two boys! I am having a boy! Oh good, that's another good story for me to hold onto. I'm not expecting it to be amazing or anything but wow, so many people say they almost died and things.
I think those types of situations are rather rare! The medical field has come a very long way. I'm sure you'll be fine and it'll all be worth it in the end.
