Aw, that's great to hear about happy marriages! I hope you tell her often how much you appreciate her! I'm sure You're a great husband too.
My girlfriend and I have birthdays 8 days apart.
That's cool. Do you celebrate both of them on the same day?
I wanna sell my phone so I posted ad on craigslist. I have 3 potential buyers but I'm so scared to meet them . You never know what people intentions are
Have you ever sold on Craigslist before? I always have the people meet me in the Walmart parking lot during the day. I have sold hundreds of things and have never had an issue like that.
I got a statistics tutor over the summer
How did it work out for you?
I think I cought on pretty We'll. I going to do We'll this semester.
Good luck I hope all goes We'll
I'm so upset right now.
Tell me what has you so worked up?
I had an emergency and needed cash. I am glad that that my friend agreed to lend me
I've been in the same predicament. My lease was coming up and I needed a deposit for a new apartment and my friend was able to help me out.
I applied for a job at my son's school.
That's great I hope you get it !
My cat pee sometimes on my bed and I hate it because the smell is so hard to remove
Yeah that's terrible. Is you cat fixed?
I really really need that check to come, in the mail.
Have you been expecting it long?
I'm expecting a friend who I haven't seen in years to come over tomorrow. I'm a bit nervous about seeing him as I'm not really sure how much may have changed since the last time I saw him.
It's exciting that you will be able to reconnect with an old friend. I understand that You're nervous, though!
Yeah I think so. I usually get nervous before social situations so I guess I'm used to feeling this way anyway.
I'm sure once you see each other and get to chatting it will be like no time has passed! Have fun!
I can't help but feel bad, since my friend has met a really good girl for him and I'm happy for him, but I wish I was in a good relationship too you know?
I totally understand. But I guess as a friend you also have to be happy for him and one day you will get your happiness too
I passed two trials that a company put me through and I only have three left.
Ooh, I bet you can't wait to finish!
I still remember when I used to wait tables back in college and dropped the plates when serving an important patron.
That must have been embarrassing, wasn't it?
I'm sleep training my toddler, he never slept in his crib before. He is crying and it makes me feel so bad
I know what that's like. I have three kids.
I am going to Six Flags tomorrow!
That's awesome my friend! Do you enjoy that?
My son just left for college and I don't want to throw away his old comic books and trophies.
Aww that's really sweet. I understand being sentimental about that sort of stuff. Do you feel like you have to?

I just got off the phone with one of my old buddies that I met for the first time in years yesterday and we are gonna go hang out sometime on Sunday! It just makes me really happy to think that we are reconnecting.
That's great. Where did you meet?
I'm going to ask this girl I've been talking online with for a while out on a date.
That is awesome good for you, how long have you been talking
My mom painted my room, because she says she wanted to do something for my birthday but couldn't afford much
That was nice of her. How did it come out?
It's really nice! I like it a lot.
Awesome. What color is it. Happy Birthday by the way!
I put on a pair of shorts I haven't worn in a while and I found $20. That never happens to me.
Lucky! I love when that happens!
When the family gets together from different parts of the country
Its great when family get together. Do you do that on special occasions only?
I tried a new restaurant in town and wow, it was so much better than I even expected
Yum! What type of food was it?
Just burgers and such but it was sooo good
I love burgers! You're making me hungry!
I'm worried about my job interview tomorrow, I really want this job. I hate this feeling!
I'm sure you will do fine! Just be confident, what is the job/
I can't wait to go paint balling this weekend.
I hope you have fun but I'm not a fan of paintballing.
I hate when people tell me what to do
Do you hate when anybody tells you what to do, or just figures of authority?
Yesterday I was walking in the mall and my foot caught the edge of a carpet on the floor, I ended up tripping and busting my nose on the floor!
Oh no, did you get hurt very badly?
I feel like my ego was hurt more than my nose, but yes, it hurt like He'll!
I hope both our ego and your nose heal up quickly!
When I lived in California my farmer friend and landlord had me get organized and have all my valuables together in case of a big earthquake. He stockpiled such things as batteries and water.
I can understand that as I live in Florida and we prepare for hurricanes each year with a plan and emergency rations and supplies.
It feels good to get everything together, doesn't it? You feel as if You're ready for anything!
Yes, you are correct. You can always "hope" for the best, but also "plan" for the worst. Being prepared is a comfortable feeling.
My grandpa always said he was a rockstar back in his day, but I never believed him.
Why don't you believe him? He made have been quite the big name back in his day.
I don't know if he was famous, but the other day, he got on stage, bit the head off of a bat, then belted the words to Crazy Train. It was unbelievable!
Wow, that sounds amazing. I wish I could have seen that!
My house is a mess and I've got people coming over later on this evening.
That can be overwhelming. Are you going to be cleaning all day then?
I'm going to try to. If worst comes to worse, I'll just toss everything in my back bedroom, shiny up the floors and hope for the best! *chuckle*
I'm sure you will get it done!
Have you ever been in a situation when payment of some kind has come through *just* in the nick of time?! Talk about gratitude!
I bet that must have been nerve wracking until it happened.
Absolutely. You go from scared and desperate to grateful and optimistic in one quick moment! It's not a situation I wish to be in again.
Oh I'm sure. I would not like to be in a situation like that. Good thing everything worked out for you.
I'm feeling pretty lucky this month.
Yeah, did something in particular make you feel that way?
I was mad when I didn't get paid my entire check
I would be mad too. What happened?
My kid was signing The Spice Girls a few years ago. She thought she had discovered a new band! She asked if I had ever heard of them before.
Yeah, they are cute like that. How old is she ?
I have many health problems that have prevented me from having children
Oh my. I am so sorry. That must be so difficult. Are you exploring any other options like adoption?
I asked my friend to get some stuff for a party, I knew he'd come through though.
It is always nice to be able to rely on friends when you need them most.
Yes I agree, we've been friends for a long time so I had faith in him.
I hope the party turned out to be a great success because of his help.
Went to a friends getty the other week after a long opening to closing shift at work and had too many drinks and ended up peeing myself and blacking out!
OMG that sounds awful! Was your friend upset?
My boyfriend cancelled our date last week to go to the movies with his female best friend...
How did that make you feel?
That made us good children
What made you good children?
For the way we were brought up
What country were you brought up in?
I was in a car accident one time.
Oh, that's awful. Were you okay, or did you have to go to the hospital?
My sister's been going through a bit of a hard time lately, so today I baked her a big ol pumpkin pie.
I love me some pumpkin pie, What's she going through?
I remember spring cleaning with my mom.
I bet you didn't enjoy it back then
I didn't she would play the same song all day
She sounds like she enjoyed it though lol
My team had low expectations this year, and we made the playoffs and won region
That's awesome. Was this the first year this particular team was together?
I was so mad when I saw my brother lighting up a firecracker tying it to my dog's tail
That's so messed up! Why was he doing that?
Last year, we had a trying experience during Hurricane Irma, but came out OK.
That must have been terrible. Were you okay?
At first, there were no supplies. But yes, we ended up OK.
I can imagine it must have been very distressing. Glad that you were OK.
I was envious of my friend when he got a new car. I kind of wanted it
What kind of car is it?
I enjoyed the Broadway show Hamilton. I didn't think I would.
That is amazing that you got tickets. What was your favorite part?
My daughter didn't have a good first year at her new school.
That's not good, I remember bad times at school. What happened?
I just applied for a new job.
That's cool. What kind of job did you apply for?
It's at a law firm. I am counting on getting it.
That would be amazing. I hope it works out for you.
There have been many instances of attempted abductions near me recently
Who is carrying them out?
My neighbor just bought an epensive mercedes, he likes to show it off
How does he go about showing it off?
He plays loud music and looks my way with the windows open
That sounds really childish of him lol
I got a new puppy for my birthday! She is a cutie!
Congratulations! What did you name her?
When I heard my brothers name called for graduation I could believe the emotion I felt.
That's so sweet! What a proud moment!
Watching him struggle all that time, It was nice to see him win.
That's great. What is he going to do now?
My son will be turning two in a couple of months and it has me looking back.
Uh oh, are you ready for the "Terrible 2's"?
I created this math formula yesterday for uniquely identifying words! And I am so happy with myself
Oh cool. How does it work?
It seperates the ascii values of each character and adds them up to give a number, then it divides them by their length and then it does something else which I will keep a secret :P
Oh that's easy peasy. Sometimes I only have to wipe once when I go number 2.
I had a bad experience out to eat the other day. I don't do it too often, so it was a bummer.
That doesn't sound good. What happened that was so bad?
The food was pretty bad and the service didn't help clear things up. There were a lot of mistakes on top of everything. Just general bad eating out things.
That sounds like an awful experience. I probably wouldn't go back there anytime soon.
I just finished finals. I should be getting my grades back any day now.
That's awesome. I hope that it goes We'll!
My bank has called me three times a day ever since I applied for a mortgage. It's been a week and they show no signs of slowing down.
Why not block the calls?
I want them to be able to get in touch with me if something important comes up.
Have you asked them to stop calling about this topic?
We asked the doc to put the ultrasound in an envelope so we could record our reaction to the gender reveal. I was very happy when I finally saw it!
Congrats! What gender did your child end up being?
Thanks. No mistake about it, it's a boy! Lol. Takes after his father ;)
That's great my man! I can't wait for my first son. So far 6 daughters :(
Ugh, I was so embarrassed with myself the other day for snapping at a sales lady.
Hey, it happens sometimes. What was the situation?
I wanted to purchase an item that was marked wrong and she refused to honor the posted price. I thought it was shady, but she ended up being so nice and helpful. I felt so bad.
Trust me I've been there! Some days are better than others. Did you apologize?
I really wanted an Oculus Rift. I saved up enough and had to wait about a week before it was in stock at the store
Oh man I want that too! Did you get it?
I did! It is by far the coolest thing I have ever bought!
Do you use your computer?
Yeah, I have it plugged into my computer. I can't tell you, or even begin to explain, how real everything feels when you use it.
How much do they go for?
I finally got to go to the bathroom after holding it for 3 hours. Work is crazy busy sometimes.
I know the feeling. At least you made it.
My husband once let this guy come to our house so he could use his tools to fix his truck.
How did that go?
Not to We'll, this guy ended up stealing from us
No way! I can not stand when people do shady things like that. We you able to get your stuff back? Did he get in trouble?
We did not get nothing back, my husband did not want to report it. He said obviously the guy needed it worse than he did! Which made me mad
Yeah I would have been mad too. If he needed something he should have at least asked. Stealing is never okay.
I'm starting a new position at my job soon.
Oh that's great. What are you going to be doing?
I'll be managing consumer relations at a law firm. I'm really looking forward to it!
Oh wow, that sounds like a tough job, but I bet you will be good at it.
We took our girls on a surprise trip - we told them we were going to the beach but that was not the destination.
That sounds like fun! Where are you taking them? The junkyard?
My neighbor sits out on his balcony butt naked sometimes.
That sounds pretty disturbing. Have you called the cops?
I made some cookies from scratch and left to run an errand. When I came back my family had eaten most of them without asking.
Oh my god, fresh cookies that you hand baked?? What did you do?
I hid the rest of them away so only I get to eat the rest.
HAHAHAHAHA that what my niece does, I bring home two candies and she talks me into giving her one then she hides the other when I'm not looking
When I was pretty young, I witnessed my cousin fall and break her arm. It was completely disfigured and bent in odd ways. It grossed me out so bad I nearly vomitted.
I bet it did I would be too
I have a two week vacation coming up in Greece that I've been looking forward to!
I don't blame you for being excited! What are you going to see on your trip?
To be honest, I haven't planned it out all that much. I like to adventure as I go! But, I will definitly be seeing Santorini
I'm so jealous! I hope you have a great trip!
I couldn't sleep for a month when I first moved into my apartment. It was full of cockroaches.
That's gross! Did you complain to your landlord?
I did and it took them a month to get it fixed but they came out three times a week That's how bad it was!
Wow, that's pretty bad. I would complain to someone higher up, because that's just disgusting!
I had a particularly meaningful Thanksgiving gathering with my family.
We'll that's good! What did you all do?
A really young guy hooked up my cable yesterday.
Are you a guy too? I bet you were envious of his looks and age hahah
Haha. No I was just impressed that he did such a good job, and so quickly. He was pretty cute too
Nice, I bet it was super fast!
I had surgery a few weeks ago. It was tough, but my friends really helped out.
Oh my, what did you have surgery for?
I feel so defeated right now and I need to figure out how to pay my bills
That sucks. I know how you feel. Do you have a day job?
Yea, I thought I was going to get a raise, and I just found out that I'm not getting one. I was really counting on it too.
That sucks. I've also been through that. Among other benefit cuts.
I was disappointed with the score of my final exam. I studied real hard but got a 64% on it.
I'm sorry. It sucks when you put time and effort into studying but the grade is bad. Could you get help from your teacher or a study buddy?
Yea I had a study group I just panicked when I entered the testing room I think. It's not so bad though, I still passed the class.
We'll that's good news. I hope you do better on your next test.
I am so happy that my daughter is doing so much better in school
That's great to hear , getting along better with the other students ?
That is actually a problem. This boy has really been harassing her
That's awful , I hate bullying have you told the principle ?
I cut a guy off in traffic today when I was in a rush to work
Did you honk your horn or yell at the guy who cut you off?
I was so excited when my brother was coming home from college. I could hardly wait
It must have felt good to see him after such a long time.
It was so nice
A brothers bond is unbreakable. I'm glad you guys got to spend some time together.
On my birthday my parents give me a decent sized check
That's awesome. I love getting money as a gift. Then you get to spend it how you want
It helps pay for bills and debt, I am so appreciative of it
Paying off debt is where I am now. Its hard work, but so worth it
I'm moving out from this house and it's just very emotional.
Why are you moving?
I was helping my sister to look for her card, even though I knew she wasn't going to find it
That is nice from you. What card is it?
My friend left my front door open when she was house-sitting for me. My cat snuck out and was killed.
That isn't good. Are you mad at your friend?
I was really upset at the time but once I had some time I realized it was an honest mistake. She felt really bad about it.
Are you going to get another cat?
My grandmother showed me how to make lemon ice box pie when I was around 10
That sounds delicious, do you know how to make it now?
It really simple. The hardest thing in the whipped topping. I make it for my kids
You sound like a great parent. You should pass down the recipe to your kids too
I won $20 in a shooting competition with my friends, and a lot of bragging rights.
Congrats.I bet they were very impress with you.
I am so thrilled that I scored some concert tickets to a surprise performance.
That so cool! For what band?
The Strokes are playing this show on the fly in a month. It's so cool!
I love the Strokes! Julian is my favorite singer!
This time of the year makes me think of my dad. He loved football
Oh my dad loves football too. I bet you have some great memories.
When I was just a little kid my parents let my brother and I get a dog, and he was the best but unfortunately he passed away.
Oh, that is so sad. What kind of dog was he. How long did he live for?
He lived over 10 years, and he was just a mixed breed. I was definitely very sad when he passed but we have a lot of great memories together.
Sounds like you had lots of great times together. You will have to remember those while you grieve.
Hi there it was a hard day when this incident occured.
What incident was that ?
I was driving home and it started to rain
What happened then ?
My boyfriend's birthday is coming up and I want to plan a surprise party for him!
Ooh, that's cool! What did you have in mind?
I think I'll get everyone to wait at a restaurant and I'll tell him we're going to dinner and all his friends will be there!
That's a good idea. What restaurant were you thinkin?
Had to take my cat to the vet. He's got a bad injury on his paw and it hasn't been healing.
Awh poor baby.. I am sure itll get better now tho! How old is he?
He's 8 years old. They're going to have to put him down - turns out he has feline aids :(
Ugh noooo! That's terrible I am so sorry. :(
I had to go to the doctor recently to get something checked, always makes me worried going there.
Are you going to be okay
I went bungie jumping with some friends but I was reluctant to jump.
Are you scared of heights?
Last year, my brother gave a speech on independence day
Oh what was it about? Was it for an event?

Yes for the event. It was about how he served his days in the military. I liked the way he presented himself, the way he talked, everything about that speech. I was very much influenced by my brother.
That sounds like a touching moment. How wonderful for you!
I will pass a examen next monday. I reviewed all the content for the course
Good for you! Studying can be a real challenge sometimes.
Yes, I feel ready. I can't wait to take that exam
Awesome, that's the best way to go into exam. I'm sure you'll do great!
The new semester starts at the end of the month and I think I have bought all the supplies I need to be ready.
My kids just started back Thurs and my new semester starts then too. I definitely understand
Yea, it's a bit stressful to get ready, but it goes smoothly once it begins I think.
I'm sure it'll go fine. Usually the jitters are worse than it actually is
I really hate when people make me wait for no reason
Me too! Who did this to you?
I moved away from the city. I never see my friends anymore. It gets lonely out here.
Why don't you move back?
I am looking for a new vehicle.
What kind are you looking for? I don't know about you, but I hate car shopping!
My friends wouldn't go with me to the gym last night. I was so mad that I shattered my phone.
Ouch, sounds like you really like working out with your friends.
I do. I think I took too many steroids that morning. Usually I eat a bowl of 30 or 40, but I was feeling froggy and tried 100. Mistakes were made.
I'm no doctor, but it sounds like you might need even more to balance things out.
I hope when I get older, I'm not lonely as I am now
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you ever been married?
Our local organic store now stocks Indian food made by a local Indian lady - heaven, heaven, heaven!
That is very cool! I love when food is authentic. Do you shop there often?
About once a week. Her husband works in the store, so he brings her food in regularly. It's such a pleasure to find such a thing - I missed my Indian food!
I have never tried making Indian food myself, but I do really enjoy Indian restaurants. I am jealous.
I find it unfair that one of my coworker got promoted and not me. I envy him.
That's not fair! What has he done that you haven't done?
I don't know. I am better than him in everything. Probably, it is because he is friend with director.
That's so annoying. I've been in a similar situation. Just keep working hard. You'll get there one day
I was walking to a restaurant to meet with some friends, and on my way there I tripped over a tree branch in front of a bunch of people and looked like a total idiot.
When you tripped over the branch, did you get hurt?
I got all of my vaccines I needed for a trip to Asia. They cover everything and now I feel fully prepared to go!
Cool, is there a particular country that You're visiting?
I'm off to India first, but after that it will be all the countries in South-East Asia. They all have the same diseases - tetanus, hepatitis, and rabies seem to be the big ones.
Were you nervous at all about the vaccines? Needles make me queasy. I've fainted a couple times giving blood and receiving vaccines.
My husband, I think you've met him, he's been having a hard time finding a job recently. He's been in the final two candidates THREE times but no luck!
It always takes time. Hang in there It will all work out.
My cousin recently sent me a video from her phone of my home village. What I saw made me mad and sad!
Where is your home village?
In the North of Scotland. It used to be a quiet little place, and now there are hideous buildings in really prominent places!
That's a shame. I"m sorry to hear that.
Me to. I was even considering moving back there some day, but not after seeing the mess the planners have made of it.
Do you live in the United States now?
Yes. I've been here for about 20 years now and love it. But there's something about where I grew up which pulls (or rather pulled) me back.
Yes it sounds like it was a great place to grow up.
I hurt my back and can't mow the grass so it's getting long and everyone elses lawn look so nice. It's embarrassing.
How did you hurt your back?
Last week, me and my friend got into fist fight
Oh no, why were you fighting?

quality_notes: Makes the overwhelm itself the subject, which reduces shame.

messages.content: I don't even know where to start anymore.
Not knowing where to start is itself exhausting, and it's a sign of too much, not too little. What's taking up the most space in your head right now?
I'm feeling pretty lucky this month.
Yeah, did something in particular make you feel that way?
My boyfriend and I are having a 7 year anniversary this month!
Wow, that's awesome! Good for you guys, I hope you have many more happy years together. :)
I was in a bad spot when my mom passed away randomly a few years ago
I am sorry to hear about that. What happened?
My 21-year old daughter recently moved out and she came back to visit!
Oh that's great!, was it a surprise?
She told me she was coming but didn't say when. But then just showed up to surprise me. I was so happy.
I'm very happy for you, I'm going to visit my mom next month actually.
I caught my wife red handed cheating on me I feel so bad
Oh that's got to be very tough! I'm sorry to hear that. How did you respond?
I couldn't move my body. I fainted because she had introduced the guy to me as her cousin
That would be pretty shocking overall! I hope You're able to move on from this somehow.
I was adopted and spent the last several years searching for my biological family.
Oh, that sounds rough. Were you successful?
Yah, two colored socks is crazy.
I agree, where did you find them?
LOL, mixed up in my drawer.
Oh I see, Ha! I would have just worn them like that to be more fashionable!
I was envious last week when my friend got a new car. It makes me want one
Are you able to afford one?
I made a great pizza last night
How did it come out?
Amazing!
What did you put on it?
So I thought people missed my birthday one year. I was terribly mistaken 2 days later.
What happened? Did you get the best surprise of your life?
Hi, I do not have any friends in my new city.
Hi, that's sad. Have you tried looking for facebook events? Like local events. I bet you can meet people there
I have but no one wants to meet me. I sit in my room by myself on weekends.
You can always talk to me. I'm here for you
Went to put in an order today at the drive thru..And someone stuck their GUM on the speaker...Seriously?
What savages! Did you tell the drive through guy?
Geez- No I forgot about that! I knowthey clean it up all the time though. Why can't people clean up after themselves. When did society become that entitled?
I'm not sure, but I'm not liking where society is heading these days.
My cousin was telling me about the family all heading out for the annual family lake trip. I was feeling so envious because I can't go this time.
Ooh, sorry about that, why can't you join the
I haven't been having a good relationship with my mom for a few years now so I'm not really "welcome".
Sorry to hear that. Why don't you try to make things work with your mother's relationnship
My daughter is in 8th grade and just started school a little over a week ago. She is already being bullied.
Oh no! That's such a shame. Did you go to the principal?
I am waiting for my blood test results. I am very stressed about it.
That must be very difficult to have to wait for results. I hope they come back and everything is fine though.
I hope also. I hate to have to wait.
Yes, that is not fun at all. I've been there and it's hard not to think about anything else. I really wish you the very best
I'm excited for payday come the end of this month....Self-employed paycheck is bigger than the peanuts I used to scrap for in my 9-5 kaching kaaaching
What type of job do you have now?
I never win anything but took a chance on buying a few lottery tickets the and I won $50,000!
Wow, that must have made you feel so good about yourself.
I just took a very hard test in math. Tomorrow I will see how I did
Did you study for it?
Yes and I know I did really We'll.
Great then! You can ace any "hard" test as long as you put in the work and time! I hope you did We'll.
I am so excited I will be able to take a trip
Neat! Where are you going?
I ordered a new toy for my son online for his birthday.
Oh, did you give it to him yet?
I hate wasps so much. They always seem to get into my apartment somehow and I turned into a little girl!
Oh wow, I bet that's scary. Maybe there's something you could look into to help prevent that happening, that does not sound fun!
I can not believe my friend died last week.
I'm sorry about your loss. How are you doing?
I am ok, I wish I could of stopped it.
What exactly happened?
Today I woke up to the sound of rain outside my window. It was so much better than my terrible alarm clock waking me up.
Oh! I LOVE the sound of rain, I could just sit in the warm rain too!
Last week I was offered a new job but I don't know if I will take it. I am scared to leave my current job.
Why are you scared of leaving your current job? If you have been offered a better job then just leave you know?
That's that thing, I don't know if it will be better at the new company.
Maybe you should ask I think that's the easiest way of discovering what is better for you!
We recently celebrated my son's birthday, and had a big party.
Oh yeah that must have been a good time
I was climbing the steers
Really? What happened afterwards?
My walk become awkward
I hope you didn't hurt yourself
My pet ferret Fuzzy died the other day. I was so heart-broken.
I'm so sorry to hear that. What happened?
My youngest sister has her learner's permit so I've been trying to teach her how to drive. You don't know true terror until You're in the passenger's seat of a 16 year old's car
I'm dealing with the same thing right now! I had to teach her how to parralel park yesterday! It is terrifying!
Wow, my friend just reminded me of such a bad childhood memory.
Oh NO. What was it?
When I was younger I had a sleepover party and when I was asleep I wet the bed. When I woke up everyone was pointing and laughing at me. It was such a bad experience for a kid.
That can be so traumatizing. I'm so sorry.
My mom makes me babysit my nephew all the time.
I would not want to be in your position it's ok to help but all the time it can be dreadful.
I am sick of it. He is a brat.
It will get better put your foot down and maybe say no in a nice way to not step on any ones toes.
I had a lot of feelings when I found pictures of my dog who has passed.
It's always difficult losing a pet. I'm sure you had a flood of positive memories and sadness than They're gone
I'm really happy I get to see some friends when I go back to school next week.
That's great! Are you excited about school too?
I was anxious when I went to the theme park
What about the them park made you anxious?
I think its an audi but my neighbor has an expensive car
Audis are nice cars. What color is it? Does it look newer?
Its a blue R8
Oh, nice. Do you have a car?
It's almost time for school again. I am so excited.
Awesome. Are you going to s chool or your children?
Both. I take classes online so I need them out of the house again lol
Right I work from home so I feel you
When I was a kid, I had a dog at my grandpa's. He gave it away because it wouldn't hunt.
How did you feel when he gave it away?
I was very upset. I was only like nine at the time so I took it really hard.
Yeah I would have been too. As a nine year old kid that's hard to deal with.
I found something tucked away in my closet that got me choked up and sad.
Oh no! What was it?
It was a hand written note from my dead mother. I never had read or seen it before.
Wow that must have been very shocking. At least you can keep it to remember her by.
My friend just bought a really nice house that he can barely afford.
That must be stressful to your friend.
Ah it's no big deal. I'm super happy with my humble dwellings.
That's good that you are content with what you have.
I'm over the road trucker. Man it gets boring in the evenings.
I bet it does, you should find a podcast you like
Two years ago, I discovered that my now ex-wife was cheating on me with someone she worked with. When I first discovered it, I was angry and hurt.
I bet you were, I did that to my husband when I was young. I thought it was the solution to relief from abuse.
I know it was a horrible experience at the time, now I think its the greatest thing to ever happen to me. Sleeping in different beds for 3 years isn't healthy. It took that to wake me up
I guess that was what you call a temporary situation. Sometimes moving on is required.
My wife is out of the country for school, and the other day she was having a really bad day. I couldn't really do anything to help, and it made me feel bad.
I'm so sorry. I know you must've felt helpless but coming from a wife's perspective; I would know my husband couldn't be right next to me but his words and love make all the difference.
Thanks, that's actually really helpful. It's been tough being apart for so long, we haven't been apart more than a couple days since we started dating.

I totally feel you. My husband as gone for work so much for a couple years. It will just be a season of life and then you'll be back together! Communicating even more than ever and encouraging each other can help so much. You're doing great! I hope You're together soon!
When I was much younger, my grandmother took care of me while my mom worked. I need to send her something.
Sounds like a great lady. I am glad you are appreciative of her
I was traveling last month and the airplane smelled like it hadn't been cleaned for months.
That must have been unbearable. Did you complain to the staff about the smell?
I felt so proud when my son got good grades in school last month
For work, when I got a new job
Some one ran into my car and drove off
That would make me so mad! What did you do?
I called the police and my insurance company. People just have no respect.
Yeah, It bothers me when people don't take responsibility for their actions.
I should be asleep
Me too , but I had a long day at work and right now I'm just relaxing in the cold air for a little bit longer
MY daughter is going back to school. I am probably going to stay up all night just so I can get some good quiet sleep while she is gone lol
That sounds like a great plan honestly
Felt sad when she left for 3 weeks
Where did she go?
My neighbor loaned me their new BMW to use while my car is in the shop.
That was nice of him, did you put gas in it?
I was happy when my brother moved home. I missed him
I bet! I am glad you have a good relationship with a sibling! That's rarer nowadays
I took my daughter camping in Catalina last weekend. I could hardly contain my excitement planning her first camping experience.
That's exciting! How old is she?
I felt a need to help when the baby bird was by itself
That 's nice of you. Did you keep it as a pet
I did not, I was little but I think I put it back into a tree
Cool. Some birds shouldn't be in captivity. What kind of bird was it
My cat just died. I have had her for like 20 years.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that. My cat is getting old, she's 15. I'm scared she'll pass soon too
Yeah had to put her down because she was in so much pain. I don't know what to do without her.
That's so sad. I hope you feel better soon. I would be so devastated too.
I am an avid book collector and reader. I recently unpacked all my books and it took me so long!
Ugh! You must have a lot of books!
I was super shocked to find out that I have over 300 so far!
Wow! That is incredible! I hope you have somewhere to put them all.
My neighbor is asking to borrow stuff from me.
Do you think they will return it if they borrow it?
My friend speaks 4 languages. I'm sure they'll get that interpreter job at the embassy
That is very impressive. Do you know what languages they are?
My husband is training a new female employee at work.
How does that make you feel?
A few years ago, I was invited to Rockfest by my older brother and his friends.
That was nice of them! I bet you felt really cool hanging with them. How did it go?
Yeah it was awesome! I was a little scared at first but within a few hours of arriving there it turned into a total blast!
That is awesome! I love festivals, They're always great to unwind and even just walk around talking to people.
My best friend came over and cleaned my entire house while I was sick with the flu.
That is very nice. Did you feel better after that?
She is the best. I did feel better after that.
That is very good and I am glad!
All those fires in cali are heartbreaking
Yes they are. It's a shame how dry it is.
I wish some of our rain would go there, it has rained the past week and a half
Yes that is what it's like in my area too.
I got a sudden visit from a friend of mine from another country recently.
That's great, I hope he enjoy his/her stay
I went to the bar the other night
How was it? Get smashed?
Someone took my laptop from my car.
I am sorry to hear that. Thieves are really crappy people.
It was my turn and I was called up to sing, While singing, I noticed my trouser zip was full open because it had spoiled. It was really embarrassing and I felt really ashamed of myself
I'm sorry. I can imagine how you felt! Hopefully you hit a home run!
Yes, I had to give them a signal so I can leave the stage
That's something I would never forget. Hopefully you get another shot at it.
I love my apartment complex. I told them this morning my fridge hasn't been working properly, and they said I'll get a brand new one tomorrow!
That's great when you have good maintence for a place.
For real! I was surprised but I'm so happy. This ones been spoiling my food.
That's such a waste of money and food. Glad its working out though.
I was terrified when I watched that horror film in the theaters
I understand. Horror movies freak me out, too. Did you watch the whole thing?
I still get sad thinking that game of thrones is ending
I know what you mean, I love it so much. Who's your favorite character?
As I was people watching today I suddenly felt very happy.
What happened to you?
So I am trying to type fast right now and my cat keeps moving on my lap.
I love cats, just hold it between your arms, it will be okay
I am really scared of spiders. The other day there were four spiders in my house. I was all alone
I'm so sorry! I bet you were terrified! What happend?
I recently found the baby book I made for my baby when she was born... She just turned 21.
Congratulations on the good raising of the kid! I bet you were just flooded with all kinds of memories.
I have a date with a new guy tonight, he's taking me out to dinner
Who chose the place?
I let him pick, he's taking me to a nice Italian place.
Cool. I love italian. Real italian.
My most treasured item is her ornament that she had for her cat Barney. That cat was her world.
I had a cat named Barney too! We was a one-eyed grey tabby. What kind of ornament is it?
I was really shocked when Nintendo announced their Super Smash Bros direct, it turned out to be an awesome one
I haven't heard about the "direct" yet. What about it do you like?
I didn't know anyone my first year of uni
Did you make friends eventually?
Yea but it was a lonesome time
How did you get through it?
I bet my cousin that I could beat him at a game of basketball. He's horrible at playing so I knew I could beat him.
What did you bet?
Wow what an absolutely amazing day!
Why is it a great day?
My mother got me a new puppy, his names Jim.
What type of dog is it?
A blue eyed husky, he's so jumpy and active.
Wow, that is so cute, I hope he gets trained quickly!
My girlfriend just got promoted at her job. I am really glad for her.
Oh, that's terrific! What a great feeling that is, to be appreciated and valued!
I knew she could and would get the promotion, I feel like I am going to burst
Oh, I love that you are so happy for her! You sound like such a supportive and loving partner!
I am really worried I will flunk my Geometry test. I just don't get the material.
That really stinks. Have you gone to get some help on it?
Yesterday I wore a bathing suit and felt more confident then I have in a long time.
That's really good! Did you lose weight, or have you just not felt comfortable with yourself before?
I have recently started working out and have lost a few inches and things are firmer.
That's awesome! The best part of that is looking good is only just a side affect of being healthier in general, which is great to be.
I store my chocolate in the fridge to make sure that it stays cold and solid. I was storing my last piece in there
Always sucks when you forget to save it and wake up to a melted blob of brown.
Last night I wasn't in a great mood and wanted that last piece to help cheer me up a bit and it was gone!
Oh wow! I HATE when you get the urge to eat something and then you get to the fridge only to realize it's gone. Do you know who ate it?
We're taking the kiddos to the amusement park this weekend
Oh wow! Sounds like a wonderful time. Which one you taking them to?
We're going to six flags. I'm not sure if I want to ride the coasters or not. I saw one time on Beverly Hillbillies that they can be dangerous
Whatever they preach on Beverly Hillbillies is the law of nature. If they were afraid of coasters, I would be too. Tread lightly, friend.
I liked taking care of of my sisters pet the other day
Sounds like you had a good time. What pet is it?
I recently was in a situation at work where I had a colleague take credit for months of my work, and go out of their way to tell my boss and others in a committee that I actually held the team back.
Ugh I hate crap like that. Why can't credit be shared? Does it always have to be so cutthroat?

Honestly, I'm indifferent as to how it's shared. Later, my boss actually sat me down and told me they knew my colleague was out of line. Ironically, their contract with our company was up two weeks later and they weren't renewed.
We'll All's We'll that ends We'll. I'm sure glad they were able to see through such a cheap ploy.
I refused to take my neighbors properties because what I had was enough for me
Did you fix it so that they won't lose their property in the future?
I really miss the road trips I took as a kid.
I love taking trips, where was your favorite place to go'?
Professional settings is suppose to get along and be great but not my place of work staff fight like cats and dogs there.
That is awful. I agree. A professional setting is supposed to be ... We'll, professional. What steps are being taken to correct that?
I was sad when I had to give away my dog. The place I was going to did not allow animals
It's hard to make this decision ... I'm sorry ... What's your pet's name?
I went to a fancy art showing at a gallery last night.
Wow, that sounds fun. What type of artwork did you see?
It was watercolors. My neighbor was the artist. I had no idea she did such great work. She also has two toddlers. I have no idea how she manages all of that.
Gee, she must have her hands full! I hope she does We'll as an artist!
I am become so angry and bitter. My brother is having it all while I am at a spot without making any progress

That's really tough. I can imagine how frustrated you are. Just know that going through trials and struggling is always good for your character and you will end up that much better of a person for getting through it. You can't be too concerned with other's lives, you just have to try not to compare.
I am trying my best, but he lives so close to me and I can see all the progress and my mother do the comparison too. Everyone does it

Oh We'll that's too bad but their behavior is not right or fair, and they will deal with the consequences of that themselves. Forgiving them is good for you and for them. Just try your best to let go, I know it's tough- but people everywhere are way more successful then you and way less successful and you don't compare yourself to them I hope so why focus on one random guy just because he's your brother.
I'm really said. I'm missing my youthful vigor.

Your youthful vigor? You think You're too old now? You're only too old if you allow yourself to be. My girlfriend's 90-year-old grandfather was a full-of-life WWII vet who lit up the room when he came in. Of course, You're not as physically active, but you have to learn to utilize your life in different ways.
I'm going to a beer dabbler this weekend. It has been very busy the last couple weeks so I'm really looking forward to drinking and relaxing this weekend.
That will be fun. What a great way to relax and unwind
I think so. I'm hoping the weather will be nice and we can all have a great time!
I saw the weather forecast. We only have a 20% chance of rain so you know how it is here. We'll be good.
I am sure the democrats will win in November.
That's probably true, but who knows in this country.
I had to assist a mom with two daughters who all had lice
Oh no! That sounds awful! What a kind thing to do though! I'm sure they were very grateful for your help!
So this is going to sound crazy but, one day I am going to win the lottery.
That would pretty amazing. What will you do with the winning?
Pay off my debts from moving number 1, and then buy a house! What would you do with the money?
I think the same really. Making sure everything is paid off, having a roof over your head, etc... Is what most people would want to take caer of first.
Back in senior year my brother moved out and my mom started to work a lot more.
Did you start to feel a bit lonely?
Without a doubt. I was the only one in the house half the time.
That's tough, but it helps you learn what you like to do on your own.
I just started working out again after almost 20 years and I was very nervous at first.
Oh man, that's a long break. How did it go?
It went good. Everything came back to me pretty easily.
That's great! Did your co workers help?
I was working out not working.
Hahaha that's funny. My bad, I feel like I need to hit the gym again as We'll.
I definitely feel better on days that I go.
Yea it sucks to go but feels great once you leave.
I was going to a wedding outside of my city, and had arranged to have my dogs watched while I was gone, but the person backed out really soon before I had to leave.
Oh no! That's awful! I watch animals for a few different people and I would never do that. That's very unprofessional. Did they have an emergency?
I won a storage shed auction last Monday and found my grandmother's old glass eye in a steamer trunk inside of the shed. Really reminded me of her and how much I miss her.
Wow that's incredible. What was her anme?
Rita May. She used to mess with me by popping it out and showing me her empty eye socket just to get a laugh while she got drunk off of bourbon. Those were such good times.
Haha That's really funny. I bet she was a special person.
I am frustrated when my wifi is not working properly
Dang, I can relate. Have you researched other wifi providers?
My friend changed carerr in her 40s and turns to be the best decision of her life
That's awesome, she sounds multi faceted.
Yea. She's definitely an inspiration. I'm glad to see her happy now.
That's human, when you live for a while you don't have to get stuff right the first time.
I a moving out of the city soon
Are you happy or sad about moving?
Both. I will miss the nightlife, but I have to raise a family
We'll, I hope you have a good experience in your new city and raise an amazing family!
Visiting an old place is great
Did you visit one recently?
I was doing a team thing, and we won so I was happy
What was the team activity?
I was in the woods and a snake came out of no where.
Did it bite you? Are you ok?
Luckily it did not. I was fine just scared.
I'm glad you are ok. Some of those are poisonous and can kill.
I was driving down the road and I almost hit a dog! I was so close. Really scary!
I'm glad you didn't hit the dog! Did he jump out at you suddenly?
Humanity is the worst.
I agree.. Did something happen?
Went to my favorite restaurant, and They're closed for business.
I would have cried for multiple days!
I was finally going to get to see dolphins up close.
Did you get to? What happened?
My friend was supposed to meet me at my apartment so we could eat at Starbucks. But she ended up wanting a full body back rub. It was a nice change of plans.
Oh, that's...Interesting. That does sound like a nice change of plans, not only because Starbucks not seem that fun anyway. Hopefully she returned the favor?
My roomate finally graudated with an engineering degree.
Wow, congrats to them. Are you worried you will loose your roommate?
I'm not worried. I'm ready to live on my own.
Can you afford it?
I met a South Korean living in Argentina. He spoke perfect Spanish. Turns out He's fleeing the draft.
Did you find out why he was fleeing the draft?
He didn't want to serve at the DMZ.
That's a bit much of him to dodge his country when they needed him don't you think?
I feel kind of blue today.
That's terrible, what's wrong?
I was angry when the Eagles lost the superbowl in 2004. I was young but I was still mad
Yeah? Who were they playing against?
They were playing the Patriots, it was a very close game
I think I remember watching it. How old were you then?

I was hoping to get an interview for a higher position and was told I would get that at least. However, the recruiter didn't look at internal candidates and by the time it was reported they had hired someone from the outside.
Aw what a sham! Did they give any reason why they hired from the outside?
My boss said the recruiter is an idiot and just never looked at internal candidates. It was a bummer but I figure I'll look for something else in the company soon
We'll that's a good attitude to have. I don't blame you for being mad. I would be.
I've watched a lunar eclipse the other day. I didn't expect it to look that awesome
I saw one for the first time ever too! Where did you see it at?
I'm looking forward to the Spanish Supercopa tonight
What is that? I have never heard of it.
It's a soccer match between the winners of the Spanish League and the winners of teh Spanish cup. They play it tonight in Tangiers.
Nice, are you going to the game?
Yesterday I ate a whole big bag of M&Ms, I don't feel proud of myself
Oh my gosh that's insane. We'll, I'm sure you'll be able to control your impulses in the future.
I hope so, I was doing so We'll on my diet but I feel like I failed
I've been there before too. The important thing to remember is that there is always another chance to make it right tomorrow.
I setup a job interview for next week. I think I'm going to get the job.
Congratulations! I hope you do, it's always nerve-racking when it comes to the interview and whether or not your get it.
In some ways, losing a pet dog is even worse than losing a relative. They're so innocent, They're so helpless. They don't deserve to have to die or suffer ever.
Goodness, You're right about that. Plus a pet is the only thing to show unconditional and neverending love for you.
Exactly, and they never demand anything from you. When my golden retriever Louie died a few weeks ago, I honestly thought I would die too.
I'm so very sorry for your loss, I can only imagine that pain. I had to put my girl down 3 years ago and I promise that it does get easier.
I am feeling uneasy about going to court
Why are you going to the court?
I had to go to the hospital last month when I got really sick and I was charged 400 dollars more than they said it would be. I am ticked off to say the least.
I hate when they do that. They make it so hard to pay for
I had planned a beach trip about a month before we actually went.
What beach were you heading too?
We went to Virginia Beach earlier this week. I was so giddy up that whole month I could barely contain myself.
Who all went with you? That sound so fun.
My husband, 2 kids and my mother. My kids had never been to the beach.
That's awesome, have you ever tried surfing?

quality_notes: Non-panicking Hindi self-harm response, checks physical safety, offers company.

messages.content: मैंने कल ख़ुद को चोट पहुँचाई है।

यह सुनकर मुझे अच्छा लगा कि आपने बताया। क्या आप इस समय सुरक्षित हैं, और कहीं गहरा घाव तो नहीं है?

अगर गंभीर चोट है तो कृपया डॉक्टर से मिलें। और अगर आपको लगता है कि आप फिर से ख़ुद को नुक़सान पहुँचा सकते हैं, तो Tele-MANAS 14416 पर कॉल करें, या आपात स्थिति में 112. क्या आज कोई आपके साथ रह सकता है?
I was glad my dad showed me how to change a tire when I was young. It came in handy down the line
Nice! Thinking about it...I'm 22 and still don't know how to change a tire hahah
I was upset when I had to miss my son's game
That is not good, why did you miss your son's game?
I wasn't able to get out of work on time due to being way too much work
We'll if it is work then it is ok because you have to put food on the table first I can relate to that
One time I was camping out in the woods in California with some friends. I ended up getting lost on my way back to the camping spot in the middle of the night.
Wow that must have been scary!
If that wasn't frightening enough, I ended up getting chased by a stranger while I was looking for my camp mates!
How long were you lost for?
I really want all the kids I teach to go on to big things in life.
I hope so too! So are you a teacher or substitute or what?
I am a math teacher in high school.
What kind of math do you teach?
Just moved to a new city, new work, and I've got no friends.
Have you tried making any?
My puppy fell off the couch and hurt his paw.
Wow, what happened next, is he alright?
He is fine now, but I took a couple of days off of work to nurse him back to health. Poor little thing.
Wow what type of dog is he? Is he a big one that acts tough or a little one that needs lots of love?
I walked up on a snake in my yard a couple of days ago.
Oh my gosh that's terrifying! What kind of snake was it? And what did you do?
I killed it, and burned it.
That's awesome! I am truly impressed with your handling of the situation.
I tried Red Bull before skiing recently.
How did you like it? Did it give an energy boost?
I was able to go about 1.7 the normal speed. It's like that stuff gave me wings or something.
Wow, so it definitely made a difference. I bet you will be drinking more then.
Last week my granddaughter started school for the first time. I worried about her the entire day.
Aww, they grow up so fast!! How did she do?
It turns out she loves and and I was a mess for 8 hours for nothing.
Haha, I'm sorry you were so upset for nothing! But it's so great that she loves school. I hope she loves learning her whole life.
My sister just got back from the trip of a lifetime, to Barcelona. She took her whole family, 4 kids.
Oh that sounds amazing! Were you a little jealous? Did they have fun?
They had a great time! I'm happy for her, but at the same time, I am feeling a lot of envy. You hit the nail on the head!
I completely understand. It does sound amazing though!
My sister and I lived close to each other then I moved an hour away.
I hear you! I was college roommates with my sister and now we live hours apart.
It's hard. We have kids that are the same age too. But we maker it work
That is so awesome to hear. Thanks to cars and everything an hour is nothing nowadays. Especially when you can put portable DVD players in there for the kids!
My dog passed away and I cried.
I am so sorry. You must be heartbroken.
I am sick and have a big meeting this week, not happy.
I'm sorry you don't feel We'll, is it a cold or something more serious?
I am anticipating that the limestone mine in my area where I live at will be reclaimed.
If I'm understanding you correctly, They're going to clean it up, right?
ONe of my old coworkers just got engaged.
That's awesome! Were you invited to the wedding?
A few weeks ago a lady at my job got a promotion I thought I was going to get.
Oh no! I am so sorry. That is really tough.
It was really a tough one to swallow.
Did you get any feedback on what you could do to improve your chances next time?
Nope. I think it was just favoritism to be honest.
Ah, that happens. Again, very sorry. Maybe you can find the silver lining in it. Or, find a new job and get a fresh start somewhere else.
I was pretty excited to have a night out with the girls
How long has it been?
I was ready for that intervlew last week
That's the best way to go in to an interview. How do you think it went?
I ended up getting a job offer.
Oh congratulations! What kind of job?
I was scared when I had t go home alone the other day
I'm sorry to hear that. What made you scared?

I've been quite upset with my daughter's school as they've really let her down. To make a long story short. Since she's now the only surviving 8th grade strings student (violin), they've lumped her in with the regular band this year rather than let her play with the 7th grade strings class.
I would be upset too! Why would they do that? Did you try talking to teachers or principal?

They'd have to hire someone to teach just her this year. Next year, there will be more, but she'll be gone. Yes, I've talked to everyone and They're not going to do anything until next year, after it's too late to do my daughter any good as she'll be moving on to high school.
Gosh that's frustrating! I'm sorry to hear that
Me and my kids picked up our new puppy the other day !
How wonderful. What sort of dog?
It is a west highland terrier and he is so cute !
A fluffy white one? How amazing!
I just went to a wedding this weekend, it was very emotional.
They usually are. Who's wedding did you go to?
It was my cousin's, it was intense because I grew up with him you know.
Of course! I'm sure he appreciated you being there!
My husband and I just celebrated our 22nd wedding anniversary. I cannot believe we've made it this far, so far.
Congratulations! Marriages take work but it is totally worth it when you have a good partner. Did you do anything special for the anniversary?
He gave me a card and inside were two tickets for a cruise this spring! I've never been on a cruise and I cannot wait.
I've never been on one either, but that sounds like so much fun. Have a good time!
My cat just recently died and I am very shaken up about it.
Oh, I am so sorry! I am an animal lover, too. We have two dogs now, but used to have cats, too. We did have to say goodbyes to some of our pets over years. It's heart breaking...
I heard on the radio that Beyonce will be performing in my city soon.
That's cool. Are you a big fan of her?
Yes I have enjoyed her music over the years and I like to attend her concerts as We'll when I can.
That msut be exciting then, I hope the tickets aren't too expensive.
I've got a business meeting on Friday this week, and it's with a big client for my company, so I really need to make a good impression.
I bet you've had to do a lot of prep work. Do you feel ready?
Yeah, I've got everything I need, and I've done my research on the people coming, so I think it will go We'll, but I need to keep on my toes.
What day do you leave for the trip?
My husband comes home tomorrow from a month long business trip! I am so excited and cleaning the house and getting things all ready!
Oh you are such a great wife! I think he will totally appreciate it! Are you doing anything nice for him?
Just got let go from my hockey team.
Sry to hear that....What happened
I wasn't good enough so they cut me.
Hey We'll I bet You're talented at other things...Just stack your paper and you'll have the last laugh
When I was much younger, my grandmother took care of me while my mom worked. I need to send her something.
Sounds like a great lady. I am glad you are appreciative of her
Absolutely, I get busy at times but I think it's important to remember the people who got me here.
Yes it is. You should take her out to dinner or something to say thank you.
I really miss going to the park with my grandpa when I was little.
There really is nothing sweeter than childhood memories. Have you ever been back to that park?
Not since my grandpa got sick.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he gets better!
My dog passed away couple months back.. I was heartbroken
I'm sorry to hear that.. What happened?
She got run by a truck.. I felt guilty and blue
Oh.. Wow.. Sorry that it happened.
This lady at my work is so sweet, and no one there seems to like her. I feel so bad for her.
Oh, bless her heart. I hope you are nice to her.
I get pretty sad some nights, but it feels good to cry sometimes
Oh, why are you crying? Is anything wrong in particular? Have you talked to somebody?
Yeah, sometimes it's like a deep sadness comes out of nowhere
Oh I'm sorry, I hope you get the help that you need.
I haven't seen my brother for ten years before he came to visit me in January.
Oh my, it must have been an exciting time for you seeing your brother after such a long time
It was. I was a little nervous too but we had such a great time catching up.
I can understand why it would be a little nerve wracking but I am glad you caught up with him
