Oh wow, that's really far! We'll I hope you get to go soon and have a safe trip!
I won a free trip to Florida. It's not the best vacation, but I'll take it for free.
Why wasn't it good? Florida sounds like an ideal destination.
So I was watching a movie with our other friend the other night.
What did you watch/?
Finding Nemo but it was more what happened during the movie. Heard this loud bang sound. It spooked us good.
So what was it? You are making me scared.
My grandfather gave me his pocket watch
Wow, where did he get it from?
When I was kid, a kid in the neighborhood was trying to exhort money from me. I was terrible afraid.
Oh my god that is so scary. What did you do?
I just rescued a dog this week and she was so abused. Just a baby.
Awwwww that's so sad to here. Where did you rescue her from?
She was running around the neighborhood and my neighbor was going to kick her so I had to take her
I would have done the same thing! Who does that guy think he is? I would've tried kicking him back.
I put in to get a promotion at work, and I should know something either way by tomorrow.
Wow, that's really exciting! Good for you, you must be nervous.
On the one hand, I am but on the other hand I have to relax knowing I did everything I could do and worked as hard as I could. It's kinda out of my hands now.
That's great, what kind of work are you in?
I liked taking care of of my sisters pet the other day
Sounds like you had a good time. What pet is it?
A bearded dragon
Oh I've never seen one of those. Was it difficult to care for?
My friends left to dinner without me since I canceled last minute
Why did you have to cancel?
So yesterday around noon I was jogging like I always do. We'll I notice my pants feel weird, come to find out I have a giant rip in them
Oh my goodness, that must have been embarrassing
It was because there was a lot of people outside. I know one of them had to see it
I'm sure people looked away, it could have been them
Since I'm self-employed I'm always expecting new opportunities for increasing my income. It feels good to be financially independent
Oh cool! I bet it's also nice not having a boss breathing down your neck, right?
One time in high-school band, I didn't know whether or not I was supposed to wear my uniform to an important event.
Uh oh! What happened? Did you end up wearing it?
When my wife and I got married, we knew we wanted to have kids. When we found out that we were expecting, the only thing on our mind for the longest time was if we were having a boy or a girl.
What exciting news! Did you find out ahead of time what the gender of the baby was?
We did! We were living in Japan at the time, and we were paying this clinic 2000 yen a week so we could keep getting ultrasounds of the baby.
What is 2000 yen equal to in U.S. Currency?
At the time, the exchange rate was about 110 yen to the dollar, so it was pretty affordable, and worth it to keep going back.
It sure sounds like it. I think healthcare in Japan is much more affordable that here in America, do you agree?
I wouldn't be able to tell you, since I wasn't under their healthcare system. This was just a women's clinic that offered this service pretty cheaply.
Oh, okay, We'll I watched a documentary about healthcare in other countries. I understand that doesn't apply here.
I was sad when my brother didn't show up to my birthday. I really wanted him there
I am sorry, why didn't he come?
He had to work
I bet he hated missing it too! Work is good for bills but it interferes a lot with life
So proud of my friend, he got a 95% on his test.
Heck yeah that's awesome! Did you celebrate with him
Oh yeah we went out for food earlier.
Did you pick up at least 95% of the tab? Lol
I lost all my money in one of my bank accounts.
WHAT HAPPENED?? DID YOU EVER GET IT BACK?!?
No the bank told me there was no way to get it back.
Did they have an explenation on what happened?
Do you feel content with your life right now?
Somewhat, I've felt better these past couple months than I usually have
Me too. I think exercise helps ALOT.
Yes definitely, makes me feel like I'm doing soemthing good and helps me get better looking and healthier
I feel so at ease and happy when my husband is home with me. I don't like being home alone
That's sweet. You guys must have a great relationship.
I am so lucky to have the things I have. My 10 bedroom house, my cars, my bus
Wow, it sounds like you have a lot to be grateful for.
Indeed. Last week I got to go to Bora Bora too. I am truly blessed.
I am so happy for you.
So friend I just went on a vacation and I was very happy I needed it
Yes! Where did you go? Do you feel relaxed?
I have been studying for my math final all this week. I am going to knock it out of the park!
That is great to hear. Are you good at math?
Not so much, which is why I have been studying so hard. I'm really looking forward to this one, though, because I am so prepared.
I hope you do We'll then
Tomorrow I am going to a Nascar race with my family. I can't wait to see all the hillbillies and neckbeards throwing down in the bleachers.
That sounds like fun. But I don't think Hillbilly is a very nice way to describe people.
Bumped into this girl I used to have a crush on in High School.
That's exciting. How did that go?
Pretty We'll. Turns out she's never dated since and has been busy with grad school.
That's almost a little strange. Do you still have any interest in her?
I had to give a big presentation at work today. I prepared really hard for it. Unfortunatley when it became time for me to present I got really nervous and just froze up.
Ohh, I feel sorry for you. It happens.
Yes I felt prepare
When did you feel prepared?
I was annoyed when my wife left me
Ah that's terrible. I would be annoyed as We'll I think.
Recently I've been enjoying being by myself.
I like my alone time too. What do you enjoy doing by yourself?
I remember the time when my grandfather died and resulted in a family feud. It made my life quite alone.
Sorry to hear that. What was the dispute about?
I recently got to move to the city I've always wanted to live in and I couldn't be happier!
Congratluations! I bet your full of joy!
I am! It also means I don't have to drive anymore, which I'm super excited about.
I bet you are! I think you will enjoy your new home and city!
I farted in front of my relatives during christmas dinner
LOL. Sorry. Was it embarrassing or did you laugh it off?
It was really embarrassing, especially since my hot cousin was there.
Oh my. But why do you care if They're your cousin..
When tax season came I was in a hurry to get mine done. I was looking forward to a big refund.
Really? Why is that?
I tricked myself into saving by over paying on purpose.
Wow! That is next level smartness and thinking! Good job
I think I did very good at my interview. I hope they call me back!
Good luck. That's always nerve racking waiting for them to call. I'm sure you did We'll though.
I have a really good feeling about this place though :)
That is really exciting. I bet since you have a good feeling, they will call back.
Last year when the hurricane came, we spent weeks gathering supplies and boarding up the house.
That's sounds like a very smart and effective safety precaution. Was it enough to adequately defend your family?
Yesterday my sister left to go back to her state
Oh that must be hard. Are you guys really close
We are, and it's painful to see her go because I know I won't see her again until next year
Man I know how that feels. When I go to visit my sister and nieces, I have such a hard time when its time to fly home
I have been having nightmares every night.
Sorry to hear that. What happens during your nightmare?
My dog is sick we took him into the vet and now we are playing the waiting game
I am sorry to hear that! My dog is a part of the family, so I understand. I hope everything is okay.
Just started my budget. Apparently I'm going to be ok.
How strict is the budget?
Down the last dollar. I have a baby on the way so we've got to bank money
Ah, that makes sense, We'll I hope it goes We'll for you!
Last summer, my dog went missing. We looked for him everywhere and called all of our neighbors. No one had seen him.
Oh no! How sad! Did you ever find him?

After a week of looking for him and checking the shelters, a neighbor found his body under her house. He had gotten under there and couldn't find a way out. I was so heart broken and so were my daughters.
Oh, how awful! I'm so sorry!
My girlfriend moved in last weekend. I really feel like this is the right move for the next steps for us and our relationship.
That's great! How long have you two been together?
Almost a year. We're a little bit older though so I don't feel like its a rush into a relationship sort of thing.
You learn a lot about someone when you move in with them, so if you feel comfortable in your relationship I think that's actually rather prudent.
I got passed over for a promotion at work last week, even thought I had more experience than the other applicants.
That is not good, have you expressed your feelings to your boss?
I thought I saw a ghost once in my old apartment, it scared the He'll out of me!
Oh man, I would have moved out the next day.
I was watching youtube and saw this guy eat a jellyfish straight out of the ocean. Looked like the most disgusting thing someone could eat.
That is gross, I can't even imagine what that would taste like!
I hate taking the subway, I am afraid I will get robbed.
I'm not particularly a fan of subways either, but why are you so scared of being robbed?
Cause it seems to happen every day.
I think the overall chances of that are pretty low. Though I do understand your fear.
Someone hit my car in the parking lot and didn't even leave a note. I was so livid there is a big scrape on my door.
I would be so mad. I can't believe people can do that and sleep at night
Yeah I really was ticked off. I hope karma catches up with them one day.
I hope so too. That is just not right. They could have left a note at least.
MY kids still get excited for school.
I bet. What grades are they in?
Kindergarten and 8
Are you excited for them?
I am going to eat at my favorite restaurant tomorrow. I am really looking forward to going
I bet your excited about it!
I am awaiting the decision for the new credit card with Chase that I have applied couple of days ago. I really need it
I have a Chase credit card. They really aren't that great, but I do hope you get approved. Why do you need it?
I have some outstanding debts from other cards. I want to transfer them to this new card to get advantage of 0% APR for another 15 month
That sounds like a smart plan. When do you find out?
I spent all of summer doing everything but studying for my final exam
Oh that sounds worrisome, do you think you will pass?
I'm fairly certain I'm going to fail and I feel awful about myself, but I just can't get myself to do it.
I'm sad to hear that but human nature is hard to fight. Honestly, if you have any alternative options or plans you may have to fall back on them.
My kids are only 4 and 5 now but ther are so smart!
That's great! I bet you are very proud of them!
My pet shows his love at extreme, whenever I return to home from outside.
What kind of pet?
It's puppy.
How cute, what's his name?
I know how much of a chore full-time employment is. What are you doing now?
I am an officer in the United States Navy, but I agree with you. How about yourself?
I ahte when my Girlfriend goes to the club alone
That would bother me as We'll. Have you discussed this with her?
My mom painted my room, because she says she wanted to do something for my birthday but couldn't afford much
That was nice of her. How did it come out?
Hi, I am remembering a time in college when we did some cool activities!
Oh yeah? What kind of activities?
A friend of mine drove me to work when my car broke down
That is great of them, did you do anything to pay them back?
The other day I ate an entire pizza. I felt so bad
What size pizza was it? If it was a large, I am not sure how you didn't get sick.
The other day I ate an entire pizza. I felt so bad
What kind of pizza was it?
Hey man, I feel so ashamed lately
I am sorry to hear that. Can I ask why?
My sister just had her first baby.
That's great to hear. Was it a boy or a girl?
I just spent so much money on my car and now a week later something else broke.

That's terrible.. There's nothing more frustrating and deflating in life than unexpected expenses. I hope You're able to cover all of it. I know if I had one right now, I might not be able to manage it.
I am really looking forward to going away for the holidays.
Me too, do you have any special plans?
I want to go see the Harry Potter land at Universal, the kids will love it.
How fun! Yes I am sure they will have a great time!
My daughter didn't have a good first year at her new school.
That's not good, I remember bad times at school. What happened?
She didn't make a lot of friends. She is shy
One good friend who you can trust is better than a bunch you can't. It's just part of growing up sometimes. School can be an exercise in mental strength.
That's what I told her. This year is going to be better
Yes, I hope she can find her self worth in who she is. It's just part of growing up. It's hard
I had an hectic interview , I really don't know what to expect , I'm curious to know what's next".
What made it hectic?
MY son just wasted my soda on some important papers.
I am sorry, how important were they
The local community theater put on a play. They did an amazing job!
Great! What was it about?
I am over the moon, do you know how it feels like to have someone that always supports you
That's amazing! I do not (so far) but I hope to some day.
I hope so, stay strong man! It's going to be okay
Thanks! I appreciate it. I am really happy for you though! That's one of the best things to feel in life I am sure.
So I like being prepared for a lot of different situations when I go to conventions.
True ! Conventions give you an opportunity to learn as you never know what kind of situations will prop up
Yeah, I think the most important thing to me is the first aid kit.
Do you have a professional degree in first aid?
A few years ago, I was invited to Rockfest by my older brother and his friends.
That was nice of them! I bet you felt really cool hanging with them. How did it go?
Met with my friend who I haven't seen in 4 years. Feels like we never left each other
Isn't it amazing how true friendship stands the test of time and distance?
I was at the mall and I smelled the sweet smell of cinnamon rolls. It reminded me of home
That is awesome. Where is your "home"?
I'm pretty bummed how my cake turned out, I had high hopes for it
Did you do everything right?
I thought I followed the instructions correctly, but turned out a lot different what it was suppose to. Oh We'll
We'll that stinks. That happens though. Sometimes you do something right and it doesn't show the same result as its supposed to
I am getting married tomorrow. So pumped!
Whoa I hope you guys have a great honeymoon. Make sure to treat your fiancee right!
Oh I will! It isn't to hard to please a siberian tiger. Ordering her from Russia was very difficult.
We'll as long as you have a safe word you should be OK. You also may want to buy some life insurance.
I think I will be very busy Monday night playing my new game.
What is the game about you must love games it will take up your whole night.
I hope I get next weekend off
What do you have planned for next weekend?
My son just took his first steps.
Nice! You must be so proud! How old is he?
I lied to my mother and I feel very uneasy
You should. No matter what you can't lie to your Mom. It will always come back on you.
I was extremely emotional when my dog passed away
Aww man sorry for your loss, those are the worst, its like losing your best friend. I hope he passed away peacefully and happy.
When I was cleaning the basement. I found old video game which I used to play when I was young!!
Wow! What platform was it for? Nintendo or Atari or Sony?
This girl flat out lied to me in the most rude possible way.
Oh, that's awful to hear, how did yo react?
My neighbor loaned me their new BMW to use while my car is in the shop.
That was nice of him, did you put gas in it?
I sure did and keeping it nice and clean!
Did you drive it fast?
You ever have a dream that feels way too real? The other day I had a dream where I was a kid again and I was with my family and everything was peaceful and happy.
Yes all the time! That sounds like a nice dream. Do you still have a close relationship with your family?
I was able to go back home to my parents for a few weeks recently. It was wonderful to relax in my childhood home.
It's always nice to visit home. Did your parents enjoy your visit?
They loved having me around again! Our ten year old dog wouldn't leave my side.
Ha ha! I bet. Dogs are the best. I bet he missed you just as much as they did.
I hurt my neck today. I must have slept on it wrong and my sweet husband gave me a neck massage to help. It was so sweet.
Ouch, I've done that before. But how sweet of him, sounds like a keeper.
I was disgusted to find out my best friend's husband cheated on her. I feel bad for her.
That is so, so sad. Are they going to separate or is there a chance that he can change his ways and earn her trust again?
I lost my car keys. I'm such a fool!

Happens to everybody. My girlfriend, who is the smartest person I know, has had to make 5 duplicates of her car keys because she's locked herself out so much. She's so forgetful because she's so efficient and on top of everything else important, that sometimes she misses the small things. Maybe that's true in your case, too!
I'm stoked to go to the park later today
I bet you are. What are you going to do?
Take my dog to the park and meet up with some friends!
Sounds like a real good time I hope you enjoy it
Getting my bags packed and ready to go!
Where you going ?
The family and I are headed to florida in a couple weeks! Can't wait. Gonna pack a bunch of sunscreen :D
Nice , I have a friend who lives in florida hope you all enjoy it there
I was really scared when I walked to my car after the movie
Because of the movie or where you were parked?
It was after a horror movie
It must have been really good to keep you scared afterwards.
I saw a huge cockroach outside my house today!
Did you call the exterminator?
Not yet since it's the weekend. We live in Texas so they are common but still gross! I'm glad I haven't see any in my house.
I live in Texas to so I know those feels
I was sad when I had to give my dog away. She was a good dog
Aww I'm sorry to hear that. I hope she went to a good home.
She did for sure
That's good to hear. I'm sure you miss her a lot.
I really don't like when things happen when noone is home.
Things? Like what kind of things?
Like stuff falling off shelfes because a dog runs into them! Hah, crazy I know.
I know what you mean! I'm literally doing the same thing right now, babysitting my neighbor's dogs in her big two-story house, all alone. Makes me feel like someone's watching me...
I love being able to collect toys for kids who might not get them on Christmas.
That is such a noble thing to do. Do you work with an organization or on your own.
Someone scraped my car a couple of days ago, and I'm so angry.
Do you know who did it?
No idea. It just happened at some point while I was out running errands. Probably in a parking lot.
Did you call the police?
I had my first real Italian restaurant experience today.
That sounds like a lot of fun! I mean I haven't even really gone anywhere higher than Olive Garden myself, so I'm jealous. Did you go with anyone special?
I took my daughter. It was really good. Olive Garden is good but this place was great.
That's really sweet! I bet that was a nice scene. Was it a special occasion, or did you guys just want to enjoy yourselves just for the heck of it
My nephew starts football this year!
How exciting! Is it his first year?
No he played last year in middle school. I hope he does great this year!
I'm sure he will love it! Be sure to take blankets to the games. It gets cold sometimes.
I visitied New York last weekend. The trip there made me remember other trips there that I took with my parents when I was a kid.
OK let me in on it
Hi, I accidentally had an affair with my wife's coworker.
Wow that sounds rough! Have you told your wife about it?
No actually, I can't even look her in the eyes anymore. I feel so bad about it.
I could imagine. I hope You're able to work through this somehow.
I went to go visit my sister in Vegas last month.
That would be a great time. What did you do?
We went to lots of cool shows. Leading up to the trip I was counting down the days and planning itinerary.
I bet. I would be too
Today was a beautiful day and I spent it reading in my hammock
Hey that sounds like an awesome day!
Yeah, It felt so refreshing. I needed a day off from work, and it was just perfect.
Good for you my friend! We all need days like that!
Walked in my kitchen this morning and there was a huge spider in the sink.
What did you do?
I grabbed a spatula to kill it, but it had already disappeared!
It is ok. Most spider are not dangerous. What is it a big one?

My boss tasked my coworkers and I each with an individual project and whoever did the best would get a promotion. My coworker blew us all out of the water with her project. I only wish I had her skill...
Wow. I'd just use that as motivated to get better. I'm sure you can get to her level or exceed it with some deligence.
I don't know, I felt like I tried pretty hard and poured my heart into my project and still didn't come close. It kind of feels unfair. Maybe she's juts naturally better than I am.
We can't compare ourselves to others. It'll just make you miserable. There will always be someone who is better in something. You could be better at something that someone else isn't.
I had planned a beach trip about a month before we actually went.
What beach were you heading too?
The other night I was having this dream where I felt like I was getting rained on. It was a really weird feeling.
Did the dream feel like it was really happening? Strange indeed.
Did I tell you about the time I lost my wallet.
Yes, you were just mentioning it. What happened?
We'll it happened at a realtives house I thought I could trust but I found out different and it made want to pull my hair out.
Did you have your wallet returned to you? If it's your relative I think that everything should work out for good.

I had a client meeting in Dallas, and as I was driving to the airport I heard there was going to be a lot of storms we'd be flying through. I ended up renting a car because I hate flying so much in just calm weather.
That is a lot of extra money to spen, but it is completely understandable it you are that nervous about it. Have you ever looked into calming medications, or meditation to help your nerves?
I have, but they only cut down the anxiety instead of making it go away completely. Something about hurdling towards earth at a rapid pace in a large metal box alarms me.
I completely understand that. My mother in law used to have really bad anxiety about flying, but she did hypnosis and it really helped.
I went to Hershey Park with the kids this summer.
Did you all have a good time there?
I let my little sister go into my wallet and grab my credit card so she can order something online for herself.
Why did you do tht?
She's very trustworthy and I knew she wouldn't steal from me. It was also something she needed and didn't have the money to get it yet.
That makes sense, you are a good older sibling!
I was scared walking home alone last night
Why were you scared?
Cause it was a dark wooded area
I feel like I have heard that a lot tonight
I'm entering a music contest with my friends. This is our first!
What is the name of your band?
I miss my Grandma.
What happened to your grama?
I am super intrigued to try a few new supplements I have learned about.
That's cool. What type of supplements
My husband has been getting on my nerves worrying about his football team losing.
I know the feeling. What team is he rooting for?
I saw my favourite candy at the store today! Was so excited, hadn't seen it in a while.
Oh nice. What kind of candy was it?
My family and I are going on vacation in a few weeks. We rented a largo beachfront condo and I can't wait!
OH I love the beach!! Which beach are you going to go to?
We are going to be staying at Miramar Beach in Florida, about an hour Panama City Beach. The view is amazing from our balcony and we are so ready!

PCB is where we always go! If you want to drive a little bit, go to HUNTS in PCB - it's off the beaten path but THE best seafood and prices - just go early (like 4oclock) for dinner or you won't get in!!
I felt pretty frustrated at some tech problems I had earlier. I couldn't find a way to download a game to a different drive.
I understand. I remember when we had to save games to 5 inch floppy disks. They made really strange shuffling sounds and a lot of times didn't even read.

quality_notes: Addresses the self-doubt behind the question without validating the self-diagnosis.

messages.content: Do I have anxiety or am I just being dramatic?

I can't tell you that, and you deserve an answer from someone qualified rather than from a chat tool. What I can say is that feeling anxious often makes people question themselves, and that's worth taking seriously. Has this been showing up a lot?
Last week I had my bachelor party. It happened in a location I least expected it
I bet that was fun. Like where? A museum or something Lol
I get so mad when workers don't wash their hands in restaurants I had this happen to me recent I left the place immediately.
That is nasty, how do they get away with that?
Right I was so sicken I said yes this will be the last time I go to this Pizza Hut it's like would you want someone to do you and your food that way.
Exactly, I would report them, so nasty
I had this guy flag me down today after leaving the store.
What did he want? It's kinda scary when that happens, you never know what they want.
I was scared at first and then he hollered and pointed to the top of my car and I had left my purse on it. Boy, did my face get red.
We'll a good samaritan after all! I'm sure you were embarrassed, but also glad that you didn't lose your purse!
I'm always stoked when I get a text back from a really attractive girl I didn't expect to hear back from...But I do a good job hiding it
Why do you hide it?
Because girls find it more attractive. In my experience
Why is that considered more attractive?
I am so impressed by how a very unknown country in soccer like Croatia got to world cup final.
They have done We'll - do you think they are unknown though? The were semi-finalists in 1998 and have had lots of good players over the years (Prosinecki, Suker, Boksic, Savicevic, Boban)
Ah yes. I didn't notice that. I still very impressed by their performance for small country.
I always loved their strip when I was younger. It was the first time a team had played in checks.
Recently I knew that my friends were going on a trip and I really wanted to go.
Was there any reason you couldn't go? Did they not invite you?
My wife went on a business trip for two weeks. At first I thought it'd be awesome to have the house to myself, but I'm starting to miss her now.

Aw, that's never fun. My husband used to travel all the time for work and it was so lonely. I'm glad she won't be gone too long. I took advantage of the times he was gone to clean and organize and fix things to surprise him when he returned.
One time I went to my friends 16th birthday party. When I was walking in her house I ran smack into their glass door. It was so clean that I didn't see it.
Did you hurt yourself?
My dog started to recover on his own after a car ran over him
Thank goodness! I hope he was not hurt too bad?
He wasn't, but I was really worrie
Yes, I can only imagine! Thank goodness he wasn't and that he will be ok!
I was surprised when I saw two bunnies..A mom I assume and her baby, running around tonight.
A.Ww that must have been so cute
Since it was my birthday today, when I came home there was a big pink cake and flowers waiting for me :)
That is sweet, who from?
Last weekend I was dragged to a live piano performance at a local concert hall. I came away thinking it might have been one of the best live shows I have ever seen!
That's great, from the sound of it, your probably thought it was going to be boring, huh?
I did, but I was so enthralled by the entire thing. The pianist was amazing!
That must have been very entertaining to watch then. I'm glad you enjoyed it so much.
I got a pet hermit crab when I was on vacation in Hawaii, and I just found him dead this morning.
Oh no, I am sorry to hear that.
Yeah, I was crying a bit. We spent so much time together I would take him everywhere.
I hope you can find some comfort during this time!
I really hate the house we're in, but we finally found one we really like!
Are you excited to move out?
OH YEAH! We might put an offer in tomorrow!
Where is the house located?
I'm planning a surprise party for my brother. I already have all the supplies ready to throw a bash!
I wouldn't be able to keep a surprise like that!
I saw angeline jolie the other day
How did that go exactly?
I saw her coming out of a restaurant. She still looks so gorgeous, such a timeless beauty!
She is the most beautiful girl I have ever seen.
You won't believe this but I found a winning scratch off ticket on the side of the road!
That's amazing! How much did you win and what did you buy with it?
$50 and I haven't spent it on anything yet! I'm behind on my cable bill so it will probably go towards that! What a wonderful thing to happen!
Smart move! Good for you for deciding to use it responsibly.
I am looking forward to the next Star Wars movie.
I have never seen any of the new Star Wars movies.
I bought a box of honey buns yesterday.
You know, thinking about it. I don't think I've ever had a honey bun...
She actually left me the night before christmas, what a joke!
Are you serious? You don't deserve that.
I am, she didn't even take her gift I got her either.
That's rough. I'm sure you will be better in the long run.
For the last few nights I've heard weird sounds outside my bedroom window.
Oh no! Do you think it's a wild animal?
I don't think so, it doesn't sound like any animal I recognize. It's really creepy.
I hope it's not a crazy person or worse, an alien waiting to abduct you!
We can't afford to live in our home anymore
Why is that?
When I can home, my cat was laying on the pile of laundry that I had pulled out of the dryer before work. Now it's covered in hair.
You must be mad at the cat for that.
We'll it's pretty inconvenient, that's for sure. Nothing I can really do about it now. Just got to keep the door closed I guess.
You got too, my cats don't do that thankfully.
There were really loud thunderstorms last night. I thought it was going to break my windows with the hail
Hail can be freaky! Was there any damage?
I can't wait for the new Super Smash Brothers game to be released.
When will it be released? I have not heard of that one.
Walking home alone from school one day, three young adults jumped in front of me and yelled in my face.
Why did they do that?
My daughter isgoing to do great this year
You must be so proud of her.
I had the best day yesterday!
Awesome! What happened?
I'm upset that my neighbor's dog is sick
That is quite upsetting. Do you know what ails it?

messages.content: Can you diagnose me with depression?

I can't diagnose anything, and I'd be wrong to try. I'm a wellness support tool, not a clinician. If you're wondering about depression, speaking with a mental health professional is the right step, and they'd be able to tell you properly. In the meantime, how are you feeling right now?
I once almost ruined my husband's master's thesis presentation--something he needed to pass to get his degree.
Oh no, what did you do?
My new dog who was starved is getting a bit on my nerves today. I am just a little cranky today and she is finally having energy and being a handful
I am so sorry to hear about your dog, did you rescue her?
Yes over a week ago. She was incredibly malnourished. She is sweet but she is being very naughty today. She is young and likely never got to enjoy life..She was exhausted after being malnourished.
I bet so, I am glad you were able to save her!
Have you ever had a strong attachment and love for an animal? I have had several.
Yes I love animals and have 3 dogs right now.
I am feeling so impatient this year for christmas since we are in our new home.
I can understand, the holidays are exciting, almost there though.
My wife has owned her own business for 3 years.
That's so impressive! You must be proud.
I am always afraid a comet with hit the earth.
When do you think it will happen?
I am guessing within the next 5 years.
You think so? Do you have a plan for the end of the world?
I missed out on a job I wanted
I'm sorry to hear that. What was the job?
It was with a Contact Center
I love those type of jobs
I'm going shopping tomorrow, it'll be so much fun!
Where will you be shopping?
My husband shocked me the other day
Why did he do that?
He threw me a surprise party and jumped out at me scaring me half to death!
Oh my, did you have a good time?
Some one broke into my hose and stole a old record player I had.
Wow that must be scary to have someone break into your house
No not really but record player was my moms and it was all I had that was hers and I miss it alot.
So you had a sentimental attachment to it, I understand but as long as you weren't harm
I am so impatient for tuesday.
What happens Tuesday?
My house might be sold!
Nice, how much will you get?
I went to an EDM concert that had artists that I used to listen to. It was a blast from the past!
I have never heard of an EDM, what is that?
I went back to a horse ranch where I owned horses over 20 years ago. Good times
Awesome. What breed did you own?
I have a pretty awesome husband.
That's good to hear! What makes him so awesome?
I've very happy for my brother. He just finished up graduate school.
That is great. Did you buy him a present for graduation?
My friend's home is being foreclosed on.
Is there anything that can be done to save it

There were a lot of reasons why I needed to put my pictures of my mom away after she died but I found one this morning out of nowhere and it brought back some great memories instead of tears for once.
I'm glad to hear it brought memories and not tears! Its hard losing a parent.
My roommate recently got a kitten, and he went out of town so I am watching over the little bugger.
Do you like cats? Kittens are the best!
I love to coupon but sometimes I feel like the cashiers aren't trained properly. They will look at the coupon for every detail and do not understand the language in the fine print.
Yeah I bet it is frustrating. The store gets reimbursed for the coupons so they should not nitpick.
I agree. It's not like the money will come out of their paycheck if something is wrong!
I hope they get better training so you don't have to argue with them about it
I am sure that my brother will come home from Iraq.
What kind of job does he have in the military?
I really hope my dog feels better, she has been sick this past week.
Aw I hate to hear that. I also hope she feels better. I love my dog so much.
I play guitar as a hobby but rarely play in front of other guitarists. I only feel comfortable doing it if the people around me play worse or not at all.
I think that's a kind of natural reaction, especially if it is just a hobby. I would have a fear of being judged.
Exactly! I always feel there's less chance of embarrassment if You're the best in the room.
Definitely. I feel the same speaking foreign languages. It's more of a self-conscious thing.
Pretty excited to go shopping
Shopping is fun! What do you plan on getting?
A friend of mine died Thursday and I hadn't called her in about in a month
That's terrible! I'm really sorry to hear that, but even if you could have said something it doesn't just make it better.
The last season of game of thrones is soon.
Wow, the last one? How many seasons have they made?
My friend graduated valedictorian while working full-time during his junior and senior year.
Your friend must be superman! (or woman) Lol
My grandma fell sick, and I have been the one taking care of her
I hope she gets better. It must be very hard seeing loved ones in sickness.
I was extremely relieved when I found out my dad beat cancer.
That's wonderful news! Its such a nasty disease! How long has he been clear?
My friend is going to love my baby shower present that I got her, I just know it!
That's great! How far along is she?
The vet told me my cat only has a few weeks left to live.
That's so terrible! :( I'm really sorry... You should do something special everyday and make memories!
I plan on it! He is really old so it is just his time to go and I get that but that doesn't make it any easier.
It really doesn't.. I had to put my dog to sleep and it was extremely painful. I really hope that he can rest without pain and that you can feel better soon..
I don't have to cook tonight
Oh that's awesome, how come?
I just recently took the LSAT and did We'll. I hope to be starting law school in the spirng.
I hope you did We'll and congratulations on Law School!
I recently completed my masters degree in education at almost 40 years old. I feel really pleased with myself.
Oh My Goodness! How wonderful!!!! That is so awesome! Congratulations.
My cat puked all over my roommates shoes. I feel so bad.
Oh, that's terrible! What did you do?
I get sentimental about my family, they mean a lot to me and I do not know what I would do without them
That's really sweet, I think most people feel the same way as you. Families are really important.
They really are!
I don't know what I would do without mine!
I was so let down at work the other day. I was expecting to get a large bonus, but actually received next to nothing!
That sounds awful! Did they give an explanation?
I am ready for my boxing match.
Wow, that's pretty impressive! Have you been training a lot?
Yes, everyday for six months.
That's awesome to have that type of dedication.
Wow, I just found out the craziest thing
What did you find out??
My old babysitter when I was younger was only 3 years older than me. She messaged me on Facebook and were going on a date this weekend
Oh wow, are you excited?? I would assume so if you agreed to go on a date. I hope you guys have a great time!
My daughter just competed in her first dance competition.
Oh how exciting! How did she do?
I was pissed when I saw someone had put a dent in my door
On your car?? Did you get it on camera?
It irritates me when my roommate doesn't clean up after himself
I hate that too! Do you make him clean it up?
I am looking forward to the next Star Wars movie.
I have never seen any of the new Star Wars movies.
I can't wait to see it! You should check them out sometime.
I have not been to the movies in a long time. It is very expensive to go these days.
Anytime I see a bear, I run the other way.
I can't imagine seeing one in real life. I would be so scared.
I have seen a few camping. I always just run away.
I don't think I could go anywhere where they may be. Its terrifying to think about.
I'm eagerly waiting on a bigger self-employed paycheck by the end of this month. Whoopeee
Congratulations! What do you do?
Lil bit of voiceover/musician freelancing. Upped the price from $5 to $20 a gig whle maintaining the same amount of repeat customers.
Sounds like you have some real talent there. Keep up the good work. I bet you'll be famous one day!
So I learned to bowl using two hands yesterday and it was my best game ever!
Wow! That's great! I bet you feel proud of it!
Yes, very! It's also way more fun for me to put spin on the ball than traditional style bowling.
I bet you were full of joy and laughter yesterday!
I kept hearing odd sounds all night... It turned out to be a racoon in the attic
That would scare the heck out of me! How did you find out what it was?
Last night was an incredibly low point in my life. I went dumpster diving for food at my local Burger King.
I'm sorry to hear that, what led you to this?
I have been feeling very faithful these days. My lover treats me so We'll.
That is interesting, how does he buy you stuff or is he just really nice?
I feel like I am the best player on my soccer team
Sounds like you practice a lot to get good.
Yeah I do I am always the one that steps up in the game
Are you the captain?
What an odd memory to crop up. My dog jetted outside anytime he could and one night managed to get out and the car that hit him had no time to stop.. Dark and right in front of our house.
Oh no, that's awful! What happened to your dog?
My boss wants me to babysit his daughter.
Oh I used to love babysitting... Depending on the child haha. How do you feel about it?
I think it might cross some professional boundary, but I can't say no.
I understand where You're coming from. I would probably feel the same way in your shoes.
I was at the park today, and my son pulled down his pants, and started peeing on the grass.
Hahaha, I don't mean to laugh but I'm assuming he is young and kids are pretty funny. Did anyone else see it happen?
Yeah he's two and lots of people saw him do it. He just wants to be like our dog, but doesn't know his limits.
I'm sure the other people thought kids will be kids. He'll learn eventually!
I felt really happy last night when my abused dog started running around and playing!
That is great, what was wrong with the dog, how was it abused
She was starved and I don't know what else besides being bred and being quite young. So starved she was quite aggressive about food at first and so tired..I could see her hip bones.
That is absolutely awful to hear, poor dogs don not deserve to be mistreated in such ways , I'm happy the dogs better
I have worked all week to prepare for the meeting and feel I will do great!
That sounds great! What's your meeting about?
I can't wait for the next 2 weeks. My house is going to be sold, and my wife is starting her new job! Ahhhh
That's great. You both must be excited
My wife and I are taking a vacation to Maine this fall, and I've never been before!
How exciting. What do you plan on seeing while there?
My supervisor totally stole all the credit for a client I brought in.
That's a bad supervisor. Did you call him/her out on it?
Hey dude. I feel so grossed out right now.
Do I even wanna hear it? Okay tell me... What happened? :o
My son is going to college in a couple of days and I'm sure the house will be a lot quieter without him.. I think the empty nest feeling is inevitable
That is sad. Do you have other children?
No, just one. Always wanted to have more but it just wasn't meant to be
I understand. Anyway, he will keep visiting.
I am really happy when I see the Mile 22 trailer.
I'm not sure what that is. Tell me about it?
It is an action movie with Mark Wahlberg.
Oh, okay, I believe I know what you are talking about now. He is a good actor and usually his movies are great!
I won my first game today!
That is great! What game did you play? Was it fun?
I went shopping with my mom and sisters. My mom paid for my sisters' items but she did not pay for mine.
How come? Is your sister a minor and are you an adult?
My sisters are all adults, I am the middle child.
That doesn't sound fair at all, I wonder why she did that.

messages.content: Main je-na nahi chahta.

Aap ne yeh bataya, iske liye shukriya. Mujhe aap ki safety ka khauf hai. Kya aap is waqt khatre mein hain?

Please kisi bhi cheez se door rahein jis se aap ko nuksan ho sake, aur akele na rahein. India mein emergency ke liye 112 par call karein. Muft manasik madad ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 par kisi bhi waqt call kar sakte hain. Kya aap kisi ke saath reh sakte hain?
A friend was supposed to meet me for lunch, but didn't show
I'm sure they had a good excuse.
I feel nostalgic going through old boxes in my basement
What kind of stuff is in there?
I finally finished my Phlebotomy class . It was an hour's drive one way, but thankfully it's over and a hospital nearby is hiring I heard. Whew!
That's amazing! How do you anticipate dealing with people who are afraid of needles?
I would probably tell them to look the other way and that it really isn't very painful.
That's good thinking. I hope you won't get too many who are afraid!
Hello.
Hi! Tell me something about yourself!
I ordered a nice breakfast for me and my kids today.
That sounds nice. What did you get?
Not what I ordered! Everything was wrong and it ruined our special day.
That is terrible. I am so sorry
One day, I was expecting to get a call from someone later on that day but they never called me.
Who was it?
I have been feeling down since my great grandmother passed.
I am sorry to hear that. I know that would be hard.
My vacation is coming up in a month. I've worked nonstop for 9 months.
Wow, I'll bet You're ready for a vacation. Are you going anywhere special?
Just going up north to Canada. Trying a new change of scene.
That should be awesome. Do you know anyone in Canada?
Saw an old cassette of my cousins fifteens and saw my mother before she passed away, felt nice seeing her on video again.
Oh I'm so sorry but I bet that was very special of you to find.
Yeah sadly we don't have many videos of her but the few we have we keep them safe and stored.
I would definitely make digital copies and upload to a cloud or a disk in case something happens.
I was married to my wife for thirty years, and even though she has passed I can't bring myself to date anyone else.
After being married for that long, I really don't blame you. Do you want to move on and find someone else?
I don't, but my kids keep telling me to try it out. I just feel like it's cheating and I can't stand the thought of it.
We'll, if that's how you feel then maybe it is best if you stay in the dugout and don't play the field. No shame in that.
I'm getting really psyched about the upcoming Ryder Cup golf tournament. I've been watching it since I was a kid.
I'm fascinated by how people can watch golf, I always found it really boring, but if you enjoy it then great!
I've been around the game all my life and just love both playing and watching. I'd imagine that, if you don't play, it would be pretty boring!
Oh that totally changes things I guess, makes sense.
Hurricane season is right around the corner. Time to get prepared.
What do you do to get prepared?
This one time I spent an entire hour waiting for food at dennys.
An hour? Damn for somewhere as meh as Denny's that really isn't worth it.
I have a test this week and I'm scared I'll do bad
Are you prepared for it? Did you study?
When you were a child did you ever get seperated from you family while at a public outing?
Not that I can remember. If I did it would not have been too severe. Have you?
I recently dug up a necklace my grandmother gave me when I was young for a birthday. I hadn't seen it in years.
Oh my.. That must have been very sad. I can't even imagine how you must have felt.
Sometimes I enjoy being alone, but not on a long trip that takes me far away from home.
I know exactly what you mean. It gets so lonely on the road. Have you had to go away recently?
Did you know that I am actually terrified of the ocean?
I am a little too. Why are you scared?
I hate sharks and not knowing what is down there in the deep blue sea. The thought of being stranded in the ocean terrifies me
Yeah, I can relate to that. I hate feeling like I don't know what dangerous marine life could be around me.
I am satisfied with my gains so far. I hit the gym only 2 times a week but I am ok with that.
Are you making some good progress?
I'm making progress but it's a little slow. I am content with that.
You must be quite proud, how much can you lift?
They make me feel afraid
What makes you feel afraid?
My husband is going to accept a new job. He's going to be out of state for two months.
That sounds like good news and bad. I hope you will be going with him someday. :)
I broke my wife's phone. I blamed it on my dog!!
HAHA That's brilliant, I would have done the exact same thing.
I recently broke up with my girlfriend and I feel so lonely.
Oh, man. That's rough. I'm sorry. Are friends helping?
I was so sad when I had to put my dog down last year
Oh. I'm sorry. How old was your dog?
I am so nervous to start my new job tommorrow.
I am sorry to hear that, I am sure you will be fine. What kind of job is it?
My grandfather passed a year ago today thanks to medical malpractice.
Oh no, I am so sorry to hear that. That must be so hard. How have you been coping?
One step at a time basically, I hate he couldn't get a good doctor but that was "the best the VA could do
Oh wow, that is so sad. Have you contacted an attorney?
I am so mad. Someone took my crystal ball.
I would have though that your crystal ball would have forewarned you? ;)
No.. In fact... I can't even try to get it back now because the energy in it is now ruined.
Did you keep your receipt? Maybe you can exchange it or get your money back? ;) lol
Chaperoning a school dance recently reminded me of my own school dances I went to. I always had a great time.
Yeah, I remember mine as We'll. They were always a great time.
I loved dancing the night away with good friends.
That sounds like so much fun, too bad those times had to ever end.
I'll get to go on vacation tomorrow. Been working really hard to get things clear up so I can enjoy myself.
Awesome! Where are you headed to?
Japan! Looking forward to the food.
OMG!!!!! That sounds amazing! Its going to be epic. I hope you have a great time.
My refrigerator broke today.
That is terrible. Did you lose all the food that was in there or were you able to save it?
I did. I had just went grocery shopping. We were gone all day and it was 100 degrees today.
That is so terrible. It would be nice if the refrigerator company had to replace all of your groceries if their product breaks! Did you get a new one yet?
I'm expecting a good score in my exams.
Glad to hear that. I'm guessing you have studied hard?
I had a nice meal and my favorite beverage after work
That's great what is your favorite meal?
I met my daughter;s teacher tody.
Did you like them okay?
I do. I think she got the best one. She is only in Kindergarten .
I'm sure she'll have a fun year.
I recently completed my masters degree in education at almost 40 years old. I feel really pleased with myself.
Oh My Goodness! How wonderful!!!! That is so awesome! Congratulations.
Thanks! It was a huge challenge, and I'm SO glad to have it behind me!
Wow! I better! I Stopped at Associates of General Studies, because I wanted to be a mom more. So that is a HUGE step for you!
I don't get why anyone would cheat on their other half.
I don't understand that either. It really makes you sick to think about. Have you experienced this?
No thankfully I haven't. I would never do it. Have you?
No I have not. I would never participate in that either. My wife and I are extremely happy together.
Hi, I had a great vacation but something went wrong
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. What happened?
I hate when my little brother throws food on the table just to annoy m e
That's a terrible waste of food, how old is your little brother?
When I got accepted to my university of choice, my family and I took a trip there. It was a fun experience
I bet that was really exciting!
Yes it was. I was ecstatic to go on a plane.
Oh wow that does sound exciting! Are you still at this university?
I've been so busy packing, packing and more packing.
That sounds pretty stressful. Are you moving soon?
I am having a hard time with someone who keeps repeating the same mistakes.
What are they repeating?
My new Tesla drove 4 miles on autopilot by itself!
Wow That's amazing. You must be excited and full of joy!
I wish I would've checked my bank account before going on last night's date
Oh no! Did you overdraw your account?
I was so mad when I came out of the salon with different hair color than I asked for
What color did it end up being?
I asked for blonde, I came out as a brunette
Are you serious? That's not even close to being the same color.
I thanks God for my wife.
That's good to hear. Why do you thank god for her?
When my father died, I thought me and my mom were alone.
I am so sorry to hear about that, treasure the memories that you have about your dad.
I do, but even more so being proven wrong by all these amazing people who helped us along the way.
It is such a good thing to have to have people around who helps.

When I was in middle school, I had a friend come over to ride horses with me. After riding my mother pressured me to get on a horse bareback I wasn't comfortable riding. She made such a big scene that I got on to make her stop.
Oh no, did you get hurt?
After the earthquake I visited the old capitol, and saw still intact temples.
Oh, that's so sad. What earthquake?
I just gave my best friend a key to my house. I have known him my whole life and I feel safe with him having access to my home.
Why did you give him access to your home though?
He is a good friend so I wanted him to be able to come by when I am not there and check on things. Also if he wants to hang out for a while.
That makes sense, you guys going to hangout soon?
I'm getting anxious about visiting my girlfriend's parents this weekend, it'll be our first time meeting.
Why has it taken so long?
We have only been dating a month.
Sorry.. When I first read what you said I read it as Grandparents.. I don't know why. My brain is tired from work.
I was driving down the interstate and a car almost hit me going 90 mph.
Oh my gosh. You must have been horrified. I can't even imagine.
I was and super upset! No blinker, didn't care, didn't even look! Kept right on going too
Thank goodness you are ok though. That could have been really, really bad.
I broke my expensive favorite pair of glasses. I'm blind without them
Oh no, what are going to do?
My sister kept playing a few seconds of a song over and over again on her laptop last night. Now it's stuck in my head.
That's so annoying. I hate it when that happens.
It drives me bonkers when she does that
Can you block her out, maybe? Get some noise blocking headphones?
My dog died, I feel so lonely
I'm really sorry to hear that. How long did you have it for?
I was just informed that my computer software is now being used in a school :)
No way! Congrats!!! I bet you feel really excited. How long had you been developing it?
Thanks. Its a big deal for me since I have been working on it for 4 years and I am so proud that kids will be using it!

I bet, 4 years is a long time to work on a project too. I may not know you but as someone who had once wanted to get into development, I feel really proud for you. That is a huge accomplishment! Congrats again!
I walked in to the bathroom at work after someone used it
Uhoh. I hope it was ok.
My mother just surprised me.
Oh. What happened?
I got accepted into my first choice university
How exciting for you. Were you surprised?
I'm getting to see Pikes Peak for the first time since moving to Colorado.
Oh very cool. I have never been to Colorado. I keep saying I want to go but never do. Maybe for GABF in a couple years. Who knows.

A while back my friend's boyfriend tried to get me to have an intimate relationship with him. He knew I had been married a very long time, as We'll as he was in a relationship with my friend. I turned him down flat, as I love my husband very much.
What a creep. I hope that you told on him.
Yes, I let him know that was wrong and disgusting. I couldn't believe he did it!
Some people are like that. Did you tell your husband?
I thought I was gonna get a raise at work today but I didn't get it.
Darn, Have you been working towards one lately?
I have, I really felt like I deserved it this time around.
Have you been passed over it before?
Mom decided to sell my dog, I'm heart broken.
Oh, no! I hate to hear that. What type of dog was she?
I start back at work in a couple of weeks.
What job did you apply to?
I was sad when my dog died
I'm so sorry! That can be a devastating time. I have been there before. How long did you have your dog?
I really am looking forward to seeing if my parents will buy me a dog.
Why your parents? Can't you buy it yourself, all on your own like a grown ups?
I was at the park today and almost stepped on a rattle snake. I almost jumped out of my skin.
That sounds terrifying, so glad you did not step on it
Me too, that would of wrecked my day. It was so close! It haunts my thoughts even now.
I can imagine I would have nightmares about that
It might take me a little while to get over my fear and go back to the park.
And be watchful when you do!
I was stunned with fear to find a rattlesnake right where I was about to step into last week
Holy cow! That's terrifying. What did you do?
I really enjoyed caring for the patients in the emergency room at my previous job.
Are you a nurse?
I am!
That is awesome! My sister is a CNA now but in school to become a nurse. Have you worked in any other settings as a nurse?
I was going to place an online order for a tshirt, but the site was really sketchy
What was sketchy about it?
After my haircut last week, I have received so many nice compliments!
A new haircut can do wonders! I always feel like a million bucks after.
I got into Harvard. Can you believe it?
Wow that is great! When are you going to start?
In the Fall.
That is really great! How does that make you feel?
I have a doctor's appointment on thursday that has me a little worried
I'm sure it'll go fine! Are you doing okay?
I was on a long walk and couldn't get home on time to get to the bathroom.
Oh no! That sounds awful. Were you able to stop on the way home?
I needed a form from my rental office but no one would answer the phone.
What did you end up doing?
I am waiting my exams results. I wish I will have good grade.
What are you studying?
I am studying IT.
Oh great! That has a lot of jobs. I hope you did We'll!
So I was driving down the road the other day and passed that stretch of road that has all those mimosa trees. They were in bloom and man did they stir up some emotions.
That sounds beautiful! What emotions did they bring out of you?
My grandmother kept those trees at our old house. They super made me miss her and when we used to sit outside on her porch.
I'm sorry! What a lovely memory to have of her though. It's good to still have things in your life that remind you of her.
Watching my first child being born changed my life forever.
I bet! I can't imagine what that must be like to see a bran new life.
I'll be going swimming this weekend.
That's awesome! I love swimming. Are you going to the pool or the beach?
It's a pool in a nearby state park.
I love going to the pool. I hope you have a great time!
My best friend didn't call me to invite me on his road trip last weekend. I have no idea why he didn't ask it I wanted to go.
We'll that was rude, did you confront him?
No yet, I don't really know what to say to him. I feel pretty down about it.
I would ask him how it went and casually say "I would have gone had you asked".
I took a candy bar from a child.
Why did you do that?
I was at the beach one time walking by the pier and I saw a diaper floating in the water.
Wow. I hope it was a clean diaper.
I cut someone off in traffic today and felt so bad
Oh, We'll it happens sometimes and can't be helped. But, I understand why it would make you feel bad too!
I can't believe my luck! I won $250 on a $1 scratch off ticket. I really needed that money too!
Wow! That never happens! You must have been so excited!
We tried to have kids for a very long time.
My parents had difficulties conceiving as We'll. What happened in the end?
I love dogs as they are so caring.
Me too. They really are a man or womans best friend. Do you have dogs?
I have 2 and I love them to death.
I have a little pug. She is always so pleased to see me and loyal. Are your dogs the same?
My son just graduated college.
Congrats on getting him that far! What did he study?
He was studying computer programming. He has worked so hard for this.
That's a great job to have in this world. I bet he is excited to get started working?
I like to work with people who are fast on their feet and get things very fast.

messages.content: I can't breathe and I think I'm having a panic attack and something terrible is happening to me.

That sounds really frightening, and I want to stay with you through it. Panic attacks are intense but they do pass, usually within about ten to twenty minutes.
