I have a good feeling tonight is going to be fun. I am going to an event
What kind of event is it?
Its a tattoo convention
Ohh fun, I love the artistic nature of some. My daughter just got a tattoo in honor of me.
I can't wait! I am going on a vacation to Rome, Italy in a couple weeks!
Oooo, that sounds fun. Will you visit that giant place where gladiators fought?
My husband is going on a trip for a weekend.
Are you going to miss him?
Against all odds, I won two tickets to go to a music festival last summer.
That is awesome. I have never won anything in my life. What festival was it?
That's a shame! It was a festival called Pooza Fest. Many punk-rock and acoustic shows!
Congratulations! Did you have a good time?
I'm excited for Red Dead Redemption 2 to come out!
What is that? A video game?
Yes, sadly I'm still an adult who still gets excited about video games.
No worries, we all have our hobbies!
I am waiting for my blood test results. I am very stressed about it.
That must be very difficult to have to wait for results. I hope they come back and everything is fine though.
I was happy when my dad got to retire. He worked hard for it
Congrats to your father! At what age did he get to finally relax!?
He was in his mid 60s
Good for him! He sounds like an awesome guy.
I picked up a 2nd job last year and today made my last student loan payment
That's awesome. I think it's great that you stepped up to repay your loans!
I am always afraid a comet with hit the earth.
When do you think it will happen?
I was mad when I missed my credit card bill. I felt dumb
Oh no! I've done that before. Did you call them and ask for a grace period so you didn't build fines? We all make mistakes like that so don't beat yourself up.
I did, I still felt bad though

Those kinds of things are part of life and its better for our minds if we let them go and move on or see the humor in it. I hope it didn't hurt your standing with the company. You just reminded me to pay my internet bill! Thanks!
So my friend adopted a new kitten very recently.
I love kitten, but I can't have one where I live. I bet it is so cute
I went through the drive thru at a fast food place, and the cashier would not give me a receipt!
Oh no! I would have asked for the manager! What did you do?
That's what I did actually. The manager was apologizing to me. It was just frustrating.
I can't imagine why that person would do that! So unreasonable.
We are supposed to get severe thunderstorms tomorrow.
Oh wow, I love thunderstorms.... Though I know they make some people really uncomfortable.
I enjoy them if they don't get dangerous. I put together a storm emergency kit just in case.
It's always good to be nice and prepared for anything. Better safe than sorry they always say. Good for you.
I like to prepare before a long trip.
Are you going to go out alone or with the family? Vacation?
It'll be a family vacation, to a cabin.
We'll, I hope you have a lot of fun in contact with nature
I love roller coasters, but I hate that my favorite amusement parks close during the winter.
I hate that most parks close during the winter too. Do you have any indoor type amusement parks near you?
Hey there
Hi what you got going on?
Uhm.. Just feeling blue. My gf broke up with me recently and got married to an investment banker
That is really sad. Are you alright?
I will always cheer for the New York Jets.
Why? Are you from New York?
Yes. Born and raised.
Nice, do you play football too?
I just found out that my sister in law is pregnant which is so exciting, but she has had a miscarriage before so I'm just trying to stay positive for her and I know things will go We'll.
That is exciting! I hope everything goes We'll.
I know she'll be great. They're having a little boy and they already have a little boy so they'll be brothers!
I have two boys myself! I feel like two kids is the perfect amount. Not too much to drive you insane and just enough so your first isn't lonely.
I'm feeling blue because my days and nights are mixed up
That really sucks. Have you tried taking some melatonin?
I have tried taking benadryl and some other sleep aid. I should try melatonin.
Yeah, it works wonders for me when I can't sleep.
I'm super bummed out. I worked really hard for this promotion and I ended up not getting it.
I'm super bummed out. I worked really hard for this promotion and I ended up not getting it.
I am so happy these days.
I am so glad to hear that. What is the secret?
I was at the mall yesterday. I sat down for a few minutes and when I looked away someone stole my shopping bags.
Did you catch the person after?
I had to take a test for work and didn't have time to study so I snuck notes in so I could get a high score.
I hate to ask what happen, I imagine something went wrong
I've finally finished writing the book that I've been working on for the last few months.
Great. Are you going to get it published?
Definitely! I'm pretty happy with this one, can't wait to get it published.
What is the book about?
To say anything about it at all would be giving too much away!
Boo. What genre?
There were really loud thunderstorms last night. I thought it was going to break my windows with the hail
Hail can be freaky! Was there any damage?
Trees down but nothing too bad. I just don't like thunderstorms
We don't get them too often, here. Though there's usually a few tornadoes that touch down somewhere in the area, each year.

quality_notes: Hinglish that stays natural, offers a concrete split of the anxiety.

messages.content: Mujhe interview mein kuch nahi bolna aayega, bahut nervous ho raha hoon.
Interview ke time nervous hona bilkul normal hai, aap akele nahi hain ismein. Jo cheez aapko sabse zyada pareshaan kar rahi hai woh kya hai - questions ya interview ke baad ka wait?
We'll I bought a bunch of scratch offs today. I really wanna win the lottery.
Fun! Those can be addictive for me. I only get them around Christmas time...Not sure why but its a fun stocking stuffer. Did you win?
Not yet... I haven't scratched em yet. I really could use the money I hope I win!
I hope you win too! Scratch them now and let me know if you win. Now I'm excited for you! Hope you hit a big bank!
I think about the past this time of the year. It makes me miss my parents
How come? Do you not live with them anymore?
No they passed away a few years ago
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that.
I went to the optometrist, and my prescription got strong. She warned me about being at risk for losing my vision.
That's not good. I know my eyes hurt when staring at the bright white screen on computers . So I change them to a darker color when possible.
Oh yes. That is smart. After the warning, I use the screen dimming program called f.Lux.
Haven't tried that yet, but I have heard of it. I will check it out. Thanks !
I like collecting survival items in case of an emergency! I will be ready for any disaster or zombie Apocalypse that comes my way!
What all do you have stored so far?
I had to have a digital mammogram and ultrasound earlier this year.
What were they looking for?
My dog has cancer.
I am sorry to hear that. Unfortunately a lot of dog breeds have a high risk of cancer. Is it treatable?
I guess not because the surgery didn't work so we have to put her down.
Oh my. I have been in that situation before. You have my sympathies.
He did not change all
Who is he that you are speaking about?
My old friend
Do you want your friend to change?
I can't believe I'm even sharing this with anyone because I want to forget it but earlier I was walking around the office with my dress shoved in my underwear!
Oh man! I've been there. That is hard. I hope it wasn't too long!
I have no idea! I don't even know if anyone noticed because they didn't tell me! I figured it out myself when I went to the bathroom again.
Don't you hate that when people don't tell you? We'll now you know your co-workers can't be trusted! But maybe they were busy and just didn't notice- which is goo!
I there, don't know what to do, jst broke up with my girlfirned, we were 8 years together
Sorry to hear! Do you have any idea about the break up? Did you think about it ?
Yes we decided together with our minds, and know I come home and feel so distant from the world
Sorry again! Hope you'll get relief from this sadness. Please concentrate on your interests to divert your mind from this.
I told my husband that I was going to see a friend when I didn't. I went to a party planner's place.
Are you going to have a surprise party?
I recently had a test that I spent a lot of time studying for.
Good job studying. How did you do?
Since I was really prepared and understood all of the material, I did really We'll.
Congratulations! Tests are always hard, it feels great when you do We'll.
I fell down on stage while dancing, I felt so bad".
Oh dear, that must've been embarrassing, are you okay though?
I was eating some food at a restaurant when I found a hair in it. I didn't NOT want to eat any more!
I know how you feel that would gross me out too. Makes me feel like whoever prepared my food was not very clean.
I received an excellent grade on an exam I studied really hard on
Congratulations! That is always a great feeling! A reward after such hard work. :)
Thanks! Yeah, it's so satisfying and motivating. It makes me feel like I can accomplish anything as long as I put in the work!
This is very true and what all the great thinkers out there preach!
I have a new sweet dog who was abused and her little puppy.
So you have two dogs? That is so nice I love dogs.
Oh no, I have a LOT of dogs, lol. I rescue. I am happy about her though- she is easier then some I have taken it and it's nice to have a little baby around again to love on.
Beautiful, sounds like she is in good hands.
I am very sad these days.On a deep funk.
I am sorry, what are you sad about
My grandma died 5 weeks ago. I am still sad.
I have been there. I guess just remember the good times
I didn't realize that stealing was bad until I realized how it made me feel afterwards
So you probably felt pretty guilty huh. Did you return what you stole?
Once my dog got really sick. It was scary but I decided to completely trust my vet and he's still healthy today.
I am glad! You must have a very good veterinarian
I was so sad when I had to put my dog down last year
Oh. I'm sorry. How old was your dog?
She was 12. It was old age but it was so hard because I had had her for years.
Have you thought about getting another dog?
I am ready for my camping trip next weekend.
Are you excited about it?
Yes, I am going with my best friend.
I hope you have a great time!
So itt was me who spent hours in a work seminar with my zipper down and shirt on backwards lol.
I'm sorry but I am laughing. I bet you were so embarrassed.
I am very happy that I have graduated today!
Wow, that's exciting! Congratulations, you must be very proud.
I am very proud. And I will celebrate by going to Disney Land!
I would love to go their! I hope you have a great time!
Love getting together with my brother and reminiscing about when we were younger
Things were much simpler when we were kids. You are your brother must have a close relationship.
We went on a vacation a few weeks ago, and it really made me think back to our last vacation. It was with my father, the last one before he passed away.
Oh wow, I hope you cherished your time with him.
I miss living in the Caribbean.
Why would you ever move away from the Caribbean.
My students have a big test coming up to see if they can move to the next grade. I think they'll do great! I made sure they were We'll prepared.
That's wonderful that you are looking out for them like that.
We'll, it is my job to teach them! Kidding aside, it was very tough to prepare them but I believe we got this one in the bag!
Awesome! I'm sure they will all do their best!
I'm so happy and relieved my mom came to my rescue this week.
Moms are good at doing that, aren't they? What did she do for you?
It killed me pretty much when I lost my dad. It was so random and I was not ready for it
That's awful. It sounds like a freak accident. What happend?
He had a brain issue that got him instantly
Wow, I am sorry to hear. I had a friend with an aneurysm pass suddenly about 2 years ago. It was hard and I can't imagine how you feel with it being your father.
I get to fly up and go see my girlfriend in Boston soon!
How exciting! Has it been a long time since you've seen her?
About two months! However while it is sappy, more than a day without seeing her feels like eternity.
I'm jealous! That's so sweet and I hope you have a great time!
My grandfather passed away not too long ago, I received a bunch of items he left for me.
I'm sorry for your loss, I bet you two were close. What did he leave you?
Some interesting antiques, grandfather clocks, and a lot of items related to his work for the house of representatives. Interesting stuff
Oh he worked for congress? That's very interesting. That sounds like an awesome haul of vintage stuff.
I just started working out again after almost 20 years and I was very nervous at first.
Oh man, that's a long break. How did it go?
We knew she was pregnant, but didn't know the gender yet. Imagine my shock when I saw the ultrasound for the gender!
I am sure it will be fine, do you have a preference
We'll it's a boy. Which is what I have been wanting since we met
I am happy for you then
In a few days I need to go to a company presentation and make a big speech!
Wow, I bet that's exciting, but also makes you a bit nervous. Congratulations though, I'm sure you are proud to do it!
I am! But, yes, you are right. I am extremely nervous about it. What if I mess up!
We'll, I would probably feel the same way, but I'm sure you will be great. If they didn't have confidence in your abilities, they wouldn't have chosen you to do it!
How can one stay married for 10 years without cheating?
By being a decent person...I'm not a cheater and could never..I am very monogomous..Why would you get married if you wanted that?
I'm really excited for dove season that starts next month
That sounds fun. What are you most excited about?
The dove hunting part.
I've never been dove hunting. It sounds interesting.
I was trying to sleep train my son but I failed. I didn't it's gonna be that hard. I think we will be co sleeping till he goes to college
Ha ha, I'm sure he'll get the the hang of it eventually. It takes some children longer than others to get used to.
It irritates me when my roommate doesn't clean up after himself
I hate that too! Do you make him clean it up?
I say something and he just gets all grumbly and then it's uncomforatable.
That's a tough situation to be in. I would just take all his belongings to the dump and be done with it. Maybe he can stay there too.
I got a surprise gift in the mail yesterday.
Wow! What was it?
A gorgeous vase. It's so pretty. I have no idea who sent it.
I'd like to see this vase. Do you like flowers?
My friend just got a new job
That's great! Where are they working?
I was a cheater in highs school. I always got some nerd to help me, bet now I really regret it.
We all do stupid stuff as kids. The important thing is you realize how bad that behavior is now.
I watched a horror movie yesterday.
Did you enjoy it?
Last month I found out my son decided to drop out of college without telling me.
Oh no that sounds terrible. Hopefully it's not as bad as some of those stories I have read about where they go so far that they fake having the degree.
My car engine start smoking but my mechanic arrived and fixed my car within an hour!
That's good timing at least. Glad it didn't take too long.
I agree I was thoroughly impressed by his expertise. I was glad to be back on the road so quickly.
What ended up being the problem ?
I felt all alone the other day
I hear you! What made you feel all alone?
I am pretty sure I am going to get this planning done soon
What are you planning?
I've spent my entire life dedicated to this one thing
And what was this thing?
I get to go to the park today for a BBQ with friends, it should be so much fun!
Ooh nice. That does sound like alot of fun. Do you guys play any sport while your there?
I cannot sleep tonight..My son starts first grade tomorrow.
Oh wow that's really exciting! You must be really happy.
I am beyond happy!
That's great to hear, I hope his first day goes We'll!
I lost my job a couple of months ago and yesterday I finally got a full time job!! Such a relive
That is a relief I've been in a similiar situation. I know its hard to bring yourself out of a hole, I can barely see the light at the end of the tunnell
I'm so glad you understand me! We were struggling financially
I'm struggling myself, with 5 kids and 1 big kid (my husband) I feel like I should just buy a farm to be able to keep up. LOL
We just got back from the beach two weeks ago. It was such a lovely vacation. We loved relaxing on the beach and just taking it easy.
Oh yeah that sounds very relaxing! I hope it was good weather for you all!
Sat here by myself for 10 days straight. Car was in the shop being repaired
Wow that must have been frustrating. I hope it didn't cost too much.
My girlfriend just broke up with me.
Oh shoot! What happened, are you okay?
I feel really hurt and sad.
What happened? I thought you guys were attached at the hip?
I hope I win the lottery
That would be awesome. What would you do with the winnings?
Change my name and move to hawaii
Hahaha have you ever been to Hawaii?
I am so annoyed that France is in the world cup final. I do not like their style of play
What is it about their style of play that You're not a fan of?
One time there was a large mouse in my kitchen.
What did you do with it? Did you try to kill it?
I have done a very bad thing and feel terrible about it
Oh no, what did you do?
I have been getting everything ready for grad school and I think I finally have all that I need.
What are you studying?
Counselor Education for School Psychology.
Oh wow that sounds impressive. Good luck!
I felt heartbroken when my girlfriend moved away without telling me first
I would too why would she not tell you!? Did yall break up?
I keep everything my kids make
You are a good parent. How do you have space for it all?
I don't/ That's the problem lol
I guess you'll have to get a storage unit. The question then is what goes in the storage unit? Furniture or the kids crafts. Haha.
My parents bought me a car when I turned 17, I was so surprised
You must have been thrilled! There is nothing like a first car. Did you love it?
I do not like the dark.,
There are a bunch of people who really don't! I don't get really why people are afraid of it, though.
When I got the phone call that my mom had cancer I was so upset.
I am so sorry to hear that. No one should have to go through something like that.
It's hard watching one of your parents get sick. We were at the movie theater when I found out and I had to leave.
I'm sure I would have done the same thing! But stay strong, many people have beaten cancer! Keep a positive attitude and stay by her side!
Yesterday was my nephews birthday party. Unfortunately, I missed it!
Uhmnn, so how do you think she would react?
I am super joyful when my family comes together to eat dinner
That sounds nice. How often does this usually happen?
Usually once a week. Its a great feeling
I hope this continues for you for a long time.
I was furious when my dog ate the wires to my Television
That must have been so annoying. Hopefully you can just get a replacement.
My best friend just got a new car. Here I am driving the same car for 10 years.
I feel you. I need a new one asap. POS falling apart. Cost me lots for a repair recently
I know how that is trust me. Why can she get a new one and not me.. UGH!
They're not cheap let me tell ya
I got to relax today and sleep. I was off of work
Oh nice. I'm happy that you got some rest. What do you do for work?
Ever just stare at the ocean at dark? The bright moon shining into the water and into the retina of your eyes, it makes you very sentimental
Yes! I live about 30 mins away from the coast . I love going at night
My sister got to go with my mom on vacation and I couldn't go.
That's no fair! Where you left out on purpose?
I am going to Six Flags tomorrow!
That's awesome my friend! Do you enjoy that?
I think I will! I've never been there before!
It is so much fun. I have been there, you are going to have a blast
I considered becoming a vegan, but I'm not so sure if it'll work out.
I have never tried and never will lol
I like the idea of it, for moral reasons, but I can't imagine I'd like any of the food.
That's what I think. Plus I'd miss bacon too much.
I know I will win Gold in the Olympics.
You sound very confident! What sport do you play?
I compete in rowing.
That sounds fun! I like boats, but I don't think I would be a good rower.
I feel like my children will grow up to be very compassianate human beings
Wow That's a good feeling to have
I practiced my solo for band so many times I can still do it today, many years later.
What instrument do you play?
Clarinet.
How long did you play for? Do you still play today?
I have a big test coming up.
What subject is it in?
Its for college. If I don't pass it is going to affect my graduation negatively
Do you anticipate a problem?
I got lucky and passed my course this semester
Awesome! What are you studying?
Computer Science. There was a 3 point curve on the final that really helped me out this time.
Curves are always a good thing! I was always thankful for them.
She jilted me!
Who did? What happened? Are you OK?
My ex girl friend left me for a rich dude.She said I was still a struggling man
Wow! That's horrible! Don't feel bad though. She is obviously just a gold digger. You most likely just dodged a bullet!
I will always remember the day I found out I was pregnant with my first child. I was so happy and hurried out to get a card and gift for my husband to surprise him.
That's awesome. My wife and I will hopefully be in that same boat soon. Was he excited?
He was very excited! We were nervous when we first decided we wanted to have one, but we immediately were thrilled when we found out.
That's awesome. I can't wait to experience it.
I paid $1000 for one of those mystery boxes on eBay. It said it would be filled with all sorts of fun and expensive items.
Please tell me it was not full of Oriental Trading Company rubber ducks and cheap tchotchkes.
I would've happily taken that! Instead, it was filled with literal garbage, like a bunch of those empty 99 Bananas bottles and candy wrappers.
Oh man! I feel bad for laughing but "literal garbage" is pretty funny. That sucks, can you report them to eBay?
My cat was just diagnosed with hyperthyroid.
That is horrible. What is the treatment for it?
They gave us meds but They're not working. He still seems happy but he's constantly losing weight.
I wish your cat the best. I know it must be hard
I'm ready to meet my interviewer tomorrow.
I'm ready to meet my interviewer tomorrow.
I am currently expecting my first baby, it's a boy!
Congratulations! When is it due?
Hi! I watched a movie yesterday with my son.
That's good, how old is your son?
He is 23 and he picked a movie I didn't really want to see.
Oh he is quite a grown man. I bet you wanted to catch up on old time growing up with him
I cannot wait for the new super smash bros for the nintendo switch
I've always wanted a nintendo switch, Is it any good?
First time making a cake. It turned out pretty We'll.
You must be proud. What kind of cake did you make.
I haven't been in a relationship for a while now. I am so alone..
I bet you find someone soon
I was over the moon when I passed my classes last semester.
Happy for you. Which course are you taking?
Physics, calc, and other normal filler courses or engineering classes
Wow! You nailed it. Sound like a tough course to study
My grandmother was diagnosed with stage four cancer. I feel helpless.
Oh no, I am so sorry to hear that. That is awful and makes me sad. Have you talked to anyone about it?
My kid's birthday are coming up again. It always makes me remember them as babies.
Awe how sweet, I bet those are good memories
I literally ate all you could eat at a chinese buffet
LOL, I bet you couldn't move after that.
I am going to do We'll at work next week, I have been working on a project
That's great. So you are confident in the progress of it?
I just feel like its good work
That's a great feeling to have. A job We'll done.
I forgot to pay the electric bill last week so a lady came a turned the power off.
Oh no! I hate that! So what did you do about it?
I made my late payment as quickly as possible and called my provider to ask them to turn my power on asap. I managed to get it back later that night.
Wow, no power at home is terrible. What would we do without electricity?!
I am really in shock
Shock? Uh oh, what happened? Is everything okay?
I have big renovation plans for my house. I've made a money plan and have kept to it so far.
We'll at least you have a plan. Are you planning to start the renovation soon?
Yes, hopefully it will all go as planned. So far so good.
Awesome. I'm sure it's going to turn out great.
I purchased a new router and it was DOA when it got to me today :(
I hate when that happens. Makes you want to leave things for the mailman.
The package wasn't too beat up
I hope they can take it back for you.
My dog pooped in my wig today. I was so mad!
Oh no! How are you going to clean it out?
I am going to eat some BBQ later.
That sounds so good and the perfect way to spend a Sunday.
I had to cancel on my friend tonight. I felt bad when I did too

That happens sometimes. Sometimes life just gets in the way. Heck, sometimes you just decide you can't physically do a night out, and that's okay, too. I'm sure they'd understand no matter what. Maybe you can make it up to them somehow.
I hope I can too

Maybe take a few days to think it over, and then when the weekend comes, think of a way to surprise them in order to make it up to them. Or if nothing else, just be as honest as possible and not try to cover anything up when you need to bail on them. They'll appreciate that the most.
I had to send back my food at a restaurant last week.
What was wrong with it?
Everytime I start to think a girl likes me she Let's me down
I'm sorry to hear that bud. I don't have that great of luck either
I was floored when I found out I won an award at work
Nice! What was it for?
I'm awaiting eagerly to meet my friend. She is coming to my home.
That's awesome, I recently reconnected with my friend, its really awesome when it happens
My friends were finally coming over to visit, it had been a long time since I saw them last.
I know how you feel, it's always good to bond with your buddies when you can
I really like the new stadium my school built.
That sounds great, it's always nice to have a new place to play like that!
Yes, it is beautiful and a fun place to watch games.
Glad you have a place like it to enjoy
My neighbor just bought an epensive mercedes, he likes to show it off
How does he go about showing it off?
The braves have a shot this year!
Yeah? How much of a chance do you think they have?
I think a very good shot, they are young though
That would be awesome! I hope they do too!
It was a very busy week for me, but now that the weekend is here I'm looking forward to relaxing at home.
Why has your week been so busy?
My son is going to college in a couple of days and I'm sure the house will be a lot quieter without him.. I think the empty nest feeling is inevitable
That is sad. Do you have other children?
Looks like we have something in common, when I walk through my house, the rooms are empty. There are no one here but me
I'm sorry to hear that it can be hard ;/
A while back my loud upstairs neighbors went away for a week. My life went from night to day. It just felt as if all was right in my world.
Did you think about moving after that?
Funny you should mention that - in three weeks time, lol.
Haha are you serious? Did you move in with your girlfriend?
I knew I was going to get this job. I was prepared for it
I'm really glad to hear that! What kind of job is it, if you don't mind me asking?
It was really hurtful
What was hurtful may I ask?
I wish mt surgery for my back was today not in a month.
I am sorry you have a bad back
I have had a bad back since I was a baby. It is a genetic disease.
I have had one too, its not a good thing
I can't wait to go to Disney World next month!
That sounds awesome! I wish I could go!
Yeah, I haven't been since I was very young so I feel like it's my first time all over again.
That sounds like a really good time. It will be like you are a kid again!
During my first year in grad school, my basement apartment flooded. EVERYTHING was destroyed and I had to start over fresh.
That is awful! Did you have insurance to cover everything?
My dog chewed a hole in my carpet 2 weeks ago.. I was very disgusted to say the least!
Haha I'm sorry! My dog is chill now but he ate a hole in the wall when he was a puppy lol
Someone keyed my car at work today.
Yikes! Did you find out who it was?
I met a guy on a dating app a few weeks ago and we're really hitting it off.
That's good! Have you met in person?
We haven't, I'm worried to meet strangers off the internet.
Totally understandable... I'd be a bit apprehensive too
My food order today did not turn out as We'll as I had hoped.
Sorry to hear! What all did you order? And what was wrong with it?
Everything was cold. We had burgers and fries. You can't eat cold fries.
Cold fries are the *worst* b/c the potatoes are just gross at that point. Did you get your money back, at least?
Nope. I was starving so I ate it lol
Oh bless your heart! I'm sorry to hear! I'd have returned it and gotten the whole meal free for the cold messed up fries!
I voted today and can't wait to hear the results.
Oh. Who did you vote for?

Exactly, especially since we were only dating for a few months! I felt so awkward but she just laughed it off.

Yeah, she knew what you meant. She probably forgot in two minutes, while you've thought about it for much longer. The best thing to do there is to just show off your sense of humor and ability to make fun of yourself and not take yourself too seriously, which it sounds like maybe you did.
I love the new Tesla.

I took it for a test drive, man it is fast.
I know right! It's weird how it's faster than a gasoline car.
I watched as the knife cut my buddies arm wide open.
Omg it must have been quite an experience for you
I felt really good tonight after I got back from the cinema.
Oh that sounds like fun! What kind of film did you see?
It was an action film, and it was surprisingly one of the best I've seen recently.
Action films on the big screen are very exciting with the loud sounds and visual effects!!
I went on holiday to san sebastian recently
That must've been nice. I've never been.
There's a new pizza place opening up.
Are you excited about that, do you think you'll be checking it out when it opens.
I am feeling good about my money making skills.
How are they? Are you doing pretty We'll in that area?
I hate when I make plans and the rain cancels them....
I agree with that! I just had the rain cancel my trip to the beach yesterday! Makes me so mad...

The moment I graduated college I have nothing that I can do. I took the same degree but that 5 year gap has led me to have nothing compared to him. It was so fucking annoying

I'm not sure, I'm not complaining though! It was my best week ever!

We haven't actually! We're just friends, but now we're getting married apparently

I had a wonderful experience with a friend a few years ago. I wonder if I will see her again any time soon.

Yeah, it was scary but good in the end

They think someone needs to take his phone away

On Monday. I'm going to treat myself if I did We'll
As you should. You must have good teachers too!

Sorry to hear that. You sound like a hard worker, which is something to be proud of, even though it's kind of wearing you out maybe. Are you able to roll the days over to next year and save them, at least?
No, not really . They have to be taken by the end of the year. I might take a few days off here and there at the holidays.

That's kind of a lame policy. I hope you get to use them at some point, because they should be worth something. If You're just physically unable to because of the job and its demands, and then they end up passing you by, that doesn't seem fair. I hope you get to relax during the holidays, then.
I am very glad with my new job

Lightening hit my house and fried all of my appliances! Ugh frustrating.
What do you mean?
I had a court date to dispute a parking ticket.
I hate parking tickets! What a rip off. How did it go?

When you tripped over the branch, did you get hurt?
Only my pride, I fell right on my backside and made a ridiculous noise.
I hope you were able to laugh about falling and looking silly and not be too embarrassed?
Some girls can just breakup with you for no reason
I think there must be a reason for that
Without the help of my professor I would have failed my first english class!

Yes! She made sure I aways had a study guide, and I was always prepared!
Awesome! That makes me glad that there are still teachers and professors that truly care!
I made a list of what to bring to the waterpark. Hopefully, I am ready and didn't forget anything.
Did you get sunscreen and a waterproof belly bag and a hat?
I saw an uncle I hadn't seen in awhile the other day

Not really. Made me remember old times when he used to live down here with us. He moved away. It was good to see him
I'll bet. It's always nice to see someone who can bring back good memories.
I remember when a movie ticket was a dollar.
Oh my heavens, how long ago was that?
It was only 20 years ago. Those were the days.

One time I bought water and snacks before a hurricane came to wreck my city
Oh god, how did you . Have the courage to even go outside?
There was a time I had no food to eat now I'm so glad I can afford food and my pantry is stocked to the brim

Not that far but I had to go to a pantry to get food , it was generic foods
Oh yes, I have been there to! Some food pantries are amazing but some have just crappy sugary foods.
Just once was I late with my payment and they charged me 39 bucks, I hate visa
That is obnoxious, I would switch just to stick it to them

So I lost my wallet and had to get a new I'd issued to me.

I'm a little on the fence if I should ask for time off this week

Me! I was such a dork back in those days!

She just seemed to be so much more energetic and engaged when she was talking to him.
Oh wow, I'm sorry to hear that. That must hurt.

My brother is doing so We'll at his rehab. I'm so proud of him

Yes, totally but at the moment I felt like the stupidiest person on earth, didn't know were to hide! And my mom was watching

Oh man, I bet you did. I would have had a gag reflex if I saw some one puking at the bar.
I was feeling I'll most of the month and discovered I am pregnant!
Are you excited?
My best friend at work recently left the job to start her nursing career.
Have you heard how she's doing at her new job?
She's doing We'll. I was so emotional with her leaving. I feel a lot of sentiment about it.
Yeah, that sounds hard. :/ I'm sorry You're missing her.
Oh, I am so sad that my family could not come and visit me. I miss them all so much. Why is life so busy for everyone these days?
I sure wish it wasn't. I live far from my family and they can't even make time for me to go to them. So I feel for you, it is very sad.
Family should come first, right? The people of today are just becoming more isolated and lonely. I wish everyone would wake up!
Absolutely first. Especially when you don't live close.
I am very proud of my daughters.
Oh yeah? Why is that?
I lost a couple of loved ones last year and I can't get it off my mind.
Have you thought about speaking with a counselor?
Guess what! I nailed my review for this year and got a raise!
That's great! I'm so happy for you!
Thank you! I worked so hard and I am so freaking excited! I am also up for a promotion if we keep growing!
Ooh, will you be managing anyone?
My husband asked me to put on a blindfold the other night and he led me outside! I was so scared at first
I bet that was scary. Did he surprise you with something?
I stupidly lent my car to a friend.
Uh oh. What happened?
I recently interviewed a job, but then the company threw a wrench in my plans.
Oh damn, that's not good. What happened?
Yesterday, my dog managed to perform a trick I have been trying to teach her for months. I was so proud that she did it!
Dogs are so much fun. It is amazing how smart they are.
They are! Especially my little Yorkie. I'm trying to teach her how to hunt for mice around our house now.
Little dogs are so much fun. I have a big dog and a little one.
Why won't I feel good about my son's accomplishments?
Do you have certain expectations for your son?
I thought I saw a ghost once in my old apartment, it scared the He'll out of me!
Oh man, I would have moved out the next day.
Yeah it wasn't long before I did move out! I never believed in ghosts until then, and it still creeps me out!
I don't blame you. I've never seen one before, I'd hate to see one.
My child is having his first birthday soon.
Congrats, how fast did it go by?
I was at this major store and the lady ahd like 4 items on the belt , and I wanted to put mines on but she would not move hers
Oh wow, sorry to hear, that was really rude of her.
The start of school is soon, I'm ready to get back to work!
I feel you! Summer is great and all but I miss my classmates and the work I'm studying.
Yeah, I love the feeling of keeping busy during the school year.
I hope you have a successful semester!
Someone at my work missed part of their shift due to a personal issue, but requested I withhold any information that would reveal they missed such time
Oh no! That must have put you in a bad position. How did you handle it?
I always like making sure I am ready for anything! I always pack a ton of food when I am on long car rides.
I used to do the same thing when I went on long trips. I would also bring extra things like blankets if it was winter.
Me too!! I also started wearing disposable underwear so I don't have to make any pit stops. I love being ready for anything.
You're so lucky! I would do the same, except they don't make them in my size.
I've been married forever. I'm good with it.
What is your wifes name?
Sonia
Do you love her lots?
My friend to me I'm dumb and really bad at my job. I'm so upset with him!
I'm sorry to hear that , whant happened ?

Okay, How come?
They clothes are cute and afordable and they don't shrink. Plus they give me coupons.
That sounds great! I should look in too them more.
I came home from a long day of work ready to eat this steak I had marinating when I found my roomate had eaten it. I was so upset!
No way, that is the worst. Did you ask your roommate why he or she ate it?

So, I got done with a game and I had a bat that sort of fell loose in the back of my car. It could have been bad since I didn't have the back on it, but luckily someone stopped me before I got on the highway!
Oh wow. Glad that person helped you out there.
Me too. It could have led to a very, very bad accident for someone else.
Glad to hear there's still some good people out there.
I cheated on my old girlfriend. I felt so guilty afterwards.
On no! Did you ever tell her?
I am so tired of tell my daughter the same thing over and over.
Yeah I know how that feels. I think it is part of growing up.
I remember having dinner at my ex's parents for the first time
I bet you were very nervous that day.
I was at the store last week and slipped on some water on the floor I didn't see. I broke my leg! I was mortified!
Oh, no! That's awful! Are you still in pain?
Yes, I will need to wear the cast for at least another 5 weeks. People are so rude too. They all just stood there and laughed at me!
I can't believe it! How could they? I'm so sorry to hear that...
The college football season starts today!
Oh really? I'm not the biggest football fan
When my nephew's car broke down and I loaned him my car, I know that he'll be careful with it.
We'll at least you can trust him to be careful. I don't think I would be able to trust my nephew as he is only 18 and not very responsible yet.
Yeah, 18 is an inherently irresponsible time, mine is 24 and getting married soon so that makes a lot of difference.
Yes its amazing how much of a difference a few years can make in age. It seems that males take quite awile long to mature than females.
My husband got a raise at work this week! I was so impressed with him.
Thats's great! I bet he's been working really hard.
I was a dog on the side of the road that got hit by a car, and I was so sad
Oh no That's horrible. I'm glad I didn't see that, I wouldve been so upset
I hate wasps so much. They always seem to get into my apartment somehow and I turned into a little girl!
Oh wow, I bet that's scary. Maybe there's something you could look into to help prevent that happening, that does not sound fun!
I've been looking into bug sprays and bug repellants but nothing has changed. I think it's time to call the exterminator!
I agree, get those things OUT! I hope they never come back!
I was flying alone, even though I had before, this particular time I felt wary.
Really? Why was that?
I think I felt concerned that the plane would crash or that something else bad might happen.
Do you normally feel like that when you fly?
When my father died, so many people helped us and lended us support.
I'm so sorry to hear about your father. That's so awesome to hear about the support you received, though!
I'm a neat freak and my house has to stay clean and in place always such a pet peeve of mines.
Do you have OCD?
My friend's went on vacation for a week and I got to watch their super adorable puppy for a week!
That's awesome! I love dog sitting no matter the occasion!
Yea, They're fun even when They're jerks lol. He's a little Jack Russell so he's got quite the energy
That sounds like a good way to have fun and get some exercise!
Did you ever attend college? I just completed my bachelor's degree and I'm feeling really good about my future!
Yes, I have an Associate's in Nursing.
Wow that's great you must enjoy helping others!
Yes, it's been a great career. How exciting for you to be about yours. Congratulations!
I work with high school dropouts. One of my students went above and beyond to complete their last course and finish high school. It was very inspiring. He even invited me to his graduation!
Did you end up going to the graduation!
I stole money from my son's piggy bank.
Why did you do that?
I need money for beer. I feel so ashamed for my behavior.
That is terrible, I hope things get better for you both
My child sneaked in my room to get the Xbox controller while I was sleeping. The night before, I had grounded her.
Oh no, do you think she was trying to get back at you for grounding her?
I think she thought she could play a few minutes of Minecraft and then return the controller before I woke up! I caught her getting into the drawer where I hid it.
I definitely remember trying something like that when I was a kid. I think sometimes kids think They're sneakier than they actually are.
I was angry in the supermarket this week
How come? What made you so angry.
I love every year when I get a vacation and a raise.
I love that too! Isn't it great!
It truly is, the extra money helps very much.
What are you planning on doing with your vacation time?
Ugh. My boss called me into his office today...And he didn't even give a reason.
Oh wow. I would hate that. What ended up being the issue?
I feel so happy when the sunsets are beautiful and I can take the time to watch and relax. It is the best time of the day for me.
Oh I know, mine too! I love how all the colors change with the setting sun.
I'm surprised the police are going to let they get away with it.
Did you have an enemy or someone as a suspect?
I was very envious on my best friend
It's OK we all get jealous sometimes. What did you envy about your best friend?
He got highest paid job in one of the biggest firms. But, don't know why, it bothers me.
Don't sweat it! I am sure with hard work and determination, you will land a good job too!
I was kinda shocked my co-workers pitched in and got me a cake for my birthday recently.
Awe That's so sweet! How long have you worked there?
My girlfriend got me concert tickets to see my favorite band. I had no idea she did that for me. I thought the tickets were sold out.
What band? That was very thoughtful or her.
I was nervous for my first day of college
What about it made you feel nervous?
I spent a long day planting the garden. At the end of it all I was happy with what I had accomplished and felt good about myself.
That sounds great! What are you growing?
A variety of vegetables and herbs. I can't wait for the finished product.
That sounds delicious and healthy also.
Just got back from my moms graduating, so proud.
I would be too! My mom got her degree recently as We'll, so I know the feeling.
Just went by the lake. Made me think of a friend I used to play with a lot when we were little.
Oh nice did you have fun? What lake?
I babysat and worked odd jobs all summer when I was younger to save up and buy a sega dreamcast.
Oh god I miss my dreamcast, I bet you were so happy when you got it.
I love who I am now. But I'm livid at my older self, that guy was a deadbeat and I'd probably beat the crap out of him haha
I'm glad you made changes for the positive in your life. You can't go back into the past, but you can keep moving forward
I really like the feeling of the unknown on christmas morning
Oh yeah, that was a great feeling to have, especially as a child.
I know right. My husband and I don't exchange gifts so it's mostly the childhood nostalgia memories
It's the same with me and my finacee. We'll just go somewhere nice for dinner or something. That childhood magic was the best.
I love camping! I'm going down to the beach this weekend and going to sleep out there for a couple of days!
That is awesome and sounds like so much fun! What are you most excited for?
One time I got pantsed in PE class. The other girls thought I should lose my pants while we were playing dodgeball.
That must have been embarrassing. Did the girls get in trouble for it?
I don't remember. I was pretty numbed out.
I would have switched schools if I were you. I would hate to have to be with bullies like that
I am looking forward to a good match today. I have worked hard
That is good, so you must have prepared We'll for it.
Yes I have and I am anticipation to wait the trophy
I hope it goes We'll for you. Hard work tends to pay off!
I just ate 3 donuts by myself
What kind of donuts?
My cat somehow figured out how to open the cabinet and stole a bag of treats.
Wow that is very clever. I would have never thought that could happen.
Right? I wasn't even mad about it, I was astounded by his ingenuity.
That is incredible. I wonder what else you can train him to do.
I was disappointed with the score of my final exam. I studied real hard but got a 64% on it.
I'm sorry. It sucks when you put time and effort into studying but the grade is bad. Could you get help from your teacher or a study buddy?
I was shocked the US didn't qualify for the World Cup.
I was too! What do you think caused it?!
They did not have a good coach.
I agree with you. Having a good coach is crucial for team success.
My husband has been travelling for work for years now and we just found out that he might be able to work from home anywhere in the world. I really want it to work out!
That's great! What will you do with all the extra time together?
When my son was born it felt like I had everything I needed in life.
I bet that was a wonderful day
It really was, my life finally felt complete.
I am very happy for you
I am scared that I might not have enough money for food next month
Oh that sucks, I know how that feels, its why I got an extra job online
I thought I was gonna get a raise at work today but I didn't get it.
Darn, Have you been working towards one lately?
I was grateful when I married my wife
I bet. I was the same way. How did you guys meet?
I have my final math exam tomorrow. I think I am going to crush it.
That's awesome! Good luck to ya.
Thanks! I feel like all the time I spent studying is really going to pay off.
Are you a math major?
I had planned a beach trip about a month before we actually went.
What beach were you heading too?
We went to Virginia Beach earlier this week. I was so giddy up that whole month I could barely contain myself.
Who all went with you? That sound so fun.
When I was younger, my dad got into a motor cycle accident. It made me not want to learn how to drive for almost 2 years.
That is understandable. Such an experience can be tramatic. Did you eventually learn?
I did learn, but it took a long time to overcome my fear. I'm glad I eventually did!
My wife had a similar experience, she still doesn't drive. Good for you for overcoming it.
When I got home from work, I realized I had my shirt inside out the entire day
O no, I hope no one noticed
I hope not. I don't think anyone did or my coworkers would've told me.. But who knows if someone was just laughing behind my back?!
Yeah I would not think about it to much.
I am away in another country for 2 months and I left my apartment with my friend.
Wow, that must be scary to have to trust someone else with all of your stuff. What took you out of the country?
I have to bake a chocolate cake tomorrow.
Hey that's sweet! What for?
I was scared and worried when it came to going to a new high school my sophomore year. I was not sure how it would go
Yeah, I think most people feel that way, but it's still a valid feeling. How did it end up?
We got to go to Walt Disney World this February. We didn't think we'd be able to go.
That's great! I went a few months ago and really enjoyed it
I read a book the other day and it made me feel all warm inside.
I love good books, what was it about?
My friend had to have a mole biopsied and check for cancer, and they were quite worried about it. Luckily, we found out the other day that it is noncancerous and just needs to be remmoved.
That's awesome, what great news! I'm sure your friend was really frightened at the prospect of cancer.
My toddler is learning how to talk and what objects are called. The other day he was at my parents house and came out of his room with a stuffed giraffe and told everyone, "look, giraffe!
Wow! How old is he?
He is 2 and a half. He was born a month early too, so when he hits milestones its always really cool for us.
Amazing! Congratulations. When so many children have issues, it is always great to see one that is healthy and We'll.

When I was in labor with my third child, they were monitoring me regularly in the hospital. The nurse came in and made a face and then called the doctor. In the 2 minutes it took for him to get to my room, my heart dropped and I started to panic. He told me that the baby's heart rate had dropped and they had to preform an emergency C-section right then.
Wow that's really scary! Labor is a really terrifying thing, especially when something like that happens. Did everything turn out okay?
I moved to a different state for my husband's job and left the rest of my family behind.
Oh, dear. That sounds lonely. How are you holding up?
I'm doing okay. It was for a good reason, his new job is so much better. But it can get lonely
I can imagine. But you'll make new connections there, I'm sure.
When my girls were younger and playing softball sometimes I couldn't make it to all of their games.
Oh no, I know that must make you feel bad, but you can't always be there.
I went through allof m FB photo albums today
That's always so fun to see everything that's gone on in your life. Do you have a favorite moment that was captured in a picture?
I was really looking at my kids pictures and how they have grown so. I could have cried lol
They grow up so fast! How many kids do you have?
Three they are in school now so its bittersweet
Sounds like you are so blessed though! I know you must miss them while They're away. You have been a priceless influence on them. They will always love you!
I recently totaled my car. There were no injuries but I feel absolutely terrible
Oh no! I've been there. How did it happen?
It was very wet and I took a turn at too high of a speed.
I'm glad your safe! Those roads can be dangerous.
I'm pretty stoked because I'm putting together this business idea in my head. If done right with my friend we could rake in a ton of cash
That's really cool. What is your idea?
It involves splitting up some freelancing work and maximizing productivity.
That sounds like a really cool idea. I hope that it turns out We'll!

messages.content: I have this thing where I hurt myself when things get bad, and things are bad right now.

That sounds really painful, both the thing and what it does to you. Thank you for telling me. Are you safe in this moment?

If you feel you might act on it, please move away from anything you'd use and be around someone. Tele-MANAS in India is free on 14416, and 112 is the emergency number. Is there someone who could stay with you today?
I kept thinking I had left the front door unlocked whilst I was on vacation!
That is a terrible feeling. I saw a movie where a family actually left their kid at home. That would be the worst.
I came across my wedding albums the other day and showed them to my kids.
Oh wow, I bet the emotions of that came back to you.
I had an embarasing moment recently
I'll try not to laugh, I promise. Tell me about it!
I was excited my first day of college. I was excited to start my next chapter
So, you are not anymore?
It was a long time ago
Did you graduate?
I saw this guy playing an entire song by himself at a talent show, talk about skilled.
What song / instrument was being played
It makes me angry when I let someone out in traffic without being acknowleded
Do you honk your horn at them?
I was walking and say a cat in front of me wagging its tail on the sidewalk and thought it was awesome
That would be pretty cool to see, but you should know that typically most cats swish their tail when They're annoyed or angry! It didn't attack you, did it?
I attacked it with some pets, it was an outside cat which don't get angry too much I'm guessing
Ahh, okay. Yeah I don't know. It might have also been scared or feeling like it had to protect it's turf. But still, that's neat to see and not an everyday thing!
My aunt is coming to visit soon. I'm ridiculously excited because she always makes this desert I love.
That's awesome. What desert is it?
My best friend from high school and I pulled out our old year books the other day.
That's awesome! I was actually looking for mine the other day. Were you looking up anyone in particular or just for fun?
Just for fun. We had a blast telling stories about our high school days.
I still see my high school buddies on a somewhat regular basis but it is a great time telling those stories over and over.
I downloaded some old Nintendo games last weekend. I haven't played some of those games since I was a little kid.
I love Nintendo, I use to play every time.
I'm going to a show on sunday, I can't wait
That's great! What kind of show?
I've been a bit worried waiting for some test results from the doctor.
What kind of results? Are you okay?
I got some blood work done, and they are testing my insulin levels.
I'm sure You're in tip top shape.
Last week my friend I have not seen in a couple years surprised me at my doorstep. It was awesome seeing them again.
Oh, wow! That's awesome that your friend unexpectedly surprised you.
Yea I was totally not expecting it. I was so happy to see them in person.
I bet that was really heartwarming. I'm glad you had that experience.
Oh my goodness! I was really stressed out the other night and ate a whole container of ice cream by myself.
