You're right that I can't feel this the way you do, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. I also can't replace someone who's actually there for you. That said, you did keep talking, and I'm glad you did. What's the hardest part right now?
I was so scared of going onto the train!
Was it your first time riding on one? Is there something in particular that makes you afraid?
No but I hate going in objects that travel fast, I really did not want to go on it.
Was it your only choice to get where you were going?
I miss my aunt. I wish she was still here
When did she pass away?
I miss my dog. I wish I would've spent more time with her when she was alive.
Aw, I'm sorry. Losing a pet is very hard. I recently lost a cat. It hurts.
I'm sorry for your loss as We'll. They are really like family.
Thank you. Yes, even though it's been a month since we said goodbye, I still look for him around the house.
I hope I'm going to get to go fishing this weekend
Fishing is truly fun. We occasionally go with my friends too. Do you go frequently?
I was supposed to meet up with my volleyball team today, but I'm so tired.
Why are you so tired?
Been working since 6am this morning.
What is your job?
I enjoy getting things done
What kind of things do you like to do?
I was pretty happy this weekend. I got to go kayaking with friends
Sounds really fun do you go kayaking often?
No it was my first time going actually
I bet you are going to go more often now. Kayaking is really enjoyable.
A man in our community was hit by a drunk driver the other night while walking his dog, he didn't survive. It's very heartbreaking.
That is so sad! I would be so mad at the drunk driver! How could he live with himself!
Who knows, I hope he gets the book thrown at him!
I agree! There is no excuse for that to have happened! Such a tragedy!
I have a lot of anticipation in me right now. I will finally be able to get a new phone after all these years.
Oh, I know that feeling! I only just got my first decent smartphone this past year!
I was thankful that I got the weekend off
That most have been really nice. What did you do?
Have you ever tried to steam clean an antique rug?
I have not, I feel like it should be done by a professional.
We'll I figured that out. I cleaned mine last night. They are clean but now they smell horrible!
Oh no! Probably tons of years of dirt caked into the rug. Did you use the right cleaner?
We'll my wife just quit her job, but if this new endeavor works out, we'll be better off in the long run.
What kind of endeavor are you reffering to?
Boy this weekend is going to be He'll
What is going on this weekend?
I have a long drive planned. About 9 hours. I hate long drives :/
Are you driving with anyone?
I lost my wallet the other day and my neighbor returned it.
Whoa, that is a good neighbor. I hope you return the favor some time!

So I was at a friends house and our kids were running around playing games. While chasing eachother my small child bumped into a vase that fell over and broke! My friend was so understanding but I still felt really bad! I helped clean it up with her.
If they have kids I'm sure they understand. Sometimes you just can't have nice things.
It was not even that it was nice or expensive, It was just a gift from someone and meant alot to her sentimentally, and its like, what do you do? Replacing it won't make it better
Yeah, That's too bad. But, I can understand her side too. Sometimes things can't be replaced.
I need to put my dog up for adoption.
Aw, why is that? Is it acting up?
I am joining the military. I am so devastated thinking about it.
Why is that? The military isn't so bad. The pay is really nice if you stick around for a bit.
I felt bad when I couldn't get the gift my daughter wanted for her birthday
What did she want?
A horse
Ohh wow! Those are expensive I bet
I am sad that they closed my favorite restaurant.
That feeling is not alien to me. Had been through it in the past. It is truly frustrating looking for new favorite restaurant
I have hit a dog while driving on the road. But I didn't stop it was so late in the night
Oh NO. Accidents happen. I feel really sorry for the dog.
Some people are so slow at answering text messages, it's like they read it and never reply
I agree. Its frusterating, especially when it was an important conversation.
Yeah, my friends are flakey I guess. I hate that
How annoying. Don't pay them now mind! Do your own thing
My grandma is 93 and needs a lot of assistance with everyday tasks. I try to look after her as best as I can.
I understand, my parents are 85 and 88, both with dementia.
Yeah, it is hard, but worth it to make things easier for them.
I'm glad it's that way for you. My parents destroyed my life intentionally years ago.

Lately, my family and I have been very blessed. We are all happy and healthy. All of our major bills have already been paid for the month, and we have been going to a three week long revival at a local church.
That's awesome! What's your secret to success?
We have just been trusting in the Lord.
We'll he seems to be guiding you in the right direction. I hope your blessings continue!
The thing the bugs me the most at my job is really lazy workers , they only work when management is around and as soon as they leave back to being lazy
We'll That's part of being in the workforce, work when everyone is looking, hang out when they are not. Most people aren't paid enough to care
We'll I do care , and if I every become management again I'm firing everyone slowly
Sounds a bit harsh, but business is business
I've been a little nervous lately and I don't know why exactly.
Nervous? That's interesting. Has anything changed recently? What are your thoughts on why it's happening?
I'm really not sure, it's just a general type of thing.

I see. I'm sorry You're having trouble with that. Have you thought about therapy? Maybe your health insurance will cover a free consultation or something. Or perhaps you just need a simple routine change, with some exercise and more time outside. I hope you find the answer, whatever it is.
Today I helped a friend of mie who is going through a rough time. Her husband has left her and he drained the bank account.
Oh my gosh, how horrible! I hope she will be okay.
I was furious when my brother lit a firecracker tying it to our dog's tail
That's an awful thing to do! What did you do?
I usually keep only professional relationships at work.
Do you feel like that helps or hinders your personal life?
Nothing like a fresh pair of Air Nikes to make me feel ready to take on the world
Man I have recently been getting into shoes, I don't have nearly as many as some of my buddies, need to step my game up.
Some ppl think you need 20 different pairs. Me I just need 2-3 with good arch support and knee comfort and I'm gold
I just like the style, I want to show off with ever outfit.
You know it is hard to be an immigrant and be alone and far from your family
I cannot imagine. Where from?
Our new baby newborn pup here is getting bigger everyday!
I love dogs, what kind of puppy is it?
So I'm buying my first home, and I'm worried about all the expenses that might happen besides the mortgage.
Oh, that is exciting. How big is your house?
It's a small 3 bedroom home, 1 level. It's just me and my elderly mom.
Oh, that sounds nice. What's your occupation?
When I worked as a hotel rep. In Spain a few years ago I was greeting guests one morning. Suddenly I saw someone I knew - it was my cousin who decided to come and visit me. It was so unexpected!
Oh that must have been so exciting and surprising!
It really was. I had no idea he was coming to visit. I couldn't believe my eyes!
Did you all do some fun things while he was there?
I have my job interview today. I am quite hopeful that it is going to go We'll.
I hope too !! I think you will do We'll!!
Hello ... I confess that when I see my daughter's eyes, my heart suffers.
Wow, what happened to her eyes?
I was on the patio and a giant roach crawled out from underneath.
Those are my nightmares. They are so big where I live in the South.
I know I have high potential so the fact I failed my college course had me down.
We'll that's not good. I'm sorry to hear that. Do you think maybe you were just too nervous during the test?
The test and the whole semester I just didn't give it my all like I should have and now I feel really crappy and regretful I need to redo course and give it my all.
Never be too confident! You've got to give life your all at every step.

When I bought my first house I put down 20% of the loan, which made me broke quick. My monthly paycheck helped me with bills but my parents bought me groceries for a month until I got on my feet. SO grateful for them
I would be too! You did what you had to do!
Yes, I am always better off with them as my parents, they want to see us succeed
Do you find the home buying experience worth it?
Yes, it was We'll worth it! I love being independant. Teaches you a lot.
How long do you plan on staying in that house?
I had to assist a mom with two daughters who all had lice
Oh no! That sounds awful! What a kind thing to do though! I'm sure they were very grateful for your help!
I tried to stay positive and see the bright side of it but boy was I itchy afterward
I hope you took the right precautions not to get it yourself! I can only imagine that, I have never had it and never want to!
My coworker just bought a brand new car!
They are so lucky. I would love to have a new car.
Found out recently that one of my best friends from back home died in an accident.
Oh my gosh! That is horrible! I am so sorry to hear that.
My in-laws just suddenly showed up yesterday and said they were staying for the week. I had no warning at all but I guess they were trying to make it fun, ha ha.
Oh no! I would have a heart attack! Are you able to take time away from life so unexpectedly to spend time with them?

Not really, but my husband is going to try to get some time off if he can. Its hard in the summer since so many other people at his work have planned vacations. I did have a heart attck and ran around like a crazy person cleaning upstairs before they came up.
Hahaha I would have been like a mad woman trying to clean too! I hope it works out and your husband can take time off!

quality_notes: Validates in Hindi, asks a specific Hindi follow-up question.

messages.content: कॉलेज में बहुत दबाव है और मैं अब थक गया हूँ।
कॉलेज का दबाव वाकई थकाने वाला होता है, और यह सुनकर अच्छा लगा कि आपने बताया। क्या दबाव सबसे ज़्यादा किस चीज़ से है?
I returned home from school one afternoon to news that my dog was run over by a car.
I'm so sorry! You must've been so sad. Did you find out who did it?
Unfortunately not. I was so upset! Thankfully, my dog was okay - just needed some rest and a cast for a couple of months.
Oh thank goodness! I hate hearing people losing their pets.
I really wish I had been able to finish that project yesterday.
I'm sorry to hear that you couldn't finish it! What couldn't you finish?
I was happy to see my aunt at Christmas. I had not seen her in a long time
That's awesome. Are you and your aunt close?
We are very close
That's cool man. I'm really not close to any of my relatives.
I am very much looking forward to going to Busch Gardens next week with my family!
I've been to Busch Gardens before. They have some really cool Roller coasters. I hope you have a great time.
I do too. Did you go to the one in Williamsburg or in Tampa?
I've been to the one in Tampa. They have this new coaster that rotates forward and backward and spins around. It was equal parts fun and scary.
My cousin, who am seeing after a very long time grew up so tall. I used to tease him a shorty
Do you feel bad for teasing him?
My dog took a fat ole dookey on my prized family heirloom.
Uh oh. Did you put him in the corner?
I have been practicing for the interview tomorrow that all this week.
It sounds like a big opportunity for you. Are you ready for it?
I had an hectic interview , I really don't know what to expect , I'm curious to know what's next".
What made it hectic?
I mean the rigorous process of the interview weighed heavily on me
Oh, I understand. Was it a long interview?
The other day my cat vomited on my best shoes and it really made me mad.
Wow, that cat must have loved that shoe, he wanted it
Went out to eat with my boyfriend the other day. Saw our waiter pick his nose and wipe it on his shirt.
Oh gross, I would lose my appetite
It really was gross. I was so grossed out I asked to get moved to the bar so we could get a different server.
Yeah, I would probably just leave the restaurant altogether
I tried really hard to make a good argument but I was scared.
Oh that doesn't sound good! What all happened?
You ever get your hopes up over a job that you just knew was yours.
Yes one time. I was feeling very hopeful that day. Have you?
Me too- until they called and told me it wasn't mine
Oh my, sorry to hear that. I am sure there is another job out there for you.
I recently was worried about a job interview even though I think it went We'll. I hope I get it.
Good for you. I had couple of interviews couple of years ago. Was very nervous, but thankfully they all went We'll. My advice, just try to hide your nervousness and show confidence
Thanks, I'll take all the advice I can get!
So when are you expected to hear back for final decision on your hire?
I was thankful I went on mission trips in high school.
Oh that sounds cool, where to?
Vermont, Denver, Baltimore, and Prince Edward Island.
Sounds like a lot of fun, I kinda wish I got to do those too back in high school.
Last month, a buddy of mine bought a scratch off ticket and won $4500. I never win anything when I buy them.
Wow!! That's crazy. I'm like that though. I never win anything either
My birthday was last weekend, and no one wished me a Happy Birthday.
I'm so sorry to hear that. How sad for you.
I was at a bus station and a woman was sitting in the bus station. A homeless person came close and started peeing.
That sounds about right for the bus station, unfortunately. How did everyone react when they saw it?
We were two at the bus station. I told the woman to get away. She pretend he doesn't exist because he was behind her. It was disgusting.
Wow. I hope you don't ever have to see anything like that again!
I'm really excited for dove season that starts next month
That sounds fun. What are you most excited about?
I am ready for my birthday next week.
Congratulations. Do you have any party planned for this event?
I am going to Las Vegas for my birthday.
That is cool. Are you going alone or with friends?
I dumped my girlfriend for a younger woman.
Oh my, why on earth did you do that?
She was better looking. I am so ashamed.
As you should be, you hurt your girlfriend's feelings.
The other day, I was putting my groceries in my car and a friend that I hadn't seen in a while called my name.
Did you punch him in the nose?
My grandmother is in the hospital after being in a car accident. The doctors are taking good care of her so I feel she is in good hands.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that about your grandmother. I'm close to my grandmother so I would definitely need for the doctors to provide the best of care. I'm sure you are looking for a speedy recovery.
Yes, she is a strong woman and I am confident that she will recover We'll.

That's a great position to take especially when something like this occur. It puts so many things in perspective on what's important. I'm glad you have good doctors so you can focus on just being there for her.
I watched my best friend juggle knifes.
Are you serious? I wish I could do that. Was he apart of a show
I tried to be cook and do a flip and ended up splitting my head on a cabinet!
Oh man!! I hope you are ok. Please tell me someone recorded it
HAHAHA no I had to go get stitches, I was horrified!
That sounds like a crazy day
I am sad that they closed my favorite restaurant.
That feeling is not alien to me. Had been through it in the past. It is truly frustrating looking for new favorite restaurant
Yes and the worst part is they torn it down to build an office building.
I hope you would be able to find a new one as a replacement for your favorite dining place
I care about my wife and I always want the best for her
That's very nice of you. I feel the same way about my husband. Isn't it nice to care about someone?
It is so beautiful when you can just rely on them and not even overthink about it.
It is probably one of the best feelings!
Before I met my girlfriend and friends I was very lonely, that was not a fun time
I've been there, it can really suck to be lonely. It sounds like You're doing better though :)
I am, I am so happy that is the case
I'm glad to hear it. It's great to have found someone.
I let my teenage son borrow my car and he crashed it!
Oh no, so sorry. Was your son okay?
We had a birthday party for my son the other day!
Aw, yay! How old is he?
He's 6. It was so much fun to watch him open his presents.
I love that age! My niece just turned six and she seems so grown up!
Today is my birthday! I am 34!
Happy Birthday!!!! What are you going to do for it?
I never thought I would be where I am today. If you would have told me I would go back to school at 27, I would have thought you were crazy.
Why did you go back?

I had always wanted to be an electrical engineer, but had settled for life in the service industry (not knocking it). I re-taught myself basic algebra, and was accepted to a state university two years ago!
Good for you, best of luck!!
My girlfirend is recovering from an eating disorder.
That is tough. How is she doing?
I was dating someone else when I met the man who is now my husband. I thought he was just going to be a friend, but I eventually developed feelings for him.
Wow. Did the other person know what was going on?
I felt so down when I failed the test at school and didn't win
What was the prize you didn't win?
A golden medal and my name in the gym wall
Oh We'll I'm sure there's always next year! Was it a fitness test or what
A few months ago we were planning our wedding and I couldn't wait until the actual day finally arrived.
Did it turn out how you expected it
It makes me think of the good old days when I was a kid when I listen to the music in my aunts car
What does? Were you in a car ride with your aunt?
Yes, she plays 80's music and I grew up in the 80's
Oh You're an 80s kids, hu? What do you feel about the music nowadays?
I went tonight to meet my daughters teacher.
Do you think she will be a good teacher for your daughter?
Yes, I think she will be a great teacher. She showed us her plan for the year and I think it was great.
A good teacher makes a huge difference in how We'll the child learns and how much influence the parents are allowed to have - I hope your daughter has a great year.
We lost our faily dog she had been with us since I was 15 years old.
Aw, that sucks. Did you give her a proper burial?
I was scared walking home the other day
Why was that?
Sometimes it's impossible to shove more food down my gullet
Do you have a medical condition?

I saw Henry Winkler at the airport the other day! The Fonz! He came walking by, and other people were asking him for a picture. He sounded very approachable and genuine, and accommodating. I was only 30 feet from him, but I didn't want to be yet another person to ask for a picture
I have never been to an airport honestly.
It's alright. Some of them are cool, some of them are uneventful. It's fun for people watching. Other times it's a hassle. I usually try to get long layover times so that I don't have to rush.
I like to stay home where I know I'm a little saffer.
I recently bid farewell to a good friend. I miss her
I am sorry for your loss. I hope you can find comfort during this difficult time.
Thank you, that means a lot. I will see her again
You will, and that is what gives us the strength to face tomorrow!
I went to the skating rink all by myself today because my friends ditched me.
That's disappointing. I'm glad that you didn't let that stop you, and that you still went out and had a good time!
I am happy my brother plays in the MLB.
He does?! So exciting! What team does he play for?
He plays for the New York Yankees.
They are doing really We'll this season! You must be so proud!
Before I got my dog, my life felt empty. He's my best friend now !
That's great! He sounds like a good addition in your life.
My life is now complete. He's so trustworthy and listens to everything I say to him lol.
Awe I love my dog too, she's really sweet. We'll except my dog doesn't listen, so I guess your dog beats mine, lol.
I saved up for months to build my first pc. It was awesome
We'll done! Did you buy all the parts separately?
Yes I did buy them all separately.
Did you find it difficult?
Actually it was alot easier than I expected. Once you understand the basic functionality in each part, the process is becomes less overwhelming. Kind of like putting together a puzzle.
Yeah - I've done it a few times and it's much easier than most people think. Still impressive though
I have been really bad at work lately. Just plain lazy.
Why have you been lazy?
Trying to get school things together. I've just been tired. And the work is so repetitive.
What kind of work is it?
I had the best day yesterday!
Awesome! What happened?
Nothing much. I just got to spend most of the day reading and relaxing.
I love days like that, with two gets that would be the best day for me as We'll!
I was in a rush this morning and I dressed my self in stained clothes. I feel so dirty today. :(
Oh wow, are you going to be in front of anyone important?
I was cleaning out my bathtub drain this morning with bleach and hot water. My cat has never done this before but she jumped in and got covered in bleach and water.
Oh my that must have been frightening! Poor little cat, what happened afterwards?
My daughter just got her drivers permit a few months ago.
We'll that's great! Has she practiced enough to get her actual license?
No, not yet. And it's kinda nerve-wracking to teach her, mostly because other drivers like to be in a hurry and want her to speed or blow their horns when she doesn't go fast enough for them.
Oh yes, definitely. It's OTHER drivers you have to watch out for. People halfway pay attention to what They're doing on the road!
I'm so happy that it is Friday!
Oh me too! Do you have a monday to Friday type job?
Somewhat, I work 4 10 hour shifts and have a random off day during the week. Yesterday was my off day. What about you?
Oh that is a pretty good schedule. I am a teacher so I'm off right now. It's wonderful.
I can't wait to go on my trip next week
Oh yea? When is the trip?
Next week its gonna be great
I bet you are going with a loved one that's why you are so anxious about the trip
I was recently working on a project where unfortunately, my teammate really didn't pull their weight.
That is the worst!! I know that you must have been very frustrated with your teammate.
My sister let my dog run out the door when she was not paying attention!
Oh damn.. Did your dog come back?
No! And, I am just lost with out him. I have had him for 8 years!
So sad to hear that.. I am so sorry about that buddy. Hope you feel better
I've not been around too many people lately.
Why not? What's going on?
Nothing, just haven't felt like getting out lately.
Happens to the best of us we are only human. Don't take it in a bad way I'm sure its been real nice being alone.
I felt bad when I saw a homeless man on the street. I wanted to help
I understand, I feel the same way sometimes. It's hard because sometimes you can't help or know they have problems that made them homeless like drinking.
Yeah, that is a good point too
Yes, sometimes they won't accept when I offer them food. They just want money to buy beer. It is very sad!
I don't like my new neighbors
Ugh, I hate that! What are they doing to irritate you?
They have people coming in and out at all times of the night. Our doors are like 4 feet apart
That's horrible - can you complain the complex or HOA? Or figure out a way to cut their power is always an option?
I miss my dog, Baby Girl, poor thing passed away last year after 15 years.
Oh, that is SO hard. It sounds like she had a long and happy life. I'm sure you miss her so much.
Took my daughter to the Animal Kingdom for the first time, I think I was more excited than she was.
Oh that sounds like so much fun! I love animals!
Me too. But she didn't seem to care. She loved the Dinosaur ride. It's a rough one.
Hopefully she'll get more interested when she gets a bit older.
My pet turtle died.
Oh no! I am so sorry- Turtles need a lot of care to thrive
Usually They're not too maintenence intensive.

Actually they are, that is why so many die in captivity..They need proper lights and diet etc..I guess if you know how to take care of animals then no- but so many just don't care when they have a pet who relies on them
I just went cliff diving recently.
I love cliff diving, was it your first experience ? And if so how did you find it
Yes, first time. I wasn't even nervous actually. I surprised myself. It was a lot of fun.
Wow that's amazing man, first time for me was so amazing too and are you planning to go again?
The most awful time of my life was when my wife went to jail for a month. I'm glad it's all over.
Holy cow! Why did she go to jail?
Some old stuff from 2 years before but court was appointed this late!
I'm glad y'all were able to make it through such a hard time.
I have never cheated on my wife.
Why do you think that is?
Cause I love her.
I love my dog, I still cheat on it.
My grandmother passed away last thanksgiving. It is tought without her.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Hopefully it will get better with time.
It will. She was an awesome lady.
I'm sure she is in a better place. Looking down on you.
I get really mad when I hear about people abusing animals. What revolting individuals!
Me too!!! Ii never could understand what drives people to be so mean to such innocent creatures.
They're filthy, ignorant bullies. I would sentence them to life in prison, without parole!!!
Really!! I would go even further and give them the electric chair. I have no tolerance for those types of people.
I'm going on a date tonight. I'm pretty nervous
That's great! Don't be too nervous! Your date is most likely just as nervous as you are!
I buy things that my kids don't like so I don't have to share.
Haha that's a smart strategy. What kind of things do you like to buy?
I was in a back room in our house and everyone else was asleep. I heard a weird crinkling noise and was worried that someone had come in the house.
Oh my goodness, did you go to check what the noise was?
My junior year of college starts in August. I am studying criminal justice.
I would have loved to study criminal justice
I have switched my major three times, but I think I'm sticking with this one. I ready to graduate.
I hear you. I love true crime, so I think that would be such a fun thing to study
MY friend is having a party for her two year old.
Aww that is sweet are you going?
I want to go on a date instead. I feel bad
Aww We'll do what you think is best
That's what I want to ask you lol
We'll I would go on the date then buy the kid a big present.
I'm hosting a dinner party for some friends tomorrow night.
That's very nice of you. I hope you guys have a great time!
Thank you very much. I believe that I have gotten everything ready for it. Fingers crossed.
I'm sure it will go We'll! What are you cooking?
My son won the gold medal conducted in his school. I am so happy about it
You must be so proud, but what was it for?
As a father, I couldn't be more proud. He won it for swimming competition.
He must have worked really hard and it paid off. Good for him.
My partner left me the other day.
That's rough, I'm sorry to hear that
That's fine, its not your problem. I just feel very lonely right now.
I am sure you will find someone who will love you even more than your ex did soon.
I can't wait until I see my golden retriever Blue this weekend!
Where has he been?
I live away from my parents, he lives with them.
Oh I bet you are excited then! He will be happy too!
Have you ever just had a great week?
Yes, I have many great weeks.
Lol. This week has been just the best!
What happened to make it great?
I lied to my dad when I was younger and I hope my child doesn't do the same.
Sometimes you've gotta live with regrets. Accept it as part of your past life and move on
I am trying to but its hard because I was not an easy child.
Same I've put my parents through a lot. But now I'm trying to be the best version of myself so I can eventually pay them back
I was going through pictures the other day and came across some pics of my last hiking/camping trip.
Do you still talk to the people you went with.
Oh yeah, it made me want to go back really bad, I'll probably see if they want to do another one!
Where did you guys hike? Did you stay over night
Going to see my long distance girlfriend this weekend, and we're going to have a movie marathon. I only get to see her every so often because of the distance. I'm excited
Oh welcome to the long distance club! I am exactly in the same situation as you, we are going on a cable car, we are going to meet in 2 weeks and I also can't wait, I feel you, LET'S HAVE A BLAST
Riding a big roller coaster for the first time while having a fear of heights, I was kind of worried how I would do
How was the experience?
It was great in the end. A little nerve-wracking doing it, but eventually after it was over, I had a lot of adrenaline and pride in doing it
It was good you got over the fear, do you ride roller coasters more now?

In the 8th grade, my friend and I sold the most chocolate bars in our entire school. Our prize ultimately ended up being a pair of New Balance shoes. $1150 in sales, for a pair of $25 kids shoes, each.
I would not of been happy with that were you?
I witnessed a man rob an old woman walking across the street. Boils my friggin' blood!
Oh my God that's terrible! So sad. I'd be mad too. What did you do?
